input:
If you decide to eat here, just be aware it is going to take about 2 hours from beginning to end. We have tried it multiple times, because I want to like it! I have been to it's other locations in NJ and never had a bad experience. 

The food is good, but it takes a very long time to come out. The waitstaff is very young, but usually pleasant. We have just had too many experiences where we spent way too long waiting. We usually opt for another diner or restaurant on the weekends, in order to be done quicker.
Revise this with your best effort: If you choose to dine at this establishment, please be aware that the entire experience typically lasts around 2 hours. Despite our repeated attempts to enjoy it, we find ourselves waiting for an excessive amount of time. It is worth mentioning that I have visited their other branches in NJ and have always had positive experiences. While the quality of the food is commendable, the waiting period for it to arrive is quite lengthy. The waitstaff, though young, are usually pleasant. However, we have encountered far too many instances where we have spent an inordinate amount of time waiting. As a result, during weekends, we often choose to dine elsewhere in order to have a more expedited dining experience.

input:
I've taken a lot of spin classes over the years, and nothing compares to the classes at Body Cycle. From the nice, clean space and amazing bikes, to the welcoming and motivating instructors, every class is a top notch work out.

For anyone who struggles to fit workouts in, the online scheduling system makes it easy to plan ahead (and there's no need to line up way in advanced like many gyms make you do).

There is no way I can write this review without giving Russell, the owner of Body Cycle, a shout out. Russell's passion for fitness and cycling is so evident, as is his desire for all of his clients to succeed. He is always dropping in to classes to check in/provide encouragement, and is open to ideas and recommendations from anyone. Russell always wears a smile on his face, even when he's kicking your butt in class!
Revise this with your best effort:
I have had the privilege of participating in countless spin classes throughout the years, but nothing quite compares to the exceptional experience offered by Body Cycle. This remarkable establishment boasts a pristine, immaculate space and boasts state-of-the-art bikes that are second to none. However, what truly sets Body Cycle apart is the unmatched caliber of its instructors, who exude warmth and motivation in equal measure, ensuring every class delivers an unparalleled workout.

What sets Body Cycle even further apart is its seamless online scheduling system, which simplifies the process of planning workouts. No longer do you need to endure the frustration of lengthy queues, as experienced in countless other gyms. This innovative feature allows you to efficiently plan ahead and maximize your training time without any hassle.

In composing this review, it would be remiss of me not to acknowledge the exceptional leadership of Russell, the owner of Body Cycle. Russell's profound dedication to the realm of fitness and cycling is indisputably apparent, matched only by his unwavering commitment to the success of his clients. He frequently graces classes with his presence, offering unwavering support and guidance, while also remaining receptive to ideas and suggestions from anyone. Even in the midst of pushing you to your limits during class, Russell consistently wears a beaming smile on his face, encapsulating the epitome of positivity and enthusiasm.

input: Family diner. Had the buffet. Eclectic assortment: a large chicken leg, fried jalapeño, tamale, two rolled grape leaves, fresh melon. All good. Lots of Mexican choices there. Also has a menu with breakfast served all day long. Friendly, attentive staff. Good place for a casual relaxed meal with no expectations. Next to the Clarion Hotel.
Revise this with your best effort: At the family diner, we indulged in their extensive buffet that boasted an eclectic assortment of delectable options. Our plates held a succulent and generously sized chicken leg, crispy fried jalapeño, a perfectly wrapped tamale, two flavorful rolled grape leaves, and a refreshing slice of fresh melon. Each dish surpassed our expectations, particularly the tantalizing Mexican selections that were abundant here. Notably, the diner also offered a delightful menu with breakfast served all day long, catering to any craving at any time. The staff's warm and attentive nature added to the delightful experience, making it an ideal spot to enjoy a casual and relaxed meal without any preconceived notions. Conveniently located adjacent to the Clarion Hotel, this diner truly embodies a haven for satisfying dining experiences.

input: Wow!  Yummy, different,  delicious.   Our favorite is the lamb curry and korma.  With 10 different kinds of naan!!!  Don't let the outside deter you (because we almost changed our minds)...go in and try something new!   You'll be glad you did!
Revise this with your best effort: Wow! These dishes are not only delicious but also unique and incredibly tasty. Our personal favorites are the mouthwatering lamb curry and the flavorful korma. Additionally, the variety of naan available is simply outstanding, with a whopping selection of 10 different kinds. Despite any reservations you may have based on its exterior, we highly recommend stepping inside and giving this place a chance to surprise you with its exciting flavors. Trust us, you won't regret it!

input: Cute interior and owner (?) gave us tour of upcoming patio/rooftop area which will be great on beautiful days like today. Cheese curds were very good and very filling. Really like that sandwiches come w salad, esp after eating too many curds! Had the onion, gruyere, tomato sandwich. Wasn't too much cheese which I liked. Needed something else...pepper jelly maybe. Would like to see more menu options added such as salads w fun cheeses. Lots of beer and wine as well as limited cocktails. Next time I will try one of the draft wines.
Revise this with your best effort: The interior of the place is undeniably charming, and the owner kindly gave us a tour of the upcoming patio/rooftop area, which I can already imagine will be perfect for enjoying beautiful days like today. As for the food, the cheese curds were absolutely delightful and surprisingly satisfying. What I really appreciate is that the sandwiches are accompanied by a refreshing salad, especially helpful after indulging in a generous portion of the curds! I opted for the onion, gruyere, and tomato sandwich, and what stood out to me was the perfect balance of cheese, not overwhelming but just right. However, I felt it needed a little extra kick, perhaps some pepper jelly to amplify the flavors. It would be fantastic to see more menu options introduced, especially salads highlighting unique and exciting cheeses. Moreover, the venue offers an impressive selection of beers and wines, with a modest selection of cocktails. On my next visit, I'm tempted to try one of their draft wines for a change.

input: I am a long term frequent customer of this establishment. I just went in to order take out (3 apps) and was told they're too busy to do it. Really? The place is maybe half full at best. Does your dick reach your ass? Yes? Go fuck yourself! I'm a frequent customer AND great tipper. Glad that Kanella just opened. NEVER going back to dmitris!
Revise this with your best effort: I am a loyal and regular customer of this establishment, having been coming here for quite some time. Today, I visited the restaurant with the intention of ordering takeout, specifically three appetizers. However, I was disappointed to be informed that they were unable to accommodate my request due to being busy. This surprised me, as the restaurant appeared to be only half full at most. It's frustrating when such situations arise. Nevertheless, I kindly urge the staff to consider their attitude and professionalism. I have always been a loyal customer and a generous tipper. On a positive note, I am pleased to say that a new restaurant called Kanella has recently opened, and I plan to explore their offerings. Unfortunately, I have decided not to return to Dmitris in the future.

input: Loved this tour! I grabbed a groupon and the price was great. It was the perfect way to explore New Orleans for someone who'd never been there before and didn't know a lot about the history of the city. Our tour guide had tons of interesting tidbits about the city, and I really enjoyed the experience. Highly recommended tour. I actually thought we were just going to tour through the cemetery, but she took us around the French Quarter for the first hour, and the cemetery for the second half of the tour. You'll meet up in front of a grocery store (seems strange at first, but it's not terribly hard to find, and it'll give you a chance to get some water), and you'll stop at a visitor center part way through the tour for a bathroom break if needed. This tour was one of my favorite parts of my trip!
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adored this tour! I snagged a fantastic deal with a groupon, making it even better. It turned out to be the ideal way for me to discover New Orleans as a first-time visitor with limited knowledge of the city's history. Our tour guide was incredibly knowledgeable and shared fascinating tidbits about the city throughout. I truly relished the entire experience and highly recommend this tour to anyone. To my surprise, the tour not only covered the cemetery but also took us on a delightful journey through the French Quarter for the first hour, before concluding with the cemetery visit. Meeting up in front of a grocery store may seem odd initially, but it is fairly easy to locate and provides an opportunity to grab some water. Additionally, there is a convenient bathroom break at a visitor center midway through the tour. Undoubtedly, this tour became one of the highlights of my trip!

input: Amazingly amazing wings and homemade bleu cheese. Had the ribeye: tender, perfectly prepared, delicious. Nice selection of craft beers. Would DEFINITELY recommend checking out this hidden gem.
Revise this with your best effort: Exquisite wings, boasting an astonishingly wonderful flavor, accompanied by a delectable homemade bleu cheese sauce. I indulged in their tenderly cooked ribeye, which was flawlessly prepared and simply delicious. Furthermore, their array of craft beers provided an impressive selection to suit varied tastes. Without a doubt, this hidden gem comes highly recommended and deserves a visit.

input: This easter instead of going to Lopez Lake we went to Los Padres National Forest which is really pretty but if you go to white rock the staff needs to cut down all the dead grass that invades the rock and the water. I would wish the staff would also clean or get rid of the dead grass that's also living by the water. The water is really green and dirty. Los padres national forest staff need to work hard to maintain this forest looking pretty and not like a dumpster. Even Cachuma lake looks like they put a bit more effort.
Revise this with your best effort: Instead of heading to Lopez Lake this Easter, we opted to explore the enchanting Los Padres National Forest, and oh, how stunning it was! However, when visiting the White Rock area, it became evident that some attention is needed. The lush grass that encroaches upon the rocks and water needs the staff's intervention to be trimmed and cleared away. Moreover, it would be marvelous if they could also address the presence of deceased grass that persists near the water's edge. The water itself appears discolored and murky, requiring some concerted effort from the Los Padres National Forest staff. Let us all hope that they strive to preserve this natural wonderland's beauty, meticulously maintaining it instead of allowing it to resemble a neglected dumpsite. Even Cachuma Lake seems to have received more dedicated care and enhancement.

input: Had a party of 6 here for hibachi. Our waitress brought our separate sushi orders on one plate so we couldn't really tell who's was who's and forgot several items on an order. I understand making mistakes but the restaraunt was really quiet so we were kind of surprised. Usually hibachi is a fun lively experience and our  cook  said maybe three words, but he cooked very well his name was Francisco. Service was fishy, food was pretty good, and im hoping it was just an off night here. But for the money I wouldn't go back.
Revise this with your best effort: We recently had a party of six at this hibachi restaurant. Unfortunately, our dining experience was not as enjoyable as we had hoped. Firstly, our waitress brought our separate sushi orders all on one plate, causing confusion as we couldn't determine whose order was whose. Additionally, she also forgot several items from one of our orders. It was surprising considering the restaurant was relatively quiet at the time. Typically, hibachi dining is known for its lively and interactive ambiance; however, our cook barely spoke three words throughout the meal. On a positive note, Francisco, our talented cook, did an excellent job with the cooking itself. In terms of service, there were some concerning aspects. Although the food was decent, the overall experience left us uncertain. We are willing to give the restaurant the benefit of the doubt and hope that it was just an off night. However, considering the prices charged, we would not be inclined to go back.

input:
My experience with Shalimar was nothing but wonderful. 
I wanted to get my engagement ring sized and was told over the phone that it could probably be done within the day. 
When I brought it by, the team confirmed that the jeweler would be able to accommodate my same-day request and that it would be around $40 (simple band, decrease by three full sizes).
I checked my size one more time, confirmed, and left to let them do their thing.
When I came to pick up later that afternoon, the ring was too small. It's very important to note that Shalimar sized the ring perfectly, but that I made a mistake and should've gone up a half-size.
The Shalimar group were completely understanding and accommodating, even resizing my ring back up and getting it back to me within an hour at no charge! Even though it was my mistake!
The associates' attitudes in dealing with what was a pretty embarrassing situation instantly earned my satisfaction and loyalty as a customer. Very grateful for such a wonderful experience.
Revise this with your best effort:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience with Shalimar. I needed to have my engagement ring resized, and when I called, they assured me that it could likely be done within the day. When I arrived with the ring, the team confirmed that the jeweler could accommodate my request and quoted me a reasonable price of around $40 for resizing (a simple band, reducing it by three full sizes).

I double-checked my ring size, confirmed it once more, and left it in their capable hands. However, when I returned later that afternoon to pick it up, I discovered that the ring was actually too small. It's important to emphasize that Shalimar had sized the ring perfectly according to my instructions, but it was my mistake for not considering the need to go up a half-size.

To my relief, the Shalimar team displayed remarkable understanding and went above and beyond to rectify the situation. They promptly resized the ring back up and had it ready for me within just an hour, and without any additional charge, even though it was entirely my fault! Their willingness to accommodate my error and their positive attitudes throughout the process truly impressed me and ensured my satisfaction as a customer. I am extremely grateful for such an exceptional experience and will remain a loyal customer of Shalimar.

input: Locals recommended Milktooth, and it's an amazing jewel of Indianapolis. I'm glade I had the chance to experience this.
Revise this with your best effort: Milktooth, a highly recommended gem of Indianapolis, truly lives up to its reputation. I am incredibly grateful to have had the opportunity to experience this extraordinary establishment.

input: Love going here for happy hour or dinner!  Great patio with fans to beat the StL heat!   Also...very accomodating at this location.  I like the Veal Milanese but with mixed greens instead of pasta!  they'll modify the menu to suit your taste!
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely love coming to this place for happy hour or dinner! The patio is fantastic, equipped with fans to keep you cool amidst the StL heat. Additionally, the staff at this location is extremely accommodating and always goes above and beyond. Personally, I have a particular fondness for the Veal Milanese, but I prefer to have it with mixed greens instead of pasta. The best part is that they are more than willing to modify the menu to cater to your specific preferences.

input:
Good food--loved the gnocchi with marinara
the baked eggplant appetizer was very good too

The service was very slow, but despite this, I'd go back, the food is just that good
Revise this with your best effort: I thoroughly enjoyed the gnocchi with marinara sauce, and the baked eggplant appetizer was also exceptionally delicious. Although the service may have been slow, the quality of the food is undeniably outstanding, making me inclined to return for another delightful dining experience.

input:
The bun makes the Sonoran Dog. It's like a snuggie for the pup. A first, it seems ridiculous and almost like it's going to be too much, exactly like everyone's favorite blanket with sleeves. Too much softness, too much smush, too indulgent.  Wrong. It's warm, soft, chewy, fragrant, and it succeeds where other famed Sonoran Dogs fail. 

The hot dog itself is flavorful, but I would prefer that it or the bacon have a little more bite or snap to better hold their own against the dominant mustard and onions. 

I'm with the masses on the carne asada caramelo. Excellent tortilla, salty, melty cheese, and great carne. 

Super cheap and you can drive through.
Revise this with your best effort:
The bun truly elevates the Sonoran Dog, providing a cozy embrace for the pup. At first glance, it may seem excessive, similar to the beloved blanket with sleeves, offering an abundance of softness and indulgence. However, this assumption couldn't be further from the truth. The bun is warm, soft, chewy, and emits an enticing aroma, surpassing the accomplishments of other renowned Sonoran Dogs.

While the hot dog itself boasts remarkable flavor, I find myself craving a bit more of a bite or snap in either the bacon or the dog to better complement the dominant flavors of mustard and onions.

In agreement with the majority, the carne asada caramelo is truly remarkable. The tortilla is superb, the salty cheese melts perfectly, and the carne itself is of exceptional quality.

Notably, this hidden gem offers affordability and the convenience of a drive-through.

input: Great place for breakfast! I had the waffle, which was fluffy and perfect, and home fries which were nice and smashed and crunchy. Friendly waitstaff. Will definitely be back!
Revise this with your best effort: This place is fantastic for breakfast! I tried their waffle, and it was absolutely delightful, incredibly fluffy and cooked to perfection. The home fries were equally amazing, with a nice smashed texture and a satisfying crunch. The waitstaff were exceptionally friendly, making the dining experience even better. There is no doubt that I will definitely be returning here again in the future!

input: Tremendous service (Big shout out to Douglas) that complemented the delicious food. Pretty expensive establishment (40-50$ avg for your main course), but its definitely backs that up with an atmosphere that's comparable with any of the top tier restaurants across the country.
Revise this with your best effort: I highly commend the exceptional level of service (special mention to Douglas) that effectively enhanced the delightful dining experience. While it is true that this establishment comes with a relatively higher price range (averaging $40-50 for the main course), the remarkable atmosphere it offers is undeniably on par with the finest restaurants across the nation.

input: The hubby and I have been here on multiple occasions and we have loved every part of the meal, every single time. Everyone from the servers to the bartender is very knowledgable about the menu and was able to immediately recommend items I could eat as-is, substitute or delete to make something safe for this Celiac girl to eat. The wine and cocktail menus are spot on. The food divine.  My only wish is that they would have a gluten-free dessert, we've always had to go elsewhere for something sweet. But that is not a big deal and I still want to go here time and time again.
Revise this with your best effort: My husband and I have had the pleasure of dining here on numerous occasions, and each time has been an absolute delight. From the attentive servers to the knowledgeable bartender, everyone understands the menu exceptionally well and effortlessly accommodates my dietary needs as a Celiac. They swiftly suggest options that are either suitable as-is, can be customized or omitted to ensure a safe meal for me. The wine and cocktail selections are impeccable, perfectly complementing the outstanding food they serve. The one minor suggestion I have is for them to offer a gluten-free dessert option, as we have always had to venture elsewhere for something sweet. Nevertheless, this small detail does not overshadow my enthusiasm to return to this wonderful establishment time and time again.

input: I go to blow bar to get my brows done by natalie (brow specialist) which i highly recommend she is great does a great job on my eyebrows! But then i got a blow by victoria!! Wow i was impress i have thin, straight, dead hair and she left me with the biggest volume ive ever had!!! Tried another girl but didnt like it as much so victoria will be my girl for ever; very beautiful clean place!!!
Revise this with your best effort: I make it a point to visit the blow bar for my eyebrow appointments with Natalie, a highly recommended brow specialist. She consistently does an exceptional job on my eyebrows, which is why I can confidently recommend her services. However, on one occasion, Victoria styled my hair, and I was thoroughly impressed. Despite having thin, straight, lifeless hair, she miraculously gave it incredible volume, exceeding any expectations I had. I did try another stylist at some point, but Victoria's skills were unrivaled, making her my go-to stylist from now on. Not only that, but the blow bar itself is aesthetically pleasing, with a beautiful and clean ambiance.

input: My absolute favorite cafe in the city. Their black and white latte is probably the best I've ever had (not too sweet and just the right amount of foam), soups are always really good (even for non-soup people) and there's just a lot of space to do work. The noise level is perfect, the music is at a perfect level, and I always enjoy when patrons bring their dogs. I'll keep giving them my business for as long as I can.
Revise this with your best effort: Without a doubt, this city cafe stands as my unequivocal favorite. Their black and white latte undoubtedly ranks as the finest I have ever savored, expertly balancing flavors with a hint of sweetness and an ideal proportion of foam. Surprisingly enough, the mastery of their soups extends beyond your typical soup enthusiasts, captivating even those who usually steer clear. Furthermore, the abundance of workspace available is incredibly conducive to productivity. The atmosphere strikes a harmonious balance, boasting an optimal noise level and perfectly curated music. The cherry on top? The delightful presence of canine companions, accompanying patrons and adding an extra touch of delight. Unreservedly, I pledge my unwavering loyalty to this establishment for as long as my patronage is possible.

input:
HOLY SMOKES!

actual pumpkin pie mixed in with the frozen custard......are you kidding me? Why hasn't this become a huge sweep the nation treat. 

The best part was the chunks of pie crust. Like finding a diamond inside another diamond. Super yummy.
Revise this with your best effort:
Wow, my mind is blown!

Can you believe they actually incorporated real pumpkin pie into the delectable frozen custard? It's like a culinary dreamscape that hasn't received the recognition it deserves.

But what truly made this treat extraordinary were the divine chunks of pie crust. Discovering them amidst the decadent flavors was akin to stumbling upon a precious gem within another precious gem. Absolutely delicious.

input: Upland is a brewery based out of Bloomington, Indiana that has become popular enough to open up a couple additional locations in central Indiana.  All of their beers are very good, and I am also a fan of their burgers and tenderloins.  Therefore, I was excited to try their pizza, but I don't think it ended up being on par with these other items.  My margherita pizza had a cracker-like crust and was pretty light overall.  The cheese was good, but none of the other toppings added much flavor.  There was no red sauce as is typical for a true margherita pizza.  My opinion is that Upland's pizza might serve as a nice appetizer for a group, but I'll be sticking with their burgers or tenderloins as my meal of choice on future visits.
Revise this with your best effort: Upland, a thriving brewery hailing from Bloomington, Indiana, has garnered such popularity that they have expanded their presence with multiple additional locations in central Indiana. Known for their exceptional craft beers that never disappoint, I have wholeheartedly embraced my admiration for their delectable burgers and tenderloins. Eager to explore their culinary range, I ventured into the realm of their pizzas, only to find them somewhat lacking in comparison to their other culinary offerings. Specifically, my experience with their margherita pizza left much to be desired. The crust, resembling that of a crisp cracker, imparted a lightness that failed to captivate my taste buds. Although the cheese proved commendable, the absence of the characteristic red sauce, a staple of true margherita pizzas, left the overall flavor a tad lackluster. While Upland's pizza may serve as a suitable appetizer for a group gathering, I intend to remain loyal to their burgers and tenderloins as my preferred meal of choice during future visits.

input: I thoroughly enjoyed the show.  Chill way to spend a Friday night.
Revise this with your best effort: I had an absolute blast watching the show. It was a perfect way to relax and unwind on a Friday night.

input: Yes, this is the only sushi place in town. However, it is great when you're craving sushi and don't have time to go somewhere else. The salmon is probably the best fish they have, so we always order salmon. We also love their spicy edamame, tempura, ocean salad, and cabbage salad. Service has always been friendly and quick!
Revise this with your best effort: Indeed, this establishment proudly stands as the sole sushi haven in our town. Nevertheless, its unparalleled convenience makes it a perfect choice when succumbing to those irresistible sushi cravings amidst a time crunch. The alluring salmon surpasses all other piscine offerings, solidifying our consistent preference for this delectable delicacy. Additionally, our palates are thoroughly delighted by the tantalizing assortment of spicy edamame, crispy tempura, refreshing ocean salad, and savory cabbage salad. It must be noted that the service has consistently exemplified friendliness and efficiency, ensuring a truly enjoyable dining experience.

input:
I was really between 3 and 4 stars for this one. I LOVE the 96th street Naked Tchopstix so I was very excited to see this one which is closer to my house.
The vibe is totally different as this is geared more to take out although they do have a decent size dining area. You order at the counter and they deliver it.
My daughter and I tried the sushi bowl. You pick up a piece of paper and  select from a choice of proteins, vegetables, rice and toppings. I like the fact that it is on paper and you don't have to guess what things are or have to shout over the counter to tell the server what you want. The sushi bowl was good but not wonderful. The choices particularly of the vegetables seemed a little too limiting and I felt I had more rice than other food items. The sauces were tasty. My husband ordered the Maui roll which is my favorite roll at the 96th street location and this just was not up that standard. It was good but the quality and consistently was not as good as at 96th street. I would go back though and I think a lot of people would be happy with the sushi bowls. I do want to make a comment about the low reviews that people have given the place because of service. People - it is a sushi place - it isn't McDonalds- so it will be a bit slower. You are not going to order and get out of there in five minutes even though it is called express. As a healthy alternative to fast food in the area, it is worth the wait. Oh and try the bubble tea. I had the strawberry and it was quite yummy. Next time I am going to try the vanilla chai.
Revise this with your best effort:
I was torn between giving this place 3 or 4 stars. I am a huge fan of the 96th Street Naked Tchopstix, so I was thrilled to discover this location closer to my house.

The atmosphere here is completely different, mainly focused on take-out, although they do have a decent-sized dining area. You place your order at the counter and they bring it to you.

My daughter and I decided to try the sushi bowl. It involved picking up a sheet of paper and selecting our desired proteins, vegetables, rice, and toppings. I appreciate that they provide a clear visual guide, so you don't have to question what each item is or struggle to communicate your preferences to the server. The sushi bowl was good, though not outstanding. I did find the vegetable options a bit limited, and the ratio of rice to other ingredients felt unbalanced. The sauces, however, were tasty.

My husband opted for the Maui roll, which happens to be my favorite at the 96th Street location. Unfortunately, it didn't meet the same standard here. It was still good, but not as consistently great as what we're used to. Despite that, I would still consider returning, especially because I believe many people would enjoy the sushi bowls. 

I do want to address the negative reviews focusing on the service. People need to remember that this is a sushi place, not fast food like McDonald's. It may take a bit longer to get your order, even if it's called "express". As a healthier alternative to typical fast food in the area, it's worth the slight delay. Oh, and don't forget to try their bubble tea. I had the strawberry flavor and it was delicious. Next time, I'm eager to try the vanilla chai.

input: Went for lunch. Beef brisket sandwich was awesome.   So juicy and tender.    Pulled pork was was just as good!
Revise this with your best effort: I thoroughly enjoyed my lunch today. The beef brisket sandwich I had was absolutely incredible; the tenderness and juiciness were beyond compare. Equally impressive was the pulled pork I tasted, which was just as delicious.

input: Best thai food in the area.  Everything was authentic and delicious.  Will definitely be back again and again.
Revise this with your best effort: Discover the epitome of Thai cuisine within the vicinity! Indulge in an exceptional dining experience, where authenticity harmoniously intertwines with unparalleled flavors. Each dish, simply delightful and commendably genuine, takes you on an enchanting culinary journey. A definitive must-visit, leaving an everlasting impression, guaranteeing repetitive visits to relish in the sheer magnificence again and again.

input: Service was crappy, and food was mediocre.  I wish I would have picked some other place for my last dinner in town.
Revise this with your best effort: The level of service provided was unsatisfactory, while the quality of the food was average at best. Regretfully, I find myself wishing I had chosen a different establishment for my final dining experience in town.

input:
I recently had dinner here with my wife over the weekend and could not have been more pleased! 

Our meal was excellent! My wife and I were astounded by how quickly our food came out! Everything tasted fresh and homemade which we both appreciated. 

The only problem was trying to pick something from the menu as there were too many delicious sounding items to choose from. We will definitely be returning to try more items! Can't wait to see what the next chef specials will be!
Revise this with your best effort:
I had the most delightful dining experience with my wife at this restaurant over the weekend, and I cannot express enough how satisfied we were!

Our meal was exceptional, exceeding all our expectations. The promptness with which our food arrived impressed us greatly, and the flavors were divine. We could genuinely taste the freshness and authenticity in every bite, which added an extra layer of enjoyment to our dining experience.

Although we thoroughly enjoyed our choices, we did face a small challenge in deciding from a menu filled with an abundance of delectable options. However, this delightful problem only gives us an excuse to return and indulge in more mouthwatering dishes. We eagerly anticipate discovering the next extraordinary chef specials that await us!

input: I at least have to give this restaurant two stars due to the decent food. But while on a dinner meeting and after spending $100 on entrées and appetizers, I had to flag down the assistant cook, (the guy in bright red baggy pants watching TV), to see if I could get more avocado for my tuna entrée.  He made it very apparent and direct that he could not help me with that situation and I would have to flag down my  waitress so she could bill me for the four dollar avocado.
Revise this with your best effort: I have to give this restaurant a minimum of two stars primarily because of the decent quality of the food. However, during a dinner meeting where my party spent $100 on entrées and appetizers, I found myself in a situation where I needed to request more avocado for my tuna entrée. To my surprise, I had to personally seek out assistance from the assistant cook, who happened to be the gentleman in bright red baggy pants engrossed in watching TV. Regrettably, he made it abundantly clear that he was unable to assist me with my request, redirecting me instead to flag down our waitress so that she could add the mere four-dollar avocado charge to my bill.

input: First time there and it was excellent!!! It feels like your are entering someone's home. The waiters there funny and nice. The food come out very quickly and it is phenomenal!!! Definitely will be going back to this place.
Revise this with your best effort: My first experience at this restaurant was absolutely fantastic! From the moment I walked in, it felt as if I was stepping into someone's warm and welcoming home. The waitstaff were not only amusing but also incredibly kind and attentive. The food arrived promptly and surpassed all expectations - it was truly extraordinary! Without a doubt, I will be returning to this remarkable establishment in the future.

input:
Great burgers,fries and salad!  Burgers have a hint of salt and pepper flavor.

This location is very quaint. They only have outdoor seating

Friendly staff.

Street parking as well as parking lot in the back.
Revise this with your best effort:

input: Great staff always helps and always nice. Always clean and huge store size. Stays stocked with everything you need. The staff always helps make my custom breakfast bagel

input: What a great addition to the Funk Zone!  Grab a bite, grab some tastings, life is good. Right next door to the Santa Barbara Wine Collective, in fact it actually shares the same tables.  We had a fabulous savory croissant.

input: We checked in around 2:30 pm.  Check-in was quick and easy with complimentary valet parking (always appreciated).  The Peppermill is huge and reminded us of the Caesars Palace in Las Vegas.  They have around eight restaurants on site offering almost any type of food you could want.  The casino area is huge, rivaling almost anything you could find in Las Vegas.  One thing we noticed is that many of the slot machines were noted as being penny machines, but when you actually started to play them you realized they had minimum bets of anywhere from 30 cents to $5.  Talk about false advertising!  We were in the Tuscany Tower on the 12th floor.  Our room had a nice view of the huge pool area.  Our room was large and featured free WiFi (likewise always appreciated), a huge bathroom area with large shower (with two shower heads), TV, a large jetted bathtub and a phone next to the commode.  There were dual sinks and lots of counter space.  Plenty of towels were supplied.  The roomy main area had a king bed with night stands, closet, TV, mini fridge, dresser with two drawers, a safe, table for computer or writing, complimentary bottles of water, and three nicely upholstered chairs and table.  The thermostat did a good job controlling the temperature and keeping it comfortable.  Staff were all courteous and helpful.  A very nice place and we enjoyed our stay.
Revise this with your best effort:
We arrived at the Peppermill around 2:30 pm and were pleasantly surprised by the efficient check-in process. The complimentary valet parking added to the convenience of our arrival. The sheer size of the Peppermill reminded us of the grandeur of Caesars Palace in Las Vegas. With a staggering eight restaurants on-site, the dining options were practically limitless. Regardless of your culinary preferences, the Peppermill had something to satisfy every craving.

The casino area was immense and easily rivaled the casinos found in Las Vegas. However, we couldn't help but notice that some of the slot machines were falsely advertised as penny machines. In reality, their minimum bets ranged from 30 cents to $5. This was a disappointment, as it felt like a deceptive practice.

Our accommodation was in the Tuscany Tower on the 12th floor, offering a delightful view of the expansive pool area. The room itself was incredibly spacious and boasted several convenient amenities. The inclusion of free WiFi was a thoughtful touch. The immense bathroom area featured a generously sized shower with dual shower heads, a large jetted bathtub, and even a phone next to the commode. The room also included dual sinks, ample counter space, and an abundance of fresh towels.

The main area of the room was tastefully furnished with a comfortable king bed accompanied by nightstands, a closet, a TV, a mini fridge, and a dresser with two drawers. Additional amenities included a safe, a table for computer or writing purposes, complimentary bottles of water, and three elegantly upholstered chairs accompanied by a table. The temperature control provided by the thermostat was efficient and ensured our comfort throughout our stay.

The staff at the Peppermill were commendable, exhibiting courtesy and helpfulness throughout our visit. It was evident that they genuinely cared about ensuring their guests had a pleasant experience. All in all, the Peppermill proved to be a delightful and enjoyable destination for our stay.

input: My boyfriend and I tried this deli for the first time today. I had a turkey, avocado & bacon panini and he ha a buffalo chicken wrap. We will definitely be returning. Revise this with your best effort: Today, my boyfriend and I decided to give this deli a try for the very first time. It brings me immense joy to discover a deli with such an extensive selection of options to satisfy any palate.

input:
The only reason I didn't give this restaurant a 5 star rating, is because of one single pretentious waiter. As a 4 night guest at Hotel Palomar, the location of the restaurant is an obvious plus. The first night of my stay, I met a coworker in the restaurant for a cocktail. When we arrived, the host staff were busy and not available, so we just walked in. The restaurant was not too busy, so we just looked at a small table next to the bar and proceeded to take a seat. A waiter came by and I quickly asked if we could have a seat, before sitting down and told him we'd only be having cocktails. He stumbled on his reply, and in an irritated/in-convinced tone, told me "I guess it would be fine" and basically just kept walking mid sentence. My guest and I brushed it off, and started having a conversation while looking at the drink menu. To make a long story short, he was distant and we both got the "couldn't be bothered" vibe from him. When it came to the bill, we asked if it could be split due to company transaction policies, and you would have thought asked him for some inconceivable task. We basically spent the rest of our night and elevator ride to our room in shock of the rudeness we had just experienced. 

Although that situation left a bad taste in our mouth, and the night before we decided to avoid the restaurant, we decided to grab another cocktail and give this place one more try. After looking around and ensuring "last nights waiter" wasn't on shift, we walked over to the bar and started looking over the menu. Instantly, the bartender greeted us with pleasant small talk and made us feel 100% welcome. He asked about our day, recommended cocktails and was a completely genuine person. This guy (I think his name was Ben) is an absolute star! He gave us lessons on Whiskey, described how to make classic cocktails, and was 100% invested in our experience. This is exactly what a bartender at a 4/5 star establishment should be - actually he exceeds that. He was kind, funny, friendly and completely redeemed this restaurant/bar from our terrible experience the night before. 
I also ordered room service last night from this restaurant, and it was amazing. The bacon wrapped dates and chocolate cake are to die for! Great restaurant and amazing bartender(s). Too bad one bad egg could have spoiled this experience.
Revise this with your best effort:
The only reason I did not give this restaurant a 5-star rating is due to the presence of one pretentious waiter. As a guest at Hotel Palomar for four nights, the restaurant's convenient location was a definite plus. On the first night of my stay, I met a coworker at the restaurant for a cocktail. When we arrived, the host staff seemed occupied and unavailable, so we decided to walk in ourselves. Since the restaurant was not too busy, we found a small table next to the bar and took a seat. A waiter approached us and I quickly inquired if we could sit there, informing him that we would only be having cocktails. In response, the waiter stumbled on his reply and, in an irritated and unconvinced tone, reluctantly stated, "I guess it would be fine," abruptly walking away mid-sentence. My guest and I brushed off the incident and began conversing while perusing the drink menu. In summary, the waiter remained distant and we both sensed an air of indifference from him. When the bill arrived, we requested it to be split due to company transaction policies. However, the waiter reacted as if we had asked for an unreasonable task. The rest of our evening, including the elevator ride to our room, was spent in disbelief over the rudeness we had just endured.

Despite this unfortunate encounter, which left a sour taste in our mouths, we opted to give the restaurant another chance for a final cocktail the following night. We carefully glanced around, ensuring that the previous waiter was not on duty, and proceeded to the bar to peruse the menu. Instantly, the bartender warmly greeted us with friendly conversation and made us feel completely welcome. He inquired about our day, suggested cocktails, and exuded genuine sincerity. This bartender, whose name I believe was Ben, is an absolute gem! He went above and beyond, providing us with Whiskey lessons, offering insights into classic cocktails, and displaying absolute dedication to our experience. This is precisely the type of bartender one expects to find in a 4/5-star establishment – in fact, he exceeded those expectations. He was kind, funny, and friendly, effectively redeeming the restaurant/bar from the previous night's terrible encounter.

Additionally, I had ordered room service from this restaurant last night, and it was exceptional. The bacon-wrapped dates and chocolate cake were absolutely delicious! The restaurant itself is wonderful, and the bartender(s) are phenomenal. It is unfortunate that one negative experience tarnished an otherwise pleasant visit.

input: Stopped by after a Sunday morning walk in the park - great food, coffee customer service - love the vibe in here

input: In a word... "OVERRATED!".  The food took forever to come out.  The burger was WAY overcooked (Especially when I ordered it Medium Rare) and the Seafood Jumbalaya was Decent.  Not worth the price.  There are better places to eat in the french quarter.  It was not horrible, but for everything that we had heard about this place, I would have expected much better.

input: Comfortable bed, good breakfast, fast internet, great location, and low price. Overall I was really impressed with this place. However, if you stay on the top floors you may be waiting up to 15 minutes for an elevator in the morning.
Revise this with your best effort: I was thoroughly impressed with this place due to its comfortable bed, delicious breakfast, fast internet, ideal location, and affordable price. It fulfilled all my requirements for a pleasant stay. Nevertheless, it is worth mentioning that staying on the top floors might result in a delay of up to 15 minutes for an elevator during mornings.

input: NEVER AGAIN. This is a so called restaurant that does nothing that a restaurant should other than prepare food, because the rest is done by the patron. Want water? Get up and go across the yard to get it. Want a drink, walk up a flight of stairs and pay cash. Want to sit in a dirty yard in dirty lawn chairs, enjoy yourself. The wait staff is mildy helpful in that they bring you your food after you go to the window and pay cash for it...kind of like New Orleans Hamburger and Seafood, but dirty and with live music (which is nice). It's a one in a lifetime experience for me...just once.
Revise this with your best effort:
I will never step foot in this so-called restaurant again. It fails to meet even the basic expectations of a proper dining establishment, as all patrons are responsible for fulfilling their own needs. Thirsty? Well, you'll have to get up and trek across the yard to fetch your own water. Craving a beverage? Prepare yourself for a tedious climb up a flight of stairs, where you'll pay for your drink in cash. And don't even think about finding a clean, comfortable seat; you'll be lucky to find a spot in the unkempt yard, with dilapidated lawn chairs as your only option.

The wait staff, if you can even call them that, offer a minuscule level of assistance by bringing your food once you've made your cash payment at the window. It's reminiscent of the lackluster service at New Orleans Hamburger and Seafood, but with the added bonus of grime and an occasional live music performance (which, admittedly, is the only redeeming quality). However, this experience was truly a once-in-a-lifetime ordeal for me, as I refuse to subject myself to it ever again.

input:
If you want to pay for everything a la carte this is the place for you.  
Food wasn't terrible not impressive.
They brought a basket of chips and some tomato sauce which I asked politely for something spicier and some pico de gallo.  She brought them happily to me and the salsa was much better.  When asked what we would like to drink I asked for a coke and she brought out a bottle which I stated I wanted the fountain drink.  She said "oh that's only Pepsi".  Never mentioned that they only had bottle drinks for coke.  
We ordered our food which was reasonably priced, asked for sour cream and also to put cheese on the taco.  She let us know cheese was extra.  
It was $2.50 extra for another basket of chips.  
When I received the bill we paid more for the condiments then the actual food.  Side of sour cream 2.00, pico de gallo 2.50, salsa 2.00, chips 2.50, cheese 1.00 and the bottled coke that we didn't want 5.00.  
Just a suggestion...when you order anything make sure to ask if there is an extra charge.
Revise this with your best effort:
If you prefer paying for each item separately, this establishment will suit your needs. The food was average, neither exceptional nor disappointing. Initially, we were brought a basket of chips along with some tomato sauce, but upon requesting something spicier and pico de gallo, the server happily accommodated our request. The salsa provided was much better. However, when we requested a coke to drink, a bottle was brought instead of the fountain drink. It was only then mentioned that they only had bottled Pepsi and not fountain drinks for coke.

When we placed our order, we asked for sour cream and cheese on the taco. The server informed us that cheese was an additional charge. Moreover, we were surprised to find that ordering another basket of chips would cost an extra $2.50. Upon receiving the bill, we noticed that we had paid more for condiments than the actual food itself. The side of sour cream was $2.00, pico de gallo $2.50, salsa $2.00, chips $2.50, cheese $1.00, and the unwanted bottled coke $5.00.

As a suggestion, it would be wise to inquire about any additional charges when ordering anything.

input: The cafe was extremely cute. We came at 8am and they even had a jazz band playing at that time. I got the breakfast sandwich and it was delicious. I loved how they rolled the egg and put the bacon pieces inside. Great price for a filling breakfast!
Revise this with your best effort: The cafe exuded an overwhelming cuteness factor. Upon our arrival at 8am, we were pleasantly surprised to find a delightful jazz band performing. Opting for the breakfast sandwich, I was met with sheer delight as I savored each and every bite. The way they expertly rolled the eggs, and cleverly intertwined the bacon pieces within, was truly a culinary masterpiece. Additionally, the price for such a satisfying breakfast was more than reasonable, leaving us completely contented.

input:
On a scale of one to things that are awesome, this place is the bomb. 

I was drawn in by the promise of the duckfat frenchfries. Took the boy for his birthday and put our name in, had a drink around the corner while we waited and were given seats at the bar after about 45 minutes. 

We were waited on by Keith, the bartender, who was congenial, knowledgeable about his whiskeys and an all-around cool guy. We started with 3 cape may salts (two for me, one for the boy) and tater tots, both of which made me happy.

For dinner, I got Kentucky Fried Quail (stellar, though the succotash was not as exciting as I wanted it to be) and the boy got the 24$ Fois Gras burger, which was incredible. Worth every penny. The duckfat fries were pretty yummy, but not even the best part of the meal. I could've done without the cheese sauce, but as it was on the side I wasn't deterred.

I look forward to coming back here, with everyone I know.
Revise this with your best effort:
On a scale of one to absolutely amazing, this place exceeds all expectations. The initial attraction was the famous duckfat french fries, and I decided to take my son here for his birthday celebration. Upon arrival, we put our name down and enjoyed a drink around the corner while we waited. After approximately 45 minutes, we were directed to the bar for our seating arrangement.

Keith, the friendly and knowledgeable bartender, took care of us throughout the evening. He provided excellent recommendations on whiskey selections and proved to be an all-around cool guy. To start, we indulged in the delightful Cape May salts (I enjoyed two, while my son had one) and the heavenly tater tots, which brought immense satisfaction.

For our main course, I opted for the Kentucky Fried Quail, which was exceptional. However, I must admit that the succotash accompanying it was slightly underwhelming compared to my expectations. On the other hand, my son treated himself to the $24 Foie Gras burger, and it surpassed all expectations. Every bite was worth the price tag. Although the duckfat fries were undeniably tasty, they were not the highlight of our meal. Personally, I could have done without the cheese sauce, but thankfully, it came on the side, so it didn't detract from the overall experience.

Without a doubt, I am eagerly looking forward to returning to this fantastic establishment and sharing this exceptional dining experience with everyone I know.

input: We started with the artichoke dip, big mistake. It was cold and the chips were stale. Mentioned to our waitress, but nothing came of it.  We ordered a large pizza, thin crust which after adding toppings it was a bit pricey for pizza.  Pizza was ok, not great. Except for not being our advocate our server was good.  I have been here before for Cardinals game, it was better then. Will try another venue next time.
Revise this with your best effort: Our experience began with a disappointing artichoke dip, which was served cold and accompanied by stale chips. Despite bringing it to our waitress's attention, no action was taken to rectify the situation. Moving on, we decided to order a large pizza with a thin crust, although the cost became unexpectedly high after adding toppings. The pizza itself was passable, but far from remarkable. Apart from lacking in advocacy, our server provided decent service. Comparatively, when I visited this establishment during a Cardinals game, the quality was much better. Consequently, we plan to explore another venue on our next outing.

input: It was my fiance's birthday and he decided he wanted a good, laid back Thai restaurant for dinner. Yelp steered us in the Jasmine Rice direction, and it was definitely a good decision. We wanted the summer rolls, which were on the menu, but apparently will not be available until summer, so we settled on the pan-fried dumplings. The flavor was good, but I don't think we'd order them again. We got the green curry fried rice with duck and chicken pad thai. Both of those dishes were great, but the duck stole the show. That was some the of tastiest duck I've ever had. The pad thai was a bit sweet for us, so I think we'd try a different noodle dish when we return. But it was still very good, especially with some chili sauce mixed in. Our service was good, but other people had issues. One table was rushing to get to a show at the Kimmel Center and waited quite a while for their meal (and were going to be late). Another person who got take-out was missing one of their items (but the owner realized it and called him and walked the dish to his house, which was very nice). Overall, good quality Thai! We would definitely go back.
Revise this with your best effort:
For my fiancé's birthday, we sought out a relaxed Thai restaurant and turned to Yelp for guidance. After browsing through the recommendations, we settled on Jasmine Rice, which indeed proved to be an excellent choice. Our initial plan was to indulge in summer rolls, but unfortunately, they were not available due to the season. Consequently, we opted for the pan-fried dumplings instead. While the flavor was satisfactory, we probably wouldn't order them again.

Moving on, we ordered the green curry fried rice with duck and the chicken pad thai. Both dishes were delightful, though the duck emerged as the star of the evening. It was truly some of the most delectable duck I have ever tasted. However, we found the pad thai to be slightly too sweet for our liking, which prompts us to explore other noodle dishes during our next visit. Nevertheless, even with this minor setback, the pad thai was still delicious, especially when complemented with a dash of chili sauce.

In terms of service, our experience was positive, though it seemed that not everyone had the same fortune. One table, rushing to get to a show at the Kimmel Center, had to wait quite a while for their meal, potentially making them late. Additionally, another customer who ordered take-out realized that one item was missing. Fortunately, the owner promptly rectified the situation by personally delivering the missing dish to the customer's home, showcasing exceptional customer service.

Overall, Jasmine Rice delivered quality Thai cuisine, and we would definitely consider returning.

input: I absolutely love Courtney! She is hands down the best hairstylist I have ever had. The reason I think she is so great is that she knows what will look best on me and over the past year has understood my limits for styles. I always go into the salon and tell her to cut my hair how she thinks will look best, and I always leave blown away at what she does. You know you have a great stylist when you don't have to specify what you want done, but instead they see what needs to be done. Great stylist, great personality and very knowledgeable. I would highly recommend her to anyone who wants to look their best.
Revise this with your best effort: Courtney is absolutely amazing! Without a doubt, she is the most talented hairstylist I have ever come across. What sets her apart is her incredible ability to understand what suits me best and her unwavering consideration for my personal style preferences. Whenever I step foot into the salon, I simply ask her to work her magic, and time after time, I am left completely awe-inspired by her brilliant creations. Courtney possesses that rare gift of anticipating exactly what needs to be done without me having to utter a single word. Her expertise, matched with her charming personality, make her the ultimate powerhouse in her field. I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone yearning to look their absolute best!

input:

input: Replaced 2 old 70s lennox with 2 new ones.  They did a great job and have been runnong for 3 years now.

input:
I love the Brewpub for their variety of dishes.  Nachos, pizza and sandwiches.  Variety of beers to choose from crafted right on sight.  

Every time we go, the service is slow.  I think it's just the pace of the restaurant.  It's never a quick beer and a bite of food.  Instead, enjoy the patio and friends, savor that time.  

Kid and dog friendly environment.  Also great for your vegetarian and vegan friends.  

My go to is a half order of the nachos or fish & chips.  

Tried their Pumpkin Seasonal Beer and it's on par with some of my favorite pumpkins.
Revise this with your best effort:
I am a huge fan of the Brewpub mainly because of their diverse menu offerings. They serve a mouth-watering selection of dishes like nachos, pizza, and sandwiches. Additionally, they have an impressive range of beers available, all of which are expertly crafted on-site.

However, it is worth noting that the service at this establishment tends to be on the slower side. I believe it is simply the pace of the restaurant, but rather than seeing it as a downside, it provides an opportunity to fully enjoy the experience. Rather than rushing through a quick beer and a bite to eat, the Brewpub encourages patrons to relax on their patio with friends and truly savor the time spent there.

Not only is the Brewpub great for those with children or dogs, but it also caters to the dietary preferences of vegetarians and vegans, making it an inclusive and welcoming environment for all.

For me, the go-to dishes are a half order of their incredibly delicious nachos or their delectable fish & chips. I have also had the pleasure of trying their Pumpkin Seasonal Beer and am pleased to report that it exceeds the quality of some of my favorite pumpkin beers.

input: Farmhouse, rustic, chic.Helpful staff with great ideas to decorate your home. Prices reasonable. Store has items from Joanna Gaines ( Fixer Upper) and much more. Finally a good home store in SB with reasonable prices.

input: My brother came to visit and we wanted to pick up a six pack of good beers for a night in. Ended up staying and having a few while playing their Nintendo 64 (Super Smash Brothers, which the owner said was donated by fellow patrons). Revise this with your best effort: When my brother came to visit, we decided to grab a six pack of quality beers for a cozy night in. However, our plans took a delightful turn as we found ourselves engrossed in a captivating game of Super Smash Brothers on their Nintendo 64. The friendly owner informed us that this nostalgic console was gifted by generous patrons. It was indeed a remarkable experience at this establishment, boasting not only great food but also a warm and inviting atmosphere created by genuinely kind people. Without a doubt, this place deserves to be a prominent fixture in the Northeast.

input:
My go to menu is coconut soup and pad thai with protein. I tried same menu here. 
Actually really like their coconut soup. They used enough amount of coconut milk that soup was really creamy and wasn't over powering with herb. I am so used to Americanized thai cuisine that I prefer less herb on my dish except cilantro.
Pat thai was great too. Liked the amount of peanut they used, noodle was chewy and perfect and not too sweet. They gave me generous amount of chicken and white meat wasn't dry so I was very happy with my meal.
Revise this with your best effort:
When it comes to choosing a menu, my go-to always includes coconut soup and pad Thai with protein. I recently had the opportunity to try this exact combination at a restaurant, and I must say, I was incredibly impressed.

The coconut soup was a standout for me. The chefs knew exactly how much coconut milk to incorporate, resulting in a creamy and satisfying texture. What I appreciated the most was that it wasn't overpowering with herbs like many Americanized Thai dishes tend to be. However, I do have a soft spot for cilantro, so a touch of it would've made it even better.

Moving on to the pad Thai, it was nothing short of fantastic. The balance of flavors was spot on, with just the right amount of peanuts added. The noodles were cooked to perfection, offering a delightfully chewy texture. Additionally, the generous portion of chicken they provided was cooked perfectly, and the white meat remained moist, leaving me thoroughly satisfied with my meal.

Overall, my experience with this coconut soup and pad Thai dish was truly exceptional. It's safe to say that the restaurant exceeded my expectations and left me craving more of their incredible flavors.

input: Excellent service! Great diner food and breakfast is served all day. Came here for lunch- they were busy but very friendly and hospitable. Easy to get to off the 295.
Revise this with your best effort: Outstanding service! The diner offers delightful meals, including a scrumptious all-day breakfast. I visited during lunchtime, and although they were bustling with customers, the staff remained incredibly friendly and welcoming. Conveniently located just off the 295, it's easily accessible for all.

input:
My go-to spot on a Saturday night! I was real bummed that lucys closed, but was pleasantly surprised by this bar just across the street!
Their food is better than expected. I always get wings and fries. (be careful of the wtf sauce though) Sometimes it takes a real long time to get the bartenders attention, but the place is usually packed. And if you're lucky the always sunny crew will pop in!
Revise this with your best effort:
My favorite Saturday night hangout spot! I was disappointed when Lucy's closed down, but much to my delight, I stumbled upon this incredible bar just across the street.

To my pleasant surprise, their food surpassed my expectations. I never miss the opportunity to order their mouthwatering wings and fries. (Word of caution: be wary of the wtf sauce!) Occasionally, it can be a bit challenging to grab the bartender's attention due to the bustling crowd, but that's a testament to the popularity of this place. Plus, if you're fortunate, you might even catch a glimpse of the always sunny crew dropping by!

input:
We were a bit weary about trying the Shellfish Company on the Wharf as more often than not, many places like these (see Cannery Row, Monterey) feast on a captive audience and provide sub-standard fare at high prices.

However, emboldened by the perennial good reviews on Yelp, we suppressed our initial observations and went ahead with the trying it out. The place is small, so definitely plan ahead. You will have to wait, so either you know, just do so, or perhaps try to visit outside of peak hours. Luckily, our wait was only about 20 minutes as the dinner rush was just leveling off.

The special was the local rock crab - $25 for 3 lbs of California Rock Crab, salad, and your choice of soup/chowder. After taking a look at a few trays of rock crab being served out, the wife and I both opted for it, as it looked awesome.  

The salad/chowder combo was great as you actually received hearty portions of each, so it was a good start. As much as I liked the chowder however, the Shrimp Bisque the wife ordered was amazing, so I would recommend that going forward. 

But enough of prattling on about side dishes: the rock crab tasted just as glorious as it looked. Juicy, buttery chunks of white crab meat await you, just a few cracks away. While the rock crab shells are pretty thick, once cracked, they splinter and separate easily, a good sign they are cooked to perfection. The rock crabs provided a great amount of meat for what I felt to be the least amount of work you're going to do for crab, King or otherwise. 

We were thoroughly satisfied with our meal and along with the special being an overall great value, devouring the Rock Crab at SBSC turned out to be one of the favorite meals on the trip. I think ordering crab here is a safe proposition indeed.
Revise this with your best effort:
We approached the Shellfish Company on the Wharf with a bit of skepticism, as many similar establishments in places like Cannery Row tend to take advantage of their captive audience and serve subpar food at exorbitant prices. However, encouraged by the consistently positive reviews on Yelp, we decided to put aside our initial reservations and give it a try. Although the restaurant is small, it is definitely worth planning ahead and either waiting patiently or visiting during off-peak hours. Thankfully, our wait was only around 20 minutes, as the dinner rush was starting to wind down.

The star of the menu was the local rock crab - for $25, you could savor 3 lbs of delicious California Rock Crab, accompanied by a salad and your choice of soup or chowder. After observing several trays of the beautifully served rock crab, both my wife and I eagerly opted for it.

The salad and chowder combo was satisfying, as both portions were generous and provided a hearty start to the meal. Although I enjoyed the chowder, my wife's choice of the Shrimp Bisque was truly exceptional and something I would highly recommend.

But let's not dwell too much on the side dishes; the rock crab itself was as magnificent as it appeared. Succulent, buttery chunks of white crab meat were just waiting to be savored, requiring minimal effort to extract from their thick shells. The fact that the shells easily splintered and separated indicated that they were cooked to perfection. The rock crabs offered a substantial amount of meat, requiring far less work than other varieties such as King crab.

Overall, we left the Shellfish Company completely satisfied with our meal. The special offer provided excellent value for money, and indulging in the Rock Crab at SBSC turned out to be one of the highlights of our trip. We can confidently say that ordering crab here is a wise decision.

input: I LOVE Weaver's Way and really disagree with some of the content in previous reviews. WW is not necessarily meant for convenience shopping. I am a single woman and I find that I have no trouble shopping at the co-op, during peak times or otherwise. I actually find the co-op to be a great place to shop if you live alone because I can get smaller quantities of items than if I shop at the corporate stores like Acme. I also enjoy the work hours - I've worked throughout the store, but most recently, I have been getting in my hours by participating in the membership committee. I wouldn't say that the community is necessarily made up of "tree huggers" and "earth children", though. The community is made up of a variety of similarly-minded folks from different backgrounds. I enjoy having a place to go to where I can obtain locally grown produce, a place that offers more natural, wholesome, and preservative-free foods than chain stores with prices way below that of Whole Foods. I enjoy interacting with other members and contributing to my local and global community. I don't find the membership fee or the work hours to be prohibitive being a single person vs. a family. I don't think that membership in a co-op is for everyone and, if you aren't single, it's definitely not a solo decision. If you're keen on being committed to the Weaver Way values, you couldn't find a better place to shop. If not, stick to the chain stores or just pay the 10% visitors' fee to pop in once in a while.
Revise this with your best effort:
I absolutely adore Weaver's Way and strongly disagree with some of the points raised in previous reviews. Contrary to what has been said, Weaver's Way is not intended for convenient shopping. As a single woman, I have no trouble shopping at the co-op, regardless of peak times. In fact, I find it to be an excellent place for solo shoppers like myself, as I can purchase smaller quantities of items compared to corporate stores like Acme.

One aspect I particularly appreciate about Weaver's Way is the flexibility of their work hours. I've had the opportunity to work in various departments of the store, but recently, I've been actively involved in the membership committee. This involvement allows me to contribute to the co-op while also fitting into my schedule seamlessly.

Contrary to popular belief, the community at Weaver's Way is not solely comprised of "tree huggers" and "earth children." In reality, it is a diverse group of like-minded individuals from various backgrounds. Personally, having a place where I can easily access locally grown produce and find more natural, wholesome, and preservative-free foods compared to chain stores, at prices lower than Whole Foods, is truly delightful. Additionally, the chance to interact with other members and make a positive impact on both my local and global community significantly enhances my shopping experience.

Regarding the membership fee and work hours, as a single person, I have not found them to be prohibitive in any way, especially when comparing it to a family's perspective. It is important to note that membership in a co-op is not suitable for everyone, and if you are not single, it should be a decision made collectively. However, if you are genuinely committed to the values of Weaver's Way, there is no better place to fulfill your shopping needs. Alternatively, if those values do not align with your own, sticking to chain stores or paying the occasional 10% visitors' fee would be more suitable options.

input: Honestly the food doesn't knock my socks off but other people seem to love this place. I go because my husband likes it as for me I'd rather go to a different BBQ spot. I guess it also depends on what you order.
Revise this with your best effort: In all honesty, the food doesn't exactly blow me away, although it seems to be highly regarded by others. input: The TV shows are $4.99 and they have commercials! What a cheesy way to make money and a sign of a less than classy hotel, particularly when you pay more than $150 a night. input: I stopped here because it was by the hotel I was staying in. The guys working at the shop were super nice and friendly. I really like the buy one get one deal they do. input: I've only had the cannolis here but they are awesome! They're freshly filled when ordered and the filling is phenomenal. Not too sweet, it's perfect. If you like cannoli, if you don't think you like cannoli, you should definitely get one from Termini Bros.

input: Traveling through in our RV, stopped over in Granite City. Found this little gem of a cafe. Upon entering, the staff was very sweet and friendly. This is like home cooking. We ate here twice and all our food choices were fresh, delicious and like we would fix at home. Yum.

input: After 3 weeks of working in the area I finally found a place off of Magazine that is not overrated. Friendly staff! Y'all know I love Phò so it's pretty damn good!

input: Our family returned for breakfast again this weekend and the food and service was again impeccable ... Highly recommend

input: The kayaking tour at the Santa Cruz Island was great.  My husband and I had a wonderful time.  Jen, our tour guide, was helpful and informative.  We had a lot of fun exploring the caves.  We didn't expect much but this tour definitely exceeded our expectation.
