input: Definitely recommend for anyone looking for a delicious meal at a reasonable price. The shrimp and goat cheese crepes are a must have!
Revise this with your best effort: Highly recommend this place to anyone seeking a delectable meal at an affordable cost. The shrimp and goat cheese crepes are an absolute must-try!

input:
After living in the STL area for way over 10 years now, I am both ashamed and remorseful to admit that I ate here for the FIRST time just a few weeks ago. I am ashamed because it's a St. Louis tradition and remorseful because I missed out on it for so..many...years! 

This place is amazing. What is not to love! It's a factory where you can get a tour (Friday-Sunday, noon-5pm on the hour), there's a shop, bar, and dining area. They also host many event with live music on the weekends. It's fun to just kind of wander and look around - don't worry, you'll get a chance because there will likely be a wait before you dine. The beer is, of course, amazing. The Hefeweizen is my personal favorite and a great start for anyone who is not a huge beer drinker (like myself). Additionally, the food is homegrown and damn good. I had the pizza (recommendation from my server) and it was really spectacular, though I'm admittedly a pizza connoisseur so I enjoy a good pizza pie more than most probably ;P My date had a bison burger which was also really good. 

More fun info: the service is great! I think they tend to hire more funky and alternative people (like tattoo parlor staff) which I support. The quality is what makes this place stand out along with the emphasis on local food and brewery. 

It is a little on the pricier side but for all the experience you get and the quality, it is worth it. I will go again and again and you probably should, too!
Revise this with your best effort:
Having resided in the STL area for well over a decade now, I am feeling a profound sense of shame and regret as I confess that I recently visited this place for the very first time, mere weeks ago. My shame stems from the fact that it is considered a true St. Louis tradition, while my remorse arises from the realization that I have missed out on its offerings for such an extended period of time.

But let me tell you, this establishment is simply extraordinary. It has everything one could desire, and more! Not only does it function as a fascinating factory, complete with guided tours available every Friday to Sunday from noon to 5 pm on the hour, but it also boasts a shop, bar, and dining area. On weekends, they even organize a variety of events accompanied by live music. It's truly a pleasure just to wander through and explore the premises, although be prepared for a potential wait before you can indulge in their culinary delights. And what delights they are!

Naturally, the beer is unparalleled, as one would expect. The Hefeweizen, personally my favorite, provides an excellent choice for those who may not consider themselves avid beer drinkers, just like me. Furthermore, the cuisine absolutely shines with its locally sourced, homegrown ingredients. Based on a recommendation from my server, I opted for their pizza, and it proved to be a truly spectacular choice. However, I must confess that as a self-proclaimed pizza connoisseur, my standards are quite high when it comes to a good pizza pie, so my enjoyment may be even greater than most ;P Meanwhile, my companion decided to try their bison burger, which turned out to be equally fantastic.

Moreover, the service at this establishment is simply superb! They seem to have a penchant for hiring individuals who exude a more alternative and eccentric vibe, much like a staff you might find in a tattoo parlor. This unique approach to staffing truly adds to the charm of the place, alongside their unwavering commitment to using local ingredients and supporting the community.

Although it should be noted that this experience may be a bit on the expensive side, considering the overall package—memorable experiences, unparalleled quality, and exceptional service—it unquestionably warrants the investment. I now find myself yearning to return to this establishment time and time again, and I wholeheartedly encourage you to do the same!

input:
If I could give it a zero, I would. I order a plain hamburger, and realized they put  bacon in it (which I am allergic to and unable to eat) after two bites. When I went back to the drive-through window to complain (didn't realize the actual restaurant was open--it was almost 2 after all...), the guy took back the burger, said nothing, and disappeared. After 2 minutes of awkwardly making conversation with the next people in line in their car, he came back and rudely told me I had to go inside to get my food. Which I did. And still did not get an apology.

I refuse to go back there after that ordeal, which is a shame, because it's nice to have a variety of places to go to after DT. Guess Freebirds it is!
Revise this with your best effort:
If I could rate it lower than zero, I most certainly would. I specifically ordered a plain hamburger, only to realize, after a couple of bites, that it contained bacon, an ingredient I am highly allergic to and cannot consume. Frustrated, I decided to voice my concern by returning to the drive-through window. To my surprise, the physical restaurant was open, despite the late hour of almost 2 o'clock. When I approached the window, the employee silently took my burger back and disappeared without uttering a word. As I awkwardly engaged in small talk with the customers in the car behind me, two lengthy minutes passed before the employee finally returned, only to rudely inform me that I needed to go inside to resolve the issue. Reluctantly, I complied and ventured inside, but even then, I received no apology for their mistake.

Considering the unpleasant experience I had, I have made the decision never to return to that establishment. It's unfortunate because having a diverse range of dining options after leaving the drive-through is quite enjoyable. Alas, I suppose I will have to settle for Freebirds instead.

input: First time here and they did a great job, very satisfied with the car wash  and the service I received. Thank you
Revise this with your best effort: I am absolutely delighted with the outstanding car wash and impeccable service I experienced during my first visit here. input:
I just started going to Sushi Nara this month (they opened just a short time ago).  I love this place; it is clean, the staff are friendly and acommodating, and the service is fast.  The sushi is always delicious ((I've been here 3 times) and the prices are reasonable. In fact, this week my husband stopped in for take out, bought 4 sushi rolls and the total was $24.  That is amazing.  

I love the freshness of the food and there's a huge selection to choose from.

Everyone on the eastside, check this place out!
Revise this with your best effort:

input: Awesome little shop.  The owner really knows his stuff and you can tell he loves his work.  They have tires and other parts you won't find anywhere else.

input: Been here so many times before and all I can say is the food is really good. A hidden gem in Florissant, it has the best Panang curry around. Haven't been to their sister restaurant yet, but I can't seem to want to move on when I am always so satisfied with their fare here.
Revise this with your best effort: I've frequented this place countless times, and I must say, the food is undeniably exceptional. input: My food only merited maybe two stars but I will give an extra star because I like the menu (and will try more of it) and their design and concept.  Sadly though, my tomato-basil soup tasted kind of like a weak marinara and my tuna melt type sandwich had a very sharp, off-putting flavor.  It was citrusy, for sure, and I love lemon in a tuna melt but perhaps this was lemon zest or something just way too overpowering?  I think next time I will focus on the dishes with cured Italian meats, mortadella and prosciutto.  And also the baked goods, those sounded pretty good, especially the Nutella bruschetta!
Revise this with your best effort: Although my overall dining experience only warranted two stars, I am willing to give an extra star solely based on my appreciation for the menu and the establishment's design and concept. Unfortunately, the tomato-basil soup I ordered left much to be desired, resembling more of a weak marinara than a flavorful soup. Additionally, the tuna melt sandwich I had was rather displeasing due to an overpowering and off-putting sharpness. While I do enjoy a citrus-infused tuna melt, the intensity of the lemon zest or other elements used was excessively overwhelming. For my next visit, I intend to explore the offerings featuring cured Italian meats like mortadella and prosciutto, which have captured my interest. Furthermore, I've heard great things about their baked goods, particularly the enticing Nutella bruschetta.

input: We visited once and were very disappointed in my veggie pizza and my husband's sub sandwich.  The tomato sauce was not tasty, and they did not use enough cheese on my pizza.  The dough looked and tasted like it was prepared by a machine.  Perhaps they have improved, but we are not in any rush to try a second time.
Revise this with your best effort: During our initial visit, we were left quite disheartened by the quality of my veggie pizza and my husband's sub sandwich. The tomato sauce lacked flavor, and my pizza was disappointingly lacking in cheese. Additionally, the dough appeared and tasted as if it had been prepared mechanically. Although there is a possibility that improvements have been made, we do not feel compelled to give it a second chance at present.

input:
A couple friends and I stopped by for some late night milkshakes and found ourselves at More Than Just Ice Cream. Well, we just got ice cream...not fully taking advantage of what the name implies, but maybe next time.

3 milkshakes: 1 coffee, 1 chocolate, and 1 black&white malt. 

All were pretty good. Definitely satisfied the ice cream craving. I thought my coffee milkshake could have been thicker, same goes for the chocolate. The black&white was plenty thick and was probably the best of the three. Unfortunately, I did not order that one so I settled for my not so creamy coffee.

I did sample some ice cream flavors before setting on a milkshake. I tried the pumpkin pie which was AMAZING. I don't know why I didn't just get this. Maybe a milkshake isn't the way to go here.
Revise this with your best effort:
My friends and I decided to indulge in some late-night milkshakes, so we headed over to More Than Just Ice Cream. Despite the promising name, we only ended up getting ice cream this time, but we'll have to make sure we explore the other options next time we visit.

We ordered three delectable milkshakes: one coffee, one chocolate, and one black and white malt. All of them were quite satisfying and quelled our craving for ice cream. Personally, I felt that both the coffee and chocolate milkshakes could have been thicker in consistency. However, the black and white malt had the perfect thickness and stood out as the best among the three. Regrettably, I didn't choose that one and settled for my less-than-creamy coffee milkshake.

Before settling on a milkshake, I did sample a few ice cream flavors. The pumpkin pie flavor was absolutely incredible, and in hindsight, I wish I had opted for that instead. Perhaps a milkshake wasn't the ideal choice in this situation.

input:

input:

input:
I visited this restaurant 4 times during my 5 days stay. Crazy, right? Here are a list of reasons/pros:

- We were staying a nearby hotel.
- The restaurant opens 11 - 10:30 pretty much every day including new year's day so it fits into our schedule.
- If you are a party of two, chances are you get seated right away.
- $9 per dozen of oysters which is a really great deal by any standard!
- They have a seafood shop next door that sells boiled and fresh seafood to- go.
- Our server (same) is very friendly and recognized us every single time.

Now I want to talk about the reasons why I only give it 3 stars.

- We tried a bunch of stuff which are all pretty mediocre. Raw oysters are not cleaned well. So if your schedule is flexible, go to Superior Seafood during their happy hours for their 50 cents/oyster - better quality and cheaper. Turtle soup has a strange taste so I definitely prefer Felix's. A portion of my boiled shrimps are always mushy somhow, maybe boiled for too long?...
- The ambient is inviting but not comfortable so we basically just finished our food and go. 
- Clean the bathroom!!

Will probably visit again if we stay in the area next time or simply just pick up some seafood quickly.
Revise this with your best effort:
During my five-day stay, I had the opportunity to visit this restaurant a surprising four times. It may sound crazy, but let me share with you the reasons why I was drawn back:

Firstly, our hotel was conveniently located nearby, making it incredibly convenient for us to choose this restaurant. Additionally, the fact that they were open from 11 am until 10:30 pm every day, including New Year's Day, perfectly matched our schedule.

Another great perk was that if you were dining as a party of two, getting seated immediately was almost guaranteed. This not only saved us time but also allowed us to enjoy our meals without any unnecessary waiting.

One of the standout strengths of this restaurant was the incredibly reasonable price of $9 per dozen oysters. By any standard, this was an amazing deal that ensured we indulged in plenty of these delightful seafood delicacies.

Furthermore, the restaurant's adjoining seafood shop was an added bonus. Here, we could purchase freshly boiled or raw seafood to take away with us, providing even more convenience.

Lastly, I must mention our server, who's friendly demeanor and attentive service made each visit feel incredibly welcoming. It was refreshing to be recognized and greeted by the same server every time we dined at the restaurant.

However, despite these positives, I must admit that there were a few factors that led me to award this restaurant only three stars:

First and foremost, the variety of dishes we sampled were rather lackluster. The raw oysters, for instance, were not adequately cleaned, leaving a less than pleasing experience. If you have the flexibility, I would highly recommend visiting Superior Seafood during their happy hours, where you can enjoy higher quality oysters for just 50 cents each.

The turtle soup, unfortunately, had a peculiar taste, and I personally found Felix's to be a better option in this regard. Additionally, I discovered that a portion of the boiled shrimp was consistently mushy, indicating a possible error in the boiling process.

Moreover, while the ambiance of the restaurant was inviting, it lacked comfort. As a result, we often found ourselves rushing through our meals and leaving soon after finishing.

Lastly, it is worth mentioning that the cleanliness of the bathroom left much to be desired. This aspect certainly requires improvement.

Despite these drawbacks, I would still consider revisiting this restaurant if I were to stay in the area again or simply to grab a quick bite of their tasty seafood.

input: Skip this train wreck if you are looking for dinner.  Our server was clueless...like we seriously thought she was lost in the restaurant.  Had to ask for setups, water refills, etc.  Ordered chicken parmesan and got eggplant parmesan instead with a fish bone in it.  The drinks were good.
Revise this with your best effort: If you're seeking a satisfying dinner experience, it may be best to avoid this place. We were disappointed by our server's lack of knowledge and attentiveness; at times, it seemed as though she had misplaced herself within the restaurant. We had to repeatedly request setups, water refills, and other basic items. Furthermore, despite ordering chicken parmesan, we were served eggplant parmesan instead, which unfortunately contained a fish bone. However, it's worth mentioning that the drinks were enjoyable.

input: Meh is all I can say for TDS. The restaurant itself is just cold.... not literally, but figuratively. There was no decor, no menu boards, stainless steel prep tables as dining tables, no soda machines, staff EVERYWHERE with no identification (shirts, nametags, etc). The food is reasonably priced and most of it was quite good, but what really irked my party was the fact that they charge for extra salsa!!! We ordered a salsa trio (which included 3 samples of the various salsas, in 2oz glass prep bowls), and when my brother asked for more salsa for his tacos (mind you, we ordered one of ever taco, three burritos and guacamole), he was told he'd have to buy the trio again! Really!!??? We spent over $40 on food, drinks and apps, too. Even though the food was decent, I wouldn't return as the atmosphere is just blah and you can't get extra salsa for your damn tacos!
Revise this with your best effort:
I must say, I was quite disappointed with my experience at TDS. The restaurant itself lacks any charm or ambiance, giving off a cold and uninspiring vibe. Not a single decorative touch or menu board could be found. Instead, they had stainless steel prep tables doubling as dining tables, which did little to enhance the overall atmosphere. To make matters worse, there was a lack of organization when it came to the staff. With no identification like shirts or name tags, it was difficult to differentiate between employees.

On the upside, the food at TDS was reasonably priced and, for the most part, quite delicious. However, one aspect that truly irked our group was the absurd policy of charging extra for salsa! We decided to try their salsa trio, which included three small samples of different salsas in 2oz glass prep bowls. When my brother asked for more salsa to accompany his tacos (mind you, we ordered a variety of tacos, three burritos, and guacamole), he was informed that he would have to purchase the entire salsa trio again! Can you believe it? We had already spent over $40 on food, drinks, and appetizers. While the food itself was decent, the frustrating experience with the salsa and the lackluster atmosphere make it highly unlikely that we will be returning.

input: I'm so incredibly happy with our pictures! Angela Clifton Photography have worked with us 3 times and we have been happy with every single picture that was taken! Not only are the photos fabulous, but we had such a fun experience. The price is extremely reasonable and the pictures will be a keepsake we will cherish forever!
Revise this with your best effort: I cannot express enough how delighted we are with our pictures! Angela Clifton Photography has been exceptional, having provided their services to us three times and consistently delivering breathtaking photos on each occasion. Not only are the pictures truly fabulous, but the experience itself has always been remarkably enjoyable. What makes it even better is that their pricing is incredibly reasonable, making it all the more worthwhile. These pictures will undoubtedly become cherished keepsakes that we will forever hold dear.

input: Enjoyed my fish out at a sidewalk table.  A bit pricey but food was good.  Go to Side street in French quarter if u want quieter dining outside.
Revise this with your best effort: I had a delightful experience dining at a sidewalk table, savoring a delicious fish dish. Although the prices were a bit steep, the quality of the food made it worth it. For a more serene outdoor dining experience, I highly recommend visiting Side Street in the French Quarter.

input: The court house is very old and the art is great. The spiral staircase is funny. One can get view of entire city from 5th level. The tower clock room is really surprising with all mechanical gears inside!! You need a prior appointment to get into clock room. Worth spending 2 to 3 hours of time here.
Revise this with your best effort: The courthouse, although considerably old, boasts magnificent artwork that is truly captivating. The spiral staircase, with its whimsical design, adds a touch of humor to the surroundings. From the fifth level, one can marvel at a breathtaking panoramic view of the entire city. However, the real surprise lies within the tower clock room, as it reveals a remarkable display of intricate mechanical gears. To access this room, it is essential to secure a prior appointment. Spending two to three hours exploring the courthouse is an endeavor well worth the time invested.

input: I had the pleasure to meet with Ann today and not only was she extremely helpful and so positive, she went above and beyond to make my 1st experience here amazing and made it a absolute regular customer from this day forward. Thanks girlie!!
Revise this with your best effort: I had the pleasure of meeting Ann today, and I must say, she was not only incredibly helpful and positive, but she also exceeded my expectations to make my first experience here truly amazing. Thanks to her, I am now an absolute regular customer and will continue to be one from this day forward. Thank you so much, Ann!

input: This is the first time I tried this place and  I was surprisingly surprised. I had a combination dinner pad Thai and coconut soup. The soup was very tasty as I never had coconut soup before. The pad Thai was exactly what I was expecting and it did not disappoint. The restaurant had great Thai decor and music. The staff and service was top notch. For a town with not much selection for food, this was a great change of pace. This may become my go to place in Carp.
Revise this with your best effort: This was my inaugural visit to this establishment, and to say I was taken aback would be an understatement. Opting for a combination dinner, I indulged in the delectable flavors of pad Thai and coconut soup. The latter in particular was a revelation, as I had never before experienced the exquisite taste of coconut soup. As for the pad Thai, it lived up to my lofty expectations and left me thoroughly satisfied. Adding to the overall ambiance, the restaurant boasted charming Thai decor and played mellifluous tunes in the background. The staff, exhibiting exceptional service, truly elevated the dining experience. In a town where culinary options are limited, this establishment provided a breath of fresh air and has the potential to become my preferred dining destination in Carp.

input: This place was so chill and relaxing. When I come back it'll definitely be in my list if stops. Not to mention the artist performing was fun and eclectic  (I mean really, a country version of "Let It Go", what's not to love?)
Revise this with your best effort: This place exuded an incredibly serene and peaceful atmosphere, providing the perfect respite from the chaos of everyday life. Without a doubt, when I return, it will undoubtedly secure a top spot on my list of destinations to visit. Additionally, the artist who graced the stage was nothing short of captivating, offering a delightful and diverse repertoire. I mean, who could resist the charm of a country rendition of "Let It Go"? It was an absolute delight to behold, truly a performance to cherish.

input:
Id you haven't been to the Smoothie King center since it was know as the New Orleans Arena, you are in for a nice surprise. The arena has had a face lift and, while the seats are the same,  everything else has been refreshed.   

Most importantly,  the food options are far more varied and appeal to many tastes.  The quality of the food is very good and significantly improved from a few years back. The drink options are much improved as well and include full service bars, spiked lemonade,  bottled and draft beer and of course, smoothies.  There is even a spot for sweets. You can get funnel cake, cotton candy, and all kinds of delicious things I was too full to take in.  

The venue finally feels a bit swanky and top notch.  We are moving on up!
Revise this with your best effort:
If you haven't visited the Smoothie King Center since its days as the New Orleans Arena, prepare to be pleasantly surprised. The arena has received a much-needed facelift, refreshing everything except the seats.

One of the most notable improvements is the wide range of food options now available, catering to various tastes. The quality of the food has also seen a significant upgrade compared to a few years ago. Additionally, the drink selection has greatly improved, featuring full-service bars, spiked lemonade, bottled and draft beer, and, of course, a plethora of delicious smoothies. And let's not forget the dedicated spot for sweets, where you can indulge in delightful treats like funnel cake, cotton candy, and an array of mouthwatering desserts that my stomach was too satisfied to fully appreciate.

Overall, the venue now exudes a certain swankiness and top-notch feel. It's safe to say that we're moving on up in terms of quality and ambiance.

input: Don't know what it is but If my tummy's feeling icky, I can count on Chipotle's stake to fix me up. I just have to remember not to go during full on lunch time. I usually go between 2 & 4 when it's peaceful and calm. Busy or not the service is always friendly and fast!
Revise this with your best effort: I'm not sure what it is, but whenever I'm not feeling great, Chipotle's steak never fails to make me feel better. However, I have to be careful not to go during peak lunch hours. I typically choose to visit between 2 and 4 PM when it's more peaceful and relaxed. Regardless of how busy they are, the service at Chipotle is consistently friendly and fast!

input: I must admit, I wasn't expecting much. This place totally blew us away. This has to be one of the best Indian restaurants in the Tampa Bay. The ambience is wonderful including white table linens. The best part was the food, OMG. The chicken 65 was to die for, and the hot sour soup was rich and flavorful. The waitress (Angel) was friendly,  attentive and very pleasant. They opened just a week ago. I'm sure this will soon be the place foodies seek out for real Indian food.
Revise this with your best effort: I have to confess, I had low expectations initially. However, this place completely exceeded all our expectations. Without a doubt, it is one of the most exceptional Indian restaurants in the Tampa Bay area. The ambiance is simply delightful, highlighted by the presence of pristine white table linens that add a touch of elegance. Yet, it was the phenomenal cuisine that truly stole the show. Oh my goodness, the Chicken 65 was absolutely phenomenal, leaving us in awe. Additionally, the hot sour soup was an explosion of rich and flavorful goodness. The waitress, Angel, deserves special recognition for her friendly and attentive service that made our experience even more enjoyable. Although they only opened their doors a mere week ago, I am confident that this establishment will soon become a sanctuary where all food enthusiasts can indulge in authentic Indian cuisine.

input:
Had to wait until my third trip to NOLA to actually get in the door.  First two times I tried waiting in line, this time around we got smart and bought reserved seats so we could be on the benches. Well worth the extra $20 to not hassle with waiting in line for an hour. It goes toward the preservation of Jazz so it's a good cause...just splurge.

The show was fantastic.  True musicians and great personalities to boot. I can only imagine that this is what concerts were like 50 years ago. The band members were dapper, engaging and insanely talented.  It's in a tiny hole in the wall space that only holds maybe 200 people? So it's very intimate and nice to see the smiles on the faces of the musicians as they share their craft with you. This is a must do while in NOLA!
Revise this with your best effort:
On my third visit to NOLA, I finally managed to step foot inside. The first two attempts involved enduring long lines, but this time, we made a wise decision and purchased reserved seats, ensuring our spot on the benches. It was well worth the additional $20 to avoid the hassle of waiting for an hour. Plus, the proceeds go towards the preservation of Jazz, making it a worthy cause to splurge on.

The show itself was simply amazing. The musicians were not only incredibly talented but also had wonderful personalities. It felt like stepping into a time machine, experiencing what concerts were like fifty years ago. The band members were impeccably dressed, and their performances were captivating. Taking place in a small, tucked-away venue that holds around 200 people, the atmosphere was intimate. It was a joy to witness the genuine smiles on the musicians' faces as they shared their craft with the audience. Undoubtedly, this is a must-do activity while in NOLA!

input: A GREAT EXPERIENCE!!!!!!!!!  I was a completely new customer.  I did not have an appointment because my other plans got rained out and my dealership was too busy to take me.  I needed a PA State & Emissions  inspection which I dread because they can be a total ripoff at some places when they add things on and I just wanted to get it over with.  I saw that this place had much better reviews on Yelp than many other shops in the area.  Keystone Discount Tire took my 2008 Pontiac Torrent in for inspection while I waited and had some free coffee.  I only had to get up once to look at some irregular outer front tire wear on my car when it was on the rack during inspection.  I always appreciate it when the technician lets me look at the problem.   It was nothing major.  Easily correctable with an alignment sometime in the future.  Bill was very friendly, knowledgable, and straightforward with his overall analysis of my car.  My car was fully inspected and stickered in less than an hour without my bill being jacked up with add-ons.   I recommend getting on their mailing list for their coupons!!!!!!!!!!
Revise this with your best effort:
An Amazing Experience at Keystone Discount Tire!

As a new customer without an appointment, I found myself in need of a PA State & Emissions inspection after my original plans fell through due to rain. Unfortunately, my regular dealership was too busy to accommodate me. Apprehensive about being taken advantage of by some shops that tend to add unnecessary charges, I decided to look for a more reputable place based on Yelp reviews. That's when I came across Keystone Discount Tire and I'm so glad I did!

Upon arriving, I was warmly greeted and swiftly attended to. While my 2008 Pontiac Torrent was being inspected, I was able to enjoy their complimentary coffee and make myself comfortable. Throughout the process, I only had to briefly interrupt my wait to address an irregular outer front tire wear that I noticed when my car was on the rack. The technician kindly allowed me to take a look and reassured me that it was a minor issue, easily rectifiable with an alignment in the future.

What pleasantly surprised me was Bill, who proved to be friendly, knowledgeable, and transparent in his overall assessment of my car. To top it off, my bill remained untouched by any unnecessary add-ons that often plague these types of services.

I highly recommend joining their mailing list to benefit from their valuable coupons. Make sure not to miss out on the savings!-

input: Wow! I never thought my sons phone could be repaired after he dropped it but it is and it took less than a half an hour! Very professional and excellent service! I'm thrilled!
Revise this with your best effort: Wow, I'm absolutely amazed! I had completely given up hope of getting my son's phone fixed after he accidentally dropped it. However, I was proven wrong as the phone not only got repaired, but it was done so in less than half an hour! The service was incredibly professional and top-notch. I must say, I couldn't be happier with the outcome.

input: Service and management terrible... After messing up all 4 of our orders the waiter got mad and started cursing... The manager offered our drinks to be free.. What a mess. The food was cold and nasty didn't even eat half of it and waited over an hour... I will never dine in any cracker barrel again after this experience...
Revise this with your best effort: I experienced extremely poor service and management during my recent visit. To my dismay, our waiter not only made mistakes with all four of our orders but also displayed unprofessional behavior by becoming angry and cursing. The situation escalated even further when the manager, as a resolution attempt, only offered complimentary drinks. This ordeal was a complete disaster. Adding to the disappointment was the fact that the food arrived cold and unappetizing, leaving me unable to consume more than half of it. To say the least, I am deeply dissatisfied with this experience, and as a result, I have decided to never dine in any Cracker Barrel restaurant again.

input:
I have been to a number of dog friendly hotels...just not in the city and did not know what to expect. Usually they are motel like.  This one was in the heart of the city.

I walked tentatively into the hotel lobby as i have a labrador/golden mix who is not easy to hide.

We got to the front desk to register and i was still feeling uneasy although my  bf had assured me it was a dog friendly hotel. Reception was so nice immediately putting us at ease. As we checked in an attendant asked if Bentley could have treats which she fullly enjoyed. The Reception person also asked if we would like a welcome kit for Bentley. Holy moly. Of course. Dog dishes, a mat, treats, etc. I was blown away.  

Plus the guests at the hotel all stopped to compliment and pet "queen Bentley". Our room was on the top floor. Awesome!

Even when i went to walk her the car attendants greeted her by name. We were so impressed with the service we decided to come back an extra night. 

Thank you Loews. I didnt realize a hotel could be so dog friendly especially to a big dog.
Revise this with your best effort:
I have had the pleasure of staying at a few dog friendly hotels in the past, but they were always situated outside of the city and had a rather motel-like aesthetic. However, on this particular occasion, I found myself in the heart of the city, unsure of what to expect in terms of accommodations. As the proud owner of a Labrador/Golden mix, it is not always easy to conceal her presence.

Feeling somewhat apprehensive, I cautiously entered the lobby of the hotel. Despite my boyfriend's assurances that this was indeed a dog friendly establishment, I still found myself slightly on edge. However, my worries were quickly put to rest as soon as we approached the front desk to check in. The receptionist was exceptionally warm and welcoming, instantly putting us at ease. To my surprise, she even asked if our beloved Bentley would like some treats, which she thoroughly enjoyed. Furthermore, the receptionist inquired if we would like a welcome kit for Bentley, containing essential items such as dog dishes, a mat, and treats. I was absolutely blown away by the level of thoughtfulness.

To top it all off, the other guests staying at the hotel couldn't resist stopping to compliment and pet "queen Bentley," further adding to our overall positive experience. Our room, located on the top floor, was absolutely marvelous, granting us a breathtaking view of the cityscape.

Even when we ventured outside to take Bentley for a walk, the car attendants greeted her by name, displaying the exceptional level of service we had come to expect from this establishment. In fact, we were so impressed with our stay that we decided to extend our visit by an extra night.

I simply cannot express enough gratitude to Loews for exceeding my expectations in terms of dog friendliness, especially towards larger breeds.

input: Sometimes this food is very very good.  Unfortunately it's not consistent.   Ordered something I've been getting for years and every other time it tastes incredible. It's like they have different people in the kitchen and you don't know who you will get. So 50 % of the time it's excellent.  UGH.
Revise this with your best effort: On certain occasions, this food is absolutely delectable; it surpasses all expectations. Regrettably, its consistency leaves much to be desired. Recently, I placed an order for a dish I have been enjoying for years, and while it is usually incredible, this time it fell short. It seems as if there are varying individuals in the kitchen, making it uncertain as to who will be preparing the meal. Consequently, there is a 50% chance of it being excellent, which can be quite frustrating. UGH.

input:
Been to this location twice and will never go back again!!!!

First time was mediocre, the second time was so very disappointing it beggars belief. I ordered some ribs and had to send them back because one half was warm and the other half was refrigerator cold. They came back and one side was really hot and the other side was still cold, third time it was edible. The manager came over the third time to apologize, never once offered to comp anything. I'm not the kind of guy to cause a fuss to get something comped, but to send something back three times to get it cooked properly and only get an insincere apology really pisses me off, enough for me to write this review.
Revise this with your best effort:
I regret to say that my experiences at this location have left me thoroughly dissatisfied, to the extent that I can confidently declare that I will never return again. The initial visit was merely average, but it was the second occasion that truly astounded me with its sheer disappointment. In an attempt to indulge in a plate of ribs, I was met with an unfortunate reality: one half of the dish was distressingly warm while the other half remained chillingly cold, akin to that of a refrigerator. This predicament compelled me to send the ribs back to the kitchen for rectification. Astonishingly, upon their return, only one side of the dish had been remedied and reached an appropriate temperature, while the other side continued to persist with its icy demeanor. It was not until the third attempt that the ribs were rendered edible. 

To add further insult to injury, the manager eventually approached our table during the third instance, ostensibly to offer an apology. However, not once did this seemingly apologetic gesture extend to the notion of compensating us for our troubles. I must clarify that I am not one to purposefully cause a commotion merely to acquire complimentary items; however, sending a dish back three times in order for it to be adequately cooked, only to be met with an insincere apology, truly ignited a profound sense of irritation within me. This frustration has compelled me to express my thoughts through this review.

input:
After trying a few ramen places with crazy variety in their selections and stellar broth, I was not too excited about the ramen I got at Cheu.  Maybe it's a matter of taste, but personally, I was not a fan of their thick noodles, and extremely salty broth.  

The service was great, and they had a nice selection of beers!  The friend I went with loved it, and has been many times.  Honestly, I'm just sorry I wasn't a bigger fan.  But I hope others try it for themselves.  I might just be an oddball out on this one.
Revise this with your best effort:
After exploring several ramen spots offering an impressive array of choices and exceptional broths, I must admit that Cheu's ramen left me less than enthused. It's possible that my opinion is influenced by personal taste, but I found their thick noodles and overly salty broth to be lacking.

Despite my disappointment with the ramen, I cannot overlook the fantastic service and their appealing beer selection. Interestingly, the friend who accompanied me thoroughly enjoyed their experience and has frequented Cheu on multiple occasions. Regrettably, I simply didn't share the same level of enthusiasm. Nevertheless, I encourage others to give it a try and form their own judgment. Perhaps, I am just an outlier in this particular case.

input:
Federal Doughnuts is a new concession at the ballpark -- who doesn't love some doughnuts and fried chicken?  

Also, there is now a concession stand near 136 that is gluten-free dedicated.  They offer pizza, cheesesteaks and even brownies and cookies.
Revise this with your best effort:
Federal Doughnuts, a delightful addition to the ballpark, brings the irresistible combination of doughnuts and fried chicken for all to enjoy. 

In addition, exciting news awaits near section 136—an exclusive gluten-free concession stand perfect for those with dietary restrictions. Indulge in delectable delights such as gluten-free pizza, mouthwatering cheesesteaks, and even a selection of heavenly brownies and cookies.

input:
Looks like there is a second Red Kings restaurant in Chinatown and it did not disappoint! Since this place just opened yesterday, I'm not exactly sure if it's replacing the other Red Kings down the street, or if it is just a second helping of spicy, Szechuan food.

We ordered takeout and picked up the Dan Dan Noodles and a shredded Pork in Garlic sauce dish. The spice level in both dishes was perfect.  Extremely mouth-burning, but with delicious flavors that were sweet, earthy, and fresh. The portions were very generous and will make for great leftovers for us. I can't wait to try some of the other dishes and come back here for a sit-down dinner. They also have karaoke rooms upstairs, plus they are BYOB.
Revise this with your best effort:
It appears that there is another Red Kings restaurant now open in Chinatown, and it truly exceeded our expectations! As it has only been open since yesterday, I am uncertain if it is intended to replace the original Red Kings nearby or if it is simply an additional location offering the same delectable, spicy Szechuan cuisine.

For our takeout order, we decided on the Dan Dan Noodles and a dish of shredded Pork in Garlic sauce. The level of spice in both dishes was absolutely perfect. It provided an intense, mouth-burning sensation, but the flavors were exquisite, combining delightful sweetness, earthiness, and freshness. The portion sizes were incredibly generous, ensuring we will have scrumptious leftovers. I am eagerly looking forward to exploring more of their diverse menu and returning for a sit-down dining experience. It's worth mentioning that they even have karaoke rooms upstairs, adding an extra element of entertainment, and they also allow you to bring your own beverages.

input: This is one of the busiest Chick fil A's I've seen but they always manage to be quick and have exceptional service! I seriously don't know how they can be so quick and great all the time! One of my favorite places!
Revise this with your best effort: I am genuinely impressed by the efficiency and exceptional service at this particular Chick-fil-A. Despite experiencing high levels of customer traffic, they consistently manage to deliver prompt service. I am truly astounded by their ability to consistently provide quick service and exceptional quality. Without a doubt, this establishment has earned a place among my top favorite places to dine.

input: Best place for salads! I go there every time I'm in town for lunch. It's fast and veggies are always fresh.
Revise this with your best effort: The absolute best place for salads! Without fail, I make it a point to visit whenever I'm in town for lunch. Not only is the service prompt, but the vegetables used are consistently crisp and delightfully fresh.

input: My parents and I took the Oak Alley and Laura Plantation tour on September 26th, 2015.  I forgot the name of our driver-he was very informative on our drive to the plantations.  The schedule is perfect!  We were dropped off where we had time before and after the tour for free time to walk around the properties.  They are very flexible with drop off locations on the return drive.  We got off near Jackson Square and got to enjoy the rest of the afternoon in the French Quarter.
Revise this with your best effort: On September 26th, 2015, my parents and I embarked on an unforgettable exploration of the Oak Alley and Laura Plantation. Our tour was accompanied by a knowledgeable driver, whose name unfortunately slipped my mind, but whose insightful commentary greatly enriched our journey to the plantations. The meticulously planned schedule proved impeccable, allowing us ample time to freely explore the grounds before and after the tour. Additionally, we were pleasantly surprised by the tour's flexibility, as it provided us with various drop-off options on the return drive. Opting for Jackson Square as our final stop, we savored the remainder of the afternoon within the captivating ambiance of the French Quarter.

input: We have been here twice for brunch and have enjoyed it immensely. Everything we have tried has been delicious, particularly the grits with scallions and sour cream. But the room is always freezing so be sure to bring a sweater!
Revise this with your best effort:
We have had the pleasure of visiting this place twice now for brunch, and we must say that our experience has been nothing short of delightful. Each time, we have been thoroughly impressed by the delectable offerings on the menu. The standout, without a doubt, has been the scrumptious grits adorned with scallions and sour cream. The flavors truly come together in a delightful harmony that leaves our taste buds singing with delight.

However, it's worth mentioning that there is one minor drawback to our visits. The temperature in the room has consistently been on the chilly side, so we would highly recommend bringing along a cozy sweater to ensure maximum comfort throughout your dining experience. Nevertheless, this small inconvenience shouldn't overshadow the overall enjoyment we have derived from our visits.

In summary, this establishment has proven to be a reliable and enchanting destination for brunch. The culinary delights are nothing short of exceptional, with the grits showcasing a delightful symphony of flavors. Just remember to come prepared with a sweater to combat the chilly atmosphere.

input: Love this place...best hot dogs and chili dogs around...i go here as many times as i can..yum
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adore this place...it hands down serves the most mouthwatering hot dogs and chili dogs in town. I make it a point to visit as frequently as possible, savoring every delicious bite. The flavors are simply irresistible...yum!

input: Sweet spot in the Waterline. Came for some live music with friends on Saturday. Very cool. Best local beer in town by far. Seems like the concept is a few notches up from Fig Mountain. Definitely prefer Topa. Even cooler is that you can order incredible food from the Nook Restaurant, and walk two feet into Lama Dog which is part of the Waterline. I love it!!
Revise this with your best effort: The Waterline's Sweet Spot proved to be an exceptional experience when I visited with my friends on a Saturday for some live music. It exuded a cool ambiance that truly captivated us. Undoubtedly, it boasts the finest local beer in town, surpassing Fig Mountain by leaps and bounds. Personally, I found Topa to be my preferred choice. What made it even more impressive was the seamless integration between the Nook Restaurant and Lama Dog, which are both part of the Waterline. The ability to savor incredible food from the Nook and conveniently stroll merely two feet into Lama Dog added an extra layer of enjoyment to our outing. Needless to say, it left a lasting impression on me. I absolutely adore it!

input:
Great customer service! We were a little out of their pick up area but they were very accommodating and came and got our group of 7. When we got there we realized we were billed for 8 instead of 7. I called and he refunded my money for the extra ticket in minutes!

The tour itself was SO much fun! We were laughing and smiling and our tour guide was funny! We saw lots of alligators! From babies swimming in the water to full grown ones! We saw turtles and birds too! Our tour guide had a baby alligator we could hold that he's raising until it's a little bigger since it was a late hatch that would have died because of when it was born. The ride back was fun too because we went fast and the guide did some "tricks" with the boat! I highly recommend this tour!!!
Revise this with your best effort:
The customer service we experienced was exceptional! Despite being slightly outside of their designated pick-up area, they went above and beyond to accommodate us and came to collect our group of 7. Upon arrival, we discovered that we had been billed for 8 instead of 7. However, with just one phone call, they promptly refunded the extra ticket amount in just minutes!

Now, let's talk about the tour itself - it was an absolute blast! Laughter filled the air, and our tour guide had a fantastic sense of humor. We were treated to an incredible sight as we encountered numerous alligators, ranging from adorable baby alligators swimming in the water to majestic and fully-grown ones. Not only that, but we also had the opportunity to observe turtles and various captivating bird species.

To add to the excitement, our tour guide had a baby alligator that we were allowed to hold. He explained that he is raising this little one until it grows a bit more, as it was a late hatchling that would have otherwise perished. The dedication and care shown towards these creatures were truly remarkable.

The return journey was just as thrilling, as we sped along the water, and our guide even treated us to some impressive boat maneuvers. All in all, I cannot recommend this tour enough! It was an unforgettable experience that left us with big smiles on our faces.

input: Westfall replaced our roof in April. We could not be more pleased with the entire process. Quality roof, excellent communication and excellent follow up. Very happy we chose this company to replace our roof.
Revise this with your best effort: In April, Westfall successfully replaced our roof, and we are beyond pleased with the entire experience. Not only did they provide top-notch quality in their roof installation, but also displayed excellent communication throughout the process. Furthermore, their follow-up was exceptional. We are genuinely delighted that we made the decision to entrust this company with our roof replacement.

input: Good food, reasonably priced, and nice staff. Not ideal for eating in, but since they are going for a fast food approach to vegan food, that makes a lot of sense. I know the buffalo bella is the dish that they push the hardest, but for my money the Cheesesteak is the way to go. And pro-tip: Get the sweet potato fries.
Revise this with your best effort: The restaurant offers delicious food at affordable prices, accompanied by friendly staff. While it may not be the perfect spot for dining in, their fast food concept for vegan cuisine is well-executed. Among their standout dishes, the buffalo bella is highly recommended, but personally, I believe their Cheesesteak is the ultimate choice. By the way, don't forget to try their mouthwatering sweet potato fries – it's a pro-tip!

input: The ramen is okay, nothing spectacular. Service is okay. Good place for a quick stop but wouldn't go if there were other choices. Been here twice, will continue to go.
Revise this with your best effort: The ramen here is decent, but falls short of being extraordinary. The service provided is satisfactory. It can serve as a convenient spot for a quick meal, but if given the option, I wouldn't prioritize it over other choices. Despite these aspects, I have visited this establishment twice and will likely return in the future.

input: A menu that satisfies everyone's cravings! Clean, trendy, and delicious! I definitely recommend going early (before 9 am) as the wait tends to get longer after 9 am! But honestly, it is soooo worth the wait. You will leave there feeling so incredible satisfied!
Revise this with your best effort: Experience a tantalizing menu that will cater to all your cravings! Embracing a clean and trendy atmosphere, our delectable dishes are a feast for both the eyes and taste buds. To ensure your utmost satisfaction, we highly recommend arriving before 9 am as the wait tends to lengthen thereafter. Trust me, the wait is absolutely worthwhile. Indulge in our culinary delights and relish a blissful feeling of fulfillment upon departing!

input: Had the brisket sandwich with two sides and a drink for 9.99 - Great barbecue at an affordable price. Wonderful side such as potato casserole cream spinach baked beans green beans
Revise this with your best effort: I enjoyed a delightful meal consisting of a delicious brisket sandwich accompanied by two delectable side dishes and a refreshing beverage, all for the reasonable price of $9.99. The barbecue provided was exceptional, offering a perfect blend of flavors and textures. The accompanying sides, such as the irresistible potato casserole, creamy spinach, baked beans, and green beans, enhanced the overall dining experience, adding a wonderful variety of tastes. The affordability combined with the delectable quality makes this establishment an excellent choice for satisfying barbecue cravings.

input: The food and service was amazing! I only wish they had any vegetarian/vegan options. Can't wait to come back!
Revise this with your best effort: The food and service were exceptional! My only suggestion would be to consider adding vegetarian/vegan options to the menu. I'm eagerly looking forward to returning again soon!

input: Great food. Terrible customer service. I've been three times and I've had two different older waitresses. Not pleasant to deal with whatsoever. The owner on the other hand is lovely.
Revise this with your best effort: The food at this establishment is exceptional, but unfortunately, the customer service leaves much to be desired. Despite having visited three times, I've encountered two different older waitresses who have been consistently unpleasant to deal with. On a brighter note, the owner is truly delightful and makes up for the less-than-ideal service with their charm and attentiveness.

input: I first heard about this place on the plane ride over from a Franklin local.  He recommended that we brave the line and try one of Nashvilles best breakfast spots.  HE WAS RIGHT.  Holly cow this place kicked butt and we didn't even have to wait in line!! We were lucky to miss the rush said our waitress.   I had this super savory corn pancake with bacon, salsa, and sour cream. So good. This place will always be a stop when I get back to the south~~~
Revise this with your best effort: I was introduced to this incredible place during my plane journey from a Franklin local. He strongly suggested braving the line to experience one of Nashville's finest breakfast spots. And boy, was he spot on! This establishment surpassed all expectations, and the best part? We didn't have to wait in line at all! Our waitress informed us that we were fortunate to have missed the peak rush. I opted for a delectable corn pancake accompanied by crisp bacon, salsa, and a dollop of sour cream. It was absolutely sensational. Without a doubt, this spot will always be a must-visit whenever I return to the South.

input: OMG!!! I can't believe this kind of service exists!  My husband called to make an appointment for full detailing for next Sat with Michael, he called again to confirm on Fri before we head there since it's a distance from our home.  Michael said he didn't know we wanted to do full detailing thou we specifically mentioned that.  He advised us to come the following sat instead.  We agreed and we reached there at 8am on the following week.  Guess what?  Nobody is at the workshop, it's closed!  We called him and he said he is busy and will call back.. We waited for half an hour in our car and there is still no call from him.  We headed for our breakfast and came back again at 9:30am hoping to give him another chance.  Here comes Alex, his partner opening the shop at 9:30am!  1.5 hours away from our appt time and still no sight of Michael.  Alex tried calling Michael and couldn't get hold of him.  We gave up!!! What a horrendous experience!
Revise this with your best effort:
I am extremely disappointed and in disbelief over the existence of such a poor service. My husband had phoned to schedule a full detailing appointment for next Saturday with Michael. As a precaution, my husband called again on Friday to confirm our reservation, considering the distance from our home. However, Michael claimed to be unaware of our request for full detailing, even though we had explicitly mentioned it. He suggested that we reschedule for the following Saturday, which we reluctantly agreed to.

On the designated day, we arrived promptly at 8am, only to find the workshop closed and completely deserted. In a state of frustration, we contacted Michael and he informed us that he was occupied but would call back. We waited patiently in our car for half an hour, hoping for his call, but to no avail. Eventually, we decided to grab breakfast and returned at 9:30am, granting him another opportunity. Astonishingly, it was Alex, Michael's partner, who opened the shop at 9:30am with still no sign of Michael. Alex attempted to reach Michael, but failed to get a hold of him. At this point, we had lost all hope and gave up on the entire experience.

This whole encounter has been an absolute nightmare and nothing short of a horrendous experience.

input: I had numerous things happen during my move and required additional services from this office. The guys in this office are top notch and are very trustworthy. I'd say more about how they took great care of me, but they may have gone above and beyond what they should have and afraid to say too much. I would recommend this office to my mother!
Revise this with your best effort: I experienced multiple unexpected challenges during my recent move, which led me to seek additional assistance from this office. I must commend the exceptional professionalism and reliability of the individuals working here. Their exemplary service exceeded my expectations, making it difficult for me to fully express my gratitude without potentially underselling their remarkable efforts. Without hesitation, I wholeheartedly recommend this office to even the most discerning individuals, including my own mother.

input: We stayed at The Saint last year for a girl's trip. The lobby is lovely, they have a cool bar and restaurant that you can't help but to "ohh and ahh" over when you walk in.  All the things I'm accustomed too when I stay at a hotel anywhere...ambiance, a little sexy but not overkill! Everyone is so friendly, etc.  I'm thinking "oh shhhh this is going to be a great weekend!"  I checked in a few hours before my girl arrived because I had a ton of work i needed to do. So I set up my laptop ordered some room service and worked for about 4 hours straight. Left out to buy a bottle and get a mani/pedi.  My girl arrives...its about to be some trouble in NOLA... the two of us and no supervision...we pop out for dinner, come back in giggling as usual and we see it...a HUGH flying roach.  I'm freaked out.  I literally walk right out of the room down to the front desk.  I CANNOT!!!! They tell me they're sending a maintenance worker to handle it.  NOT GOOD ENOUGH! If there's one that's bold enough to show itself, he has other cohorts that prefer to live behind the scenes. They give us another room but tell me they can't do more until 8am.  No the room the move us too also has small spiders and other dead small bugs in the corners of the window. The TV doesn't work and one of the lamps doesn't have bulbs in it! COME ON!  At this point its about 3am and I know I'm not staying here past 8:15am. I dont want to sit my purse let alone my luggage in this hotel! I go online to my normal go to hotel, The W and book us there for the rest of the trip! 8am comes and goes no manager comes to our room. I go down and demand to see someone immediately.  This younger gentlemen comes out and apologizes.  I thank him for his apology and politely request ALL of my money back immediately.   He obliged and asked if  I would consider coming back after changes have been made! Bless his heart. NO dear!
Revise this with your best effort:
We had the pleasure of staying at The Saint last year for a girl's trip, and I must say, it left quite an impression. From the moment we stepped into the lobby, we couldn't help but be captivated by its lovely ambiance. The cool bar and restaurant added an extra touch of charm that made us say "ohh and ahh" with delight. The staff's friendliness only added to the overall positive experience. Needless to say, our expectations were high for a fantastic weekend.

Upon arrival, I checked in a few hours before my friend to catch up on some work. The comfort of my room and the prompt room service allowed me to dive into my tasks for a solid four hours. Once satisfied with my progress, I ventured out to purchase a bottle and indulge in a relaxing mani/pedi session. Little did I know that trouble awaited us upon my friend's arrival in NOLA.

As we returned to our room giggling, our joy was abruptly interrupted by the sight of a colossal flying roach. My fear escalated, and I immediately sought assistance at the front desk. The staff assured me that a maintenance worker would be dispatched to handle the situation. However, I couldn't help but express my concerns regarding potential infestations. Relocating us to another room temporarily, they informed me that the full resolution would occur by 8 am. Disappointingly, the second room also had minor issues like small spiders and other deceased insects lurking in the corners of the window. Furthermore, the TV was non-functional, and one of the lamps lacked bulbs. Frustration crept in—how could this be?

By this point, it was already 3 am, and I knew that I could not tolerate these conditions for one more second past 8:15 am. I couldn't fathom resting my purse, let alone my luggage, in a hotel with such flaws. Thinking on my feet, I swiftly turned to my go-to hotel, The W, and secured us a booking for the remainder of our trip. Regrettably, 8 am arrived without any sign of a manager addressing our concerns. Determined to find a resolution, I marched down to the front desk, demanding to speak to someone immediately.

A young gentleman promptly emerged, acknowledging the mishaps and offering a sincere apology. Graciously accepting his apology, I requested an immediate refund of all funds. To my surprise, he complied, even asking if I would consider returning once changes had been implemented. Bless his heart indeed, but my answer was a firm and resolute "no, thank you."

input:
Say you decide that you need a new door...and you only have $35.  Where do you go?  the Green Project. 

Or you have a bunch of left over building supplies, random bits of lumber, some roofing materials, maybe even some paint?  Where can you bring it so it doesn't end up in a landfill?  Again, the Green Project.
Revise this with your best effort:
If you find yourself in need of a new door on a tight budget of only $35, your best bet would be to head over to the Green Project. It is the go-to place for affordable and sustainable building materials in such circumstances.

Alternatively, if you have a surplus of building supplies, including assorted lumber, roofing materials, or even paint, and you are concerned about them being wasted in a landfill, worry not! The ideal destination to contribute these items responsibly is once again the Green Project. They ensure the proper handling and recycling of such materials, reducing environmental impact and promoting a greener approach to construction and renovation.

input:
Worst place I've ever visited. The bouncer was rude and he didn't have to be. This place thinks just cause your on broadway you can treat people bad and over charge. 
 I'm not a tourist I live here and will never visit or recommend
Revise this with your best effort: The worst place I have ever visited was undoubtedly a disappointing experience. The bouncer at the establishment was exceptionally disrespectful, showing an unnecessary lack of courtesy. It appeared that this particular place believed that being located on Broadway granted them the right to mistreat individuals and excessively overcharge for their services. As a resident in the area, I hold no affiliation with being a mere tourist, and I can confidently assert that I will refrain from ever revisiting this establishment or recommending it to others.

input: Stopped in for the lunch menu with my girlfriend, place was extremely clean, food was ON POINT!  And AFFORDABLE Can't wait to go back!!
Revise this with your best effort: My girlfriend and I dropped by for lunch and were pleasantly surprised by the impeccable cleanliness of the place. Not only that, but the food was absolutely outstanding! Every dish we ordered was flawlessly prepared and to our delight, the prices were very reasonable. We are so excited to go back for another incredible dining experience!

input:
So disappointing on so many levels. Have been coming here for years - and the quality of food has fallen off a cliff. Strike one - we shared an artichoke to start - and clearly it had been prepared beforehand (eg, cold on the inside - but the flesh was cooked through)  Strike two - my wife had a Greek salad - and it clearly all came from a bag and was extremely overdressed with tasteless dressing.  Strike three - I had grilled yellowtail which was basically execrable - could not even finish it (overcooked and an inferior-frozen piece of fish - unacceptable for SB). 

In short - great setting, good service - but with such horrible food - not worth the visit. This place really needs to up the quality of food - or it's going to end up just another lower State dive for the tourists.
Revise this with your best effort:
I am immensely disappointed on multiple fronts. I have been a loyal patron of this establishment for years, but the recent decline in the quality of food is truly disheartening. Let me elaborate on my experience. 

Firstly, my dining companion and I decided to start with an artichoke. However, it was evident that this appetizer had been prepared well in advance. It was served cold on the inside while the flesh appeared to be fully cooked. This kind of inconsistency struck me as a major flaw. 

Secondly, my wife ordered a Greek salad, and it was apparent that all the ingredients came straight out of a bag. To make matters worse, it was excessively dressed with a bland and tasteless dressing. It left a lot to be desired in terms of flavor and freshness. 

Lastly, I opted for the grilled yellowtail, which turned out to be nothing short of dreadful. The fish was overcooked and had evidently come from an inferior frozen source. Serving such subpar quality fish is unacceptable, especially in a town like Santa Barbara known for its exceptional seafood. 

In summary, this establishment boasts an appealing ambience and attentive service. However, the abysmal quality of the food undermines the entire experience. If they do not prioritize enhancing the food quality, they run the risk of becoming just another mediocre tourist spot in the lower State area.

input:
Milktooth is the place to go if you want a good breakfast cocktail and a twist on traditional brunch. At first glance of the menu, you may think you've never heard of any of these foods for breakfast, and you may be right. I guarantee no matter what you order, you're going to enjoy it. 

Milktooth is one of the most popular brunch places in Indy, which means you will typically have a wait. Trust me, it's worth the usual 30 minute wait (on weekends). To make it go by a little faster, they've got a walk up bar for their coffee drinks and pastries. Snack on one of those to give you a preview of the amazing meal you're about to have.

Their menu changes from time to time but they have a few things that stay one the menu but change ingredients. I love all of their variations on a Dutch pancake, and their raclette grilled cheese is to die for.  If you're making this a boozy breakfast, don't pass up on the michelada. And sit outside if it's warm enough!
Revise this with your best effort:
If you're in search of a delectable breakfast cocktail with a unique twist on traditional brunch, look no further than Milktooth. The moment you peruse their menu, you may realize that these breakfast offerings are unlike anything you've encountered before, and you wouldn't be wrong. However, I can assure you that no matter what you choose to indulge in, satisfaction is guaranteed.

Renowned as one of Indy's top brunch spots, Milktooth tends to have a wait, typically around 30 minutes on weekends. But let me tell you, it's a wait worth enduring. To help expedite the process, they have a convenient walk-up bar where you can enjoy their delightful coffee drinks and pastries. Nibble on one of these treats while you eagerly anticipate the incredible meal ahead.

While their menu does undergo periodic changes, there are a few staple items that remain while their ingredients evolve. Personally, I adore their various Dutch pancake renditions, each one a tantalizing delight. And let's not forget about their can't-miss raclette grilled cheese, a true culinary masterpiece. If you're in the mood for a boozy breakfast, don't overlook their irresistible michelada. Oh, and if the weather permits, definitely opt for outdoor seating to fully embrace the warmth and ambience.

input:
The bar and staff are AMAZING. we got a room upgrade for have been being on our honeymoon and the view was gorgeous. But, the room was not any better than a hilton. It had rust in the tub floor, and some weird stains on the tile. But this was only in the bathroom, so i give it 4 stars! Great staff, but too much for valet so we parked a couple streets down. That was the only other con I would say. 

Would recommend if you want to be literally in the working downtown area of st. louis. Lots of cool bars and restaurants on a friday night.
Revise this with your best effort:
The bar and staff at this hotel are absolutely incredible. They went above and beyond for us, even upgrading our room because we were on our honeymoon. The view from the room was absolutely stunning. However, I must admit that the actual room itself was not as impressive as a Hilton. There were noticeable rust stains on the tub floor and some strange stains on the tile. Thankfully, these issues were confined only to the bathroom, so I can still give it a solid 4-star rating. The staff was exceptional, but I will say that the valet parking was quite expensive, so we decided to park a couple of streets away. This was the only other downside I can think of. 

I would highly recommend this hotel if you want to be right in the heart of downtown St. Louis. There are plenty of amazing bars and restaurants to explore on a Friday night.

input: I took the beginning class there, and I loved it. It was perfectly paced, and though the moves weren't difficult, they really stretched me in places I didn't know existed! I even broke a small sweat! But I felt great afterwards! The studio is clean, and I like that I can buy some Beyond Organic food items there too.
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adored taking the introductory class at that studio. The pace of the class was just perfect, allowing me to fully immerse myself in the experience. Although the dance moves may not have been overly challenging, they managed to push me beyond my limits, targeting areas in my body that I never thought existed. I was pleasantly surprised to find myself breaking a slight sweat during the session, a clear indication of an invigorating workout. The feeling I had afterwards was unparalleled, leaving me with a fantastic sense of accomplishment. Moreover, I must commend the studio for its impeccable cleanliness, ensuring a hygienic environment for all its patrons. A delightful bonus was the availability of Beyond Organic food items for purchase, adding to the holistic and health-conscious atmosphere.

input: Not sure why it took until now for us to find this place. We started out going to the chain lobster restaurant but wanted something more authentic. A friend recommended Lobster Haven and I checked it out online. Looked like a type of place we would eat at in Massachusetts when we visit family. We were not disappointed! Service was great, fast and very friendly. Huge selection of all of the favorites. You have to visit this place if you want authentic New England seafood. You can also purchase live lobster and fresh seafood to go and cook it yourself.
Revise this with your best effort:
I can't believe it took us this long to discover this hidden gem. Initially, we had planned on settling for a generic chain lobster joint, but our craving for an authentic experience led us to Lobster Haven. This place exudes the charm and character we usually associate with dining in Massachusetts when we visit our family. And let me tell you, we were absolutely blown away by the whole experience! 

From the moment we walked in, the service was top-notch, incredibly swift, and incredibly amiable. The vast array of classic favorites on the menu left us spoilt for choice. If you're on the hunt for genuine New England seafood, you simply must pay Lobster Haven a visit. They even offer the option to purchase live lobsters and fresh seafood to bring home, allowing you to recreate the tantalizing flavors in the comfort of your own kitchen.

input: Fabulous! Best happy hour, fresh menu, Delish- drinks, if I had the time, I'd come here every day!
Revise this with your best effort: This place is absolutely fabulous! They offer the best happy hour in town with a fresh and enticing menu. The drinks are truly delish! If only I had the time, I would come here every single day without hesitation.

input: Men's clubs is the tits, plain and simple. All the barbers got skills enough to hook it up fresh. Been coming here for 3 years and I've never had any problems. input: My husband and I come here often. We love the food here, it's always fresh and the service is great. We highly recommend this place to anyone who loves sushi & hibachi.
Revise this with your best effort: My husband and I are frequent patrons of this establishment. The food here never disappoints, consistently offering fresh and delectable options. Furthermore, the service provided is exemplary, ensuring a pleasant dining experience. Without hesitation, we wholeheartedly endorse this venue to any sushi and hibachi enthusiasts seeking an exceptional culinary experience.

input:
Oh Chickie's and Pete's, you are the perfect place to watch some sports and indulge. 

No doubt this is not the best food I've ever had but, if you can get a seat, grab some beer with mussels red and crab fries, there's no way not to thoroughly enjoy this place during a game or any time you're down by the stadiums. 

My favs are the crab fries, mussels red (white is overloaded with garlic that I can't always take it), the spicy pull and peel shrimp, steamers, and if the mood is right the blue crabs (it's a lot of work but tasty). This place also makes getting down and dirty with your food easy. There are sinks all over so you can rinse the mess off your hands once you're done....good touch.

To sum it up, Chickie's and Pete's is a Philadelphia institution and always a good time. I strongly suggest going at least once to enjoy the experience. 

Please note: Make sure to remember two things before coming during major sporting events. 1. You'll never get a table and 2. You'll deal with a ton of drunk people. I've absolutely been one of these people before and we can get annoying unless you're in the right frame of mind. :)
Revise this with your best effort:
Oh Chickie's and Pete's, you are the ultimate destination for sports enthusiasts and food lovers alike. 

While it may not boast the most exceptional culinary delights, this place is a must-visit if you manage to secure a seat. Treat yourself to a refreshing beer accompanied by their renowned mussels red and delectable crab fries. It's an experience that is bound to satisfy your cravings, be it during a game or whenever you find yourself in the vicinity of the stadiums. 

Personally, I can't get enough of their mouthwatering crab fries, perfectly seasoned mussels red (though the white can sometimes be overpowering), the tantalizing spicy pull and peel shrimp, the delightful steamers, and on special occasions, the labor-intensive yet incredibly flavorsome blue crabs. One thing I appreciate about this place is its accessibility for those who don't mind getting a little messy while enjoying their meal, with conveniently placed sinks scattered throughout the establishment for easy cleanup.

In all, Chickie's and Pete's is not just a restaurant; it's a Philadelphia institution that guarantees a fantastic time. I highly recommend experiencing it at least once.

However, it is essential to keep a couple of things in mind if you plan on visiting during major sporting events. Firstly, it's near impossible to secure a table, so be prepared for standing room only. Secondly, brace yourself for the raucous antics of intoxicated patrons. I confess, I've been one of those rowdy individuals before, and while we may not be everyone's cup of tea, with the right mindset, it can add to the overall ambiance. So, approach with an open mind and embrace the lively atmosphere.

input:

Simple mirror fix, but they made it easy for me. I have used them in Charlotte and they were great then, too.

Prompt and Professional Mirror Repair Service on a Saturday
