input: Good choice in Union Station St. Louis.  I had the Ponchartrain (server said it is same as Tilapia, though that was also on the menu, so why two names for the same fish, I have no clue).  The Ponchartrain was quite good with mushrooms and a cream sauce.  We also had the shrimp cocktail and lump crab cake appetizers....both fine, but not wonderful.  Drinks and service were perfectly acceptable.  We dined outside on the patio since the weather was nice - inside looks comfy and a bit less casual.
Revise this with your best effort: I made a great choice by dining at Union Station St. Louis. I opted for the Ponchartrain, a dish that the server claimed was the same as Tilapia. However, I found it confusing that both names were listed on the menu. Regardless, the Ponchartrain was delightful, featuring a delectable cream sauce and mushrooms. As for the appetizers, the shrimp cocktail and lump crab cake were decent, but did not quite reach the level of wonderful. The service was satisfactory, and our drinks were enjoyable. Taking advantage of the pleasant weather, we chose to dine on the patio, although the indoor seating appeared cozy and slightly more formal.

input: I stopped in for a drink yesterday and have to say the atmosphere gets an A+ from me.  Such a unique concept for the St. Pete area.  The attention to detail with the remodel was outstanding, it almost feels like you are in a Harry Potter movie or something.  There is background music that is set at a low volume so you can clearly hear your friends or not have to shout for them to hear you - perfect for the old library-esque environment. Working behind the bar were Michael and Peggy - both couldn't have been more friendly and were overall just interesting people to talk to.   I had eaten dinner already before I came so can't speak on the food but will definitely be back to try - the prices for meat/cheese trays are much better than comparable places in the area.  I would definitely recommend checking this place out...
Revise this with your best effort:
Yesterday, I decided to pop in for a drink and I must say, I was incredibly impressed with the atmosphere. It's truly a unique concept, especially for the St. Pete area. The attention to detail in the remodel was exceptional, making you feel as though you've stepped into a scene from a Harry Potter movie or something equally enchanting.

What truly sets this place apart is the thoughtful consideration given to maintaining a comfortable environment. The background music is played at a low volume, allowing you to easily engage in conversations with your friends without having to raise your voice. It creates the perfect ambiance, reminiscent of an old library.

Behind the bar, I had the pleasure of interacting with Michael and Peggy. Not only were they incredibly friendly, but they also proved to be interesting individuals to engage in conversation with. Their presence further enhanced my experience at the establishment.

Although I had already eaten dinner beforehand, I couldn't help but notice the enticing selection of food options. I'm definitely planning to return in the future to indulge in their offerings. What's more, the prices for the meat and cheese trays are much more reasonable compared to similar establishments in the area.

All in all, I highly recommend taking the time to visit this place. It truly offers a one-of-a-kind experience that is not to be missed.

input: Yes! I love this place! Maple Street Patisserie is the bomb.com! I've never been disappointed. Best blueberry muffin I've ever had in my whole entire life. Delicious breakfast and lunch spot. They also do specialty cakes so swing by during Mardi Gras and grab a king cake. Also the owner, Ziggy, is the man. He's always running around working crazy hours to make all these scrumptious baked goods. Can't beat this place :)
Revise this with your best effort: Absolutely! I absolutely adore this establishment! Maple Street Patisserie is beyond amazing! I have never experienced any form of disappointment here. It genuinely holds the title for the most exceptional and heavenly blueberry muffin I have ever indulged in. Furthermore, this delightful patisserie is an absolute gem for both breakfast and lunch. Additionally, during the festive season of Mardi Gras, they offer specialty cakes, such as the delectable king cake. Let's not forget to mention the incredible owner, Ziggy, who tirelessly dedicates himself to create these mouthwatering baked goods. It is simply impossible to surpass the excellence of this establishment.

input:
Really good burger. I had the Bourbon Black and Bleu. It was cooked like I wanted and very tasty. 

I gave them 3 stars for the wait. We had a big party - 4 adults and 5 kids - and it took over an hour to get our food. Shouldn't have taken that long, regardless of how many people were at our table.
Revise this with your best effort:
I had the pleasure of enjoying the Bourbon Black and Bleu burger at this establishment, and I must say it was truly exceptional. The burger was cooked to perfection, exactly as per my preference, and its flavor was nothing short of delectable.

However, I must deduct a few stars for the unfortunate wait we endured. Despite the fact that our table consisted of 4 adults and 5 children, which may have added to the complexity of our order, it took well over an hour to receive our food. In my opinion, regardless of the number of people at our table, such an extended wait time should have been avoided.

input: It seems to me that whenever we have out of towner guests, our go to place is consistently Katie's. The variety of food wonderfully prepared is 2nd to none. Reasonably priced and delicious, Katie's never disappoints. Whether you choose the grilled ersters, the shrimp and grits, the Cuban sandwich, pizza, or soup & salad you will be very pleased and have a great meal. Daily specials hi-lite local seasonal offerings that keep things fresh. The service staff are warm and friendly. On Sunday's, you will want to time your arrival before church let's out or you will have a bit of a wait. That said, you can always manage while enjoying bottomless Mimosas!
Revise this with your best effort:
Whenever we have visitors from out of town, our go-to place is always Katie's. The restaurant offers an outstanding variety of exquisitely prepared dishes that are truly second to none. Not only is the food superb, but it is also reasonably priced, making Katie's a consistent winner in satisfying our taste buds. Whether you opt for the flavorful grilled oysters, the delectable shrimp and grits, the mouthwatering Cuban sandwich, the savory pizzas, or the refreshing soup and salad combo, rest assured that you will be more than pleased with your choice and enjoy a fantastic meal.

To further enhance your dining experience, Katie's features daily specials that highlight the best of local, seasonal ingredients, ensuring that each visit feels fresh and exciting. The service staff at Katie's are exceptionally friendly and welcoming, consistently providing a warm and inviting atmosphere.

It's worth noting that if you plan to visit on a Sunday, it's advisable to time your arrival before church services conclude, as there may be a bit of a wait. However, the good news is that you can make the wait more enjoyable by indulging in their bottomless Mimosas, adding a touch of luxury to your dining experience.

input:
Came in after attending the Zurich Classic golf tournament. It was a warm and a bit humid so what tastier then a ice cream cone? I lucked out and found a parking space on the street. The interior is quite cute and comfy.

The selection here is crazy huge but after sampling a couple of unusual flavors I went with the scoop of cookie monster ice cream on a cone. The ice cream hit the spot and I enjoyed it BC it wasn't overly sweet.

Creole Creamery was definitely worth checking out!
Revise this with your best effort:
After attending the Zurich Classic golf tournament, I decided to treat myself to a delicious ice cream cone, as the warm and slightly humid weather called for it. Luckily, I managed to find a convenient parking space on the street. Stepping inside, I was immediately charmed by the cute and cozy interior of the place.

The variety of flavors available at this ice cream shop was truly impressive, almost overwhelming. However, after indulging in a few unique samples, I ultimately settled on a delightful scoop of cookie monster ice cream nestled on a perfectly crisp cone. The ice cream truly hit the spot, satisfying my craving without overwhelming sweetness.

input: I LOVE this place!  I have been coming here for a few years now. Young atmosphere, loud dance music, and SAKI!
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adore this place! For the past few years, it has become my go-to destination. input: We absolutely love everything we have tried here. Our favorite thus far has been the Backyard Bowl, although there are several more that we still need to try. input: It's was okay service was a bit on the interesting side as the person was new. Food presentation was good though they need to either add rice or more potato salad to the gumbo. Sprite was flat but I didn't need it anyways.

input: This is a pretty good pancake place, but it's a little disorganized in the way it's run when it's really busy. The pancakes are pretty good but super sweet, so you have to be in there. input:

input: We've been coming here since I was a kid. The staff has watched me and now my kids grow up. They're personable and so nice. They're also very prompt with service. input:
Dine-in gets 2 stars. Disappointing service & venue falls short. 

The food was ok; so if you were to do take out, maybe this place would get 3 stars. 

I ordered the lamb kebab, which tasted ok; but it was very plain. No sauces, lettuce or anything - just meat.

The overall dining experience at this establishment merits a modest 2-star rating due to disappointing service and a lackluster venue. input: The best middle eastern restaurant in this area!! Food is great and consistent!! Makes my tummy happy!!!
Revise this with your best effort: Come and experience the unparalleled culinary delights of the finest Middle Eastern restaurant in this area! input: I cannot even believe someone gave this place one star. Here's the scoop. They have the BEST cannoli in the city. Termini's are no where NEAR as good, and Isgro's is far too hyped up for the quality. Potito's is my go to for cannoli, i wouldn't even THINK about going anywhere else. I'm there every xmas eve, and will be for the rest of my days. I stood in line for isgros for TWO HOURS this year for a tirimisu, i walked right into potito's and picked up my bambino cannoli stuffed cannoli. it's as good as it sounds, trust me.
Revise this with your best effort: I'm absolutely astounded that someone would give this place only one star. Let me tell you why. This place offers the most exceptional cannoli in the entire city. Termini's doesn't even come close in terms of quality, and Isgro's is simply overrated. When it comes to cannoli, Potito's is my absolute favorite and I can't even fathom going anywhere else. I make it a point to be there every Christmas Eve, and that tradition will continue for the rest of my life. This year, I wasted two hours in line at Isgro's for a mediocre tiramisu, while I could have easily walked into Potito's and enjoyed their outstanding bambino cannoli stuffed with delightful flavors. You have my word, it's even better than it sounds. Trust me on this one.

input: Truly, I cannot say enough good things about this tiny, authentic, perfectly delicious eatery!  Growing up in the panhandle of Texas, we had plenty of authentic Mexican food in our home, and I'm always searching for good Mexican restaurants. El Limon is the best I've ever had in the state of Pennsylvania!  Sopes, tostadas, enchiladas, fajitas, burritos, fish tacos....all excellent and sooooo reasonable!  Waitstaff is always pleasant and attentive.  Best two features: homemade tamales and free margaritas!!  Bring the entire family for an amazing Mexican feast!  Ole!
Revise this with your best effort: Without a doubt, I cannot emphasize enough how truly exceptional this charming, genuine, and exquisitely appetizing eatery is! Having grown up in the panhandle of Texas, where delectable, bona fide Mexican cuisine was a staple in our household, I find myself constantly on the lookout for remarkable Mexican restaurants. El Limon, located in the state of Pennsylvania, surpasses them all! Their menu boasts an array of outstanding dishes including sopes, tostadas, enchiladas, fajitas, burritos, and fish tacos, each one executed to perfection and offered at incredibly reasonable prices. The waitstaff is consistently affable and attentive, ensuring a pleasant dining experience. Yet, the two features that truly solidify El Limon as an unparalleled establishment are their delectable homemade tamales and the added delight of complimentary margaritas! Delight in a phenomenal Mexican feast with your entire family at this extraordinary gem. Bravo!

input:
I'm giving this joint 4 stars because they have earned it, but they are definitely 5 star material, if they work out a few kinks. Granted, they just opened, so some of the errors I've experienced (I work in the area, so I've been there several times) will probably get worked out and they are more than willing to make corrections and accommodations when they mess up. 

But over all, the food is REALLY good. Unlike my fellow Yelp-ers, I would say that ther pizza is not their strong suit - its kinds greasy and not sure if they use 100% mozzarella - tastes like its cut with something cheaper. However, so far I've had:  

The Quaker (Chicken version) - Delicious. They make their chicken steaks with the chunky chicken, which I like much more than the shredded version. They could season the chicken more, but the cheese was melted perfectly and the veggies were fresh. 

The fries - crisp and flavorful. I didn't even need ketchup, and I always eat ketchup on my fries

The onion rings - a little greasy, but very tasty and crisp. The onions stayed in the breading and didn't slide out when you bit them (which I hate). 

Spanakopita - mine was a little over cooked, but the flavors were really good

Baklava - VERY GOOD! 

Signature Salad - The veggies they use are very fresh which will make or break a salad. Their balsamic is great too!

The (turkey) Greek Burger - one of the best turkey burgers I've ever had! The patty was moist and flavorful all on its own, but then they top it with what must be homemade tzatziki. I could eat a bowl of that stuff! My burger had romaine instead of the advertised arugula, but it was very fresh, so I didn't mind as much. I also asked for feta, which I didn't get, but that sauce made me forget all about it. 

Overall, this place is great! Provided they don't stray from the high quality standard they are setting, I will keep going back.
Revise this with your best effort:
I am awarding this joint 4 stars because they have undoubtedly earned it; however, they possess the potential to reach 5-star status if they address a few minor flaws. Considering they recently opened, it is expected that some of the issues I've encountered (as someone who frequents the area and has visited multiple times) will gradually be rectified. It is worth mentioning that they are more than willing to make adjustments and accommodations when they make mistakes.

All things considered, the food is truly impressive. Although contrary to other reviewers on Yelp, I must admit that their pizza is not their forte - it tends to be a bit greasy and I suspect they may not use 100% mozzarella as it has a cheaper taste. However, I have thoroughly enjoyed the following items so far:

- The Quaker (Chicken version): This dish is simply delicious. They prepare their chicken steaks with chunks of chicken, which I prefer over the shredded version. The chicken could benefit from additional seasoning, but the cheese is melted flawlessly and the vegetables are fresh.

- The fries: Crispy and bursting with flavor, these fries require no ketchup - and I typically drown my fries in it.

- The onion rings: Although slightly greasy, they are undeniably tasty and maintain a satisfying crunch. Unlike other places where the onions tend to slip out when you take a bite, these onion rings expertly retain their shape.

- Spanakopita: While mine was slightly overcooked, the flavors were undeniably delightful.

- Baklava: An absolute treat! The baklava at this joint is nothing short of exceptional.

- Signature Salad: A salad's success hinges on the freshness of its vegetables, and this joint certainly delivers. Additionally, their balsamic dressing is superb.

- The (turkey) Greek Burger: By far one of the best turkey burgers I have ever tasted! The patty was moist and full of flavor on its own, but then it is topped with what I can only assume is homemade tzatziki sauce - I could easily devour a bowl of that stuff! Although my burger featured romaine instead of the advertised arugula, it was undeniably fresh, so I didn't mind as much. I did request feta, which was unfortunately absent, but the sauce made me completely forget about it.

To sum it up, this place is truly exceptional! As long as they maintain the high quality standard they have set, I will continue to be a loyal customer.

input:
Planet fitness gets four stars just because it is open 24 hours. If you are looking at cheapest it's cheapest best bang for your buck . Not much motivation since bodybuilders don't go there much mostly big women . No pun intended . No discrimination I myself used to be big, although I changed that . 
Tanning bed and massage chairs and a sculpt machine and everything. Else for 20.00 a month . 9.99 - the massage and stuff and can't bring friends . All the employees are polite and helpful .
Revise this with your best effort: Planet Fitness receives four stars primarily due to its 24-hour accessibility, making it highly convenient for individuals with different schedules. Moreover, it stands out as an affordable option, offering the best value for your money. While it may lack the same level of motivation found in bodybuilder-focused gyms, it caters well to a larger demographic, including many amazing women who are pursuing their fitness goals. It is worth mentioning that I myself have transformed my own physique, so I can speak to the positive impact the gym has had on my journey. The lower-priced option of $9.99 excludes access to the massage and additional perks, but regardless, the staff at Planet Fitness remains consistently polite and helpful.

input:
Very disappointed. We went to eat  at 2:15 on Saturday and were told the kitchen closed at 2. Their website says: Sat & Sun all day. Their website claims that they are open until 5.
I'm always a bit suspect of places that can't manage simple details like their hours on their website. It makes me wonder about the awareness to quality and other "small" items.
Revise this with your best effort:
I am extremely disappointed with my recent dining experience. My friends and I arrived at the restaurant at 2:15 on Saturday, only to be informed that the kitchen had already closed at 2. This was incredibly frustrating considering their website clearly stated that they were open all day on Saturdays and Sundays. According to their online information, their operating hours extended until 5 PM.

Instances like these make me skeptical of establishments that fail to handle such basic details like updating their website accurately. It raises concerns about their commitment to maintaining high standards and attention to even the smallest aspects of their business.

input: These guys do good work, on time, and warranty their work.  I would highly recommend them!

input: Eat here at least 2 times a week. Servers are always friendly and the food is amazing. I never leave disappointed & always leave with a full stomach
Revise this with your best effort: Make it a point to dine here at least twice a week for an exceptional experience. The servers consistently exude friendliness, and the culinary offerings never fail to amaze. Each visit leaves me utterly satisfied, with a contented belly and a smile on my face.

input:
A truly delightful find! This is the transformed Carrow's Restaurant on Plumb and Kietzke that was saved by the wrecking ball by its beautiful redwood beams and fascia. The food was fantastic. My wife had the tri-tip salad -- greens on one side of the plate with a balsamic vinagrette balanced by four good-sized slices of medium-rare tri-tip and potato "croutons" --
little heavenly bits of crunchy potatoes. I had the tri/tip/chicken combo, selecting the fresh corn salad and potato salad as my two sides. It was so good that we ordered dessert as well (not something I do regularly). The offering was lemon meringue, mudd pie, apple pie, and ice cream. We shared the first -- again delicious, with real, perfectly set and browned meringue. The prices were very reasonable for the quality of food and the experience. We've already recommended to family and friends locally, and expect to return soon. Well done!
Revise this with your best effort:
A truly delightful discovery! We stumbled upon the revamped Carrow's Restaurant on the intersection of Plumb and Kietzke, and boy, were we in for a treat. This charming establishment was spared from the wrecking ball, and its stunning redwood beams and mesmerizing fascia were a feast to the eyes.

Now, let's talk about the food. Prepare to be blown away. My wife opted for the tri-tip salad, a divine creation comprised of a bed of fresh greens accompanied by a balsamic vinaigrette that struck a perfect balance. But that's not all – four generous slices of melt-in-your-mouth, medium-rare tri-tip adorned the plate, along with delectable potato "croutons" that were like heavenly bites of crispy bliss.

As for me, I went for the ultimate indulgence – the tri-tip and chicken combo. To accompany this glorious combination, I selected the corn salad bursting with freshness and the classic potato salad. Each bite was a revelation, an explosion of flavors that left me yearning for more. In fact, our experience was so exceptional that we couldn't resist ordering dessert, a rare indulgence for me. The choices were tempting: lemon meringue, mud pie, apple pie, and ice cream. We decided to share the lemon meringue, and oh boy, it exceeded our wildest expectations. The meringue was flawlessly set and beautifully golden, offering a perfect complement to the tangy lemon filling.

What amazed us even more was the reasonable prices considering the top-notch quality of the food and the unforgettable dining experience. We wasted no time in recommending this gem to our local family and friends, and we're already planning our next visit. Hats off to you, Carrow's Restaurant, for a job perfectly executed!

input:

She loves the special role she plays as Doula to laboring woman!!  She finds beauty and strength in that magical time.

input: Recently had my car tinted by Orange Tint and Tune and had fantastic service.  They offer a car pick up service if you live within 4 miles of their shop which is extremely convenient.  Carlos was my technician and went over all the tint options with me and even adjusted the grade of the tint after I expressed the look that I was trying to achieve. input: Stayed here three nights on business.  The property is located very close to the airport but you really don't hear it.  The rooms are standard TownePlace Suite rooms with a refrigerator, stove, etc..  The area in which the hotel is located is quiet with a combination of other hotels and office buildings.  It's about a 20 minute drive to the downtown or university area.  About 5-10 minutes from Pima Air Museum.  There are not too many restaurants close by but there are some fast food options and a sandwich place called Baggins that was really good and within walking distance.  The staff of the hotel was really friendly and helpful.  The breakfast is standard continental with a couple of hot options. They also have a reception on weekday evenings.  My only complaint is that the food and drink go quickly so get there early.  You could use this as a dinner if you wanted.  I got there about 45 minutes after it started and although there was food left there were very few soft drinks left (no diet).  They could improve by keeping the area stocked throughout the period.  Anyway, the rooms are nice, beds are comfortable and area is safe.
Revise this with your best effort:
I had the opportunity to stay at this hotel for three nights during a business trip. The property is conveniently located near the airport, but surprisingly, the noise from the planes did not disturb my stay at all. The rooms themselves are typical TownePlace Suite rooms equipped with all the necessary amenities like a refrigerator and stove. The hotel is situated in a quiet area surrounded by other hotels and office buildings. While it takes around 20 minutes to drive to the downtown or university area, it is only about a 5-10 minute drive to the Pima Air Museum.

In terms of dining options, there aren't too many restaurants in close proximity to the hotel. However, there are a few fast food options available, and I highly recommend trying out a sandwich place called Baggins, which is conveniently within walking distance. The staff at the hotel were incredibly friendly and helpful, which added to the overall positive experience.

When it comes to breakfast, the hotel offers a standard continental spread along with a couple of hot options. Additionally, on weekday evenings, they also host a reception for guests. My only complaint in this regard is that the food and drink offerings tend to disappear quickly, so it's advisable to arrive early to secure your preferred options. In fact, the reception can even be considered a complete dinner alternative if desired. Personally, I arrived about 45 minutes after it started and while there was still food available, there were very limited soft drink options left, especially diet ones. It would be beneficial if the hotel made an effort to keep the area stocked throughout the entire duration of the reception.

Nevertheless, the rooms themselves are pleasant, boasting comfortable beds, and the area surrounding the hotel feels safe.

input:
We got diverted to Tampa and decided to make the drive to Orlando but first we needed somewhere to eat. Wanting to avoid chain restaurants, yelp steered us towards this little local gem!

The ladies had the 7 oz. Tampa strip and the gents both had a 14 oz. ribeye. They grill their steaks over oak and citrus Wood and the smoky flavor is to die for! We are big fans of our smoker back home and cook our steaks this way as well, it's rare to find steak cooked over woodsmoke in most places and this was worth the side trip!  Sides were veggies and sweet potatoes. The wines on offer were so reasonably priced- most under $20 a bottle but a decent selection. They just don't mark them up 5x like most places! 

Our waitress Lisa also made great recommendations and her service was welcoming, friendly, and excellent. We are so glad we went local instead of to a chain. Bookmarking this place for a return trip next time I am in Tampa for sure!
Revise this with your best effort:
After being diverted to Tampa, we decided to take a drive to Orlando but needed to grab a bite beforehand. Wanting to steer clear of chain restaurants, we turned to Yelp for guidance and discovered this hidden local gem!

The ladies opted for a mouthwatering 7 oz. Tampa strip, while the gentlemen savored the flavors of their 14 oz. ribeye. What sets this place apart is that they grill their steaks over a perfect combination of oak and citrus wood, resulting in a smoky flavor that simply cannot be beat! Being avid fans of our smoker back home, we were pleasantly surprised to find steak prepared over woodsmoke, something that's hard to come by in most establishments. It undoubtedly made our detour worth it! As for sides, we relished in the deliciousness of veggie dishes and sweet potatoes. And let's not forget about their wine selection - reasonably priced, with most bottles under $20, and a decent variety. Unlike most places, they don't excessively mark up their prices!

Our waitress, Lisa, deserves a special mention for her exceptional service. Her warm, friendly demeanor and fantastic recommendations added to our dining experience. Choosing to support a local joint instead of opting for a chain restaurant was definitely the right call. We have already made a mental note to revisit this place the next time we find ourselves in Tampa.

input:

input: Came here after my husband bought home their lemon pepper wings. They have plenty of flavors. In addition to their flavorful food, they also serve fantastic drinks. I highly recommend trying their refreshing watermelon drink, it's truly amazing. Overall, I encourage everyone to give this place a chance. Who knows, you might even bump into Skip while you're there.

input:
Back to Tom Jones and time to update my review. I didn't see that odd ATM type machine that only lets you withdraw money to apply to your check. It's no longer there-used to be next to restrooms. There is still a payphone back there which I love. There are now ATM's at front entrance.
  The blue ribbon is now $3.79, but still a bargain since it includes everything: pancakes, 2 eggs, toast, sausage, bacon,juice & coffee. I ate here with my kids. My daughter's choice. Says she "loves Tom Jones". Our meals included blue ribbons, french toast, chicken, club sandwich & baked potato . Everyone gets what they like.

input:
I've been wanting to try Trust Me BBQ for over a year now.  I stopped in there about 3 months ago and waited in line for 10 minutes with no service and left.  After reading reviews, I figured I'd give it a chance again just to see what all the fuss is about.  The food was 50/50 but the service was horrible so I'll likely never return.  The gentleman behind the counter didn't speak, smile or engage with us at all, I felt like I was at a vending machine.  Once we finally ordered, he didn't even listen to the order and put the wrong sides in our meals, we had to correct him while he was serving.  All in all, I will just stick with Down to the Bone BBQ

Pros:  BBQ Sauce is delicious, macaroni salad was different and interesting, "pulled" pork was moist.

Cons:  Chicken was more dry than a sheet of paper, inedible even with the BBQ Sauce.  Mac & Cheese was served from a pan that has probably been on the steam table for 2-3 days.  Collard Greens were very mildly flavored.
Revise this with your best effort:
I've been eager to give Trust Me BBQ a try for over a year now. However, my first visit a few months ago left me disappointed. I waited in line for a solid 10 minutes without receiving any service, so I decided to leave. Still, after reading some positive reviews, I decided to give it another shot just to see what all the hype was about. Unfortunately, the experience fell short once again. While the food had its moments, the service was absolutely horrendous, and I doubt I will ever return.

The gentleman behind the counter didn't display any kind of customer interaction - no words, no smile, nothing that made me feel welcomed. It felt more like dealing with a vending machine than a person. Even when we finally managed to place our order, he didn't pay attention and ended up getting our sides wrong. We had to correct him while he was serving us.

To be fair, there were a few highlights. The BBQ sauce was absolutely delicious, and the macaroni salad had a unique and interesting flavor. The "pulled" pork was also pleasantly moist. However, the negatives outweighed the positives. The chicken was drier than a sheet of paper and practically inedible, even with the BBQ sauce to mask the dryness. The mac and cheese seemed like it had been sitting in a steam table pan for several days, making it less than appetizing. Additionally, the collard greens lacked a distinct and flavorful taste.

Given these factors, I think I'll just stick with Down to the Bone BBQ.

input:
This small little donut bakery is located in one of Hermitage's oldest shopping centers! 

I can imagine baking donuts is a hard job, let alone running the business...it's one of those jobs that starts in the wee hours of the morning so that the donuts are freshly made daily!

Yeu, the owner, serves not only your common popular donuts, but he also serves donuts with bacon on top, apple fritters, pigs in a blanket, breakfast pastries, and  kolaches....in addition to these yummy treats...he makes doughssants....they are what seems to be a scandalous marriage of a donut and a croissant...!!!!!!!! Need I say more? Yeah...you heard me. A doughssant! Worth the trip just to eat one of these! 

Prices are considerably cheap! The doughssants are only $1.99 each! The regular donuts are about $.60 each! 

These sweet donuts are my favorite treats to buy for my kid's school teachers...and they love them! 

Coffee also served here!
Revise this with your best effort:
Located in one of Hermitage's oldest shopping centers, this charming little donut bakery truly captures the essence of a hardworking, small-town business. The laborious task of baking donuts begins in the early hours of the morning, ensuring that each treat is freshly made daily.

Yeu, the talented owner, not only offers the usual beloved donut varieties but also introduces unique creations such as bacon-topped donuts, apple fritters, pigs in a blanket, breakfast pastries, and kolaches. As if that isn't tempting enough, he has ingeniously concocted a sinful offspring of a donut and a croissant called a doughssant. Yes, you heard it right - a doughssant! Just the description is enough to make you want to rush over and experience it for yourself.

Surprisingly, the prices at this delightful establishment are extremely affordable. Indulging in a doughssant will only cost you $1.99, and the regular donuts are priced at around $.60 each. It's a sweet steal that leaves both your taste buds and your wallet satisfied.

Speaking of satisfaction, these delightful donuts have become my go-to treats for my children's school teachers. The teachers adore them just as much as my kids do. There is something truly heartwarming about knowing that your token of appreciation brings joy to others.

To complete the ultimate morning indulgence, the bakery also serves delectable coffee. So whether you're treating yourself or sharing the love with others, this small donut bakery is a must-visit destination that promises a delightful start to any day.

input:
Went here based on the high ratings and raves from people.  The entire experience was underwhelming from start to finish.  Their website which is fairly useless if you want to figure out the menu before going, you have to pick your location choice out of 3 locations and then drill down to the bottom to see the weak descriptions of their menu offering, no explanations and no price, just this

    Roast Beef
    Roast Beef Combo
    Roast Pork
    Roast Pork Combo
    Baked Ham
    Baked Ham Combo
    Roast Turkey
    Roast Turkey Combo
    Broccoli Rabe
    Broccoli Rabe Combo


No explanation of whats in a combo (its just where they add cheese by the way)

The table placecard (instead of menu) had a more detailed description than the website.  

When I walked in, its more bar than restaurant, no big deal, but there were tables.  Since I couldnt decide and the sandwiches werent too expensive at $6.85, I got the roast beef and roast port combos.

I got my two sandwiches fast enough, but the roast beef was cold and the roast pork was hot.  Not sure how a cook (for lack of a better word) could serve 2 things at the same time with such a temperature differential, one was obviously sitting for awhile.  I asked the waitress to reheat the roast beef while I finished the roast pork, and supposedly it was reheated, since it was warmer, but it was still cold-ish compared to my roast pork I had just finished.  The waitress did offer to replace it when she inquired, but I was in a hurry and didnt really care for a hot version of this sandwich.

The sandwiches were very skimpy on meat, but they "made up for it" by adding too much gravy to make it overly messy and the bread was disintegrating.  The menu place card mentions the "wet meat" option where you get less gravy, I strongly recommend you get it that style, especially if the gravy overpower the meat and structural integrity of the sandwich.
Revise this with your best effort:
I visited this place based on its high ratings and the rave reviews from people. However, the entire experience turned out to be underwhelming from start to finish. One of the major letdowns was their website, which I found fairly useless when trying to figure out the menu before going. I had to select my preferred location out of three options and then scroll all the way down to find weak descriptions of their menu offerings. There were no explanations or prices listed, just a simple list of items like roast beef, roast pork, baked ham, roast turkey, broccoli rabe, etc. Moreover, the website failed to clarify what exactly a "combo" included (it turns out they just add cheese).

Oddly enough, the table place card provided more detailed descriptions of the items than the website did. When I walked into the establishment, it felt more like a bar than a restaurant, which was no big deal for me since they still had tables. Unable to decide among the options and considering the relatively low price of $6.85 for a sandwich, I ended up ordering both the roast beef and roast pork combos.

Although the sandwiches were served promptly, I was disappointed to find that the roast beef was cold while the roast pork was hot. It baffled me how the cook or chef could serve two items simultaneously with such a drastic temperature difference. Clearly, one of the sandwiches had been sitting out for a while. I called the attention of the waitress and requested that they reheat the roast beef while I finished the roast pork. Supposedly, it was reheated, as it was slightly warmer, but it still remained somewhat cold in comparison to the roast pork I had just finished. The waitress did apologize and offered to replace the sandwich when she noticed the issue, but given my time constraints, I declined the offer and wasn't particularly interested in a reheated version of the same sandwich.

To make matters worse, the sandwiches were disappointingly skimpy on meat. They attempted to compensate by adding an excessive amount of gravy, which made the sandwiches overly messy and caused the bread to disintegrate. Interestingly, the menu on the place card mentioned a "wet meat" option where you receive less gravy. I highly recommend ordering it that way, especially since the excessive gravy tends to overpower both the meat and the structural integrity of the sandwich.

input: Love this store!  Who doesn't!  The salad bar is fresh and they have all types of ethnic food to try.  N-JOY
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adore this store! It's hard not to. The salad bar is always stocked with fresh and delicious options, and they offer a wide array of ethnic cuisines to explore and savor. Truly a delightful experience to be had. N-JOY!

input: Called in a Mediterranean chicken shawarma. Good flavor and they were generous with the amount of chicken in the pita. The food was ready to go when I arrived. Good service. I would revisit the next time I am in the area.
Revise this with your best effort: I had the pleasure of trying the Mediterranean chicken shawarma, and I must say it exceeded my expectations in terms of flavor. Not only that, but they were very generous with the amount of succulent chicken stuffed in the warm pita bread. The entire experience was enhanced by their efficient service, as the food was ready for me when I arrived. Based on this positive encounter, I am eager to visit again during my next trip to the area.

input: I love this place.  The food is great and the space and staff are very pleasant.  Highly recommended for vegetarians and non-vegetarians alike.
Revise this with your best effort: I am absolutely thrilled with this place! The exceptional food, coupled with the delightful ambiance and friendly staff, make it an absolute gem. Whether you prefer vegetarian or non-vegetarian options, I wholeheartedly recommend this place to everyone.

input: Took a while to get actual service but once we did I was happy. The gumbo was awesome and loved the chicken & waffles. Friendly staff and right on Bourbon St for good people watching!
Revise this with your best effort: It took quite some time to receive the actual service, but once it arrived, I found myself delighted. The gumbo was truly outstanding, and I thoroughly enjoyed every bite of the chicken and waffles. The staff was friendly and accommodating, and the location right on Bourbon Street was perfect for enjoying the lively people-watching scene.

input:
As airport grab-and-go restaurants are, Earl does a decent job with a variety of sandwich options including turkey, tuna and even a Hawaiian. But today I could smell the roast beef and so I got that one. Yum. Good portion of sliced beef that was beyond medium cooked with cheddar cheese and a yummy horseradish sauce. Nope, don't get lettuce or tomatoes on it. It's perfect the way it is.

And since it's right between the security station and the top of the D gates (right near the Delta SkyClub!), it's easy to get and eat at the gate or on board.
Revise this with your best effort:
Earl, the airport grab-and-go restaurant, impresses with its decent selection of sandwich options such as turkey, tuna, and even Hawaiian. Today, however, the enticing aroma of roast beef caught my attention, compelling me to choose that particular sandwich. And boy, was I glad I did! The generous portion of sliced, beyond-medium cooked beef paired divinely with cheddar cheese and a delectable horseradish sauce. No need for any additional toppings such as lettuce or tomatoes - it's absolutely perfect as is.

Furthermore, being conveniently situated between the security station and the top of the D gates (right near the Delta SkyClub!), it's incredibly convenient to grab a bite either at the gate or even on board the aircraft.

input: WOW!  What a fantastic place!  Food A+, Service A+++  We started with an appetizer of cheese curds served with a red pepper jelly.  LOVED IT!  I ordered the fish tacos and the wife ordered a beer brat for dinner.  We both thoroughly enjoyed what we ordered!  The portions were huge and priced just right for the portion size.  Our server was on it!  Very attentive and was very knowledgeable about the menu and made us feel very welcomed.  The manager stopped by and asked how everything was.  I let him know that I am pretty sure I have found a cool new place to hang out, have a beer and watch football.  He said they have great deals on game days and let us know about their brunch on the weekends.  Everyone said goodbye as we walked out and reminded us to grab a rootbeer candy on our way out.  I will be back!
Revise this with your best effort:
Wow! What an incredible establishment! The food here deserves an A+ rating, and the service goes beyond that with an impressive A+++. Our culinary journey began with a delectable appetizer of cheese curds accompanied by a delightful red pepper jelly. We absolutely adored it!

For our main courses, I opted for the mouthwatering fish tacos, while my wife indulged in a heavenly beer brat. Both dishes left us thoroughly satisfied and impressed. The portions were generous, perfectly priced, and left us feeling content. 

Our server went above and beyond, displaying remarkable attentiveness and an extensive knowledge of the menu. They genuinely made us feel welcome throughout the entire dining experience. Even the manager took the time to check on us and inquire about our satisfaction. I couldn't resist sharing my excitement about discovering this amazing place, as I mentioned to him that it seemed like the perfect spot to unwind, enjoy a beer, and watch football. To my delight, he informed us about their fantastic game day deals and mentioned their delightful brunch options available on weekends.

As we left, the staff bid us farewell and kindly reminded us to grab a delicious rootbeer candy on our way out. I am already looking forward to my next visit to this outstanding establishment.

input:
I stopped in for dinner and a drink & was thoroughly pleased! I rarely order a burger when I go out to eat, because why order "out" what you can make easily a home, right? Well..... when I go back I'll have a hard time NOT getting another burger. Oh, they also have a decent beer selection and the wait staff/bartenders made me feel very welcomed too.  My food was prepared exactly as I ordered and was served quickly.  The restaurant has a nice atmosphere and the restrooms were clean.  All in all I was very happy!
.
Revise this with your best effort: I had the pleasure of stopping by for dinner and a drink, and it exceeded my expectations! Normally, I wouldn't choose to order a burger when dining out, as it can easily be made at home. However, after experiencing their delicious burger, I can't resist getting it again when I return. Additionally, their beer selection was impressive, and the wait staff and bartenders made me feel extremely welcomed. The food was prepared exactly as I requested and arrived promptly. Moreover, the restaurant had a delightful atmosphere, and the restrooms were spotless. Overall, my experience was incredibly satisfying, and I left feeling very content.

input:
Too big, too expensive and too far from Downtown.  

I was here for a conference, which seemed like an awesome idea. It wasn't.  I'm in Direct Sales and (like most people at this conference) don't have tons of extra money to spend on mediocre meals when I'm traveling.  $10 for a slice of generic pizza, small side salad and a soda for lunch.   I understand it's a hotel but there weren't any options close by.  Just getting your car from valet was a hassle and took a lot of time.  Being such a big property, it made getting to restaurants off the property really time intensive.  Since you're so far out of Nashville (out near the airport), the good little holes you find when you're in a city are pretty nonexistent.  

The property itself was great.  The hotel is HUGE but really pretty.  I enjoyed walking around but was really happy when I found what I didn't know existed...a shortcut between my room and the Convention Center.  It took my 10-15 minute walk down to about 3 minutes!  BONUS!  Like I said, this place is ginormous.  

Room: Our room was great.  I shared a wonderful suite in the Garden Conservatory with 2 other girls.  We were under a group rate and my friend was quoted $200/night, which is awesome for the space we had.  We had a large room (probably used as a hospitality suite for groups) for socializing.  It had a great bar area set-up and a nice big fridge and lots of drawer space.  Our bedroom was separated by doors that could be locked from either side (like an adjoining room), so it looked like the hospitality suite could be reserved without reserving the room.  It was different than what I was expecting, but whatevs.  It was fine.  So, I wasn't there at check-in.  The girl who reserved the room checked in a couple days earlier than my friend and I.  So, Sunday comes, and the bill was waiting for us when we woke up.  Our friend was charged $1200 for one room (I'm guessing the suite) and $1400 for the other room.  YEP.  She reserved what she thought was a 2 room suite for $200.  The bedroom door was closed when she got there and she asked them to open it up. It was all arranged by the bellman.  She was never told that the bedroom wasn't included....kind of necessary if you're staying over for 6 nights, dontcha think???  So, she's being charged $2600 for what was supposed to be $1200.  Last I heard, the Gaylord's legal department was investigating what she was told, what she wasn't told and if they should charge her the entire amount.  

Checkout:  A FREAKING NIGHTMARE.  Between the money situation, which was not resolved as of late this week, and the 45 minute wait for a cart (in a hotel that holds thousands of people, you'd think they'd be plentiful and they aren't) and a 25 minute wait for the car, my friend and I decided to sweat it out and schlep our goods to the door where our car would be delivered to us.  It was not a short walk and we had a TON of stuff, which meant multiple trips.  UGH.

I'm sure I'll be back for another conference (I am pretty sure my company has booked this for at least one more year....) but I'm not going to be happy about it.  I might even consider driving down, staying in a hotel somewhere downtown and driving out to the Conference stuff.
Revise this with your best effort:
The Gaylord hotel was disappointing in several ways. Firstly, it was situated too far from Downtown Nashville, making it inconvenient for those attending the conference. Additionally, the hotel was excessively large and expensive, which didn't suit the budget of most attendees, including myself as a Direct Sales professional.

One major frustration was the lack of affordable dining options nearby. With limited extra funds to spend on meals, it was disheartening to pay $10 for a measly slice of pizza, a small side salad, and a soda. While I understand that it's a hotel, the lack of nearby alternatives made it even more frustrating. Even retrieving my car from valet became a tedious and time-consuming task due to the hotel's massive size, which made visiting off-site restaurants an arduous endeavor. Unfortunately, since the hotel is located near the airport, the charming local eateries one usually finds in a city were virtually non-existent.

Despite these drawbacks, the hotel itself was impressive. The enormity of the property was striking, and I appreciated the aesthetic appeal. Exploring the hotel was enjoyable, especially when I stumbled upon an unexpected shortcut between my room and the Convention Center. This shortcut significantly reduced my walking time from a 10-15 minute trek to a mere 3 minutes, which was a pleasant surprise considering the vastness of the property.

Now, onto the room. Our shared suite in the Garden Conservatory was fantastic. With a group rate of $200 per night, we had plenty of space and amenities. The large room, likely intended for group gatherings, featured a well-equipped bar area, a sizable refrigerator, and ample drawer space. To our surprise, the bedroom was separated by lockable doors, resembling an adjoining room. Although not what I had initially anticipated, it sufficed. Unfortunately, I was not present during the check-in process as my friend handled it a few days prior. To our dismay, upon waking up on Sunday, we discovered a bill of $1200 for one room and $1400 for the other. Apparently, our friend was unaware that the bedroom was not included in the reservation, leaving her shocked by the exorbitant charges. This miscommunication had her facing a total bill of $2600 instead of the expected $1200. The confusion prompted an investigation by the Gaylord's legal department to determine the responsibility and rightful amount to be charged.

The nightmare continued during checkout. The unresolved financial situation combined with a frustrating 45-minute wait for a luggage cart (considering the hotel's capacity, one would expect an abundance of them) and an additional 25-minute wait for our car led my friend and me to decide to carry our belongings to the door where our car would eventually be delivered. It was an arduous journey, with multiple trips due to the excessive baggage. Truly exasperating.

Despite my frustrations, it seems as though I'll have to endure another conference at the Gaylord in the future, as my company has already booked it for at least another year. However, I'm already dreading it and considering the option of staying in a downtown hotel and commuting to the conference.

input:
This was my first time dining at Ava and I enjoyed most of it. We ordered the Ricotta cheese & toasted bread and although the flavor was excellent, I thought the bread to cheese ratio was off quite a bit. The ricotta came in a tiny ramekin typically reserved for flavored butters, so I expected more for an appetizer. 

The two pizzas split among a couple of people were the sausage and the potato with rosemary. They were both tasty but I think they forgot the Rosemary on ours. Still yummy, tho! Another entree was the grouper w/Israeli couscous. Scrumptious!

Dessert was a must and the zeppoles, or sugared donuts, were amazing. The cherry tart a little less so, but one person at our table loved it, so maybe it was just not my cup of tea. The cherries were a sort of candied cherry-interesting, but sweet with a very dense crust. Again, just not my personal fave. 

I will definitely return to try other menu items that looked great-like the pastas made in-house daily...that's next!!
Revise this with your best effort:
I thoroughly enjoyed my first dining experience at Ava. Most aspects of the meal were delightful, although there were a few minor flaws. We started off with the Ricotta cheese & toasted bread, which had excellent flavor. However, I felt that the proportion of bread to cheese was slightly imbalanced. The ricotta came served in a small ramekin, typically reserved for flavored butters, leaving me expecting a larger portion for an appetizer.

For our main courses, we decided to try the sausage pizza and the potato with rosemary pizza, both of which were quite tasty. However, it seems they may have forgotten to add the rosemary to the latter. Despite this minor oversight, the pizzas were still enjoyable. Another dish we ordered was the grouper with Israeli couscous, which was simply scrumptious.

Saving room for dessert was a must, and we were not disappointed. The zeppoles, or sugared donuts, were absolutely amazing. On the other hand, the cherry tart fell a bit short for me personally. However, one person at our table thoroughly enjoyed it, so it may have just been a matter of personal preference. The cherries in the tart had an interesting candied flavor, but the crust was very dense and sweet. It simply didn't match my personal taste.

Overall, I left Ava with a positive impression and will certainly be returning to try other enticing menu items, such as their daily made in-house pastas. That will be the next item on my culinary journey at Ava!

input: 1st time eating here. Very clean, nice folks and very good sushi.  Would and will go back. Service was spot on, sushi was very fresh and reasonably priced .
Revise this with your best effort: This was my first time dining at this establishment. I was impressed by the cleanliness of the restaurant and the friendliness of the staff. The sushi was exceptionally delicious, and I would definitely return in the future. The service provided was excellent, with attentive staff ensuring a pleasant experience. Furthermore, the sushi was noticeably fresh, and the pricing was reasonable.

input: This place is just the best. If you really have to ask why it's all in the name itself. If u don't like chicken then don't come here bc their birds are fly! Don't forget to try their fried corn on the cobs. It's dank!
Revise this with your best effort: This location is absolutely exceptional. The reasoning is quite apparent in its name. If you do not possess a fondness for chicken, it is advised to refrain from visiting, as their poultry offerings are truly remarkable. Additionally, I highly recommend indulging in their delectable fried corn on the cob. It is an absolute delight!

input: REALLY below average food.  Akin to waffle house.  I wanted this to be good based on the reviews but not so.  The pancakes tasted like a frozen processed version, "homemade" maple syrup was watery/sugary with fake flavoring.  Trees make authentic syrup, not people.  The hash browns were greasy and fairly tasteless. The bacon overcooked, hard and chewy.  Obviously had been sitting awhile. Overall, very uninspired food.  Unfortunately, this is one of those places that is living on an outdated "must go" reputation.  There are much better offerings in Nashville.
Revise this with your best effort: The food at this establishment falls well below average, reminiscent of a typical Waffle House experience. Despite high expectations due to positive reviews, the disappointing reality sets in. The pancakes lacked the delicious homemade taste one would hope for, resembling instead a frozen processed version. The so-called "homemade" maple syrup was disappointingly watery and overly sweet, with an artificial flavor that pales in comparison to the authenticity of syrup made from actual trees. The hash browns proved to be greasy and lacking in any notable taste. Additionally, the overcooked and chewy bacon seemed to have been left out for a prolonged period, further diminishing its quality. Overall, the food lacked inspiration and failed to deliver an enjoyable dining experience. Regrettably, this establishment thrives solely on an outdated reputation as a "must go" spot, while the thriving culinary scene in Nashville offers far superior options.

input: Excellent.  Went there for lunch (the budget option).  Prix fixe menu was tempting.  Wife had the prime rib po'boy with the soup of the day (tomato fennel).  Both were excellent (the po'boy being an upscale interpretation, with gruyere and a really good horseradish sauce).  I had the seafood jamabalaya and seafood gumbo, also excellent (probably the best I've had).
Revise this with your best effort: What a delightful experience! My wife and I decided to visit this place for lunch, opting for the budget-friendly prix fixe menu. We were instantly tempted by the delectable options it offered. My wife chose the prime rib po'boy accompanied by the soup of the day, a delightful tomato fennel blend. Let me tell you, both were absolutely superb! The po'boy, an elevated version with gruyere and a top-notch horseradish sauce, was truly a culinary masterpiece. As for me, I savored the incredible flavors of the seafood jambalaya and seafood gumbo, which I must say were unmatched in taste and quality. In fact, it may very well be the best seafood jambalaya and gumbo I've ever had.

input:
We recently used Pure Design for a large event in a nearby hotel. Pure staff met with me to discuss my budget and offered beautiful, unique flower and arrangement selections. Their estimate came in well within my budget. Their staff was always professional and their expertise was obvious. The day of the event, they created such a gorgeous space with all the beautiful arrangements - our guests raved about them, even days after the event was over! I was also able to take home/give away the arrangements, which is not always the case with other florists. And the flowers lasted several days after the event.

I would highly recommend Pure for a large event.
Revise this with your best effort:
We recently had the pleasure of utilizing the services of Pure Design for a significant event held at a nearby hotel. From the outset, the Pure team held a consultation with me to thoroughly discuss my desired budget, and their recommendations for stunning and distinctive floral arrangements exceeded my expectations. Not only did their estimate fall comfortably within my financial limitations, but their staff consistently exemplified the utmost professionalism and showcased their evident expertise.

On the day of the event, Pure Design transformed the space into an absolute work of art with their breathtaking arrangements. The feedback from our guests was overwhelmingly positive and their praise continued days after the event concluded. What sets Pure apart from other florists is the fact that I had the joy of either taking home or gifting the arrangements, a privilege not always afforded by other establishments. Furthermore, the longevity of the flowers far surpassed our expectations, remaining vibrant and beautiful for several days following the event.

Without reservation, I wholeheartedly endorse Pure Design for those seeking an exceptional floral experience for their own large-scale events.

input: My husband and I are not "spring chickens", but we love to Par-Tee. The server immediately welcomed us and asked about our drink preferences.  He was very knowledgeable and helpful. The beer selection was wonderful, the liquor selection divine.  The bar food, even though it was a small selection, was excellent. I had never wanted to try pork bellies (the name turned me off.) Dan ordered it, I tried it,and we now have a convert.  WE highly recommend their pork belly sliders! I hope they continue to add a few more delicious tapas.  These folks have it together and are very engaging.  We'll be back often.
Revise this with your best effort: Despite not being young, my husband and I thoroughly enjoy socializing and having a great time. As soon as we stepped into the venue, the server warmly greeted us and wasted no time in inquiring about our drink preferences. His expertise and willingness to assist were truly commendable. The wide variety of beers and divine liquor options were simply outstanding. Although the bar food menu was limited, the quality surpassed our expectations. I had always been hesitant to try pork bellies due to its off-putting name, but upon Dan's recommendation, I decided to give it a go. To my pleasant surprise, it was absolutely delicious, and we have now become avid fans. We wholeheartedly endorse their delectable pork belly sliders. Hopefully, they will continue to expand their tapas offerings, as they clearly have a knack for crafting delectable dishes. The staff's attentiveness and charm only added to the overall fantastic experience. We will definitely return to this fabulous establishment on a regular basis.

input:
Average or slightly above, despite the hype.  On the expensive side.  For $10 or $12 you should get fries with your burger, not a large to share for $8.  I had a bison burger. that was the only reason I went there.  Seems we had 1 beer, 1 iced tea, 1 burger, 1 bison burger and split a large fry, for about $37.  Rather ridiculous. And they try to hard to be different or interesting, but ruin a good meal.  The bison burger was tainted with unnecessary slaw and BBQ on it to call it a Carolina bison burger.  Not worth $12 on its own.

Been there.  Done that.  No reason to go back.  Next...
Revise this with your best effort: Despite the excessive hype surrounding it, this place is just average, if not slightly above average. However, it is on the expensive side. It's disappointing to pay $10 or $12 for a burger and only receive a large fry to share for $8. The only reason I went there was for the bison burger, but even that was not worth the price. We ordered one beer, one iced tea, one regular burger, one bison burger, and split a large fry, and the total came to around $37, which is rather ridiculous. The restaurant tries too hard to be different or unique, but it ends up ruining what could have been a good meal. The unnecessary slaw and BBQ on the bison burger, marketed as a Carolina bison burger, were a letdown and not worth the $12 on its own. After having been there and done that, there is no reason to go back. I'm already on to the next place.

input:
Before I share the main issue, I want to share the reason I give any stars is because of our awesome server, LaToya. She was thoughtful and engaging! 

The black bean burger was dry. Sweet potato fries were good. 

Today while at lunch with a group of colleagues the most disturbing thing happened. I noticed the manager in a green sweater lingering around the entrance and then two cop cars with lights flashing pulled up and 3 officers rushed in walked to the table next to us that the manager was pointing to and one of the officer's proceeded to pull out their handcuffs and tell the guy delivering food to put food down at the table and hands behind his back. They escorted him near the front door and had him sit down for a moment before taking him outside in freeZing cold with no jacket where he stood for a few minutes while cops came in and out of restaurant. 

This entire thing was poorly handled, disturbing and unsettling not only to the customers but the other staff. They should have had the cops walk back away from where customers were and deal with it there. Then all the managers disappeared not available to talk to any of the customers let alone apologize or acknowledge people being unsettled. 

No one needs to know why the arrest happened but there needed to be more care for customers and staff in how it was handled. 

Not ok!!!
Revise this with your best effort:
I feel compelled to address a major issue that occurred during my recent dining experience. However, before delving into the matter, I would like to take a moment to acknowledge our exceptional server, LaToya, whose thoughtfulness and engaging personality deserve recognition.

Regrettably, the black bean burger I ordered was disappointingly dry. On a positive note, the sweet potato fries provided a satisfying burst of flavor.

Now, onto a disconcerting incident that unfolded while having lunch with my colleagues today. I couldn't help but notice the presence of a manager wearing a green sweater near the entrance. Suddenly, the tranquility of the establishment was shattered as two police cars, lights flashing, swiftly arrived. Three officers hurried onto the scene, directed by the manager to a neighboring table. To our astonishment, one of the officers proceeded to handcuff the individual who was delivering food to that particular table, instructing him to place the food down and placing his hands behind his back. The accused individual was then escorted to a seat near the front door, left there momentarily before braving the freezing cold without a jacket, under the watchful eye of law enforcement. Meanwhile, numerous policemen frequented the restaurant premises, going in and out.

The entire situation was not only poorly handled, but also deeply unsettling for both customers and staff members present. Proper protocol would have entailed escorting the individual away from the dining area to address the matter discreetly. One would expect a higher level of professionalism and consideration for the well-being of customers and staff. Furthermore, after this distressing ordeal occurred, the managers mysteriously vanished, rendering themselves unavailable to address any concerns, offer an apology, or even acknowledge the profound unease experienced by those present.

This series of events was entirely unacceptable. While we may not require an explanation regarding the arrest itself, it is essential that future incidents are handled with greater care and consideration for the welfare of all individuals involved.

input: Fantastic sliders!! Perfect size that you can try more than one!  Fried chicken slider, BLT slider, monte cristo and Cuban were all fantastic!  Now for Donuts to go!!
Revise this with your best effort: Amazing sliders with a perfect, bite-sized serving that allows you to indulge in more than just one! The fried chicken, BLT, monte cristo, and Cuban sliders were all absolutely fantastic. And now, we eagerly await our sweet adventure with some delectable donuts to go!

input:
They reopened up derived new management.. this was our 3rd time there. They have daily specials, which is a pretty good price, $7.95 for a plate, ice-tea and soup. Todays (Friday)special, they had Carne Asada with rice n beans, fried fish plate and 2 chicken enchiladas with rice n beans, all come with tea n soup. 

We both had the Carne asada plate but they let me substitute my rice n beans for a salad. Steak was pretty good. 

I think their specials are different everyday. So for the most part it was good all around. Oh service was good n attentive.
Revise this with your best effort:
They have recently reopened with a new management team, and this was our third visit to the restaurant. One of the highlights at this place is their daily specials, which are reasonably priced at $7.95 per plate and include ice tea and soup. Today, on Friday, they offered Carne Asada with rice and beans, a fried fish plate, and 2 chicken enchiladas with rice and beans - all served with tea and soup.

Both of us decided to order the Carne Asada plate, but I asked if I could substitute my rice and beans for a salad, which the staff happily accommodated. The steak itself was quite enjoyable.

It seems like they have different specials each day, which adds variety to their menu. Overall, the food was good and satisfying. Additionally, the service provided was attentive and efficient.

input: Love this little shop so much for so many reasons. First off, whenever I'm on my way to Sweet Divas, I can smell the spices wafting from this little, inviting shop. Second, they have such a large range of spices that you can smell, taste a little, and purchase. Yes, there's a large overwhelming variety of spices, but fear not! Their knowledgeable staff is available and more than happy to assist you in finding the right spice you are looking for all your cooking needs. Over the years I've purchased many items from here and I can attest that they do last a long time (about a year, year and a half, including some stuff I use often!). I see all kind of specialty salts for example (onion salt, celery salt) as well as sugars and powders (lavender vanilla sugar, vanilla bean powder). Their products even seem to taste fresher (I can taste a difference between their cinnamon and nutmeg and what I can get at a dollar store, for example). The prices aren't too bad and they last long. My three bottles pictured cost about $19, but that will last a good year, so its worth it to me.
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adore this adorable little shop for countless reasons. Firstly, as I approach Sweet Divas, the delightful aroma of spices from this charming store captivates my senses. Moreover, the extensive selection of spices available allows me to immerse myself in their enticing scents, sample a few, and ultimately make my perfect purchase. Despite the overwhelming variety, there is no need to fret, as their knowledgeable staff is always on hand to assist me in discovering the ideal spice for all my culinary endeavors. Over the years, I have acquired numerous items from this haven, and I can confidently assert that their longevity is impressive, lasting around a year or even longer, including those I frequently use. Notably, I am amazed by their assortment of specialty salts such as onion salt and celery salt, as well as sugars and powders like lavender vanilla sugar and vanilla bean powder. Remarkably, their products possess a distinctive freshness that discernibly surpasses what is typically found at a dollar store, particularly when comparing their cinnamon and nutmeg. Moreover, the prices are quite reasonable given the long-lasting nature of the products. The pictured trio of bottles, for instance, only amounted to about $19, a worthwhile investment for the year ahead.

input: Steve & his partner are the best! Love that he'll do a bunch of demo racquets! Great prices with lots to choose from. If you're a player this is the place to go!
Revise this with your best effort: Steve and his partner are absolutely fantastic! I love that they offer a wide variety of demo racquets at great prices. Whether you're a pro or just starting out, this is undeniably the go-to place for all players.

input: We went around 6 and it was more packed than I expected. I knew it would be busy but I was surprised. The staff was amazing. We waited in line for about 8 minutes regardless of it being a huge line going out side. Found a table and had our food in less than five minutes. Even with the amount of people they had, it ran so smoothly. One sandwich was messed up but it was very loud in there so I don't think she heard me correctly but someone came to our table and had a new correct sandwich almost immediately. I love that they made time to go around asking if we needed refills and how the food was. So glad to have a chick fil a in Reno. They upheld the chick fil a standards even with all the chaos of opening day.
Revise this with your best effort:
When we arrived at 6, the place was far busier than I had anticipated. While I had expected a crowd, I was genuinely surprised by the sheer number of people. However, the standout of the experience was undoubtedly the exceptional staff. Despite the long line that extended outside the establishment, we only had to wait for about 8 minutes. Finding a table was a breeze, and within five minutes, our food was on the table. The efficiency with which they managed such a high volume of customers was truly impressive.

Although there was some noise in the restaurant, making it challenging to communicate effectively, one of our sandwiches was prepared inaccurately. But, without delay, a staff member promptly attended to our issue and provided a replacement that was prepared correctly. I appreciated the attentiveness and quick response.

Moreover, the staff went above and beyond by periodically checking on us to offer refills and inquire about our dining experience. It was evident that they genuinely cared about customer satisfaction. I am thrilled that Chick-fil-A has finally made its way to Reno, and I must commend them for upholding the renowned Chick-fil-A standards, even amidst the chaos of their opening day.

input: Great, beautiful spot to do wine tasting. I loved all the wines I tried, great prices as well as service. I had a good
Revise this with your best effort: time enjoying the picturesque and enchanting environment while indulging in wine tasting at this exceptional location. Every sip of wine I tasted was an absolute delight, and to top it off, the prices were remarkably reasonable. The service provided was impeccable, making my experience even more enjoyable. Overall, I had a phenomenal time, savoring excellent wines and basking in the ambiance of this remarkable spot.

input:
A wee bit pricey for the portions they serve. I come to Beck's for their gator gumbo over jambalaya. The whole thing is just so savory and the spices are just right. It's not overly spicy and not too salty as well. It's a great meal. The gator is in a sausage form. All chopped up into the gumbo. During this visit, I had to order their pasta. Chicken alfredo, for my 2 year old son. It was alright. The whole pasta tasted a bit dry. It's something I wouldn't get twice.

Verdict - Gator gumbo, end of story.
Revise this with your best effort:
Beck's is a bit on the expensive side considering the portion sizes they offer. However, I continue to visit for one reason: their gator gumbo is outstanding compared to their jambalaya. The flavors of the gumbo are simply divine, with the right balance of savory notes and spices. It manages to avoid being overly spicy or salty, making it a truly satisfying meal. The gator meat, served in sausage form and chopped into the gumbo, adds an extra layer of deliciousness.

During my recent visit, I decided to try their pasta, specifically the chicken alfredo, for my 2-year-old son. Unfortunately, it was just average. The pasta itself felt dry and lacked the desired moisture. It's not something I would choose to order again.

In conclusion, the standout dish at Beck's is undoubtedly their gator gumbo. It's a meal that won't disappoint.

input: I was a little worried about seeing the reviews but everything. Was great! Not long wait time. Staff was nice from walking in the lobby and asking which way to the office, to the office staff.
Revise this with your best effort: Initially, I had some concerns regarding the reviews, however, my experience surpassed all expectations. The wait time was minimal, and the staff demonstrated exceptional hospitality from the moment I entered the lobby and inquired about the office location, all the way through the encounter with the office staff.

input: Hipsters unite!  I've never had a good time at The Taint, despite several people's attempts top tell me otherwise.  I'm not impressed by the apathy here, or the dirty-headed Garden District crapfest of regular clientele.  Boo.
Revise this with your best effort: Attention, hipsters! Let's come together! My experiences at The Taint have consistently fallen short of expectations, even after hearing reassurances from various individuals. The lackadaisical atmosphere and the presence of uninspiring regulars in the grungy Garden District have failed to leave a lasting impression on me. Disappointing, to say the least.

input:
Yea! Another Chick-fil-A!

Just happened to be driving down (up?) Bloomingdale looking for a new spot to eat, and saw this. OK, it's not new food, but it is a new location (opened yesterday).

The parking lot is crazy, like many in FL, but the staff outside kept the drive-thru lanes flowing. I was in line for less than ten minutes. *Every* last employee I talked to, and I talked to six, were pleasant and welcoming, just like every Chick-fil-A I've ever been to.

The food was good of course, although the fries could have been cooked a bit longer. Chick-fil-A sandwhcih was on poojnt, and so was the sweet tea.

Welcome to Bloomingdale CFA!
Revise this with your best effort:
Yes! Another Chick-fil-A to add to the list!

I happened to be driving on Bloomingdale Avenue in search of a new place to grab a meal, and I stumbled upon this gem. Although it may not bring anything new to the menu, it does offer a fresh location, having just opened its doors yesterday.

As expected in Florida, the parking lot was packed with cars, but the efficient staff outside expertly managed the drive-thru lanes, keeping the flow smooth. I was pleasantly surprised to find myself in line for less than ten minutes. Furthermore, every single member of the six employees I interacted with displayed a warm and welcoming attitude, mirroring the exceptional customer service I have come to expect from Chick-fil-A.

The food certainly did not disappoint, as it rarely does. However, if I were to nitpick, I would suggest that the fries could have spent a little more time in the fryer for that perfect crispness. On the bright side, the Chick-fil-A sandwich itself was on point, as was the deliciously refreshing sweet tea.

A warm welcome to Bloomingdale CFA!

input: Cute lil spot on Germantown Ave. I came in craving something sweet and they did not disappoint. There was an array of cookies and bars to choose from, if my memory serves me right. Behind the display of goodies there was a table with clear plastic cups filled with yumminess, labeled "cake scrapple" I was intrigued. They were different kinds of cakes and icings, most likely left over from a bake. There were about 5 different flavors to choose from and I went with my favorite Red Velvet with cream cheese frosting. I also ended up with an M&M cookie, my other fave! It was a nice day so I sat outside on their bench and had a couple bites of goodness! The cookie was great, soft & chewy with those hard candies for texture. The cake was also delicious and moist!
Revise this with your best effort:
