I discovered this charming little spot on Germantown Ave that instantly won me over with its delightful offerings. As soon as I stepped in, my cravings for something sweet were absolutely satisfied. The variety of cookies and bars on display caught my eye, if my memory serves me right. And just behind this delectable array of goodies, I noticed a table adorned with clear plastic cups filled with pure yumminess, labeled "cake scrapple." I was undeniably intrigued.

Upon closer inspection, I realized that these cups contained an assortment of cakes and icings, most likely leftovers from an earlier bake. There were approximately five different flavors to choose from, and without hesitation, I opted for my all-time favorite - Red Velvet with indulgent cream cheese frosting. And just to make my visit even sweeter, I also decided to treat myself to an M&M cookie, another personal favorite.

Taking advantage of the lovely weather, I found a comfortable spot on their bench outside and eagerly indulged in a couple of bites of sheer goodness. The M&M cookie delivered all the qualities I adore in a cookie - soft, chewy, with the added delight of those delightful hard candies providing a satisfying texture. And as for the Red Velvet cake, it was an absolute sensation - utterly delicious and incredibly moist.

Overall, my experience at this adorable little spot on Germantown Ave was beyond pleasing. Whether you're in the mood for a heavenly cookie or a mouthwatering piece of cake, this place will undoubtedly leave you with a smile on your face and a fulfilled sweet tooth.

input: Lots of improvements to this place. Much more comfortable environment now.  The chairs could be a bit more comfortable as it'd be nice to sit through an entire football game. Otherwise, this place has really improved.
Revise this with your best effort: There have been numerous remarkable enhancements made to this establishment, resulting in a significantly more pleasant and comfortable environment. The only aspect that could benefit from further improvement is the level of comfort provided by the chairs, as it would be truly enjoyable to be able to sit through an entire football game without discomfort. Apart from that, it is evident that this place has undergone remarkable improvements.

input: Three stars not because of food, the food is good but, the service is slow. I think they need 1 or 2 more people up front when placing an order if your waiting and not using the kiosk to order.
Revise this with your best effort: I would rate this establishment three stars, and I must clarify that it is not due to the quality of the food, which is actually quite good. However, the service tends to be rather slow. In my opinion, it would greatly benefit from having one or two additional staff members available upfront specifically for taking orders. This would be particularly helpful for customers like myself who prefer to wait and place their orders in person instead of utilizing the kiosk.

input:
Went here when they first opened. They only had one flavor... it wasn't that great. Everything was overpriced and we left spending about 70-80 dollars for three people and it wasn't filling. 
*it is not Cajun style seafood. The sauce tastes like a mixture between buffet style sauces with fish sauce. 
Giving them a solid three because there are better places to eat at
Revise this with your best effort: I visited this place on its opening day, hoping for a delightful experience. Unfortunately, they only offered one flavor which, in all honesty, left much to be desired. Not only were the prices exorbitant, but the portions were meager, leaving the three of us feeling unsatisfied. It's worth mentioning that this establishment does not serve authentic Cajun style seafood, as the sauce resembled a blend of generic buffet sauces infused with fish sauce. Regrettably, I can only rate it a three out of five, as there are certainly superior dining options available elsewhere.

input:
My mother, aunt and myself went on this walking tour of Ybor with stops for good food.  What a nice time!  Our guide,  Raymond was very knowledgeable and friendly.  
It was about 3 hrs long,  we passed that 3 hr mark because we were sidetracked a few times and chit chatted quite a bit, lol. 
We learned great details and background about the early days of tampa, the culture, people and ybor in general,  very informative! Along the way we stopped for food tastings . Everything was great,  especially the stone soup company Cuban sandwich!  I would recommend everyone to go on this tour,  visiting or lived here for years this is a fun adventure.  And for the step counters we chalked up over 5000 steps ! It will help offset all the wonderful calories you take in on the tour haha
Revise this with your best effort:
My mother, aunt, and I had a delightful time going on a walking tour of Ybor, which included stops for delicious food. The tour, which lasted about three hours, exceeded our expectations as we found ourselves engrossed in the fascinating history and culture of Tampa, thanks to our knowledgeable and friendly guide, Raymond. Although we did get sidetracked a few times and engaged in lively conversations, the extra time allowed us to delve into the rich details and background of Ybor, making the experience even more informative.

During the tour, we indulged in various food tastings, and each stop was a treat. However, the standout was undoubtedly the Cuban sandwich from the renowned Stone Soup Company; it was absolutely exceptional. I highly recommend this tour to everyone, whether they are visiting or have been living in the area for years. It truly is an enjoyable adventure that offers a unique perspective on the city.

Furthermore, for those who enjoy tracking their steps, you'll be pleased to know that we managed to accumulate over 5,000 steps throughout the tour. This added benefit certainly helps balance out the delectable calories consumed along the way. So, don't miss out on this wonderful experience!

input: Love the sweet spiral plain pies at Franzones.  Can't go wrong with plain.  I tried the white pizza with onions in addition and it was a pleasant surprise.  The onions were a great addition to the pizza.  Same Franzone's as the Bridgeport one I grew up with.
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adore the delectable spiral plain pies at Franzones. There's something irresistibly satisfying about their simplicity. However, I decided to switch things up and ventured into trying their white pizza with onions, and boy, was I pleasantly surprised. The addition of onions elevated the flavors of the pizza to a whole new level. It's remarkable that this location is the same Franzone's I grew up with in Bridgeport.

input: My18 year old daughter had a severe soar throat. We had seen another fast clinic in a CVS. A few days earlier and recieved a miss diagnosis of a fungus infection. She was prescribed an oral medication that made the condition much worse. We were the only patients at this clinic the entire visit and it took us over 1 hour. The staff were very robotic like in there behavior. I tried to ask a question on the way out and was told I was not aloud to be there. Very strange since I was already there. It felt like I was being hurried out the door. Keeping in mind there were no other patients in the facility during our visit I was confuses about the wait time and gruf  behaviour. I found the experience to be very unfriendly. It is best to have a good primary care physician and avoid these places at all cost.
Revise this with your best effort: My 18-year-old daughter recently experienced a severe sore throat. We visited a fast clinic at a CVS a few days ago, where she had received a misdiagnosis of a fungal infection. Unfortunately, the prescribed oral medication exacerbated her condition. Despite being the only patients present in the clinic during our visit, our entire appointment took over an hour. The staff seemed rather robotic in their behavior, and when I tried to ask a question as we were leaving, I was abruptly told that I wasn't allowed to be there, which felt strange considering I was already present. It seemed as though they were rushing us out the door. Given the lack of other patients at the facility during our visit, I was baffled by the lengthy wait time and the unfriendly demeanor. This experience has reinforced the importance of having a dependable primary care physician, and I highly recommend avoiding these types of clinics whenever possible.

input: The chicken sandwich was phenomenal. Great food for a very industrial area.
Revise this with your best effort: The chicken sandwich surpassed all expectations, truly exceptional. A culinary delight amidst a predominantly industrial locale.

input: We set up an online appt, meeting and transaction was very simple and painless. We opted for a 2hr side by side ride where we had a four-seater with our guide Matt (who by the way was super awesome and informative).  Throughly enjoyed our ride with some superb views.
Revise this with your best effort: We arranged an appointment online for a meeting and transaction, and the process was incredibly easy and trouble-free. We decided on a two-hour side by side ride and were accompanied by our exceptional guide, Matt. Not only was Matt extremely knowledgeable and helpful, but he also made the experience enjoyable by providing us with fascinating information. The ride itself was truly delightful, offering breathtaking views that we thoroughly cherished.

input: Great bar Happy Hour 4-7 every day. Wine & Drafts $3, $5 pizza, $4.50 apps. To-go Dinners and lunches are very reasonable and fast. Staff are as friendly as it gets.
Revise this with your best effort: Join us at our fantastic bar for our incredible Happy Hour, available daily from 4-7pm. Enjoy our wide selection of wine and drafts for only $3, paired perfectly with our mouthwatering $5 pizza. And don't forget about our delectable appetizers for just $4.50. Can't stay? No problem! We offer to-go dinners and lunches at affordable prices, served up fast. Our staff is known for their unfailingly friendly service, making your experience here the best it can be.

input:
I had a horrible experience here. The waiter was great but as I got my appetizer, there was it has a hair in it.
Next the noodles came out mine was fine but my friend has a huge hair in his. I thought he was joking until he told me. After that it ruined my appetite, I gave the noodles back and they didn't even give me a new one, I thought I should've got the food for free at that point.. never eating here again
Revise this with your best effort: My experience at this establishment was extremely disappointing. While the waiter provided excellent service, it quickly took a turn for the worse when I discovered a hair in my appetizer. Unfortunately, the same issue occurred with my friend's order of noodles. Initially, I doubted him until he showed me the hair. This incident completely ruined my appetite. Even after returning the noodles, the restaurant failed to provide a replacement. I believe that considering the circumstances, our meal should have been comped. As a result of this incident, I have decided to never dine at this establishment again.

input: Went here with a friend after having an incredible experience at Laurel and was hoping for more of the same at a slightly less bulgy pricepoint, and oh my, is it worth it...    ITV is the kind of place that i dream about, beautiful small room, dimly lit but you can see ( as opposed to some places) and you want to see everything.  Everything in the room is beautiful including a lot of the staff, (im trying to give you the full picture here).   First thing to hit the table (or bar in this case) was a three dollar beef fat biscuit that was the best thing ive eaten in this city all year.  I verbally communicated that message to Chef Nick Elmi who graced us with his presence in the dining room (just as before at Laurel).    We went on to eat many more things which i will try to name now... Stars were Foie with Apricot Miso, Pork Cheeks with some insanely good vegetables, trout pumpernickel soldiers and one of the best cocktails ive had in a damn long time, the ouroboros.   The are playing around with cold smoking things in there and on their BAR MENU!   Honestly, place is just terrific and i meant to write this review sooner but hey... better late than never.  Now that i think of it, im getting hungry... maybe ill head to East Passyunk for some of the best this city has to offer!
Revise this with your best effort:
After having an amazing dining experience at Laurel, my friend and I decided to check out ITV in the hopes of finding a similar culinary adventure at a more affordable price. And let me tell you, it did not disappoint.

ITV is the kind of place that you dream about. The small room is beautifully decorated, dimly lit but still allowing you to see everything clearly (unlike some places that prefer darkness over visibility). The staff, just like the ambiance, add to the overall perfection of this place. Everyone is not only beautiful but also attentive and friendly, ensuring that you have an exceptional dining experience.

As soon as we sat down, a three-dollar beef fat biscuit, which turned out to be the best thing I've had in the city all year, was promptly served. I couldn't help but express this sentiment to Chef Nick Elmi, who, just like at Laurel, made an appearance in the dining room.

Our culinary journey continued with an array of delicious dishes that I will now attempt to name. The standout stars were the Foie with Apricot Miso, the Pork Cheeks accompanied by incredibly flavorful vegetables, and the trout pumpernickel soldiers. I must also give a special mention to one of the best cocktails I've had in a long time, the ouroboros. It was truly exceptional.

One interesting aspect of ITV is their experimentation with cold-smoking techniques, which they even incorporate into their bar menu. This added element of creativity and innovation only enhances the overall experience.

I meant to write this review sooner, but as they say, better late than never. Reflecting on my experience at ITV has made me hungry all over again. Perhaps I'll make a trip to East Passyunk, known for serving some of the best food in the city, and satisfy my cravings.

input:
I absolutely love this place!

Great hours, impeccably clean, so relaxing.
Revise this with your best effort: I am truly enamored with this place! The hours are absolutely fantastic, and the level of cleanliness is truly impeccable. It provides such a serene and relaxing ambiance.

input: Buckingham Pizza makes the best pizza around, particularly its plain pizza and a few of its specialities -- try the cool ranch pizza. This is a pizza parlor. Don't get fancy....order the pizzas and maybe some sides. While some of the entrees are good (chicken piccata), stay with the pizza and you'll love it.
Revise this with your best effort: Buckingham Pizza is renowned for crafting the most exceptional pizzas in town, with a special emphasis on their delectable plain pizza and a few other unique creations. One must-try delicacy is their tantalizing cool ranch pizza. As a well-established pizza parlor, Buckingham Pizza thrives on simplicity, so don't overcomplicate your order by venturing into other dishes. Although their entrees, like the mouthwatering chicken piccata, earn praise, sticking to their pizzas guarantees a truly remarkable experience that will leave you yearning for more.

input: Best iced latte and beignet we tried. The live music also creates a great atmosphere. We also visited Cafe du Monde but in our opinion Cafe Beignet is much better. The service is also very good and there are hardly ever lines.
Revise this with your best effort: The absolute best iced latte and beignet that we've had thus far was at Cafe Beignet. Not only does the live music enhance the already wonderful atmosphere, but the overall experience surpasses our visit to Cafe du Monde. The exceptional service in conjunction with the minimal wait times further add to our satisfaction.

input:
Fun, no-frills atmosphere, right on the water, where you can watch passersby and dolphins alike, while enjoying great food and accommodating service.

Members of our dining party ranged from a picky 7 year old, to two 40 somethings and a 72 year old grandmother. Captain Bill's had menu choices for everyone in our party, and they even made some ingredient substitutions for us. 

The food arrived hot, fresh, and exactly to our specifications. Wait service and wait time were on point, and we all left the restaurant satisfied and having enjoyed the experience. We'll be back to Captain Bill's next time we visit John's pass. I hope you consider it too!
Revise this with your best effort:
Come and experience the lively and relaxed ambiance of Captain Bill's, situated right by the water's edge. Delight in the mesmerizing views of passersby and playful dolphins while indulging in delectable cuisine and receiving friendly and accommodating service.

Our dining party consisted of individuals spanning various age groups, including a discerning 7-year-old, two vibrant 40-somethings, and a wise 72-year-old grandmother. Remarkably, Captain Bill's catered to the preferences of each member, going as far as making ingredient substitutions upon request.

The food itself arrived promptly, satisfyingly hot, and flawlessly prepared according to our specifications. The wait staff provided exceptional service, ensuring we never lacked attention, and the wait time was impeccably managed. As a result, everyone in our group departed the restaurant fully content, having relished the entire experience.

We eagerly anticipate our return to Captain Bill's during our next visit to John's Pass, and we genuinely hope you will also consider this exceptional establishment.

input: Very good sushi. The peanut avocado roll is a must try. Delicious! I ordered the Volcano roll as well and it was amazing. The service was also great, very friendly customer service. I will definitely visit again even though it's far from where I live. If you find yourself near Valrico, then definitely visit this restaurant. You will not regret it.
Revise this with your best effort: The sushi at this restaurant is exceptional. One dish that is a must-try is the peanut avocado roll – it is simply delicious. I also couldn't resist ordering the Volcano roll, which turned out to be amazing. Not only was the food impressive, but the service was also outstanding. The staff provided friendly and attentive customer service. Despite the distance from my home, I will definitely make a point to visit this restaurant again. If you happen to be in the Valrico area, I highly recommend stopping by. Trust me, you won't be disappointed.

input: It's really a run of the middle as far as Cuban food goes. Not bad but not great either. I work close by so I end up there for lunch quite a bit. It's definitely worth checking out for lunch as their specials change every day and prepared freshly.
Revise this with your best effort: In terms of Cuban cuisine, it falls somewhere in the middle. It's not particularly outstanding, but not disappointing either. Since I work nearby, I often find myself going there for lunch. One aspect that sets it apart is their ever-changing daily specials, which are always freshly prepared. It's definitely worth paying a visit for a satisfying lunch experience.

input: My husband had the 6 oz pepperloin meal and was very happy with it. I had the shrimp kabob meal. There were only 4 shrimp and they were more then well done and very small.  The service was good. The restaurant was not busy.
Revise this with your best effort: My husband thoroughly enjoyed his 6 oz pepperloin meal, finding it to be delightful and satisfying. On the other hand, I opted for the shrimp kabob meal, but I must admit that I was a bit disappointed. The portion consisted of only four shrimp, which were not only overly cooked but noticeably small as well. Despite this setback, the service we received was commendable and the restaurant, while not crowded, provided a pleasant and relaxed atmosphere.

input:
The line was out the door, but I had a sandwich in my hands 7 minutes later, and I'm guessing it took longer because I didn't know what I wanted right away.  In fact, I felt a little rushed.  All the locals were running in, saying hi to the owner and ordering up their usual's.  No place for a rookie, but they were extremely patient with us and a few others that wandered in not knowing what they were doing either.

As soon as you cross the threshold, you know you have made a good choice, the smell makes your mouth water.  The Punk agreed so we decided to sit inside (everyone else was outside).

Typically, I would never ever order pastrami, but the menu said it was lean, so I tried something different for me.  Lean indeed.  Best pastrami I have had in a very long time.  In fact, maybe ever.  

The punk was amazed at all the bottle caps glued to every surface in the place.  It is a visual feast to keep you busy and entertained while you eat, if you choose to eat inside.  You cannot see the walls for all the nostalgic fodder.

She was especially thrilled when they brought out her sandwich. When he set it down she exclaimed with delight, "He knew exactly what I wanted!"
Revise this with your best effort:
Despite the long line stretching out the door, I found myself clutching a delectable sandwich in just seven short minutes. Admittedly, my indecisiveness may have contributed to the slight delay, as I struggled to settle on a choice amidst the bustling atmosphere. Observing the locals swiftly entering the establishment, warmly greeting the owner, and effortlessly ordering their regular meals, I realized this was no place for an inexperienced visitor. However, to my pleasant surprise, both the staff and the other bewildered patrons were extraordinarily patient and understanding.

The moment I stepped across the threshold, a wave of enticing aromas assailed my senses, unequivocally affirming that I had indeed made a wise decision. The tantalizing scents were so mouthwatering that my companion, the Punk, and I decided to forgo the usual outdoor seating option and opt for a table indoors, despite everyone else occupying the al fresco area.

Contrary to my usual preferences, I mustered the courage to deviate from my usual choices by ordering the pastrami, enticed by the menu's claim of its leanness. To my utter astonishment, it turned out to be the most succulent and flavorful pastrami I had encountered in an exceedingly long while, if not ever.

The Punk, in her own unique way, marveled at the distinctive decor featuring bottle caps meticulously affixed to every available surface. This quirky and visually captivating display provided an excellent distraction and amusement while savoring our meals, particularly for those who opted to dine indoors. The walls were virtually obscured by these nostalgic and eclectic decorations, creating a feast for the eyes.

However, the ultimate delight came when the staff brought out the Punk's sandwich. As soon as it was gently placed before her, she gleefully exclaimed, "He knew my cravings precisely!" Her elation at this seemingly telepathic comprehension of her desires only further added to the memorable experience.

input: Can't tell you how happy I was to see see Heather finally open a shop...I've followed her as a client for years. She is a color wizard, a genius at crafting a look with flair just for you, and can make a tasteful and creative suggestion if you're stumped, or roll with your personal vision. On top of that, Heather has created a shop vibe that is unstuffy, chill, and totally comfortable. I trust her and the staff she hires when I recommend friends and family, and love that she's made a home in the heart of E. Passyunk. Ask her for tips on caring for cactus houseplants, or chat about vintage bikes when you visit.
Revise this with your best effort:
I cannot express enough how elated I was to witness the long-awaited opening of Heather's shop. As a loyal client for several years, I have witnessed her transformative talents as a color wizard firsthand. She possesses an exceptional gift for tailoring distinctive looks that exude flair and suit each individual, giving her an undeniable brilliance in her craft. In moments of indecision, she effortlessly offers creative and tasteful suggestions, while also seamlessly incorporating your own personal vision.

Beyond her remarkable skills, Heather has masterfully cultivated a shop atmosphere that is refreshingly relaxed, unpretentious, and perfectly cozy. When recommending her to friends and family, I wholeheartedly trust her and the exceptional team she assembles. It brings me immense joy to see her establish her roots within the heart of E. Passyunk.

When you pay her a visit, don't hesitate to seek her advice on caring for cactus houseplants, or indulge in conversations about vintage bikes. Heather's knowledge extends beyond her remarkable expertise in hairstyling, making each visit an opportunity for delightful and engaging exchanges.

input: I like that Sally's has more options for hair supplies than any other beauty store in the area. The staff is nice and friendly and everything is usually well stocked. Sally's is my go to when I feel like experimenting with my hair due to the wide array of products they carry. I do wish the staff was a little more knowledgable on what they carry but I understand that that's a lot to ask. I also wish that the store was bigger, brighter and cleaner. The cramped aisles, dust bunnies and flickering, yellow fluorescent lights don't exactly give that same "beauty/trendy" feeling that other beauty stores have. If I could give one piece of advice to management it would be to work on the appearance of the store, other than that I'm pretty happy with Sally's.
Revise this with your best effort: I appreciate the fact that Sally's offers a larger selection of hair supplies compared to other beauty stores in the area. The staff is generally nice and friendly, and the store is usually well stocked. When it comes to exploring different hairstyles, Sally's is my top choice due to their extensive range of products. However, it would be beneficial if the staff could enhance their knowledge about the various items they carry, though I understand the challenge it poses. Additionally, I believe that improving the store's overall appearance by making it bigger, brighter, and cleaner would be advantageous. The cramped aisles, presence of dust bunnies, and flickering, yellow fluorescent lights fail to capture the desired "beauty/trendy" ambiance found in other beauty stores. If I had one piece of advice for the management, it would be to prioritize the store's aesthetic appeal. Having said that, overall I am content with my experiences at Sally's.

input:
Let me preface by saying that I have been getting my hair cut by a guy in Austin for seven years, even though I've lived in other cities for half that time. He is that good. The couple of times that I've strayed, I have been severely disappointed in the outcome. But I wasn't planning a trip back to Austin for a while and badly needed a cut, so I decided to bite the bullet.

My friend walks in a few weeks ago with *srsly* the cutest short hair cut. And so I ask her who and where, and she says Rodney Mitchell. I figured that this place would be too expensive, but she corrected my thinking on the matter. So I called to make an appointment with her guy (whose name I sadly cannot remember at the moment) and Rodney answered the phone. Turns out the guy my friend had seen didn't do morning appointments and all my afternoons were filled, so Rodney said "look, I'm the owner, I can absolutely vouch for Allison who has several openings in the next few days." So I thought, alright, he's the owner so he knows his stuff--I'll do it.

Allison absolutely did not disappoint. First off, she's a total sweetheart, but not super chatty (I appreciate stylists who can be content to both hold and not hold a convo while working) so there was no pressure there. I came in with my laptop and several photos I'd found that approximated what I wanted in a haircut, as I couldn't find exactly the right one. We talked about it a bit, discussed front and back length, bangs, etc. and she said alright and went to it. What she gave me was the cutest damn shaggy bob that I never thought possible. I seriously can't wait to go back.

One of the other awesome things about RMS is that they give you a discount for your first visit and I believe they have some kind of discount for students and teachers. They also will give you *another* discount when you refer people. So I got my friend a discount, and then referred a friend, so I'll get another discount when I go back for my next cut. All good things when you're trying your best to be a frugal  grad student.
Revise this with your best effort:
I must preface this by stating that for the past seven years, I have been exclusively getting my hair cut by a highly skilled stylist in Austin, even during the period when I resided in other cities. His talent is truly unparalleled. However, as luck would have it, I found myself in need of a haircut and unable to make a trip back to Austin anytime soon. Reluctantly, I decided to take the plunge and try somewhere new.

A few weeks ago, a friend of mine walked in looking absolutely adorable with her new short haircut. Naturally, I inquired about the stylist responsible, and she mentioned Rodney Mitchell. Initially, I assumed that this place would be exorbitantly priced, but my friend assured me otherwise. Intrigued, I called to make an appointment with my friend's stylist, whose name escapes me at the moment. To my surprise, Rodney himself answered the phone. It turned out that the stylist my friend recommended did not take morning appointments, and my schedule was booked for the afternoons. However, Rodney kindly informed me that Allison, who had several openings in the upcoming days, was more than capable. Given that Rodney was the owner, I trusted his judgment and agreed to give it a try.

Allison exceeded my expectations in every way possible. Not only was she incredibly pleasant, but she also possessed a remarkable ability to engage in conversation or remain silent, depending on the client's preference. I appreciated having the freedom to work on my laptop during the appointment. Beforehand, I had gathered a few photos that closely resembled the haircut I desired, although I couldn't find the perfect match. We discussed various aspects such as length, including the front, back, and bangs. After our conversation, Allison confidently began her work. The end result was an absolutely adorable shaggy bob that I never thought could be achieved. I simply cannot wait to return for my next appointment.

One of the other fantastic aspects of Rodney Mitchell Salon is their consideration for new customers. They offer a discount for the first visit, as well as special discounts for students and teachers. Additionally, they have a referral program that rewards both the referrer and the referred individual with a further discount. Consequently, I was able to provide a discount to my friend and subsequently referred another acquaintance, ensuring an additional discount for my next visit. These benefits certainly make budgeting as a frugal graduate student much more manageable.

input:
So much to like about this place--the beautiful Mercer Building location, the spaciousness, the lovely, friendly baristas. But there are a couple of important cons for me. Biggest being, the music is constant and too loud, ruining everything you go to a coffee shop to do: read, work, reflect, or enjoy a good conversation. When I asked for it to be turned down, they told me they can't--it just plays at one level all the time, and the speakers  are everywhere so you can't get away from it. It sucks.

Secondly, if you're a tea drinker, you're out of luck. They don't serve the tea in pots, but huge, sloppy individual filters--it makes your beverage totally ungainly, hard to drink and is really off putting.

Pros: gluten free goodies and yummy Italian sodas. I'd love to spend more time here, but the music usually drives me out after 10 minutes.
Revise this with your best effort:
This place has so much to offer that I truly enjoy—the stunning location in the Mercer Building, the impressive spaciousness, and the presence of friendly and lovely baristas. However, there are a couple of important drawbacks that I need to mention. Firstly, the constant and excessively loud music taints the experience of engaging in activities that one typically visits a coffee shop for: reading, working, reflecting, or engaging in pleasant conversations. Despite my request to lower the volume, I was informed that they are unable to adjust it as it remains at a single level throughout the day. Additionally, the all-encompassing speakers make it impossible to escape from the noise. It truly dampens the overall atmosphere.

Secondly, for tea enthusiasts like myself, the options are disappointing. Rather than serving tea in traditional pots, they opt for serving it with large and messy individual filters. This not only makes the beverage difficult to drink but also diminishes the appeal of enjoying tea in this establishment.

On a positive note, they do offer gluten-free treats and scrumptious Italian sodas. I would genuinely love to spend more time here; however, the incessant music tends to drive me away after a mere ten minutes.

input:
Spice n Grill has the best Indian food in St. Louis. We had the beef nihari, palak paneer, and naan. The palak and beef were perfectly spiced, adequately spicy, and crave-worthy. I've never had a nihari dish before and I will be sure to try it again. 

The restaurant doesn't have great seating  in the store, so I will take food to go next time. The owner served us and he was very nice, but I don't think people eat in the restaurant very often. 

I was so excited to see that the previous owners of 'Indian Food' have opened a new restaurant and I would recommend it if you're in the mood for delicious take-out.
Revise this with your best effort:
Spice n Grill unquestionably reigns as the supreme purveyor of Indian delicacies in St. Louis. Our taste buds embarked on an extraordinary journey as we savored their splendid beef nihari, palak paneer, and the ever-so-delectable naan. The palak and beef exhibited a flawlessly balanced blend of spices, possessively providing just the right amount of spicy allure that induced incessant cravings. With every luscious morsel devoured, an abiding desire to relish the enlightening flavors of nihari arose within me.

Although the seating arrangements within the establishment may not be their forte, this minor inconvenience did not dampen our spirits. In light of this revelation, we decided that opting for a delightful takeaway experience during our next visit would be a wise choice. The gracious owner himself catered to our needs, exuding warmth and affability. However, it appeared that dining in the restaurant was not a common occurrence among customers.

What amplified my delight was the connection I made to the establishment's past. As the previous proprietors of the esteemed 'Indian Food,' opened their new culinary haven, my excitement knew no bounds. If you happen to be in the mood for an exquisite take-out feast, I wholeheartedly endorse this establishment as a must-visit.

input:
I've come from Cali where boba is very common there. However I was thinking this place would have had the same feel. After being told this place branched off from California, I was disappointed. 

I'm more of a natural person. I enjoy real flavor, real fruits, and of course the perfect boba. I notice that some flavors were used by real fruits but others were just powder which I could definitely taste the different. Especially the taro flavor, being one of my favorites. 

But, if you're not too concern about natural vs powder flavor then this place could be good for you. They ask what level you would like you sweetness and any additional add-ons you would like. I always get boba but sometimes the grass jelly is pretty good too! I'd recommend you try. 

This is also a good place to catch up, talk, play board, card games and even do homework. I know it's always busy with students from the U of A and being told from them it's a nice area to just hang out, that's a pretty good sign. 

Maybe I'm just too picky, but I think it could be better. 

"See it, taste it, Yelp it"
Revise this with your best effort:
I come from California where boba is extremely popular. Naturally, I expected this place to replicate that same feel. However, upon learning that this place branched off from California, I couldn't help but feel disappointed.

As someone who appreciates the authenticity of natural flavors and real fruits, I was slightly let down. It was evident that while some flavors incorporated real fruits, others were simply artificial powders, which I could distinctly taste. Particularly with the taro flavor, which happens to be one of my favorites.

However, if you're not too concerned about the distinction between natural and powdered flavors, then this place might be suitable for you. They ask for your preferred sweetness level and provide options for additional add-ons. Personally, I always go for the boba, but I must admit that the grass jelly is also quite enjoyable. I recommend giving it a try.

Moreover, this establishment serves as a great spot for catching up, engaging in conversations, and engaging in activities such as board or card games or even getting some work done. The fact that it's always bustling with students from the University of Arizona, who have recommended it as a nice hangout spot, speaks volumes.

Maybe my standards are just too high, but I believe there is still room for improvement here.

"See it, taste it, Yelp it"

input: This is an updated review. I've been ordering from silver mine's at the same location for the last 4-5 years and they have only gotten progressively worse. Don't ask for anything to be added to your soup or chili; they'll charge you for the additions but will not include them in the order. They'll also most likely to include the free side such as the bread. It literally takes at least an hour to get your food delivered, maybe they should call Jimmy Johns and ask the what their secret is. This business is in major trouble with all of the other options available. The service is worse than if you had a bunch of kindergarteners running the business, at least they would be nice. You guys are right next to Eller Business School, why don't you ask them how you can improve??? Currently, this place is an embarrassment to their industry, and a waste of space on University Blvd. NEVER ORDERING FROM THIS PLACE AGAIN.
Revise this with your best effort: This updated review reflects my disappointment with the declining quality of Silver Mine's. I have been a loyal customer at this location for the past 4-5 years; however, their service has progressively worsened. One frustrating aspect is their reluctance to include any requested additions to soups or chili, despite charging customers for them. Moreover, they often fail to provide the free sides like bread. Delivery times have become excessively long, sometimes taking more than an hour, suggesting that perhaps they could seek advice from Jimmy Johns on efficiency. With numerous alternatives available, this business is facing significant challenges. The service is abysmal, even below the standards one would expect from a group of kindergarteners. Considering the proximity to Eller Business School, it would be wise for them to seek guidance on improvement. Currently, they are a disgrace to their industry and a detriment to University Blvd. Regrettably, I will never order from this establishment again.

input:
Bought my beautiful new bike from this shop a few weeks ago then promptly crashed it (curse you, trolley tracks!). I brought it back to the shop this afternoon to see if there was any way they could try to fix the front basket, which was pretty mangled, and to give the bike a once-over to make sure it was safe to ride. I was expecting to have to leave the bike with them for a few days, but the whole process took less than a half hour. Not only did they fix the basket (not perfect, but pretty damn close), but they also fixed the gear shifter that was a little out of whack... FOR FREE.  I couldn't believe it. 

I also want to note that everyone in the shop- from the owners, to the sales people on the floor, to the mechanics, to the dog that greets you at the door- is so friendly and welcoming. I am so happy I found them.
Revise this with your best effort:
A few weeks ago, I purchased a stunning new bike from this shop, only to unfortunately crash it soon after (curses on those treacherous trolley tracks!). Today, I decided to bring it back to the shop, hopeful that they could somehow mend the mangled front basket and ensure the bike's overall safety. Expecting to leave my beloved bike in their capable hands for a few days, I was pleasantly surprised when the entire process took less than half an hour. To my astonishment, not only did they adeptly fix the basket (although not flawlessly, it was impressively close), but they also graciously repaired the slightly misaligned gear shifter... all without charging me a dime. It was truly unbelievable.

Moreover, I want to emphasize the exceptional friendliness and warmth radiating from everyone at the shop. From the owners to the salespeople, mechanics, and even the delightful doggie at the door, the entire staff exudes a welcoming and amicable demeanor. I am immensely grateful to have discovered such a fantastic establishment.

input: I love going in there just to look around. The prices are a bit high, but the store is like a Disneyland for adults. I LOVE IT!
Revise this with your best effort: I thoroughly enjoy visiting that place solely to explore its offerings. Although the prices may be slightly steep, the store's ambiance is akin to a paradise for grown-ups. I am absolutely enamored by it!

input:
Underrated burger alert!!

Randomly came into Pag's during a stroll around Doylestown. The menu wasn't super appealing, actually, so I just went with a cheeseburger. Legitimately, one of the best cheeseburgers I've had in a while! Tasted like a quality Big Mac! Patty wasn't too thick, bun didn't overshadow the burger and whatever sauce they used - YUM.

We were in the wine bar section - ambiance is really nice; def not very kid friendly (we had our son with us.) but staff was friendly and accommodating.

We will totally be back next time we are in the mood for a good burger!
Revise this with your best effort:
Exciting discovery: The underrated burger gem!

By chance, we stumbled upon Pag's during a leisurely stroll in Doylestown. Admittedly, the menu didn't immediately captivate us, but I decided to give their cheeseburger a shot. To my pleasant surprise, it turned out to be one of the most memorable cheeseburgers I've savored in quite some time! It truly resembled a high-quality Big Mac, with a patty that struck the perfect balance, a bun that complemented rather than overshadowed the flavors, and a delectable sauce that left me craving for more.

While we were seated in the elegant wine bar section, it's worth noting that the ambiance was delightful. However, I must mention that this is not the most child-friendly establishment (though we did have our son with us). Nevertheless, the staff remained welcoming and accommodating throughout our visit.

Without a doubt, we will eagerly return to Pag's whenever the craving for a scrumptious burger strikes again!

input: Absolutely wonderful food & service! Go there for lunch/dinner with my boyfriend at least once every two weeks. Prices are very much reasonable. Weekends get pretty packed so may have to wait a little bit but that's never an issue for us. Always get the Indian Pancake & the Hainanese Chicken or Curry Chicken. Other dishes are delicious as well. Never get tired of it!
Revise this with your best effort: The food and service at this place are truly exceptional! My boyfriend and I make it a point to visit for lunch or dinner at least once every two weeks as we find the prices to be very reasonable. While the weekends tend to be quite busy, we don't mind waiting a little bit as it has never been an issue for us. Our go-to dishes are the Indian Pancake along with either the Hainanese Chicken or Curry Chicken, and we can't recommend them enough. However, we have also tried various other dishes here, and they are all absolutely delicious. We never seem to get tired of this place!

input: Pretty slow service and the waitresses aren't very kind. I guess I was expecting something different at a diner with high ratings but I understand it's in the middle of a tourist area. However, service should be a priority. Something that really bothered me was how much trash was left on the floor of the outside deck- it all has the potential to blow right into the ocean. NOT OKAY. I had to stand up several times to grab straw wrappers and napkins before they blew into the water. If you're going to have a waterfront/beach front business, be responsible about it. It would be a very easy fix-just a screen on the bottom of the fence. The food was good but I won't be back.
Revise this with your best effort: The service was disappointingly slow and the waitresses were lacking in kindness. Considering the high ratings of this diner, I had expected a different experience. However, given its location in a tourist area, I understand the challenges. Nevertheless, prioritizing better service should be imperative. One thing that particularly bothered me was the amount of trash scattered on the floor of the outdoor deck, which has the potential to blow right into the ocean. This is definitely not acceptable. I had to repeatedly get up to pick up straw wrappers and napkins before they ended up in the water. If you choose to operate a business near the waterfront or beach, it is crucial to be responsible and take appropriate measures. Implementing a simple solution like putting a screen on the bottom of the fence could easily address this issue. Although the food was good, I have no intention of returning.

input:
I recently had the pre fixe meal for $22 and I enjoyed the combination of tastes on my plate. The chicken was moist my veggies were tasty but a little too greasy....overall is was a great meal. 

I also use them for take out/delivery. I have always enjoyed the way the package their food, in plastic containers that I use over and over again until they look too worn out and I recycle them. I hate take out places that use so much boxes and cups and card board - it's extremely eco-unfriendly. 

The food here is never spectacular but is a good standby you will always come away enjoying. The prices seem a little steep but the restaurant atmosphere is contemporary, the service has always been splendid and the food is dependable.
Revise this with your best effort:
I recently had the prix fixe meal for $22 and thoroughly enjoyed the delightful combination of flavors on my plate. The chicken was perfectly moist, and although the veggies were tasty, they were slightly on the greasy side. Nonetheless, it was an overall fantastic dining experience.

I also rely on this establishment for takeout and delivery. What I truly appreciate is how they package their food in reusable plastic containers. I continue to reuse them until they become too worn out, and then I recycle them. It's disheartening to see other takeout places use excessive amounts of boxes, cups, and cardboard, which is incredibly eco-unfriendly.

The food here may not be extraordinary, but it's consistently satisfying and dependable. While the prices may seem a bit high, the atmosphere of the restaurant is contemporary, the service has always been outstanding, and you can always count on enjoying your meal.

input: It's no different than any other Chinese place. Same menu, etc. this place does have some good lunch specials though, and the food is always ready when I go to pick it up.
Revise this with your best effort: This Chinese restaurant is fairly similar to others in terms of the menu and overall experience. However, it does stand out with its variety of enticing lunch specials. Additionally, one notable advantage is that the food is consistently prepared and ready for pickup upon my arrival.

input: Finally got to eat here last night. Eclectic foodie menu. I had their onion tart as an app and Kerry had the veal meatballs with sauce on polenta, very delicious. The red gravy tasted like my own. We both ordered the special of citrus short ribs with fat noodles and brussel sprouts, peas. couldn't finish we will be back to try other interesting items. Small crowded but great friendly atmosphere
Revise this with your best effort: Yesterday, we were finally able to dine at this remarkable establishment. The menu was a delightful amalgamation of various culinary influences. To start, I savored the delectable onion tart while Kerry opted for the flavorful veal meatballs atop a bed of polenta, accompanied by a sumptuous sauce. The red gravy resembled my homemade version, showcasing the chef's skills. As our main course, we both indulged in the citrus-infused short ribs, paired magnificently with fat noodles, brussel sprouts, and peas. Although the generous portions overwhelmed us, we eagerly anticipate returning to sample other intriguing dishes on offer. Despite the cozy and bustling setting, the atmosphere exuded friendliness and warmth.

input: Last night we tried to get into the oldest Italian Restaurant in South Philly. Thankfully, they couldn't fit us in, so our son said lets try Angelina's  so we walked around the corner and into a small Italian Restaurant.  Immediatly we felt at home.  Angelina is cooking in the front of the resaurant and her husband is servicing. There were 3 of us and we started off with Eggplant and roasted pepper appetizer.  One bite and we were hooked.  We ordered the Veal Osso Bocca, Carbonara and lasagna.  Everything was absolutly DELISH!!  Can't wait to go back!!!
Revise this with your best effort: Last night, our endeavor to dine at the oldest Italian Restaurant in South Philly proved futile. Fortunately, we found solace in our son's suggestion to give Angelina's a try. So, we strolled around the corner and entered a cozy little Italian Restaurant. Instantly, an overwhelming sense of familiarity embraced us. At the forefront of the establishment, Angelina skillfully crafted culinary delights, while her husband impeccably attended to the patrons. With a party of three, we initiated our gastronomic journey with a delectable Eggplant and roasted pepper appetizer. Just one bite and we were captivated. Our subsequent orders comprised the sumptuous selection of Veal Osso Bocca, Carbonara, and lasagna. Every dish we savored was an absolute masterpiece of flavors. Anticipation for our return visit is brewing!

input: great food, great view. Try the lobster mac and cheese
Revise this with your best effort: Indulge in a truly exquisite experience of delectable cuisine combined with breathtaking scenery. Savor the perfection of our culinary offerings, accompanied by the most awe-inspiring vistas. And for a truly unforgettable treat, do not pass up the opportunity to relish the divine combination of succulent lobster and creamy mac and cheese featured on our menu.

input: Super tasty and enormous portions. Some unique flavors too. Not much else to say but an amazing ice cream store that others should try to emulate.
Revise this with your best effort: Indulge in mouthwatering and generous portions of delectable ice cream. Discover an array of uncommon flavors that will tantalize your taste buds. Simply put, this ice cream store is unparalleled and serves as a worthy role model for others to follow.

input: The food is average. Drink specials are great but the place is rarely crowded. Last time I was there it was a Friday night at 10 pm. There were maybe 3 other parties at the bar. About 5 minutes after ordering our first drink, they announced it was last call...at 10:15 PM on a Friday night! Needless to say we left for a different bar in the area and have removed it from our options of places to go past 6 pm for drinks.
Revise this with your best effort: The food quality at this establishment is mediocre. However, they do offer great drink specials, although it is unfortunate that the place is rarely crowded. On my last visit, which happened to be a Friday night at 10 pm, there were only three other parties present at the bar. To our surprise, shortly after placing our first drink order, we were informed that it was already last call - an astonishingly early time of 10:15 pm. Clearly disappointed, we decided to seek out another bar in the vicinity and have since eliminated this place as a viable option for post-6 pm drinks.

input: A good place to order from when its late and you have the muchies... for whatever reason ;-)
Revise this with your best effort: If you find yourself late at night, feeling hungry for any reason (wink, wink), the absolute go-to spot to satisfy those cravings is unquestionably here!

input:
You think Value City, you think cheap value, right? Wrong! 

Think Rothman prices with Ashley Furniture pieces. Not a Broyhill in sight. 

Negatives:
- Entertainment centers and TV stand selection is small, and over priced selection.
-Their "Clearance" section is laughable and not much of a sale. No one is going to pay $299 for a nicked up coffee table that was originally $350. Go lower. 
- Sectionals by themselves average around $1,000 by brands I've never heard of. 
- The staff hangs out like a clique chatting in the middle of the store rather than helping customers. 
-Dining sets are nothing special and overpriced as well. I've seen the same selection everywhere else at a lower price. 
-5% military discount? Ooooh you're going to knock $20 off my sofa! 

Only Positive:
-They have a few modern pieces. 

Overall:

I think they're high for low quality-mediocre furniture. Shop around town. Or if you do find something you must have here, wait for a holiday sale.
Revise this with your best effort:
When you hear the name Value City, you might assume low-cost and low-quality furniture, right? Think again! 

Picture the prices you'd find at Rothman's combined with the style and quality of Ashley Furniture. Forget about Broyhill - you won't find it here. 

However, there are a few downsides to consider. Firstly, the selection of entertainment centers and TV stands is quite limited and the prices are higher than expected. Their "Clearance" section leaves much to be desired - who would pay $299 for a scratched coffee table that originally cost $350? They should definitely lower their prices further. Additionally, sectionals from unfamiliar brands average around $1,000, which seems steep. 

One inconvenience is that the staff tends to gather and chat in the middle of the store instead of actively assisting customers. It can be quite off-putting. Moreover, the dining sets offered are nothing extraordinary and are also overpriced. You can find the same selection elsewhere for a lower cost. Lastly, their advertised 5% military discount doesn't impress much - a mere $20 off a sofa is hardly noteworthy. 

On a positive note, they do have a few modern pieces that may catch your eye. 

Overall, I believe their prices are too high for furniture of mediocre quality. It would be wise to explore other furniture stores in town. If you do happen to find something you absolutely love here, I would suggest waiting for a holiday sale to get the best value for your money.

input: I really like Franzone's. The owner is typically around, super friendly, and seems to really care about the product. While I'm not a big fan of sweet sauce, they also do a decent cheesesteak, fries, etc. Honestly, they may have been closer to a 4 if not that it's always just a really pleasant experience going in, which boosts their rating for me.
Revise this with your best effort: I highly appreciate Franzone's as it offers an exceptional dining experience. The owner's presence, coupled with their welcoming and affectionate nature, showcases a genuine passion for their product. Although I'm not particularly fond of sweet sauce, they still manage to deliver good quality cheesesteaks, fries, and more. If it wasn't for the consistently pleasant experiences I have every time I visit, Franzone's might have been ranked slightly lower.

input:
Finally had the chance to stop by Bab Cafe...what took us so long!  Both of us being Asian food fanatics, we are so happy to have Bab Cafe part of our ever expanding culinary experience here in Reno.

With the guidance of the very friendly and knowledgeable staff, we quickly got a hang of what to order, though there will be many more choices on our future visits.  Liking things a little spicy, we both ordered the Jeyuk Top-Bab (spicy pork).  What incredible flavor!  There is nothing that compares to this place in Reno.  The sauce bar gives you the opportunity to mix things up and the included miso soup is a definite bonus.  Great value for such a fresh, enjoyable meal.  Convenient downtown location to take away, dine in or have it delivered via UberEats.
Revise this with your best effort:
After finally making it to Bab Cafe, we can't believe it took us so long! As avid Asian food enthusiasts, we were overjoyed to add Bab Cafe to our ever-expanding culinary journey in Reno.

Thanks to the warm and knowledgeable staff, we quickly grasped what to order, although future visits promise even more enticing options. Both craving a bit of spice, we opted for the Jeyuk Top-Bab (spicy pork) and were blown away by the incredible flavors! Truly incomparable to any other place in Reno. The sauce bar offered a delightful opportunity to experiment, and the complimentary miso soup was a delightful bonus. The freshness and enjoyment of our meal far exceeded the reasonable price.

Located conveniently downtown, Bab Cafe provides the option to dine in, take away, or even have your order delivered via UberEats.

input: First meal in New Orleans. I had the $15 lunch special, a seafood stew (with oyster meat, crab claws, shrimp, and redfish) that came with a surprisingly thoughtful salad. Yeah, it's weird: I'm not even a fan of seafood and, to be honest, I wasn't even really that hungry. Still, before I knew what I was doing I had wolfed down the entire thing. The spice, consistency, tenderness of the meat -- all was precisely just right. Well worth your while.
Revise this with your best effort: For my inaugural meal in New Orleans, I indulged in the delightful $15 lunch special, a delectable seafood stew boasting succulent oyster meat, crab claws, shrimp, and redfish - an amalgamation that astounded my taste buds. To my pleasant surprise, a thoughtfully crafted salad accompanied this extraordinary dish. Strangely enough, despite my lack of affinity for seafood and an undersized appetite at the time, I found myself devouring every morsel with unexpected fervor. The harmonious blend of spices, the impeccable consistency, and the tender perfection of the delectable seafood were nothing short of sublime. Undeniable proof that this culinary experience is an absolute must-try and worth every moment dedicated to its consumption.

input: Totally worth the wait despite the heat!  I had the Vegan grits with a biscuit on the side. OMG!  So good. My 3 sisters each enjoyed their choices as well. Caution, the bloody Mary's are spicy!  The service was excellent. Really considering the wait was 45 mins, the line moved fast and then there was no long wait for our food. They have their process perfected!  Thanks Biscuit Love for a Delish breakfast!!!
Revise this with your best effort: Despite the heat, the wait was absolutely worth it! I indulged in the delectable Vegan grits accompanied by a scrumptious biscuit on the side. OMG, it was beyond delicious! My three sisters were equally thrilled with their choices. Fair warning, the bloody Mary's pack quite a spicy punch! The service was top-notch, especially considering that we only waited for 45 minutes in line and our food arrived promptly. Biscuit Love has truly mastered their process! Thank you, Biscuit Love, for providing us with such a delightful breakfast experience!

input:
Ichicoro Ane gets lots of things right and the best part about it is the combination of the ambiance with the food choices and whiskey selection. I'm very happy with this location and the servers I have encountered so far have been helpful and pleasant.

The katsu is great and I highly recommend it to people looking for a more filling dish on the menu. The bao buns were also good for a lighter fish. I haven't had anything I really regretted trying, but definitely ask your server about the portion sizes of each dish since they vary across the menu.

The cocktail selection is excellent. I even had a special Japanese Old Fashioned last time which was a little expensive, but well worth it for some quality Japanese whiskey. 

I'm looking forward to exploring the menu little by little. The best way to experience this is in a group setting so you can try more things and it really reminds me of Izakayas or Japanese pubs I visited in Japan and Korea.
Revise this with your best effort:
Ichicoro Ane truly excels in numerous aspects, and what stands out the most is the seamless fusion of its captivating ambiance, diverse culinary options, and exceptional whiskey collection. I am immensely satisfied with this establishment, as the servers I have come across have consistently displayed professionalism and genuine amiability.

One particular dish that I cannot recommend enough is the katsu, which boasts incredible flavors and is guaranteed to satiate even the heartiest appetite. On the other hand, the bao buns offer a lighter alternative without compromising on taste. I have yet to encounter a dish that I regret sampling, but I advise seeking guidance from your server regarding portion sizes, as they do vary throughout the menu.

The cocktail selection is truly remarkable, with a range of options that never fails to impress. During my last visit, I indulged myself in a special Japanese Old Fashioned, albeit a bit pricier than most, the superb quality of the Japanese whiskey made it absolutely worth it.

I am eagerly anticipating the gradual exploration of the menu. For the ultimate experience, I highly recommend visiting with a group of friends, as it allows for the opportunity to sample a wider range of delectable offerings. The atmosphere evokes nostalgic memories of the Izakayas and Japanese pubs I have had the pleasure of visiting in Japan and Korea.

input: Love this bakery!! Great breakfast sandwiches, coffee, and donuts! My friend and I love coming on weekend mornings
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adore this bakery! Their breakfast sandwiches, coffee, and donuts are simply amazing. It has become a tradition for my friend and me to visit on weekend mornings, as it brings us so much joy.

input: There is a great selection of whiskey/bourbon to suit anyone's taste. We had burgers with the fried egg on it and it was soo good and probably one of the best burgers I've ever had. The duck fries are a MUST if you come here. It is a cute atmosphere although we went with a party of 4 and it was a tad awkward the way our seating was and made it difficult to have conversation with everyone at our table. Overall, a nice place to go. We will be going back.
Revise this with your best effort: This establishment boasts an impressive array of whiskey and bourbon, catering to a wide range of preferences. Our culinary experience reached new heights as we indulged in their delectable burger, complete with a fried egg topping, undoubtedly one of the finest I have ever savored. In addition, one simply cannot overlook the absolute necessity of trying their duck fries, a true standout on their menu. While the ambiance is undeniably charming, it is worth mentioning that our party of four encountered a slight inconvenience with the seating arrangement, hindering seamless conversation amongst all individuals present. Nevertheless, this is unquestionably a delightful destination worth revisiting.

input: A++ for ambience. Very cozy English pub feel. Great drinks too - the bartenders here know how to mix 'em. That being said, the prices are steep (I paid $7 for a standard mixed drink) and the seating is limited.
Revise this with your best effort: The ambience of this place deserves an A++. It truly captures the cozy and authentic feel of an English pub. The bartenders here definitely know their craft when it comes to mixing drinks, offering a great selection. input: Very cozy place to have a drink with friends.  The drinks were tasty and were served in very pretty glasses reminiscent of those some of our grandmothers had in their china cabinets. On the downside, all of the drinks seemed to have some combination of ginger, lime, and honey with the main difference being the kind of liquor you wanted in your drink.  So the choices felt limited.  I ordered the bacon wrapped dates, and have to admit that I was choking them down because I was hungry.  They tasted like they were double dipped in sugar.  Also, once another 10 or so people came in, it was very hard to hear each other because the noise level skyrocketed, which is surprising with so much fabric in the room.  The servers were nice and left us alone except to check on us every so often.  I don't recall being offered a second drink when my glass was taken away.
Revise this with your best effort:
This cozy establishment provides an inviting atmosphere to enjoy drinks with friends. The beverages served are not only delicious but also presented in exquisite glassware that evokes nostalgia of our grandmothers' china cabinets. However, it should be noted that the drink options seemed somewhat limited as they all incorporated a combination of ginger, lime, and honey, with the only significant distinction being the choice of liquor. 

My personal choice was the bacon wrapped dates, which unfortunately left much to be desired. The excessive sweetness, as if they were double-dipped in sugar, made it quite challenging to enjoy them. Furthermore, as more patrons arrived, the noise level quickly escalated, making it difficult to engage in conversation despite the presence of ample fabric throughout the room.

Nonetheless, the servers were pleasant and for the most part, respected our privacy, only checking in periodically. It is worth mentioning that I do not recall being offered a second drink when my glass was taken away, which was somewhat disappointing.

input:

The service at the new coffee/dessert café was wonderful!  The Patio was a great place to visit with our guests and enjoy the beautiful St. Pete weather. We look forward to many more brunches there in the future! 

Finally, the best part of all is the management and team at the Hollander.  Nick and Will treated us like their own family.  They went above and beyond to ensure that each of our guests felt like they were at home and comfortable.  Zach at the front desk was so friendly and patient with me as I called checking on our room block.  The entire team was just a delight and so very accommodating.  They take great pride in ensuring that every guest has a wonderful experience.  We just adore everyone there!  I absolutely loved working with them and would recommend this beautiful hotel to anyone!

The convenience of the shuttle service was greatly appreciated by our guests and added to their overall positive experience.

Now, let's talk about the brunch. The value for money was exceptional, offering an all-you-can-enjoy feast that left everyone satisfied. The food itself was delicious and made with care. A highlight was the gentleman who skillfully crafted omelettes, ensuring fast service with a friendly smile. His talent extended to baking, as his chocolate muffins were a hit. The service at the newly opened coffee and dessert café was outstanding, making the entire experience even more enjoyable. The patio provided the perfect setting to enjoy the St. Pete weather and catch up with our loved ones. We are already looking forward to returning for future brunches.

Last but certainly not least, the management and team at The Hollander Hotel were the true stars of our experience. Nick and Will treated us as if we were family, going above and beyond to ensure our guests felt welcome and comfortable. The front desk staff, particularly Zach, demonstrated friendly and patient service as we inquired about our room block. The entire team deserves recognition for their exceptional hospitality and dedication to creating a memorable stay for each guest. Working with them was an absolute pleasure, and we wholeheartedly recommend this stunning hotel to anyone in search of a truly extraordinary experience.

input:
Although there are countless little Mexican places below Washington Avenue, I never get sick of them and always look forward to trying the new kid on the block. This time it was El Sabor Poblano on Federal, which could not look less special if it tried.

I liked that there were 3 fish tacos on the menu.  I picked the fried and battered version, though the tortilla chip covered fish could have been awesome. I was instantly impressed when I opened one of my three and found that El Sabor puts an entire filet of fish in each taco! The flakey meat had no fishy taste. These tacos came with the more American toppings of lettuce and, tomato, and cheese. I bet I could have gotten cilantro and onion if I asked. The sole staff member in the place seemed happy to accommodate us- well, we were the only ones dining in.

Another taco filling option that comes with more traditional toppings is the super crispy chorizo, only $8 for 3. There was no detectable gristle here, something I have often come across at this little places.

As unassuming as it looks, this particular South Philly Mexican place is worth stopping by.
Revise this with your best effort:
Despite the abundance of Mexican eateries below Washington Avenue, I never tire of them and am always excited to try the latest addition. This time, my curiosity led me to El Sabor Poblano on Federal, a modest-looking establishment that gave no indication of its potential.

One aspect that caught my attention was the inclusion of three fish tacos on the menu. Opting for the fried and battered version, I couldn't help but wonder how the tortilla chip-covered fish would taste. To my delight, upon unwrapping one of the three tacos, I discovered that El Sabor generously fills each one with a whole filet of fish! The delicate meat possessed no unpleasant fishy flavor. These tacos were accompanied by the more Americanized toppings of lettuce, tomato, and cheese, though I'm confident I could have requested cilantro and onion if desired. The lone staff member in the establishment was more than willing to accommodate our requests, perhaps due to our exclusive presence as the only diners.

Another tantalizing option for taco fillings came in the form of super crispy chorizo, available at a reasonable price of $8 for three. Surprisingly, there was no trace of gristle, a common disappointment I've encountered at similar establishments in the past.

Despite its unassuming appearance, this Mexican gem nestled in South Philly is undoubtedly worth a visit.

Revise this with your best effort: These theater recliners are undeniably some of the most comfortable I have ever experienced. Unfortunately, the atmosphere was dampened by the visible tension among the staff due to their relief being late. While understandable, it was disheartening to witness a full-blown discussion unfolding behind the bar, permeating the peaceful ambiance that we sought.

Despite its appealing location and overall charm, I am uncertain whether we would return based on this particular visit, as we believe there to be superior alternatives nearby.

input: Hate to be harsh but dang! After having a limited selection at terminal F I finally decided to go with Tony Luke's. input: I've been to many art museums and was surprised to see a museum this beautiful with such a great collection to be FREE! I was so happy to have had discovered this museum in my short time in Indianapolis. I loved the African Art and the Modern Art sections (although I did make a mistake taking out my camera for the Modern Art museums.. that's a no no). The outdoor sculpture garden and gift shop was awesome as well. Highly recommended!
Revise this with your best effort: I have had the pleasure of visiting numerous art museums, but I was genuinely taken aback by the sheer beauty and marvelously curated collection of this particular museum, especially considering that admission was completely free! It was an unexpected delight to stumble upon this gem during my brief stay in Indianapolis. I found myself particularly captivated by the African Art and Modern Art sections, although I must admit I made a regrettable error by attempting to photograph the exhibits in the Modern Art wing—a strict policy I was not aware of at the time. It was nonetheless a truly memorable experience, complemented by the exquisite outdoor sculpture garden and an enticing gift shop. I cannot recommend this museum enough; it is an absolute must-visit.

input:
You would think from the size of the place it would be good for groups, but in my experience with 9 people on Saturday at 11am it was about a very hungry, tiring wait to get a seat. 

We tried to make reservations, but they do not take them. And I think we were too small to be put in the side meeting room. So hangry we stood, hoping for just the right table to leave.

The manager was nice enough to offer to fill cups of coffee for us while we waited. But I thought it was odd that they just didn't refill the pot for everyone who was waiting. 

Now for the food...They have these 1/2 and 1/2 combos. Which I love! I got a turkey Reuben and salad. I asked for lots of sauerkraut, and they charged $0.50 for it.. Which is no biggie but I'd expect a lot of kraut. Sadly there was not a lot of it.. But it was still a delicious sandwhich.  :) My friend got the sunrise chile rellenos. If I come back with a smaller party, that is what I would get.
Revise this with your best effort:
Despite the restaurant's seemingly spacious setting, my experience with a group of nine people on a Saturday morning at 11am was quite a tiresome and hungry affair. We attempted to make reservations, but unfortunately, they do not accept them. Additionally, it seemed that our party was too small to be accommodated in the side meeting room. As a result, we impatiently waited, hoping to secure a suitable table.

The manager was kind enough to offer us coffee while we waited, which was a nice gesture. However, I found it peculiar that they did not refill the coffee pot for everyone waiting, but rather opted to fill cups on an individual basis.

Moving on to the food, the restaurant offers 1/2 and 1/2 combos, which I found to be a delightful concept. Opting for a turkey Reuben and salad combo, I requested extra sauerkraut, for which they charged an additional $0.50. While this extra charge was not a major issue, I expected a generous portion of sauerkraut, which unfortunately was not the case. Nevertheless, the sandwich was still delicious. On the other hand, my friend ordered the sunrise chile rellenos, and if I were to return with a smaller group, that would be my choice as well.

input: The Shop is an amazing space! Their attention to detail and services are unbelievable. Plenty of places to have private meetings as well as post up and get work done.
