Despite being aware of the expected long wait for gift wrapping, I entrusted my items to the store, expecting them to be promptly handled. However, upon my return almost two hours later, I discovered that my gifts had not even been moved from the counter where I originally purchased them. As a result, a gift that had a deadline was not delivered on time due to the complete negligence of the staff. 

Although I have been fond of their merchandise, this experience has made me rethink my loyalty to this particular store. The inability to receive timely gift wrapping, despite being assured otherwise, was incredibly frustrating. I am even considering canceling my store card and resorting to online shopping to avoid any future disappointments. It is truly disheartening to witness such a downfall in the customer service provided by this store.

input: They have a couple of really nice ladies, that go out of their way to help you. But there's one that will rip your head off if you're not careful. It won't take ya long to figure this out on your own though.  Jus' sayin'......
Revise this with your best effort: They have a few exceptionally kind and helpful ladies, but there's one who, if not approached cautiously, can be quite fierce. However, it won't take you much time to perceive this distinction for yourself. Just a friendly heads up...

input: Hendricks is a must try in St.Louis. The meats,sauces,and sides are better than most barbecue places.Onion rings are huge and the coleslaw is tasty and finely shredded. Service is good and very friendly. Takes awhile to get the meal,but it gives you time to check out the unique decor.
Revise this with your best effort: If you're in St. Louis, you absolutely cannot miss out on Hendricks. Their barbecue offerings surpass those of most other places, thanks to their exceptional meats, flavorful sauces, and delectable sides. The onion rings alone are gigantic and the coleslaw is not only delicious, but also finely shredded to perfection. The service is top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff. While the wait for your meal may be a bit longer, it provides the perfect opportunity to admire Hendricks' one-of-a-kind decor.

input: Found there to be a good variety of food for a late night dinner with young kids. Wish we had one this good near us in upper PA. Person that rang us in was friendly and helpful. Two things  made our experience top notch. First was out waiter Eric, who was friendly, observant, went out of his way to get odd requests, and quick to getting back to us.  Eric is the type of waiter you would find a quality sit down restaurant.  The other were the 2 people at the grill house station. When I asked to have shrimp not basted due to a pepper allergy that offered to get different tings to remove them from the grill. I appreciated their thoughtfulness.
Revise this with your best effort: We discovered a great selection of food for a late night dinner with our young kids. It's truly a pity that we don't have a restaurant as good as this one in upper PA. The person who assisted us over the phone was extremely congenial and helpful. However, what truly elevated our experience were two exceptional aspects. Firstly, our waiter Eric made a tremendous impression. He was not only friendly and attentive, but also went above and beyond to fulfill our unusual requests promptly. Eric truly embodied the caliber of service one expects from a high-quality sit-down restaurant. Secondly, the two individuals manning the grill house station were outstanding. When informed about my pepper allergy and my request to have the shrimp un-basted, they not only accommodated me by removing the peppers from the grill, but also offered alternatives to ensure my safety. Their thoughtfulness was greatly appreciated.

input: i was looking forward to a new coffee spot, but this won't be it for me.  they dont have a menu first off, and im not a coffee connoisseur, so i was a little thrown off.  i kept it simple, asked for an iced tea, but they did give me hot tea w/a cup of ice.  v. artsy crowd here, great for people watching, but not for studying.  its a little loud, my headphones were not enough to block out the noise, so i was stuck listening to watever they chose, which wasn't my preference.  the servers were all really nice, and they kept cleaning the tables quite often.  all in all it wasnt a bad experience, but not one to keep me coming back either...
Revise this with your best effort: I was excited to try out a new coffee spot, but unfortunately, this place didn't meet my expectations. To begin with, they didn't have a menu, which was a bit confusing for someone like me who isn't well-versed in coffee. I decided to keep it simple and ordered an iced tea. However, they mistakenly gave me hot tea with a cup of ice. The atmosphere was filled with an artsy crowd, making it great for people-watching but not suitable for studying. The noise level was quite high, and even with my headphones on, I couldn't block out the distractions and had to listen to whatever music they chose, which wasn't to my taste. On the positive side, the servers were all very friendly, and they consistently kept the tables clean. Overall, it wasn't a terrible experience, but it certainly wasn't enough to make me want to return.

input: lit!!!!! just wanna give a shoutout to my g, kyle. he was such a chill waiter and deserves a raise or somethin. he recommended me the honey hot sauce and it was some of the best hot sauce i had eaten in ages. kyle from milk and honey changed my life and i will forever owe him. also the biscuits brought me to heaven. i didn't even order one i just stole from my friends but they were just that. good. so yeah def come here and ask about kyle. tell him i miss him and that i hope we get reunited soon.
Revise this with your best effort:
I would like to take a moment to give a well-deserved shoutout to my amazing waiter, Kyle. He was incredibly friendly and attentive, making my dining experience absolutely fantastic. I firmly believe that he deserves recognition for his exceptional service and would even go as far as to say that a raise would be appropriate. 

On top of his attentive service, Kyle recommended the honey hot sauce, which completely blew me away. It was without a doubt the best hot sauce I have had in years. It brought a whole new level of flavor to my meal, and I am extremely grateful to Kyle for introducing me to it. 

I must also mention the heavenly biscuits that were served at the restaurant. While I didn't officially order one, I couldn't resist trying one from my friends' plates. They were absolutely delicious and truly took me to another world. I can confidently say that they were worth every stolen bite.

I highly recommend visiting this restaurant and specifically seeking out Kyle for his exceptional service and recommendations. Please let him know that I miss him and eagerly look forward to being reunited soon. Thank you, Kyle, for making a lasting impact on my dining experience.

input:
Went here before a show we were seeing in the University City area.  It is just across the street from 30th Street Station, and just down the street from Drexel University.  We we able to get street parking about 2 blocks down the street, so that is always a plus.  

Service was sufficient for dinner.  We tried the mac and cheese appetizer that had just the right amount of breadcrumbs on it.  It was served hot, but with average taste.  We also tried the cheeseteak egg rolls - decent, but not a lot of meat in them.  Some of the bites I had of the egg roll were merely the fried dough without getting to any of the cheese and meat.   They were served with ketchup and a special mustard that had some horseradish in it for a bit of a kick!  I must say, it is a neat thing for a Philadelphia Pub to have on a menu.  

For our main entrees, we both had the chicken pot pie.  The vegetables were plentiful, and the chicken was all white meat, though there was not that much of it.  The crust was somewhat flaky, but there was a section of my pot pie crust that didn't seem like it was cooked all the way through.  

Dessert portion sizes were huge!  We had the bread pudding which was average in taste, and served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.  The brownie was served ala mode with vanilla ice cream as well.  The brownie was definitely dry and lacking in taste, though I consider myself to be a brownie snob, so maybe I'm being overly picky.
Revise this with your best effort:
My friends and I decided to go here for dinner before catching a show in the University City area. The location is perfect, right across the street from 30th Street Station and just a short distance from Drexel University. We were lucky enough to find street parking about two blocks away, which was a nice bonus.

The service at this place was adequate for a dinner. To start, we ordered the mac and cheese appetizer, which had a delightful amount of breadcrumbs sprinkled on top. It arrived hot, but the taste was just average. We also gave the cheesesteak egg rolls a shot, and while they were decent, they seemed to lack substantial amounts of meat. Unfortunately, some bites consisted solely of the fried dough without any cheese or meat. The egg rolls came with a side of ketchup and a unique mustard that had a slight hint of horseradish, giving it a pleasant kick. I must admit, it's quite a unique addition for a Philadelphia pub to have on their menu.

Moving on to our main entrees, both of us opted for the chicken pot pie. The dish was filled with an abundance of vegetables, and the chicken used was all white meat, although there wasn't an ample amount of it. The crust had a somewhat flaky texture, but there was a part of my pot pie where the crust didn't seem fully cooked.

The dessert portions were gigantic! We tried the bread pudding, which was fairly average in taste and came with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. The brownie was served with vanilla ice cream as well, and unfortunately, it was quite dry and lacked flavor. I have to admit, though, I can be quite picky when it comes to brownies.

input: Went for a bachelorette party on a Saturday night in April. Definitely try to arrive on the earlier side! We got there at 8 and there was no line (by the time we left at around 11 there was a line down the street). The cover band is awesome. There were at least 10 other bachelorette groups there and a few 50th birthday parties too. Their signature cocktails are great but overpriced in my opinion. I would go back though for another bachelorette party or birthday. Probably wouldn't try if it was any regular night out. Gets very crowded.
Revise this with your best effort: I attended a bachelorette party on a Saturday night in April and I highly recommend arriving early. When we got there around 8, there was no line, but by the time we left at around 11, there was a line stretching down the street. The cover band was truly amazing, and it was a lively atmosphere with at least 10 other bachelorette groups and a few 50th birthday parties. While their signature cocktails were tasty, I found them a bit overpriced. Nevertheless, I would gladly return for another bachelorette party or birthday celebration. However, I might steer clear on regular nights as it tends to get extremely crowded.

input: Hands down best fall off the bone BBQ I've ever had.Excellent pulled pork everything had that great smoky flavor.Very creamy mac and cheese.Service was fast and friendly. Dessert was equally as good walnut brownie and ice cream delight.Such a great find.
Revise this with your best effort: Without a doubt, this was the most exceptional fall-off-the-bone BBQ I have ever tasted. The pulled pork was extraordinary, each bite bursting with a fantastic smoky flavor. The mac and cheese were delightfully creamy, adding a perfect touch to the meal. The service was fast and friendly, making the dining experience even more enjoyable. To top it all off, the walnut brownie paired with a scoop of ice cream created a truly delightful dessert. This hidden gem was an absolute discovery, leaving me thoroughly impressed.

input: It's a good thing I've had a few weeks to cool off from my experience at Copabanana before writing this review or it might not have been pretty. Anyhow, I came during university city restaurant week and will never return. We sat outside and there were kids playing football right near the tables and being loud. We moved to the other side of the restaurant (still outside) and the kids made there way over to us and continued playing. We couldnt get away. We went to a table inside. Food was terrible. Steak was fatty and overcooked and mashed potatoes werent fresh. The waitress was about the only thing good about this place. She agreed on the steak and took it back. Came back with chicken as I asked for and it was like biting into rubber bands. All in all it was a disaster and I'll never return. 1 star for the waitress.
Revise this with your best effort:
Fortunately, I had a few weeks to reflect on my experience at Copabanana before crafting this review; otherwise, it might not have been as composed. Regrettably, my visit coincided with university city restaurant week, leaving me with no desire to ever return. Opting to sit outside, our dining experience was marred by the disruptive presence of kids playing football near our tables, making it challenging to enjoy our meal. Hoping for a better atmosphere, we relocated to another section of the restaurant's outdoor area, only to find ourselves followed by the boisterous kids. Our attempts to escape were in vain.

Seeking refuge indoors, we were met with disappointment upon tasting the subpar cuisine. The steak I ordered was exceptionally fatty and overcooked, and the mashed potatoes lacked freshness. The only redeeming aspect of our visit was our waitress, who genuinely acknowledged the shortcomings of the steak and promptly took it back. However, the replacement dish, chicken as I had requested, was disappointingly akin to chewing on rubber bands. Overall, our dining experience at Copabanana was a catastrophic failure, and I have no intention of returning. I can only award one star to the waitress, as she was the sole bright spot amidst the disappointment.

input: Best shrimp and grits in NOLA! Delicious fresh juices too. This is my fiance's second time here in two years and he still thinks it's the best he's tried.
Revise this with your best effort: Experience the unrivaled pleasure of indulging in the finest shrimp and grits in all of New Orleans at our establishment! Discover a culinary haven where delectable flavors take center stage with each exquisite bite. As if that weren't enough, elevate your dining experience with a selection of delicious and refreshing fresh juices. Our commitment to culinary excellence has left a lasting impression on even the most discerning palate. Reinforcing this sentiment, even after his second visit in two years, our esteemed guest and soon-to-be spouse firmly believes that our shrimp and grits reign supreme over all others.

input: Finally! A good tapas place in Nashville. Friendly staff, nice open kitchen, delicious food. I can't wait to go back and try more.
Revise this with your best effort: I'm thrilled to have found an exceptional tapas spot in Nashville! The staff is incredibly friendly, the open kitchen adds to the inviting ambiance, and the food is absolutely delicious. I'm already eagerly anticipating my next visit to savor more of their offerings.

input: Super delish!! No frills! Just great sea food, sour dough bread was great! And I loved the 80s music playing!!
Revise this with your best effort: Absolutely delicious! No unnecessary fuss, just outstanding seafood. The sourdough bread was exceptional, and I couldn't get enough of the fantastic 80s music playing in the background.

input: Dr. Curtis Dechant has an excellent chair-side manner, and he establishes a good rapport with his patients. The office is very comfortable, and the latest high-tech equipment makes eye appointments much easier to bear. I also appreciate their selection of eyeglass frames and the friendly staff.
Revise this with your best effort: Dr. Curtis Dechant possesses an exceptional chair-side manner that truly sets him apart, effortlessly building a strong rapport with his patients. Moreover, the office itself exudes a comforting atmosphere, ensuring utmost ease during eye appointments. Equipped with cutting-edge technology, the experience is made even more bearable and convenient. Additionally, I am delighted by the remarkable variety of eyeglass frames available, perfectly complemented by the warmth and amiability of the staff.

input: Very cute place and good food. Pear cider beer was really good the service was really good and great ambiance and the price was very reasonable
Revise this with your best effort: The place is incredibly charming, exuding an aura of cuteness. The food served is of a high quality and utterly delicious. Notably, the pear cider beer is exceptionally delightful. The level of service received was top-notch, leaving no room for complaints. The ambiance of the establishment was simply amazing, creating a delightful atmosphere. Furthermore, the price of the experience was extremely reasonable, making it even more enjoyable.

input:
I really enjoy this little restaurant full of goodness. Primarily a dessert place, Seasons also serves up some wonderful food dishes which are largely modernized updates on traditional classics. 

I always enjoy the shaved ice when I come here. The kind Seasons offers is a different type of dessert that I haven't seen anywhere else. The variety of boba tea that they have is also very 
good. Among my favorite shaved ice are the hula and the koko loco. If you want half and half flavors of shaved ice in your cup there is an additional $1.50 charge for a large size. There are pre-designed concoctions or you could create your own configurations of toppings and flavors. The pre designed concoctions are a better deal.

Seasons is situated on the end of a strip mall (across from a large shopping plaza with Regal Cinemas and Marshalls) with plenty of parking. The store itself is clean, bright, and modern and is kid-friendly as there are high hairs available for use. 

The service has always been friendly, fast, and efficient. Seasons employs an order at the counter, take number, and food is borough out to you when ready model. 

I can't comment on the food exactly but my boyfriend loves the quail and our friends enjoy the chicken wings which Boon touts as "the best food item" there. The quail is small and very flavorful and the wings are a good size and seasoned with five spice which was enjoyed by all. 

I look forward to many more visits with friends at this location. Check Seasons out and enjoy!
Revise this with your best effort:
I absolutely adore this charming little restaurant that is bursting with culinary delights. Although primarily known for its delectable desserts, Seasons also offers a delightful array of modernized twists on beloved traditional dishes.

One of my personal favorites when I dine here is their incredibly refreshing shaved ice. The unique dessert options they have available are unlike anything I've ever encountered elsewhere. Their selection of boba tea is also exceptional and satisfying. I find myself particularly drawn to the hula and koko loco flavors of shaved ice. If you desire a combination of two flavors in your cup, keep in mind that there is an additional $1.50 charge for a large size. You can choose from their expertly crafted concoctions or create your own personalized combinations of toppings and flavors. However, I must admit that the pre-designed concoctions are a better value.

Situated at the end of a convenient strip mall (opposite a sprawling shopping plaza with Regal Cinemas and Marshalls), Seasons provides ample parking for its patrons. The store itself boasts a clean, bright, and modern ambiance, making it an ideal spot for families with young children, as they offer high chairs for little ones.

The service at Seasons has consistently impressed me with its friendly, efficient, and prompt nature. Their model of ordering at the counter and receiving a number, followed by having your food delivered to your table once it's ready, has proven to be highly effective.

While I can't personally speak to the food options, I can attest that my boyfriend raves about the quail, claiming it to be a true standout. Our friends also thoroughly enjoy the chicken wings, which are purportedly the restaurant's crowning glory according to Boon. The quail is incredibly flavorful despite its smaller size, and the generous portions and well-seasoned five-spice coating on the wings bring unanimous joy to everyone who tries them.

Without a doubt, I eagerly anticipate many more delightful outings with friends at this wonderful establishment. I highly recommend checking out Seasons and indulging in the fantastic offerings they present.

input: Overpriced for what you get. I think this is a cute spot to meet up with a friend, but that's about it. I prefer my own homemade coffee to be honest. Adorable concept, just could use some improvement to products offered and prices.
Revise this with your best effort: In my opinion, this place is slightly overpriced considering what you actually receive. While it may be a charming location for a friendly get-together, I personally find more satisfaction in my own homemade coffee. The concept is undeniably adorable; however, there is room for enhancement in terms of the quality and variety of products offered, as well as adjusting the pricing to align better with customer expectations.

input: This place was absolutely awesome. 75 cent oysters. After 2 dozen I moved to the excellent cheesy grits. Great place to eat. Even better during happy hour.
Revise this with your best effort: This place exceeded all expectations! With its 75 cent oysters, I indulged in not just one, but two dozen of those perfectly fresh and delicious treats. And as if that wasn't enough, I then ventured towards their exceptional cheesy grits and was blown away by their rich and flavorful goodness. This establishment is truly a gem for food lovers. The cherry on top? It gets even better during happy hour, making it an absolute must-visit for a remarkable dining experience.

input: Love it!! I go to this place whenever I am in town and have NEVER been disappointed. The food is organic, fresh and delicious. I love that they buy from local farmers and fishermen. They also grow a lot of their own veggies! You can't get much fresher than that. There's lots of variety so I haven't even come close to trying everything. My favorite breakfast item is Carly's breakfast. Avocado on sourdough toast with a fried egg and sweet potatoes. Sooo good! Highly recommend this place!
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adore this place! Every time I visit town, I make it a point to go here and it never fails to exceed my expectations. The food they serve is not only organic, but also incredibly fresh and bursting with flavor. What sets them apart is their commitment to supporting local farmers and fishermen, it's fantastic to see them sourcing ingredients locally. Moreover, they even have their own vegetable garden, ensuring that the produce used in their dishes is as fresh as it can possibly be. With such a diverse menu, there are still so many options I haven't had the chance to try yet. However, I must say that Carly's breakfast has become my absolute favorite. Indulging in avocado on sourdough toast topped with a fried egg and accompanied by sweet potatoes is simply divine. I cannot stress enough how highly I recommend this place to everyone who enjoys exceptional dining experiences.

input: The burgers were very good very flavorful. I had the El Mariachi. As with what other reviewers have said the portion is not big. But I believe it makes up in flavor. I also have salted caramel ice cream it was very good homemade style. I do recommend the rooster sauce.
Revise this with your best effort: The burgers at this place were absolutely delightful, bursting with incredible flavor. Personally, I ordered the El Mariachi burger and, just like other reviewers have mentioned, the portion size was not particularly large. However, I firmly believe that the exceptional flavor of the burger more than compensates for it. Moreover, I had the pleasure of trying their salted caramel ice cream, which reminded me of homemade goodness and was truly delicious. For an extra kick, I highly recommend their rooster sauce.

input: Just had a late dinner there on a Sunday night and was really surprised at how good the sushi was and how low my ticket was. I had a plate full of sushi and it cost me $13.00. The staff seems to be having a good time too. Very friendly place. I really enjoyed it and will be back soon!
Revise this with your best effort: I recently had a delightful dining experience at a local restaurant on a Sunday night. To my pleasant surprise, the sushi I ordered surpassed my expectations in terms of quality, while the cost remained pleasantly low. Despite dining late, I indulged in a generous portion of sushi priced at only $13.00. Not only was the food remarkable, but the staff also appeared to be thoroughly enjoying their work, creating a friendly and inviting atmosphere. Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my dining experience and will undoubtedly return in the near future.

input:
I had to write an order after coming here a couple of times because this place is just terrible. I tried their hoagies and they are so greasy i got nauseous after eating them... Then yesterday i accidently ordered from here instead of angelinos and i got the buffalo chicken sandwhich and it was just covered in blu cheese and greasy sauce it was so Disgusting.  All their food is terribly greasy and over seasoned its too much.. Back off on it a little and use freasher ingredients it will be much better!

Ill also add that their desserts suck, taste bland and a waste of money. Their sodas are usually expired and flat. I hate everything about this place!
Revise this with your best effort:
After having visited this establishment a couple of times, I felt compelled to express my dissatisfaction by placing an order. Unfortunately, this place has consistently failed to meet my expectations. The hoagies I tried were excessively greasy, resulting in a nauseating experience. Moreover, my recent accidental order of a buffalo chicken sandwich was nothing short of repulsive, being overloaded with blue cheese and a greasy sauce. The excessive seasoning and overwhelming greasiness prevail throughout their entire menu, leaving no room for enjoyment. If the establishment were to exercise restraint in their use of oil and spices, opting for fresher ingredients instead, the overall quality could greatly improve.

Additionally, I must express my disappointment with their dessert offerings. They lack flavor, appearing bland and ultimately a waste of money. Furthermore, their soda selection is consistently subpar, often offering expired and flat options. Regrettably, I find nothing commendable about this place, as it fails to deliver on multiple fronts.

input: Paid for non-smoking room but there was a smell and ashtrays in the room. Since all we were doing was sleeping there we didn't say anything. Shower was crazy slow to drain. Pillows were so lumpy that I woke up with a migraine. Room was clean and staff was nice. Free wifi but wouldn't connect.
Revise this with your best effort: Despite paying for a non-smoking room, we were disappointed to find a lingering smell of smoke and ashtrays in our accommodations. As we primarily used the room for sleeping purposes, we chose not to address the issue with the staff. In addition, the shower drain proved to be frustratingly slow, causing inconvenience during our stay. The lumpy pillows provided were so uncomfortable that they resulted in a migraine upon waking. On a positive note, the room itself was clean, and we encountered friendly and accommodating staff members. Although advertised as having free wifi, we unfortunately found it unable to connect during our time there.

input: Maybe caught the staff on a bad day, but the people in the pharmacy were not friendly. Was told my prescription be ready in 15, when i showed up 20 minutes later they said it would be ready in a half hour. If your in a hurry dont bother filling up your prescription here. Might as well go next door to Walmart!
Revise this with your best effort: Perhaps the staff at the pharmacy were having an off day, as they were not particularly friendly. I was initially informed that my prescription would be ready in 15 minutes, but when I arrived 20 minutes later, they notified me it would take an additional half hour. If you have a time constraint, it might be best to avoid filling your prescription here. Perhaps consider going to the neighboring Walmart instead!

input:
I loves me some seitan, and that's why I keep going to El Camino. The seitan wings & seitan nachos are so good! Unfortunately, the service is not. It can be extremely slow. On one occasion it took them so long to get my seitan nachos out to me that they had to give them to me on the house. All of my friends were done eating and ready to leave and I was JUST getting my food! 

As for the rest of the food at El Camino, the only other thing I've tried would be the fried pickles. I have to say, I was not impressed. I love both pickles and fried things but these were not good. The coating was too grainy and I just didn't like the taste. 

The seitan is so good that it keeps me coming back. And the margaritas are pretty good too.
Revise this with your best effort:
I have a strong affinity for seitan, which is why I find myself continually drawn to El Camino. Their seitan wings and seitan nachos are absolutely delightful. Unfortunately, the same cannot be said for their service, which tends to be excessively slow. On one occasion, the wait for my seitan nachos was so prolonged that they ended up comping them for me. It was rather bothersome, as all my friends had finished their meals and were ready to depart while I was just beginning to receive mine.

Regarding the remaining offerings at El Camino, I have only sampled their fried pickles. I must confess, I was not particularly impressed. Despite my fondness for both pickles and fried delicacies, these did not meet my expectations. The coating was excessively granular, and the taste did not appeal to me.

Nevertheless, the allure of their delectable seitan keeps drawing me back, and their margaritas also receive a favorable nod from me.

input: Excellent place to get a tattoo. I have had two done at B13 and am really pleased with both. One was with a group of people and the owner was able to fit all 4 of us in with a great sketch on really short notice. If you aren't sure who to go to, I've seen especially awesome work by Amanda, though everyone is great I'm sure.
Revise this with your best effort: B13 is an exceptional destination for getting tattoos. Personally, I have experienced their outstanding service twice and have been extremely satisfied on both occasions. Notably, the owner accommodated a group of four of us with a remarkable sketch on very short notice, showcasing their flexibility and expertise. In terms of artists, while everyone excels, I highly recommend Amanda based on her consistently exceptional work. Rest assured, whichever artist you choose, you will undoubtedly receive exceptional results at B13.

input:
We went on a Friday night and the place was full, but even so there was only a 20 minute wait. 
The service was ... Hit and miss. I don't want to rip on our server too much because our server was obviously trying but just not hitting the mark. The food was Ok, but I don't believe I'll be back. It just wasn't great.
Revise this with your best effort: On a Friday night, the establishment was bustling with customers, yet surprisingly, we only had to wait for 20 minutes. However, the service left something to be desired. While I hesitate to criticize our server too harshly as they appeared to be making an effort, their performance fell short of our expectations. As for the food, it was passable, but it failed to impress me enough to consider returning. It simply did not meet the criteria for greatness.

input:
I would recommend Twisted Twig to everyone - excellent service, very friendly, and create amazing arrangements!

You will not regret working with Jen! I reached out to a few different florist 2 weeks before my wedding. I was frantic my wedding was only 2 weeks away and didn't have a florist, even though it was a small wedding. I got a hold of Jen, who I might say was very responsive.

I got on the phone with Jen and she was so nice and very genuine. We spoke about what I was looking for and I texted her some pictures of inspiration and my dress. She asked me if there were certain flowers I was looking for and my budget. I didn't have any flowers in mind, as long as the colors are what I wanted and told her my budget. She sent me a quote, staying within my budget, noting the flowers she would use for the bouquet, boutonniere, and floral arrangements for the arch I had. It was nice that Jen works with you to stay in your budget yet still get what you want.

On the wedding day, Jen arrived at my hotel door right on time with my beautiful bouquet. The floral arrangements at the site was gorgeous also. Jen really hit the mark on what I wanted for my wedding. She also was very sweet and added some roses on the chairs by the aisle to my surprise, which was not on the quote. That was very special because it pulled the whole ceremony look together and I felt Jen really wanted everything to look perfect for me.
Revise this with your best effort:
I highly recommend Twisted Twig to anyone in need of exceptional floral service. Their commitment to excellence, friendly demeanor, and ability to create stunning arrangements truly sets them apart.

Working with Jen was an absolute pleasure from start to finish. Just two weeks before my wedding, I found myself in a panic, without a florist for my small ceremony. Thankfully, I reached out to Jen, who promptly responded to my inquiry.

During our phone conversation, Jen was not only kind and genuine but also took the time to understand my vision. I shared some inspirational pictures and even sent her a photo of my wedding dress. She asked if there were any specific flowers I had in mind and provided me with a budget-friendly quote that incorporated the colors and overall aesthetic I desired. I was impressed by Jen's ability to work within my budget while still ensuring that my dream floral arrangements were brought to life.

On my wedding day, Jen arrived at my hotel right on schedule, delivering a stunning bouquet that exceeded my expectations. The floral arrangements at the ceremony site were equally breathtaking. To my surprise and delight, Jen had even added roses to the chairs lining the aisle, a thoughtful touch that pulled everything together perfectly. It was evident that she truly cared about making my day as flawless and memorable as possible.

Overall, my experience with Twisted Twig and Jen was nothing short of exceptional. Their outstanding service, attention to detail, and ability to create stunning arrangements are truly unmatched. I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone seeking a truly unforgettable floral experience.

input: I deducted one star because the service was not great. Our waiter wasn't friendly at all. The first question was "soup or salad ". I wanted to order appetizer and lunch special, but he assumed we were having lunch. Seaweed salad was really good. Shiomay was small but good. The sashimi was fresh. Banzai roll was great and unique. Raw salmon and white fish with avocado and fish egg wrapped in cucumber with some sweet sauce. Perfect for those who is looking for no-rice roll. Salad dressing was more like carrot purée.
Revise this with your best effort: I deducted one star due to subpar service. Our waiter lacked friendliness and did not accommodate our preferences. Initially, we were only asked about soup or salad as a dining choice, assuming we were only having lunch. However, we wanted to order an appetizer and the lunch special. On a positive note, the seaweed salad was fantastic and the shiomay was enjoyable, despite its small size. The sashimi was fresh and of high quality. The standout dish was the Banzai roll, which was both delicious and distinctive. It consisted of raw salmon and white fish, along with avocado and fish eggs, all wrapped in cucumber and complemented by a pleasing sweet sauce. This option caters to those seeking a roll without rice. However, the salad dressing resembled more of a carrot puree than a typical dressing.

input: I honestly didn't know this place existed until my friend suggested it for brunch over the weekend. I can't believe I live four blocks away and haven't been here before! I ordered the honeybee crepe and an almond croissant. I'm one to typically bring leftovers home but the food was so delicious there was nothing left to take much to the surprise of my friends. There is a small seating area downstairs and some window seating on the first floor. I'd recommend getting there on the earlier side if you're with a group and want to sit. I'd also recommend this for smaller groups. Will definitely be going back.
Revise this with your best effort: I must admit, I was completely unaware of the existence of this place until my friend suggested it for brunch last weekend. It's astonishing to me that I've been living only four blocks away, yet I've never set foot in here before! I opted for the honeybee crepe and an almond croissant, and to my astonishment, the flavors were so incredibly delectable that I couldn't resist devouring every last bit, much to the surprise of my companions who are accustomed to me bringing leftovers home. The establishment boasts a cozy downstairs seating area, along with some lovely window seating on the first floor. Consequently, if you're visiting with a group and yearn for a comfortable spot, I would highly recommend arriving early. This recommendation also stands for smaller groups. Needless to say, I am definitely making a return visit in the near future.

input: This is the best location EVER. The donuts are made to order I believe after 5pm. They are always super hot you can barely eat them . Even the next day they are delicious.

Remarkably, even when enjoyed the next day, these donuts remain incredibly scrumptious.

input: This place is super cute! I love how sustainable they are. Definitely recommend. The people are awesome and pretty! Not to mention the food and coffee are extraordinary!

input: Food is terrible and too expensive for how bad it is. Took over 2 hours for delivery. Rude on the phone when we called to see about our order status. Terrible decision to order from this place, never again.

input: Ew. I don't know what upsets me more, the borderline gross food or how much I had to pay for it. We waited forever to get into this place which served me a relatively tasteless burger on an incredibly soggy McDonald's quality bun and the saltiest fries I have ever eaten. Yes, truffle oil is delicious, but pouring it over burned, greasy fries does not a delicious, 16 dollar meal make. We won't be back.
Revise this with your best effort: Yuck. I am utterly disappointed by both the disgustingly unappetizing food and the exorbitant price I had to pay for it. We endured an eternity to secure a spot in this establishment, only to be served a burger that lacked any discernible flavor, sandwiched between a disgustingly soggy bun reminiscent of a subpar McDonald's creation. To add insult to injury, the fries were excessively salted, leaving me with a lingering dissatisfaction. While I appreciate the delectable nature of truffle oil, dousing it over burnt and greasy fries does not magically transform it into a palatable meal worth the hefty price tag of sixteen dollars. Needless to say, we will not be returning to this place.

input: Pleasantly surprised to find Taiwanese restaurant in Reno. Convenient to all of the hotels.  Solid boba tea and authentic Taiwanese food if you know what to order
Revise this with your best effort: I was pleasantly surprised to discover a Taiwanese restaurant in Reno, which is conveniently located near all of the hotels. Not only did they have solid boba tea, but they also offered an array of authentic Taiwanese dishes - as long as you know what to order.

input: I loved this place.  Walking by, I almost didn't go in, because Im a vegetarian and it looked like there was only meat on the menu. I'm glad that I looked closer. However, upon closer inspection, I was pleasantly surprised. Not only did they offer a delectable veggie burger, but their assortment of local microbrews was simply outstanding. input:
After a long hiatus from reviewing I have awaken from my 6 mouth yelp hibernation and my tummies a grumbles with an insatiable hunger for the cacophonous symphony of flavor that is Indian food. Like an all too familiar pattern, I go back to Mohammad Butt, my main man for marsala.
But whats this? 
There are whispers that he no longer cooks for "Best Taste of Asia," that he is gone, never to return; some sort of falling out.

No.
No, it can't be! 
I need to score - one .. final .. hit..

Life ceases to have meaning, existential murmurings dog the mind. Who am I?
Why am I here?
What is Cheeze Wiz?
Its done, over, a round falls into the chamber and just as I prepare to end it all and pull the trigger- steps in ZAIKA.

Zaika - meaning the art of taste -  stays to to its name. This is a place where the Paneer (cheese) is made fresh in house, resulting in a cheese that's silky in texture. Especially when in contrast to the prepackaged rubbery bone-white LEGO blocks most small Indo-Pak places purchase from Indian Grocers in attempts to reduce prep-times. While at Zaika such shortcuts are not taken,  the Chef takes the extra steps needed to ensure a dish comes together as a whole. For example, the Chicken Makhani uses Smokey Tandoori Chicken, which I have never seen done before but it certainly aids the chicken to cut though the rich buttery tomato sauce and elevates the dish as a whole. Even entrées like Dall Fray or  Palak Paneer  have so much flavor that they will leave you not missing animal protein in the least should you choose to go the vegetarian route. 

Zaika 's appetizers, like the Veggie Samosa and Aloo Tikki, (spiced potato patties) are generally large, peppery and well spiced - the latter of which remind me of something my own mother would make. Though I must warn others to avoid the items that occasionally pop-up as specials like the potato stuffed chili peppers, unless they have a iron stomach or are a gluten for punishment. These peppers are spicy, not deveined or even seeded. Further, I find the fish pakora to be far too fishy.
 
I've become rather taken by Zaikia. Even the simply things such as the naan are good there. Just right in elasticity, the bread does not have too much give and yet isn't too soft. It's nothing elaborate, just properly risen with a light texture and  no egg or yeast flavor. The only complaint being that it lacked that signature faint sweetness naan has. But hey, I use it mostly for mopping up the other good stuff on the plate anyway and the sweetness gets lost in the mix, so I don't mind at all.

The menu has nearly 120 different items, all numbered to order by, making take-out phone orders convenient and should eliminate any fears anyone should have of a language barrier problem. Furthermore, it has short descriptions of each dish - something all ethnic places like this should have.
Though some items like Lassie (a frothy yogurt drink) do not appear on the menu, that too is offered - both a salty and sweet mango verities. 
The head chef speaks English quite well and should be easy to deal with should you want to inquire more or want to setup large orders.

I have already noticed parties negotiating catering for Ramadan as I anxiously awaited my own order.

The bottom line here is this, Mohammad Butt has expanded on the menu he once created for "Best taste of Asia," and taken an all HALAL meat approach. 

Only good things can come of this, only good things.

P.S.
ZAIKA is right behind Nifty Fifties on Grant Ave., so you are all set for dessert should you want a milkshake. 
However, I would suggest getting the Ras Malai if available. These riccotta cheese dumplings flouting in soaked in sweetened, thickened milk are delicately flavored with cardamom, a very some amount of rose water and then garnished with pistachios. They are ungodly good.
Revise this with your best effort:
After a long break from reviewing, I have finally emerged from my six-month Yelp hibernation, craving the delectable flavors of Indian cuisine. However, to my dismay, I hear whispers that Mohammad Butt, my go-to chef at "Best Taste of Asia," is no longer cooking there due to a falling out. This news hits me hard, as I desperately yearn for one last taste of his culinary creations.

In a state of despair, questioning the meaning of life and pondering existential thoughts, I stumble upon a new restaurant called Zaika, which aptly translates to "the art of taste." True to its name, Zaika impresses me with their homemade paneer cheese, boasting a silky texture unlike the rubbery blocks commonly found in other Indo-Pak eateries. The chef at Zaika takes the extra steps necessary to ensure each dish comes together perfectly, such as using smokey tandoori chicken in their Chicken Makhani, a unique twist that enhances the overall flavor. Even their vegetarian options, like Dall Fray and Palak Paneer, are bursting with so much flavor that one wouldn't miss animal protein.

Zaika's appetizers, such as the Veggie Samosa and Aloo Tikki, are generously-sized, well-spiced, and remind me of homemade delights. However, I advise against trying their occasional specials like potato-stuffed chili peppers unless you have a strong stomach for spice or enjoy punishing your taste buds. Additionally, I find their fish pakora to be overly fishy.

I must admit, I have developed a fondness for Zaika. Even their simple naan bread is excellent, perfectly elastic without being too soft, though it lacks the faint sweetness usually associated with naan. Nevertheless, it serves its purpose in soaking up the delicious sauces on the plate, so this is a minor complaint.

Zaika's menu boasts an impressive selection of nearly 120 dishes, conveniently numbered for phone orders and eliminating any language barrier concerns. Furthermore, each dish is accompanied by a short description, a feature that all ethnic restaurants should adopt. Although some items, like Lassi, are not listed on the menu, they are still available, including both sweet and salty mango variations. The head chef at Zaika speaks English fluently, making it easy to communicate and inquire about the menu or place large orders.

I have already witnessed other parties negotiating catering for Ramadan while eagerly awaiting my own order. It is evident that Mohammad Butt has expanded on the menu he once created at "Best taste of Asia," prioritizing Halal meats.

In conclusion, Zaika is a promising addition to the culinary scene, offering delicious Indian dishes and an all-Halal meat approach. I am confident that great things await this restaurant.

P.S. Zaika is conveniently located behind Nifty Fifties on Grant Ave., so you can indulge in a milkshake for dessert if you so desire. However, I highly recommend trying the Ras Malai, if available. These ricotta cheese dumplings soaked in sweetened, thickened milk are delicately flavored with cardamom and a hint of rose water, then garnished with pistachios. They are simply heavenly.

input: Busy place, but we were offered extra- special coffee while we waited. No sooner than it was ready, so was our table. The server was welcoming and offered suggestions for us after we made her aware of some dietary restrictions. My daughter and I shared a salad, entree, and Special grits. Every bite was delicious, beautifully presented, and reasonably priced as downtown prices go. We like this restaurant a lot.
Revise this with your best effort: Despite the bustling atmosphere, we were pleasantly surprised when we were served an exceptional cup of coffee while we patiently waited. Remarkably, our table became available right after our coffee was prepared. Our server warmly greeted us and promptly accommodated our dietary restrictions by providing valuable suggestions. My daughter and I decided to share a delectable salad, enticing entree, and their renowned Special grits. Not only were each bite bursting with flavor, but the dishes were also presented in a visually stunning manner. Surprisingly, the prices for such quality fare in downtown were quite reasonable. It's safe to say that we have developed a strong affinity for this fantastic restaurant.

input: I love this place. Super friendly staff. Great with kids. And the food is amazing. Especially the hash browns. You can also get tomatoes and grits on the side. Yum! And on top of it all it's not hard on the wallet.

input:
Like many other reviewers I passed by this place a number of times before looking it up on Yelp and realizing that I really did need to give it a shot...
Wow... I was not disappointed!
We started out with the crab cake appetizer- it was very well portioned (2 large crab cakes) and the sauce with it had an interesting hint of dill (just lovely and refreshing and a little different).
We were feeling like comfort food and had the chicken tenders-  The portions were very generous and the food was just solid.  Not fussy or stuffy or trying hard... just good, wholesome and good to eat.
The service was fine- however there is only one waitress for the tables and the bar, so i can imagine that if it is full that would cause some delays.  Overall it was just a lovely meal and the prices were unbelievably reasonable (most places have crabcakes 1/2 that size for twice that price)...
The ambiance is nice, nothing crazy but it is just a very nice option with reasonable prices and lovely food!
Revise this with your best effort:
After passing by this place multiple times, I finally decided to give it a chance based on positive reviews from other customers on Yelp. And boy, was I pleasantly surprised! 

We started off with the crab cake appetizer, which was perfectly portioned with two large crab cakes. The accompanying sauce had a delightful hint of dill, adding a refreshing and unique flavor. 

In the mood for some comfort food, we ordered the chicken tenders. The portions were incredibly generous, and the food itself was simply delicious. It wasn't trying too hard or overcomplicated; it was just hearty, wholesome, and satisfying. 

While the service was fine, it's worth noting that there's only one waitress attending to both the tables and the bar. This could potentially cause some delays if the place is full. Nevertheless, overall, it was a delightful dining experience, especially considering the unbelievably reasonable prices. In comparison, most other establishments offer crabcakes of half the size for twice the price. 

The ambiance of the place is pleasant, not over the top but still charming. It provides a great option for dining out with its reasonable prices and delightful food.

input: Always excellent service and amazing food. The staff is is always friendly and there are many promotions that always keep us coming back. The quality of the fish is amazing and the perfect portion size of the rolls allows you to try many different kinds. Out favorite sushi in town!
Revise this with your best effort: Consistently outstanding service and delectable cuisine await at this hidden gem. The staff exudes warm hospitality and the abundance of enticing promotions ensures our continued patronage. The sheer excellence of the seafood is truly remarkable, complemented by thoughtfully portioned rolls that offer a delightful variety. Undoubtedly the pinnacle of sushi experiences in town!

input:
My boyfriend and I both decided to try Jesse's for the first time after we'd both grown up in the Brandon area and neither of us had ever been, and really hadn't heard much about the restaurant. 

We dined on a Saturday night and even though the parking lot and restaurant was packed, we were sat right away at a 2-top next to a window facing SR-60. 

Our server, Nikki, greeted us in a reasonable amount of time. We ordered our beverages and she brought them shortly after that. Something I did not like was there was not a drink menu on the table, but Nikki was able to tell us what beers were on draft and non-alcoholic drinks. She took our appetizer and entree order all at once. 

We ordered crab stuffed mushrooms and a French onion soup to share. These items came out together. The crab stuffed mushroom was basically a giant thing of crab stuffing on a TINY mushroom, which was almost laughable, but had a good flavor nonetheless. The French onion soup had a great flavor and wasn't scalding hot, which was super nice to eat right away. 

After our appetizer came out and we finished it, our Caesar salads came out as well as a loaf of bread and some butter. This was also really great pacing of our meal! Nikki never let empty plates sit on our table, was very attentive, and always made sure we had drinks in front of us. The Caesar salads were good. I gave the bread two chances... once dipped in the French onion soup and once just with butter on it... the bread could have definitely been better - it just didn't have a good flavor to it. 

I ordered the 6 oz filet and he ordered the 16 oz Delmonico - both cooked medium rare. The steaks are served with sautéed mushrooms, your choice of side, and a salad or soup of the day, which isn't mentioned anywhere on the menu. I got broccoli as my side and my boyfriend got a sweet potato with all the fixings. I saw three tables sat after us receive their entrees before us - I don't know if it was a kitchen issue or something else, but we were sat at least five minutes before each of those tables - I tried to make sense of the delay, but it honestly wasn't a big deal to me. Our steaks came out on hot metal plates that were inserted into a cooler outer shell. My filet was nice and thick and cooked perfectly and the broccoli was steamed very tenderly, but there were not enough sautéed mushrooms on the plate, in my opinion. If I had known it would have been like five mushrooms with the steak, I totally would have gotten them as a side. My boyfriend's steak was cooked perfectly as well, but being on the hot metal dish led the steak to cook more at the table, which he wasn't particularly pleased with. He enjoyed his sweet potato with butter, but it didn't come out with cinnamon on it like he requested. 

Anyway, I am sure we will return! Our server, Nikki, was fabulous. She was extremely attentive, had a great attitude, and was knowledgeable!

input:
This was my very 1st time in New Orleans. It's been an amazing experience and so far, every single place I've eaten at has been AMAZING. So... I took a chance with The Praline Connection and walked in. Why? The ambiance and the restaurant, overall, looked nice. 
However... I would NEVER return to this place again, nor would I Ever RECOMMEND it to Anyone. 

APPETIZERS:
I ordered the BBQ Oysters and..wow.. fucking wow...1st of all the oysters not in their shells. Instead they placed in a soup cup filled with  "BBQ sauce" that tasted like cheap Ketchup and Chef Boyarde! Disgusting! The oysters themselves were gooey.

The garlic bread was God awful! It tasted like stale frozen garlic bread. To make matters worse, when I received these appetizers, they were cold.. It tasted and looked like they had been microwaved and left out.  

I also ordered the Chicken wings. They were under cooked, cold and the sauce was nasty.  

The other members of our party ordered entrees. They all said, "This Sucks!"

PROS: The service was great. The servers were all very polite and attentive. 
Restaurant was clean, nice tables, nice ambiance.
Revise this with your best effort:
This was my first visit to New Orleans and it has truly been an incredible experience. So far, I've had the pleasure of dining at some outstanding places. However, my experience at The Praline Connection was extremely disappointing. Despite the attractive ambiance and overall appearance of the restaurant, I will never set foot in this establishment again, nor would I ever recommend it to anyone.

Let's start with the appetizers. I decided to try the BBQ Oysters and to my dismay, they were presented in a soup cup instead of their shells. To make matters worse, the "BBQ sauce" tasted like cheap ketchup mixed with Chef Boyardee, resulting in a repulsive flavor. Not only that, but the oysters themselves were unpleasantly gooey. 

As for the garlic bread, it was absolutely dreadful. It had the taste of stale and frozen garlic bread, which was a huge letdown. To top it off, the appetizers were served cold, as if they had been microwaved and left out for a while.

I also ordered the Chicken wings, but they turned out to be undercooked, cold, and the sauce was unpleasantly vile.

The other members of my group ordered entrees, and they unanimously expressed their dissatisfaction, simply stating, "This really sucks!"

On a positive note, I must acknowledge the exceptional service. The servers were all attentive, polite, and provided great service. Additionally, the restaurant itself was clean, with nice tables and a pleasing ambiance.

input: This is the McDonalds closest to my home, but I will forever drive any distance to find another bc it's a terrible restaurant. Bad service, and no offense to anyone but I cannot even communicate with most employees bc they don't speak any ENGLISH!!  I do not know much Spanish either but when I'm trying to spend my money in Fishers Indiana at a business I at least expect to be able to communicate in some way!  Their service is the slowest from any McDonalds in this area!  My advice: pass on this location unless you have allot of time and can speak Spanish !!!!
Revise this with your best effort: This McDonald's location is the closest to my home, but I am willing to drive any distance to find another one because it is consistently a disappointing restaurant. Though it may not be socially acceptable to admit liking McDonald's, on rare occasions and during the Lenten season, my family and I still choose to visit. Unfortunately, this particular location falls short in many aspects. The food quality is subpar, often cold or incorrect. The service is also lacking and, while I mean no offense, it is frustrating that most employees cannot communicate effectively in English. While I don't possess extensive knowledge of Spanish either, I believe that when conducting business in Fishers, Indiana, it is reasonable to expect some level of communicability. Moreover, the service at this McDonald's is notably slower than any others in the area. Thus, I strongly advise against visiting this location unless you have ample time to spare and can communicate effectively in Spanish.

input:
Ick.  That sums up my experience at Dinardo's in one "word."  Dinardo's gave me that "Ick" vibe the minute I set my foot in the door. THough we were greeted by a very friendly hostess, the place looked like a run down diner on the interior--and it wasn't very clean or charming.  This would have been fine because a lot of times the "run down" places have the best "authentic food," but this was not the case at Dinardo's.  At Dinardo's you do not get what you pay for as the prices are rather high and the food quality is rather low.    Our server hated his life and made snarky, mean comments throughout our time there which, though entertaining, was kind of unwelcome and unpleasant.  My friend had the mussels which were puny and in an unimpressive sauce--unimpressive being the general adjective I would use to describe any given dish my party ordered.  I had a soup which was extremely salty and bland beyond that and the broiled flounder and "seafood imperial" dishes were OK at best. 

I'd say if you're looking for good seafood you'd be better off at any BYOB; little fish, audrey claire, ANYWHERE but Dinardo's.  I don't understand how this place is still in business, to be honest.
Revise this with your best effort:
My experience at Dinardo's can be best described as unpleasant. From the moment I walked in, I felt a sense of disgust. Despite the friendly hostess, the interior of the restaurant resembled a rundown diner, lacking cleanliness and charm. Normally, I wouldn't mind such a setting if the food was authentic and delicious, but unfortunately, that was not the case at Dinardo's. The prices were high, while the food quality was disappointingly low.

To make matters worse, our server had a negative attitude, constantly making snarky and mean comments throughout our meal. While it provided some entertainment, it was certainly unwelcome and added to the unpleasant experience. The mussels my friend ordered were small and the sauce lacked any impressive flavor. In fact, the word "unimpressive" accurately sums up every dish we tried at Dinardo's. The soup I had was both excessively salty and bland, while the broiled flounder and "seafood imperial" dishes were mediocre at best.

If you're craving good seafood, I would strongly recommend visiting any other BYOB restaurant such as Little Fish or Audrey Claire. Anywhere else would be a better choice than Dinardo's. It baffles me how this place is still in business, to be honest.

input:
Drum-roll please! Review #100 coming right up! 

I chose to review Starbucks as my 100th review because it is a guilty pleasure. Something that I only allow myself once a week. But something that I crave everyday! 

This particular Starbucks is great. The baristas are always friendly and welcoming. The drinks are made correctly and quickly. I usually go with a Salted Caramel Hot Chocolate or Mocha. I also occasionally order the White Mocha. If you can't tell, I enjoy coffee that doesn't taste like coffee! In the summer their iced teas are the perfect thirst quencher! Their breakfast pastry items are always delicious. Try the Cranberry-Orange Scone and you will not be disappointed! Their breakfast sandwiches are unique and pretty tasty as well.

I always choose to go in and place my order over sitting in the drive thru. The line for their drive thru is always ridiculously long. It's usually quicker to go in!
Revise this with your best effort:
Ladies and gentlemen, get ready for a fantastic drum-roll as we unveil Review #100! Today, I have the pleasure of reviewing Starbucks, a guilty pleasure of mine that I indulge in just once a week, but yearn for every single day!

Let me begin by raving about this particular Starbucks location, which genuinely impresses me. The baristas here are consistently friendly and welcoming, always ready to serve with a smile. What truly sets this Starbucks apart is their ability to craft beverages flawlessly and swiftly. Personally, I am a fan of their Salted Caramel Hot Chocolate and Mocha, occasionally dabbling in the delightful White Mocha. Coffee that doesn't taste like coffee? Count me in! During the scorching summer months, their iced teas work like magic, providing the ultimate thirst-quenching experience.

Now, let's talk about their delectable breakfast pastries. I highly recommend indulging in the Cranberry-Orange Scone; it is an absolute game-changer that will leave you craving for more. And let's not forget their breakfast sandwiches - they are both unique and remarkably flavorsome.

While some prefer Starbucks' drive-thru, I choose to enter the store and place my order. Why? Well, let me tell you, the queue for the drive-thru is often absurdly long, making it a no-go for me. Opting to go inside usually proves to be the quicker option, allowing me to savor my beloved caffeine fix without wasting precious time.

There you have it, folks - my exceptional Starbucks experience, perfectly timed for Review #100. Trust me, this establishment has got it all - exceptional beverages, delectable pastries, and a thoughtful approach to customer service. What more could a Starbucks lover ask for?

input: My wife and I loved everything about this diner. The decor is lovely & the food was great. I had the cheese steak and it was much better than Geno's.  Our server was awesome
Revise this with your best effort: My wife and I absolutely adored every aspect of this delightful diner. The decor exuded a charming ambiance, while the culinary offerings truly surpassed our expectations. I opted for their delectable cheese steak, which unequivocally outshone even the renowned Geno's. It would be remiss of us not to commend our exceptional server, whose impeccable service truly elevated our dining experience.

input:
Don't judge a book by it's cover.  Looked like a any similar bar food type chain like Friday's, Bennigan's, or Ruby Tuesdays... JB Dawson's is far better.
Awesome experience from the second we stepped in, hostess greeted us with a smile and time to table waiting expectation.  We were promptly seated, and tended to right away with a smile and good attitude by a server, Nancy, who helped us with a beverage and app order.  

For our app we shared the twisted shrimp as it was Twisted Tuesday.  Nancy told us this dish far surpassed Bone Fish's Bang Bang Shrimp, to our surprise, it clearly did.  Our beverage and app shortly followed. 

Shortly there after another server stopped by, Kyle, who was our designated server.  Boy, smile, great greeting, great attitude, engaging.  We talked a bit, figured our way through the menu and placed our order.

For our dishes, my wife selected the Four Cheese Mac & Cheese side -- Sharp Cheddar, Pepperjack, Mozzarella & Reggiano dusted with bread crumbs with cornbread as she had large lunch.  Very good.  Unexpected, light, not overly creamy, not burnt, just right.  And the corn bread with maple butter..... ahhhhhh that was really nice.

 I ordered the fish tacos-- 3 Flour tortillas, seasoned tilapia, chimichurri sauce, mango cilantro salsa & a lime cream drizzle.  Passed on starch sides and had their asparagus that was cooked to perfection.  To my surprise the they were filling, nice size portion (see photo)  not a two bite app.  Very moist and super fresh fish.

Great first experience all around expect one key aspect.  Their so called craft beer menu was really limited and did not contain a variety of types; focused more on IPAs.  Limited thinking for the bar manager I must say.  Kyle our waiter also bar-tends.  We got to talking and he offered with no questions to swap out my beer for another option --- Stoudts Scarlet, which is a reddish beer.  For my beer palette it was better then the others limited options had a nice taste at the swallow then waned off.   Kyle informed us that they buy for all 4 restaurants and try to find a middling that works across the 4 guest demographics.  Not a great decision honestly.  There are so many great craft brewers in the Bucks County region and even Bristol area that should be showed cased and tested through.  For me a bad or poor beer selection stunts the overall experience.

We'll be back but I may need to sneak in my own beer selections from my craft collection.
Revise this with your best effort:
Do not judge a book by its cover; JB Dawson's exceeded our expectations. From the moment we entered, the hostess greeted us warmly and provided an accurate estimate of the table wait time. We were promptly seated and attended to by Nancy, our server, who greeted us with a smile and a positive attitude. She efficiently took our drink and appetizer orders, recommending the twisted shrimp for Twisted Tuesday. Surprisingly, the twisted shrimp surpassed Bone Fish's Bang Bang Shrimp in taste. Our beverages and appetizer arrived promptly.

Shortly thereafter, Kyle, our designated server, introduced himself with a smile and friendly demeanor. He engaged us in conversation, guided us through the menu, and took our orders. My wife chose the Four Cheese Mac & Cheese side, which consisted of Sharp Cheddar, Pepperjack, Mozzarella, and Reggiano topped with bread crumbs, accompanied by cornbread. It was a pleasant surprise—light, perfectly creamy, and not burnt. The cornbread with maple butter was a delightful addition.

I opted for the fish tacos—three flour tortillas filled with seasoned tilapia, chimichurri sauce, mango cilantro salsa, and a lime cream drizzle. I skipped the starch sides and instead enjoyed their perfectly cooked asparagus. The fish tacos were unexpectedly filling, generously portioned, and the fish was moist and fresh.

Overall, our first experience at JB Dawson's was fantastic, with one minor flaw. Their craft beer menu was disappointingly limited, with a heavy focus on IPAs. It seemed like a missed opportunity for the bar manager. However, Kyle, who also tended the bar, kindly offered to replace my beer with a different option—Stoudts Scarlet, a reddish beer. It had a nice initial taste and though it tapered off, it was better than the other limited choices. Kyle explained that they purchase beer for all four restaurants and aim for a middle ground that appeals to all guests. In my opinion, this decision does not showcase the numerous excellent craft brewers in the Bucks County region and Bristol area, stifling the overall experience.

Despite this, we plan on returning to JB Dawson's. Although I may have to discreetly bring my own craft beer selection from my personal collection.

input:
Stopped here for lunch on the way to drop some people off at the airport. It's a bit unexpected and a tiny bit off the beaten path on a residential street just behind a business district.

I chose the vegetarian plate and a Greek salad. The salad was the absolute best I've ever had. The cheese was absolutely fresh, the vegetables were fresh and chopped just for the salad, and the dressing and seasoning was perfect. The salad was quite large on its own and could easily make a light lunch by itself.

The vegetarian plate came along with their fresh pita-like bread that is baked fresh every morning, seasoned, pan fried vegetables, rice, and a tzatziki-like sauce drizzled on top. The flavors were astounding, and despite a lack of desire to stuff myself silly, I did anyway. Plenty of food for lunch and very reasonably priced.
Revise this with your best effort:
We made an impromptu stop at this hidden gem while en route to dropping off some companions at the airport. Tucked away on a quiet residential street, just a stone's throw away from a bustling business district, it may not be the most obvious choice, but boy, it surpassed all expectations.

Opting for the vegetarian plate and a Greek salad, I found myself in culinary heaven. The salad, to put it simply, was nothing short of perfection. The cheese, incredibly fresh and bursting with flavor, harmonized flawlessly with the crisp, just-prepared vegetables. The dressing and seasoning, meticulously balanced, elevated the experience to a whole new level. With its generous portion size, the salad alone could easily serve as a satisfying light lunch.

Accompanying the vegetarian plate was their signature freshly baked pita-like bread, a medley of pan-fried vegetables, fragrant rice, and a tantalizing tzatziki-like sauce drizzled on top. Each component exuded vibrant and remarkable flavors that left me in awe. Despite initially intending not to overindulge, the sheer delight of the meal compelled me to savor every bite. The portion was ample enough for a fulfilling lunch, and to my delight, the price was remarkably reasonable.

In sum, this unexpected find served up an extraordinary dining experience, far off the beaten path. From the unparalleled Greek salad to the mouthwatering vegetarian plate, it exceeded all expectations in terms of taste, portion size, and affordability. A true gem indeed.

input:

Revise this with your best effort: Once again, I would like to emphasize that I only allocate a 5-star rating after numerous visits. This local pho shop has managed to cultivate a diverse and devoted group of regulars, thanks to their outstanding food and incredibly friendly staff.
