The sheer number of TVs in this place is mind-boggling, easily surpassing 20. Each one is tuned to ESPN or ESPN2, although it's unclear which service they are using - Direct TV, Dish, or Cable One. Despite this, they have made a fundamental mistake that many aspiring sports bars make: they broadcast music instead of the live sound from sporting events. Considering that live sports are available every day from noon to midnight, you would think they would prioritize that over background music. It still feels like you're at the old Ruby River, courtesy of the country tunes playing in the background.

Here's a word of advice: if you want people to stay and enjoy their food and drinks, you need to give them something to capture their attention. The sounds of the game will certainly keep them engaged. After all, they came to a sports bar to immerse themselves in sports, not to listen to Conway Twitty.

Typically, when I see the word "pub" in a restaurant's name, I assume it only offers beer and wine. However, Timeout seems to have a full bar with several specialty drinks. If you have a designated driver, it might be fun to venture into trying some new concoctions.

Now, onto the food. The menu mostly consists of typical sports bar fare - salads, burgers, and pasta. Most items fall in the $9 to $11 range, with entrees being pricier. They do add a few unique twists to their offerings, which may entice me to stop by and try something different. However, unless the ambience improves, I suspect I will always leave a bit disappointed.

Although those staying at the nearby motel may appreciate the convenience, I believe they might find the extra steps across the street to Legends worth it for a more fulfilling experience.

For those seeking a good deal, Happy Hour runs from 2pm to 6pm on Monday to Friday, with a late Happy Hour from 10pm until close from Monday to Thursday. On Sundays, Happy Hour is available all day.

input: If you like onion rings order them here. Some of the best I have ever have. I also had a Reuben which was very good also.
Revise this with your best effort: If you have a craving for mouthwatering onion rings, you need to try them at this place. These are hands down some of the best I've ever had. Additionally, I couldn't resist trying their Reuben sandwich, and it certainly lived up to my expectations.

input: The cutest and definitely the friendliest coffee shop in Boise! The coffee is great but the staff is even better. Love this place!
Revise this with your best effort: Boasting an irresistibly adorable ambiance and undoubtedly the warmest atmosphere, this coffee shop in Boise stands out as the epitome of charm. With exceptional coffee that never fails to satisfy, it is the staff that truly steals the show here. Their unparalleled friendliness and genuine hospitality are second to none. Without a doubt, this place has stolen my heart and I couldn't be more smitten!

input:
Hubby and I were eager to try this establishment due to a rave review from some close friends. We decided for our date night we would give it a try on Saturday. We pulled up about 8pm and the open sign was turned off. We thought maybe the light was burnt out or someone just forgot to plug it in. So we proceeded to the door. There were people inside and the sign said open till 11pm, so we walked inside. It was like walking into the Twlight Zone, everyone stopped and stared at us. The woman behind the bar came over and told us they were closed. HUH! Ok.... so we left. It was very akward and unpleasant. If they were closed then the door should of been locked or a sign on the door stating private party or something. 
Not sure if we will attempt to try to dine there again.
Revise this with your best effort:
My husband and I were excited to check out this place after receiving a glowing recommendation from some close friends. We decided it would be the perfect spot for our date night on Saturday, so we arrived around 8pm. Unexpectedly, the open sign was turned off, leading us to assume it was perhaps due to a burnt-out light or someone simply forgetting to plug it in. Undeterred, we made our way to the door, noticing people inside and a sign indicating they were open until 11pm. Confused but hopeful, we entered the establishment.

However, as soon as we stepped inside, it felt like we had entered an alternate reality. All eyes were suddenly fixated on us, and it became evident that something was amiss. A woman behind the bar eventually approached us and abruptly informed us that they were closed. It was a baffling turn of events. We couldn't help but feel uncomfortable and unwelcome in that moment. If they were truly closed, it would have been more appropriate for the door to be locked or for a sign stating that a private party was taking place.

This whole experience has left us uncertain about whether we should give this place another chance.

input: Awesome food! It was so fresh and delicious. The papaya salad was delicious! Try the curry..simply spicy and beautiful. The service was great too! They have take out!!!
Revise this with your best effort: The food was absolutely amazing! Everything was incredibly fresh and packed with delicious flavors. The papaya salad was a real standout, bursting with taste. And let me tell you about the curry - it was the perfect balance of spiciness and beauty on a plate. Not to mention, the service was top-notch, making the entire dining experience even more enjoyable. Oh, and here's the best part, they offer convenient take-out service as well!

input: I have new dental insurance and had to find a dentist in network and came across Music City Dental. Dr. Spurlin and her staff are great! They are very gentle and make sure the patient is comfortable at all times. I had to get a filling and am terrified of shots. I didn't even feel when Dr. Spurlin gave me my shot. I was offered a pillow, blanket and choice of watching a movie or listening to music. I had a pleasant experience and am definitely a permanent patient!
Revise this with your best effort:
After acquiring new dental insurance, I sought out a dentist within my network and stumbled upon Music City Dental. Let me tell you, Dr. Spurlin and her team truly exceeded my expectations. Their approach is gentle and ensuring patient comfort is their top priority.

Despite my fear of shots, I was pleasantly surprised that I didn't even feel a thing when Dr. Spurlin administered the anesthetic for my filling. Additionally, they provided me with a wide array of amenities to enhance my experience, such as a pillow, blanket, and the option to either watch a movie or listen to music.

Overall, my visit was an absolute pleasure, and I can confidently declare that I have found my permanent dental home.

input:
The beef noodles was a bit too salty and the fried rice was a bit oily. But overall they are good. We liked the shrimp spring rolls a lot. It is one of the best we have tried. 

The place could have earned higher points. But I have to give it a three stars because of the chaotic seating arrangement. The owner gave tables to people behind us despite we reminded the him and the staff. Perhaps that is what you get when you go to a teeny tiny Chinese restaurant during a long weekend.
Revise this with your best effort:
The beef noodles in this eatery were slightly overseasoned, leaving them on the salty side, while the fried rice had a slight hint of oiliness. However, on the whole, the dishes were enjoyable. The shrimp spring rolls stood out as exceptional, ranking among the best we have ever tasted.

Despite the potential for a higher rating, I must give this place three stars due to the disorderly seating arrangement. Despite reminding both the owner and the staff, they still accommodated customers who arrived after us. Unfortunately, this may be the result of visiting a small Chinese restaurant during a busy long weekend.

input:
Great community vibe... i've run into friends and struck up conversation with new ones each time i've been in.  Its nice to have new hang within walking distance of my house.  I've stuck to the classic burger and love it... everything from the buns to the ketchup is made in-house and has unique taste. The bar had pretty much whatever i wanted... last night the bartenders made some homespun watermelon concoction.

To touch on some other reviews... i understand everyone has a different experience, but to say the place is 'too hipster' seems like someones still jaded from feeling left out in high school...  and personally attacking the owner is tasteless and has no place in a review.  We should be glad we don't all have someone looking over our shoulder attacking our motives. I like what Burger Up is trying to do and i like that they hired a bunch of folks representative of our Nashville community... if you need a non-musician wait staff who dresses just like you and takes you to prom, you're probably in the wrong town.
Revise this with your best effort:
The community vibe at this place is truly remarkable. Every time I visit, I run into friends and strike up conversations with new acquaintances. It's truly a delight to have a new hangout spot within walking distance of my house. I've always stuck to their classic burger, and let me tell you, it never disappoints. From the meticulously crafted buns to the homemade ketchup, every component has a unique and delectable taste.

Now, addressing some of the critiques I've come across, it's important to acknowledge that everyone's experience may differ. To label this place as "too hipster" seems like a reflection of someone still carrying a grudge from high school. Making personal attacks on the owner is in poor taste and has no place in a fair review. None of us would appreciate having our motives attacked and scrutinized. What I appreciate about Burger Up is their commitment to their vision and their choice to hire a diverse staff representative of our wonderful Nashville community. If you're seeking a non-musician waitstaff who dresses identically to you and treats you like prom royalty, perhaps this town is not the right fit for you.

input: I am not an indian food type of person but this place lives up to the hype. When you go, just let Hassan make something for you, don't try and overwhelm yourself with the different options. Make sure to get a chaat and a lassi as the two really complement one another.
Revise this with your best effort: Although I'm not typically a fan of Indian cuisine, this restaurant truly surpasses expectations. If you visit, I highly recommend entrusting Hassan to craft a dish for you, rather than becoming overwhelmed by the extensive menu. Don't miss out on trying both the chaat and lassi, as they beautifully complement each other.

input:
Excellent food, good service, great location. 

My wife had shrimp and grits, I had the barbecued shrimp -- both were outstanding. The appetizers were good. The bread pudding was a tad dry in the city that is supposed to be the mother lode of bread pudding. 

Mr. B came close to snagging the fifth star but the service could have been more attentive and the place is freezing - - in July in New Orleans. Wear long sleeves or bring a jacket.
Revise this with your best effort:
The dining experience at Mr. B was truly phenomenal. The food was of exceptional quality, with my wife savoring the delicious shrimp and grits, while I delighted in the delectable barbecued shrimp. The appetizers we indulged in were also quite satisfying. However, when it came to the bread pudding, which is famously renowned in this city, we found it to be a bit dry, falling short of our expectations.

Although Mr. B almost secured a fifth star, we couldn't overlook certain aspects that could have been improved upon. The service, while acceptable, lacked the attentiveness we would have preferred. Additionally, the temperature inside the establishment was quite chilly, which seemed rather odd for a July evening in vibrant New Orleans. We advise wearing long sleeves or bringing a jacket to ensure your comfort during your visit.

input:
Wow. We visited NOLA last week and took the truly awesome and informative  Steamboat Natchez trip on March 30. Can't tell you how interesting it was and pleasant. Plus these people are so well-organized and nice. JoJo reserved us a window seat - just could not believe the kind and excellent service. 
Very very nice.  Recommend!!!!
Revise this with your best effort: Wow! We had the most incredible experience in NOLA last week when we went on the captivating Steamboat Natchez trip. On March 30, we embarked on this amazing journey that was both awe-inspiring and informative. Words can't express how much we enjoyed it. Moreover, the level of organization and kindness displayed by the staff was truly remarkable. JoJo went above and beyond by reserving us a window seat, which was such a thoughtful gesture. The service provided was exceptional, leaving us thoroughly impressed. All in all, it was a wonderful experience that we highly recommend!

input: Quite possibly the perfect business model to fail if it wasn't for a sequestered clientel?  We visit New Orleans often, and it is an activity of ours to bet on how many beers or ingredients they are out of.  Bartenders rude and swearing. It's almost comical, we sit and listen to patrons asking for draft beers and mixed drinks and getting responses "can't do that".  They said "No mules", to at least 5 people as we sat for about 30 mins today.  2 out of 4 taps not working. What an absolute waste of opportunity.
Revise this with your best effort: Possibly one of the most flawed business models, saved only by its dedicated clientele. During our frequent visits to New Orleans, my companions and I find amusement in wagering on how many beers or ingredients are unavailable at this establishment. The bartenders, regrettably, exhibit a discourteous demeanor and are prone to uttering profanities. It has almost become a form of entertainment for us to witness patrons ordering draft beers and mixed drinks, only to be met with responses such as "impossible." Today, as we sat for nearly half an hour, we overheard at least five individuals being denied mules. Furthermore, a disappointing 50% of the taps were non-functional. It is truly disheartening to witness such a wasted opportunity.

input: We had a mixed experience at Mr. B's.  We started at the bar for drinks and a starter due to table wait. Bar was nice for a busy night. Our table was ready early so the bar staff transferred our starter to the table and things went down hill quickly. Starters were delivered and then we were ignored for over 45 minutes. No drinks, water etc. Finally a waiter in another section took out order. We ordered BBQ shrimp (best thing on our table), rabbit and wood plank grilled fish. Fish was a very small piece and not worth the $$$. Rabbit was good! Hit and miss service ruined the experience.
Revise this with your best effort: Our visit to Mr. B's was quite varied. We began at the bar, enjoying drinks and a starter while waiting for our table. The ambiance at the bar was pleasing, especially for a bustling evening. Surprisingly, our table was prepared ahead of schedule, prompting the bar staff to kindly transfer our starter to our table. Unfortunately, things quickly took a turn for the worse. Regrettably, once our starters were served, we were left unattended for over 45 minutes. There was no sign of our drinks or even a glass of water. In a stroke of luck, a waiter from another section finally took our order. Among our selections were the highly-recommended BBQ shrimp (which proved to be the highlight of our meal), rabbit, and wood plank grilled fish. Disappointingly, the fish portion served was considerably small and failed to meet its price tag. However, the rabbit dish was indeed pleasing. Ultimately, the hit-and-miss service detracted significantly from our overall experience.

input:
This place is so cute. The interior is adorable and casual. There's some small booths and chairs and tables for hanging out and enjoying your food/drinks. It's all so clean, too, which is a huge plus.
There's a little section with baked goods, some Asian and some more American. They have mostly Vietnamese food, but I also saw some other types of food (e.g bulgogi).
I came in with two friends and the woman who helped us was really personable and friendly. We ordered banh mi and boba tea, and sat down waiting for our food to be brought to us. The banh mi was really yummy, especially the bread. I had boba milk tea, which was as good as any milk tea I've had before. 
They have a drink card which you can get stamped to receive a free tenth drink. Definitely an incentive to return. Also, their hours are awesome, which is a huge plus.
Revise this with your best effort:
This place is absolutely adorable. The interior exudes a charming and relaxed atmosphere. With its cozy small booths, chairs, and tables, it's the perfect spot to hang out and savor your delectable food and drinks. Furthermore, the cleanliness of the place is definitely a major highlight.

One of the noteworthy aspects is a delightful section devoted to baked goods, offering both Asian and American treats. While the majority of the menu consists of Vietnamese cuisine, I was pleasantly surprised to find a selection of other types of food, such as bulgogi.

Upon entering with my two friends, we were greeted by a wonderfully personable and friendly woman who assisted us. After choosing our orders of banh mi and boba tea, we settled down and awaited the arrival of our food. The banh mi was truly delightful, especially the bread that was incredibly tasty. As for the boba milk tea, I can confidently say it rivaled any milk tea I have ever had before.

Adding to the appeal of this place, they offer a drink card that can be stamped, leading to a complimentary tenth drink. This incentive certainly encourages a return visit. Moreover, the establishment's operating hours are conveniently accommodating, which further distinguishes it from other places.

input: I stopped at Walgreens in hopes of seeing the new ELF Villain's collection. Sometimes Walgreens gets them before the holidays. Sometimes they don't. This particular one doesn't ever get them according to their cosmetics person. SAD. Really sad. I suppose I'll have to skulk other Walgreens to find them.
Revise this with your best effort: I made a detour to Walgreens with eager anticipation of exploring the newest ELF Villain's collection. It has been known that Walgreens occasionally stocks these exclusive items before the holidays, yet sometimes they miss out. Unfortunately, this specific location is not among those fortunate enough to carry them, as confirmed by their cosmetics personnel. It's truly disheartening. However, this setback won't discourage me; I'm determined to embark on a quest to seek out these elusive items in other Walgreens stores.

input: This is the best Italian food I've ever had. Very small elegant restaurant, entrees were really good and very tasty cheesecake. To top it off, the entire staff was super friendly. Highly recommended for date night.
Revise this with your best effort: This Italian restaurant has truly surpassed all my expectations. Tucked away in a cozy little space, it exudes elegance. The entrees I sampled were exceptionally delicious, and the cheesecake was a delightful treat. Furthermore, the entire staff proved to be incredibly warm and friendly, enhancing the overall experience. I wholeheartedly recommend this gem for a memorable date night.

input:
This is my favourite place to get fish tacos! It's all I ever order, along with the occasional queso or beans which are also delicious. My friend was visiting from out of town and he ordered the beef taco and chicken fajitas and thought they were pretty average. However, he agreed that the fish tacos were amazing. Since 2 full me up and they're only like $2.60 each it's a pretty happy visit all round for me! Plus the interior and patio are awesome
(And there's Ben and Jerry's right next door for dessert)
Revise this with your best effort: Without a doubt, this is by far my most cherished spot to indulge in delectable fish tacos! It has become my tradition to savor these mouthwatering treats, occasionally accompanied by the irresistible queso or beans that are equally delightful. When my out-of-town friend paid a visit, he ventured to try the beef taco and chicken fajitas, but found them to be quite ordinary. However, he wholeheartedly concurred that the fish tacos were simply phenomenal. Not only do these tacos suffice to fill me up, but at a mere $2.60 each, it's an extremely satisfying and affordable experience. Moreover, the establishment's interior and patio exude an undeniable awesomeness that enhances the overall visit. As an added bonus, the cherry on top, there's a Ben and Jerry's ice cream shop conveniently located right next door, perfect for satisfying any dessert cravings.

input: Replaced a dive watch battery in less than 5 minutes for a very reasonable fee.  Prompt, friendly service.  Plenty of staff.  Convenient location.
Revise this with your best effort: I efficiently replaced a dive watch battery in under 5 minutes, providing prompt and friendly service at a fair price. The abundance of staff ensured convenience, and the location was conveniently accessible.

input:
Stopped here last week while in the area from Burbank. Had read about it on Trip Advisor. It is in a great location, quiet, peaceful and cool under the shade of the big old trees. For its location and it being noon on a Thursday we were surprised to find there was literally only one table open when we walked in. Food is served pretty quick though so it didn't seem anyone was really waiting. 
Based on reviews we had read, my hubby had the tri-tip sandwich. I ordered the buffalo burger. I have to say that was one of the best burgers I have ever had in my life. As usual, we traded tastes of our orders. My hubby was so jealous of my buffalo burger and I heard about it several more times throughout the day, that he should've got the burger. The tri-tip was quite dry, and it was literally just the meat on bread, big bread.  The horseradish sauce (served on the side) was very tasty though.
For the tri-tip, I give a 3, hubby gives a 4. We both give the buffalo burger a definite 5++.

Either way, worth checking out if you want something with a unique atmosphere and that is away from town but not a long drive. Very peaceful.
Revise this with your best effort:
During our visit to Burbank last week, we stumbled upon this gem after reading about it on Trip Advisor. Nestled in a wonderful location, surrounded by tranquil and shaded old trees, it offered a blissful escape from the bustling city. Despite it being noon on a Thursday, we were pleasantly surprised to find just one available table upon our arrival.

Service was prompt, and the food arrived swiftly, indicating that there was no significant wait time. Following the recommendations from previous reviews, my husband opted for the tri-tip sandwich while I indulged in their buffalo burger. I must confess, the buffalo burger exceeded all expectations and easily secured a spot as one of the best I've ever savored. Our usual ritual of sharing bites only made my husband regret his decision as he found himself envious of my scrumptious choice. Throughout the day, he continued to lament his missed opportunity to order the burger. On the other hand, the tri-tip sandwich left much to be desired, as it was rather dry and consisted solely of meat piled on a substantial piece of bread. However, the horseradish sauce served on the side was a delightful addition and enhanced the flavor.

Considering our contrasting experiences, I would rate the tri-tip sandwich a 3 out of 5, while my husband would generously give it a 4. As for the buffalo burger, we both unanimously agree on a perfect 5++ rating.

Regardless, this establishment is certainly worth a visit if you crave a distinctive ambiance away from the city, without venturing too far. The tranquil atmosphere alone makes it a peaceful haven worth exploring.

input:
I have frequented the Mad Mex, University City location for years.  I was pleased to see this new location which is closer to my home and I don't have to deal with the obnoxious students.  I have been here for Happy Hour and just for dinner at another time.  It has been busy both times and it seems that the staff need to be trained a little more in chaos and crowd management.  The best deals are during Happy Hour - the $3, $5 & $7 Margarita's.  I also believe wings are 1/2 off.  My friends seemed to enjoy their orders of Burritos, Gaucamole and enchiladas.  

The food is average and for the price of drinks - it would be a great place to hang if the service improves.
Revise this with your best effort:
I have been a frequent patron of the Mad Mex, University City location for several years. Consequently, I was thrilled to discover the opening of this new location, which happens to be closer to my home and allows me to avoid the hassle of dealing with rowdy students. I have visited for both Happy Hour and regular dinner hours, and on both occasions, the establishment has been quite busy. However, I couldn't help but notice that the staff could benefit from additional training in managing chaos and crowds. 

Undoubtedly, the highlight of the experience is the excellent deals available during Happy Hour, where Margaritas are offered at attractive prices of $3, $5, and $7. Additionally, I believe the wings are half off during this time. My friends have expressed their satisfaction with their orders of Burritos, Guacamole, and enchiladas. 

While the food is decent, I must admit that the service would greatly benefit from improvement, particularly considering the prices of the drinks. Nevertheless, with some notable improvements in service, this location would be an exceptional place to spend time.

input:
I brought my boyfriend here on a Saturday for a tour and beer sampling since Yuengling is one of his favorite beers. We never knew it was so close!

Be sure to look on their website for tour times before going and read the FAQ's. 
- First note: There were many people wearing flip flops on our tours vs. the insisted closed toe shoe policy, but that could be because of the next note.
- Second note: There is no production/brewing on Saturdays so the brewery is quiet and empty.

We looked around the main waiting/lobby area and gift shop waiting for our 12p tour to begin.  We had quite a large group, which had to split into two smaller ones. The tour lasted about 40 minutes, starting with a ten minute video of the history of Yuengling and the rise to present day. Next, the guide takes you out to the brewery, and into the kettle room, around through the lab, the bottle line, and the holding tanks. The tour was informative and hands on. Our guide was informative and knew quite a lot about the history and brewing process. She did a great job!

Once done, you loop back into the lobby where the tasting room is and it's drinks galore. The BEST PART? FREE. Tips are encouraged! ;)
We tried the Premium Lager, Lager, and Black and Tan. Sadly they were out of the Lord Chesterfield this day and the Premium Light is not available here in FL.

Overall, a great tour and I will be revisitng with my parents when they are in town!
Revise this with your best effort:
I invited my boyfriend for a Saturday excursion to enjoy a tour and beer sampling at Yuengling, knowing it's one of his favorite breweries. To our surprise, we discovered that it was conveniently located nearby!

Before heading over, it's advisable to check their website for tour times and familiarize yourself with the frequently asked questions. Now, there were a few observations we made during our visit. Firstly, we noticed that many tour participants were wearing flip flops, even though the brewery strictly advises closed-toe shoes. It's possible that this policy was overlooked by some visitors. Secondly, it's important to note that on Saturdays there is no production or brewing taking place, resulting in a quieter and emptier atmosphere.

While waiting for our scheduled 12 p.m. tour to commence, we explored the main waiting area, lobby, and gift shop. Due to the large group, we were divided into two smaller groups for the tour. The informative tour lasted approximately 40 minutes, starting with a captivating ten-minute video that showcased the history and journey of Yuengling up to the present day. Our knowledgeable guide then led us through various areas of the brewery, including the kettle room, lab, bottle line, and holding tanks. The tour provided hands-on experiences and our guide was impressive with her vast knowledge of the brewing process and the brewery's history. She truly did an excellent job!

Upon concluding the tour, we circled back to the lobby, where the tasting room awaited us. Here's the best part: the samples were absolutely free! Of course, it's encouraged to leave a tip to show appreciation. During our visit, we had the opportunity to try their Premium Lager, Lager, and Black and Tan. Unfortunately, they were out of the Lord Chesterfield on that particular day, and the Premium Light was not available in Florida.

Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed the tour and I intend to revisit with my parents when they come to town.

input:
Really disappointed. I've been to the Marathon at 18/Spruce and had excellent service, drinks and food. Thought that would transfer to this location - not at all.

To sum it up, our server was extremely energetic, but not in a good way. More like a frantic energy. I was there to enjoy a few drinks and dinner with a friend who was visiting (AKA looking to spend money AKA you will get a larger tip if you let us stay longer) and we were rushed out. Server brought boxes for food we were still eating, without asking if we wanted them. A few minutes later he physically put the food in the boxes at the tableside while mumbling something like "I don't like food sitting on the table." .....we didn't even want to take it home. Next, when we said we were having another friend join for another round or two of drinks he told us we couldn't stay at the booth we were at and we needed to go to the bar. What? I point blank asked him if he was kicking us out of the booth and he said "yes!" energetically. There was no one waiting for tables and there were numerous open tables/booths around the restaurant. I felt extremely uncomfortable and wanted to leave immediately. Our friend joined after all this happened, and when the server came over to ask if they wanted a drink, he seemed surprised when we told him we were just going to leave. YOU LITERALLY just told us we couldn't sit at this table any longer!! We then left.

I worked in restaurants for a long time and I'm pretty easy to please when it comes to restaurant service. I was not pleased at all during this visit.

On another note, the food was not that great.
Revise this with your best effort:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience at the Marathon location on 18th and Spruce. In the past, I had enjoyed excellent service, drinks, and food there, so I had high expectations for this visit. Unfortunately, it fell far short.

To start, our server was incredibly energetic, but it was not in a positive way. They seemed frantic and rushed throughout the entire meal. My friend, who was visiting, and I were looking forward to a relaxed evening of drinks and dinner, with the intention of spending money and leaving a generous tip. However, our server seemed determined to rush us out of the restaurant. They brought boxes for our leftover food without even asking if we wanted them. To make matters worse, they proceeded to physically put the food in the boxes right at our table while muttering something about not liking food sitting on the table. We hadn't even expressed a desire to take the food home. 

Then, when we mentioned that we were expecting another friend to join us for more drinks, the server informed us that we couldn't stay at our booth and would have to move to the bar. It was a baffling request, considering there were plenty of open tables and booths throughout the restaurant, with no one waiting. I directly asked if they were kicking us out, to which they energetically replied, "Yes!" This made us feel extremely uncomfortable, and we immediately wanted to leave. 

Our friend eventually joined us after all this chaos, and when the server came over to ask if they wanted a drink, they seemed surprised when we informed them that we were leaving. It was baffling since they had just told us we couldn't sit at that table any longer. We promptly left, feeling unsatisfied and dissatisfied with the entire experience.

Having worked in the restaurant industry for a long time, I am generally quite easy to please when it comes to service. However, this visit was a complete letdown. 

Furthermore, the food itself did not meet my expectations. It was far from great.

input: We arrived for lunch at 12p on a Friday - wasn't busy at all. It took FOREVER to get anything. We were really pleasant and kind but we had to complain several times to get any beverages that we ordered. It took them 40 minutes to let us know that a beer we ordered was no longer available. The food was great, but not worth the lengthy wait and slow service.
Revise this with your best effort: We arrived at the restaurant for lunch on a Friday around 12 p.m., expecting a peaceful dining experience. However, despite the lack of crowds, our experience turned out to be quite frustrating. It took an excruciatingly long time to receive any form of service. We approached the situation with utmost politeness and patience, but ended up having to complain multiple times just to get the beverages we had ordered. Adding insult to injury, it took a staggering 40 minutes for them to inform us that the beer we had requested was no longer available. While the quality of the food was commendable, the extensive wait time and sluggish service overshadowed its merits.

input: Walked by this place and decided to check it out. Great beer and burger place, made even better knowing many things were organic. You can order from the menu, or create your own burger. They also have rotating beers and specials. Nice atmosphere and staff. Burgers don't come with anything, so order from the sides if you want some fries. (There's also sandwiches and salads if you don't want a burger) Vegetarian friendly.
Revise this with your best effort: As I strolled past this establishment, my curiosity compelled me to step inside and see what it had to offer. To my delight, it turned out to be a wonderful beer and burger joint, surpassing my expectations with its emphasis on utilizing organic ingredients. The diverse menu allows you to either choose from their tantalizing creations or get creative and construct your own burger masterpiece. Adding to the appeal, they feature a superb selection of revolving beers and enticing daily specials. The inviting atmosphere and attentive staff contribute to an overall pleasant experience. While it should be noted that the burgers are served à la carte, fear not, for you can easily satisfy your craving for crispy, golden fries by ordering from their assortment of delectable sides. Moreover, for those seeking an alternative to burgers, the menu graciously extends to encompass sandwiches and salads, ensuring there is something for everyone, including those with a vegetarian inclination.

input:
First time I went to Earl's new American kitchen I liked the food it was good wasn't great but it was a ok 
 service not so great sat at the bar did not really care for a bartender tried it again second time bartender was really rude I would never go back there  or Recommend it to anyone
Revise this with your best effort: During my first visit to Earl's new American kitchen, I found the food to be satisfactory. While it wasn't exceptional, it was decent. However, I was less impressed with the service, particularly at the bar where I sat. The bartender's demeanor was quite rude. As a result, I have no intentions of returning to Earl's and would not recommend it to anyone else.

input:
I visited Jake's for the first time after learning that the small diner I used to go to in Delaware as a kid had become a franchise. I was so excited to experience the delicious burgers and fries that I craved as a kid.

I walked into the establishment and was frankly unimpressed by the ambiance. The restaurant was moderately clean and very open. The menu actually reminded my of a Five Guys. You get to choose your own toppings (all free) to put on 1, 2, or 3 patties.

I ordered the regular cheeseburger with a ton of toppings and a regular size french fry to share with my boyfriend. The burgers were delicious. The bread was soft and tasty and the burgers were succulent and juicy. The fries were disappointing. McDonalds fries taste better and usually aren't even as cold as Jake's were.

Man oh man, Jake's. I'll go back for the burgers, maybe, but I definitely will stick to the original location for a better experience.
Revise this with your best effort:
After hearing that the cozy diner from my childhood in Delaware had transformed into a franchise called Jake's, I couldn't wait to pay them a visit. In eager anticipation of relishing their delectable burgers and fries, which still held a special place in my heart.

Stepping inside the establishment, however, my excitement waned as the ambiance failed to captivate me. While the restaurant appeared moderately clean and boasted an open layout, it reminded me a bit too much of a Five Guys. I noticed that, like the latter, Jake's allowed customers to freely customize their burgers with a wide range of toppings at no extra cost, giving them the option to choose between 1, 2, or 3 patties.

Opting for a regular cheeseburger loaded with an array of mouthwatering toppings and a regular-sized portion of French fries to share with my boyfriend, my taste buds brimmed with anticipation. The burgers, I must admit, did not disappoint. The bread was delightfully soft and flavorful, while the succulent and juicy patties elevated the overall experience. However, the fries left much to be desired. Even compared to McDonald's, Jake's fries fell short in terms of taste and were surprisingly colder than expected.

Oh, Jake's, though I may consider returning for your tantalizing burgers, my heart remains loyal to the original location for a more fulfilling and memorable dining experience.

input: I think its funny that my car needed a jump infront of their shop on broad street and i was told No because of not being able to leave the store. When asked if another employee could help he said no he is about to leave. I then asked if he can give me a jump when he leaves and i also got a NO. Funny how theycservice cars, help people with cars but cant even give me a jump. Lame service. Not customer oriented at all. Typical fat guy behind the counter surfing the web and playin on his phone. The worst
Revise this with your best effort: I find it rather humorous that my car required a jumpstart right in front of their shop on broad street, only to be denied assistance due to their inability to leave the store. When I inquired if another employee could lend a helping hand, I received another negative response, as he was supposedly on the brink of leaving. input: I ordered the Pulled Pork Nachos.  They were delicious!  Instead of tortilla chips they are served with potato chips...perfect to share with a Beer or Bloody Mary
Revise this with your best effort: I couldn't resist ordering the Pulled Pork Nachos and, boy, was I delighted! They exceeded my expectations in every way. Instead of the typical tortilla chips, they came adorned with crispy, tantalizing potato chips, giving them an irresistibly unique touch. The combination was simply perfection, and I couldn't help but envision sharing this delectable spread over jovial conversations accompanied by a refreshing beer or a zesty Bloody Mary. A truly delightful treat!

input: This place was cute and was in a great location!  It is one block up from the beach and wharf, two blocks over from State Street.  Parking was convenient, and our room was a King overlooking the courtyard and spa on the ground floor.  If there were people in the spa, they could be heard, but the noise didn't bother since the spa closed at 9pm.  The room was clean with a nice couch to lounge on, a refrigerator, a nice fireplace, ample closet and counter space, and a nice bathroom.  The wine and cheese at 5 was a nice touch as well.  Although this place didn't have a lot of extras, it was a pleasant stay, friendly and helpful staff, a good price, perfect location, and suited our needs just fine for a place in Santa Barbara.  My only complaint was that the room got a little stuffy, but was fine once we opened the windows and used the ceiling fan to air it out.  Would consider staying here again.
Revise this with your best effort: This adorable establishment boasts an excellent location! Just a block away from the beach and wharf, and a mere two blocks from State Street, it couldn't be better situated. The convenience of parking adds to its appeal. Our room, a King overlooking the serene courtyard and luxurious spa on the ground floor, was both comfortable and clean. It featured a delightful couch for lounging, a refrigerator, a charming fireplace, generous closet and counter space, and a lovely bathroom. The 5 o'clock wine and cheese reception was a delightful and appreciated touch. While there was a slight noise from the spa when it was in use, it was not bothersome as it closed promptly at 9pm. The staff were friendly, accommodating, and always ready to assist. With a reasonable price, perfect location, and meeting all our needs, this place proved to be a pleasant and suitable choice for our stay in Santa Barbara. The only minor issue we had was the room occasionally feeling a little stuffy, but opening the windows and utilizing the ceiling fan quickly resolved that. We would definitely consider staying here again.

input:
I've been to Mirna's about four times over the past few years and never been disappointed. The portions are HUGE, especially for the modest price tag. Do yourself a favor and get a pasta dish, I can assure you that you'll be glad you did. I've had fish there too, which wasn't bad by any means, but the pasta plates are definitely their specialty. A couple of the times I've been there they treated us to free hummus and pita, which is always a plus. BYOB!

Only knock on the place is that it's pretty small, so make sure to call ahead to reserve a table or check for a wait.
Revise this with your best effort:
I've had the pleasure of visiting Mirna's on multiple occasions over the past few years, and I can confidently say that I have never been disappointed. What sets this place apart is the generous portion sizes, particularly when considering the affordable prices. If you're looking for a winning choice, I highly recommend trying one of their delectable pasta dishes. Trust me, you won't regret it. While their fish options are decent, the real star of the show is undoubtedly their pasta plates.

On a couple of occasions, the staff even surprised us with complimentary hummus and pita, which is always a delightful bonus. One minor downside to keep in mind is that the restaurant itself is fairly compact, so it's best to call ahead and reserve a table or inquire about potential waiting times. But don't let that deter you from experiencing Mirna's flavorsome offerings. Oh, and another great perk? It's BYOB!

input: While I generally support independent restaurants over chain places,I still don't buy into the overpriced center city Phila hype. The place was actually roomier than the south Philly closets we usually take my mother in law for her birthday,but the prices were jaw dropping...quite different from the online menu. The food and portions were ok,and the dessert was something different than the average places. The bus help was a bit out of sync with the waiter,as they were asking us if we were done with our plates just as the waiter was telling us the desserts,and as the Philly standard the bathroom was a bit small to accomodate the size of the place.
Revise this with your best effort: While I generally prefer independent restaurants over chains, I must admit that I am not fully convinced by the hype surrounding the overpriced center city Philadelphia dining scene. However, I was pleasantly surprised to discover that this particular establishment was more spacious compared to the cramped South Philly spots we usually choose for my mother-in-law's birthday celebrations. The prices, unfortunately, were quite astonishing and not in line with what I had seen on the online menu. The food and portion sizes were satisfactory, and the dessert offered a unique twist compared to the average places. It seemed that the bus staff and the waiter were slightly out of sync, as the former would inquire about clearing our plates just as the latter began discussing the desserts. Additionally, the restroom, in typical Philly fashion, was on the smaller side considering the size of the establishment.

input: Platoon is awesome and you definitely want Steve C as a trainer. When I started platoon, I was going once a week and attending a different group exercise class the other days of the week. After a few months, I was only coming to platoon 3-5 days a week. I loved how my workouts were customized to what I could do and wanted to do instead of a group workout that was impossible to complete. Steve is a great listener and motivator and sets realistic goals. The staff at platoon are very nice and accommodating. I never had a problem with billing or scheduling.
Revise this with your best effort:
Platoon is truly remarkable and Steve C is an exceptional trainer who comes highly recommended. Prior to joining Platoon, my fitness routine consisted of visiting once a week while attending various other group exercise classes on alternate days. However, after a few months of experiencing the personalized workouts and tailored exercises at Platoon, I found myself drawn in and attending 3-5 days a week.

What made Platoon stand out was the outstanding level of customization. Unlike other group workouts that often felt unattainable, Platoon ensured that my workouts were crafted to my abilities and desires. Steve's ability to listen attentively and motivate was truly remarkable, allowing me to feel supported as I achieved goals that were both challenging yet realistic.

Moreover, the staff at Platoon were incredibly kind and accommodating, making the entire experience even more enjoyable. Not once did I encounter any issues with billing or scheduling, as they were always prompt and professional in handling these matters.

In conclusion, Platoon, with Steve C as a trainer, is an absolute must for anyone seeking an exceptional fitness journey. The personalized workouts, attentive staff, and seamless administrative processes truly set Platoon apart.

input: The Tater-Tots were good but not anything I haven't  had before. Burger was satisfactory.  Quick stop for lunch.  Staff was helpful with providing directions to local attractions.
Revise this with your best effort: The Tater-Tots were tasty, although they didn't offer anything particularly unique. As for the burger, it was decent and met my expectations. Our lunch stop was swift and convenient. Furthermore, the staff was accommodating, not only serving us well but also guiding us with directions to nearby attractions.

input:
As a frequent customer who has come since the place opened, I had previously rated this place higher, based on a recent experience decided to downgrade.

Myself and both in-laws had visited, one of which was senior. Had a mail coupon for $5 off, which had no disclaimer.  I wanted to apply this to our party of three (2 adults, 1 senior). Cashier gave us a hard time stating that her management dictated that she wasn't allowed to apply the coupon if we were combining it with a senior discount. What logic is that? How would it be any different if I had paid for myself and my mother in law, applied the coupon. Then told my father in law, the senior, to pay on his own. Seriously, Retarded. 

This is on YOU management not that poor girl. Either for not creating a better customer experience or poorly training your staff.
Revise this with your best effort:
As a longtime loyal customer, I had previously held this place in high regard. However, based on a recent experience, I have decided to lower my rating.

During our visit, I, my spouse, and one of my in-laws, who happens to be a senior, took advantage of a mail coupon offering $5 off. To our surprise, there was no disclaimer on the coupon indicating any restrictions. When I attempted to use the coupon for our party of three, the cashier gave us a hard time, citing management's policy that the coupon could not be combined with a senior discount. I fail to understand the logic behind this decision. How would it make any difference if I had paid for myself and my mother-in-law, applied the coupon, and then had my father-in-law, the senior, pay separately? It truly baffles me.

I want to make it clear that this issue lies with the management, not the cashier. It is their responsibility to create a better customer experience and adequately train their staff.

input: Our 1st visit here. We went through the drive thru & ordered 4 Chicago dogs. The total bill was $10.  The Chicago Dogs were great & the only place in a 28 mile radius that you can purchase one. The only 2 things missing were a poppyseed bun & celery salt. My last attempt for a Chicago dog locally was Sonic (yuck). SuperGyro uses 100% beef hot dogs, that neon green relish, sport peppers, onions, dill pickle tomatoes & onion. I'll be back for more & also to try the other menu items.
Revise this with your best effort: This was our first visit to SuperGyro and we decided to go through the drive-thru. We ordered four delicious Chicago dogs, which turned out to be amazing. We were thrilled to find out that SuperGyro is the only place within a 28-mile radius where you can get an authentic Chicago dog. The only slight drawback was that they didn't have a poppyseed bun or celery salt. Previously, I had attempted to get a Chicago dog from Sonic, but it was a disappointing experience. However, at SuperGyro, they use 100% beef hot dogs paired with the classic toppings of neon green relish, sport peppers, onions, dill pickles, tomatoes, and onion. We were thoroughly impressed and will definitely be back for more. In fact, we're excited to try out the other items on their menu as well.

input: Wawa is like a beacon in a cold, dark world.  I grew up around Sheetz locations, but I have to admit that I prefer Wawa.  The sandwiches are really good, and they have the typical snacks/drinks you would expect from a convenience store.  This particular location is not quite as friendly as the one I go to near the office, but whatever.  I can still walk out with all of my snacking requirements.
Revise this with your best effort: In a cold, dark world, Wawa shines as a guiding light. Despite growing up with Sheetz around me, I wholeheartedly confess my preference for Wawa. Their sandwiches are undeniably delicious, and they offer the expected convenience store snacks and drinks. While this specific location may not exude the same level of friendliness as the one near my office, it remains inconsequential. I can still confidently walk out with all my snacking needs fulfilled.

input: My dad and I stopped in on the way back to the hotel because we wanted a 2nd drink after being disappointed with our first at another place. We ordered the hand grenades rather than pore over the menu. There was a band playing so we decided to sit for a bit Holy cow on those drinks!! They were $9 each (with souvenir cup) and we were really feeling it towards the end of the drink. It was during the day and we were enjoying the nice weather and band playing. This place was on the corner of Bourbon, close to Jackson Square and there was lots of open air coming through. We were singing along with the band which is an indication of how good that drink made us feel, lol. We had a lot of fun, good atmosphere in that bar.
Revise this with your best effort: On our way back to the hotel, my father and I made a spontaneous stop at a different place, craving a second drink after being disappointed with our first choice. Opting for the hand grenades, we bypassed the menu and were pleasantly surprised. With a live band playing, we decided to linger for a while. Those drinks, complete with souvenir cups, cost us $9 each, but boy, did they pack a punch! By the end of our beverages, we were definitely feeling the effects. Despite it being daytime, we couldn't resist basking in the pleasant weather and the lively music near the corner of Bourbon, close to Jackson Square. The open air flowing through the venue added to the enjoyable atmosphere. We even found ourselves singing along with the band, a testament to just how good those drinks made us feel. Needless to say, we had a blast and thoroughly enjoyed the vibrant ambiance of that bar.

input:
I went to this location because it's easy to get in and out even tho it is a busy corner. This is my second visit. My first visit was mediocre. The woman who assisted me was not really friendly (sorry I didn't get names at either visit) but was helpful and professional. My second visit I was assisted by a different woman who was also helpful, knowledgeable and professional. I realized the women were not being rude; they are just quiet. Neither woman made small talk but answered every question I had. 
Now my second visit deserved 5 stars. I normally pack things myself and just need it shipped, but I was shipping a skateboard and could not box it correctly. The woman went above and beyond to help me and she offered more assistance than was professionally required.  I will return to this location for all my shipping needs.
The store is clean, and packs (no pun intended) a lot of product into a small space. The staff is knowledgeable. They have boxes, packing materials, and offer copying services. You may not get a big smile and a lot of small talk, but you will get the highest level of service. In my opinion.
Revise this with your best effort:
I chose to go to this particular location because, despite it being a busy corner, it is easily accessible. This was my second visit, and unfortunately, my first experience was quite average. The woman who served me, although not outwardly friendly (I apologize for not obtaining her name on either occasion), was helpful and displayed professionalism. However, on my second visit, I was assisted by a different woman who not only proved to be helpful and professional but also had a wealth of knowledge in the field. I realized that both women were not being rude; their reserved nature just made them appear quiet. Despite their lack of small talk, they diligently answered all my inquiries.

Now, my second visit truly deserved a five-star rating. Typically, I handle packing myself and only require shipping services. However, this time I was struggling to properly box a skateboard. The woman working went above and beyond her duty to assist me, offering more help than was necessary in a professional setting. This experience has led me to decide that I will be returning to this location for all my shipping needs.

The store itself is clean and efficiently utilizes its space to accommodate a wide range of products. The staff members are highly knowledgeable and are equipped to provide services such as box availability, packing materials, and even copying services. While you might not receive a warm smile and indulge in idle chitchat, you can rest assured that you will receive the utmost level of service. This is my personal opinion based on my experiences.

input: I had chicken BBQ burritos with all kinds of stuff that I like. I love the it ! Good place to sit down with family & had a meal. I wish they had a place for kids to play that would be even better !
Revise this with your best effort: I thoroughly enjoyed devouring the chicken BBQ burritos with a delectable selection of my favorite ingredients. The experience was truly delightful, presenting an excellent ambiance for bonding with my family over a satisfying meal. However, my only wish would be to witness the addition of a designated play area for children, as it would further enhance the overall experience.

input: We stopped here for my Chai and Hubby's coffee and caffeine mania. The line went quite fast, they're quick with the service especially not a lot of people at the time. My Chai came out good, awesome! One thing I forgot to do is to purchase more coffee for the house. They have lots for sale. But not too worry because we still have plenty of Starbucks coffee at home. What would life be without Starbucks?
Revise this with your best effort: We made a quick stop here for my Chai and my husband's coffee, satisfying our caffeine cravings. Surprisingly, the line moved swiftly, thanks to their efficient service during a rather quiet time. My Chai turned out to be delicious, which made me happy. However, I realized that I forgot to buy more coffee for our home. Luckily, this place had a wide selection available for purchase. Nonetheless, we have plenty of Starbucks coffee at home, so there's no need to worry. After all, can we even imagine our lives without Starbucks?

input:
It's a young start up company. Patience is a virtue.
Many in the gun community lack this virtue, so be it.
Owner seems to be a stand up guy and has stood by his word in my dealings with him.
I met the owner, Jacob, at a gun show in Las Vegas where I purchased a Cerakoted billet lower.
Pretty quality work on the machining and Cerakote job.
Traded emails with the owner and always got a quick response with the information I requested.
Revise this with your best effort: The company is a budding start-up, where patience is considered a valuable attribute. Unfortunately, many individuals within the gun community tend to overlook this virtue. However, the owner of this company, Jacob, stands out as an exceptional individual who consistently lives up to his promises. I had the pleasure of meeting Jacob at a gun show in Las Vegas, where I purchased a meticulously crafted Cerakoted billet lower. The machining and Cerakote work displayed exceptional quality. In my interactions via email, Jacob proved to be incredibly prompt and provided me with all the information I needed without any delay.

input: Very impressed with this place, particularly the menu (amazing) and the food. We ordered the fruit bruschetta (yum, what an awesome idea!) and the Popeye skillet and the Roadhouse sw. Great food, creative options! Couple areas of critique: it was FREEZING (every woman had a sweater on in July) and lack of ambiance. The latter could be easily remedied with some decent background music, and better lighting? (Overhead office lighting is a drag, but large windows a plus) Customer service was good not great, tad disconnected...but it was a holiday weekend. Overall, a keeper. I'll def be back!
Revise this with your best effort: I was extremely impressed with this place, particularly the outstanding menu and the quality of the food. Our choices, the fruit bruschetta and the Popeye skillet, were not only delicious but also showcased a creative approach to cuisine. The Roadhouse sandwich was also a standout option. There are a few areas that could be improved upon, though. Firstly, the temperature inside the restaurant was extremely cold, to the point where even in July, every woman had to wear a sweater. Additionally, the lack of ambiance was noticeable. However, this could easily be remedied by adding some pleasant background music and enhancing the lighting. While the overhead office lighting dampened the atmosphere, the large windows were a positive feature. The customer service was decent, although slightly disconnected, which may be attributed to it being a holiday weekend. Despite these minor criticisms, I consider this place a keeper and will definitely return!

input: Great job on my fill and gel pedicure. Even though it was close to closing, they took their time and even accommodated every request I had (I'm VERY particular). Clean environment and very friendly staff. Way more than I could have expected for a nail salon in a mall. P.S. My foot and hand massages afterwards were heavenly. I will DEFINITELY be back!!!
Revise this with your best effort: I must express my utmost satisfaction with the incredible fill and gel pedicure I received. Despite being near closing time, the staff generously allocated a significant amount of time to ensure my satisfaction and went above and beyond to cater to all my specific requirements (which I must admit, are quite particular). The salon itself maintained a spotless atmosphere, fostering a clean and hygienic environment, while the staff exuded warmth and friendliness. Their exceptional service far exceeded any expectations I could have had for a typical nail salon found within a mall. Additionally, I must commend the heavenly foot and hand massages that followed; they truly added an extra touch of bliss to the experience. I unequivocally guarantee that I will be a loyal patron and eagerly anticipate my next visit.

input: I can't recall the day I went but it was a memorial resturant experience.  I was greeted by an incredibly nice cashier. After a hard decision I ordered a Devils delight and the girl giggled ( of course I was confused) She explained it was Dev's Delight and named after her because it was her idea for a burger and me calling it Devils delight was a bit funny because her friends call her Devil Dev ( hard to believe such a nice girl could aquire such a nickname but cute). After she took my thorough of a medium burger, and truffle fires i didn't have to wait very long. Even before I ate the burger the smell it self had my mouth watering.  The burger was cooked to perfection and what was on the burger was amazing!  This burger was a standard beef foundation with mozzarella cheese tomato basil and a portobello mushroom, what great idea for a burger! For a mushroom lover this with a side of the delicious truffle fries is perfect. Excellent quality and service,  a bit expensive but worth every penny. No question about it I will be a return customer!
Revise this with your best effort:
I can't quite recall the exact day I went, but it was truly a memorable restaurant experience. From the moment I walked in, I was warmly greeted by a cashier radiating kindness. After some contemplation, I finally settled on ordering the Devils Delight—a decision that elicited a giggle from the girl taking my order. Perplexed, I questioned the reason behind her amusement, and she kindly explained that it was called Dev's Delight after her, as she was the mastermind behind this delectable burger creation. I couldn't help but find it amusing that her friends affectionately referred to her as Devil Dev, an ironic nickname for someone so genuinely nice.

Once I placed my order for a medium burger and truffle fries, I didn't have to wait long before they were served to me. The aroma alone was enough to make my mouth water in anticipation. As I took my first bite, I knew I had made an exceptional choice. The burger itself had been expertly cooked to perfection, and the combination of flavors that adorned it was simply spectacular. The classic beef patty, complemented by the melty mozzarella cheese, ripe tomato slices, fragrant basil, and savory portobello mushroom, was an absolute stroke of genius. As a devoted mushroom lover, this burger, accompanied by a side of the indulgent truffle fries, was nothing short of perfect.

The quality and service provided were truly top-notch, deserving of acknowledgment. While the price may be slightly on the higher end, the experience and taste were definitely worth every penny. Without a shadow of a doubt, I will become a loyal patron of this establishment, eagerly returning for more delectable meals in the future.

input: I was trying to find a decent place for dinner tonight for my moderately health conscious self when I came across this place. After figuring out what I wanted and put the Be My Bison burger in my cart for the online order, I realized it would be over a two mile round trip excursion from my job. Defeated, I started to search elsewhere but I could not get that burger off of my mind. I came back a few hours later and submit my order. I hiked it there and it just came out of the kitchen as I walked in.  I grabbed my burger and continued on my way back to work. O-M-G! Absolutely in love with this place. It has been quite the task to try and find healthy places that fit my diet but this is a dream come true! Thank You!
Revise this with your best effort: In my quest to find a suitable dinner option tonight that aligns with my moderate health-consciousness, I stumbled upon this gem of a place. After careful consideration, I decided to indulge in the tantalizing Be My Bison burger and added it to my online order. However, it dawned on me that this delectable treat would require a round trip of over two miles from my workplace. Feeling defeated, I reluctantly began to explore alternative options. Yet, to my surprise, I couldn't shake off the thought of that burger. Several hours later, unable to resist any longer, I returned and placed my order once again. Determined, I embarked on a journey to the restaurant, and coincidentally, as soon as I stepped inside, my burger emerged from the kitchen. Grasping my long-awaited meal, I resumed my trek back to work. The moment I took a bite, I was overwhelmed by sheer bliss. Falling head over heels for this place, I must admit that discovering eateries that cater to my dietary preferences has been quite the challenge. Hence, stumbling upon this establishment feels like a dream come true. I am genuinely grateful for this delightful experience. Thank you!

input:
this place was awful. the first time my mother and I went we were very excited because everyone had been talking about it and we want to support local business. The day we went it happened to be pouring raining. So we are standing there at the hostess stand cold and wet waiting to be seated. Not only was the hostess not there, no one even acknowledged that we were there. The bartender who was right next to he stand was on his blue tooth and only looked our way to flirt with me. My mom was so annoyed we just left. 

The second time we went was because we were going to be in the area and we decided to give it a second try. We were seated right away and the music was really good. The waiter could have cared less about our table. he acted like we were doing him a favor by even coming to the table. The menu was thin and nothing to really choose from. when he eventually brought the food it was decent. My mom hated her salmon cakes because they were overly breaded and poorly season. it honestly looked like two pieces of bread. 

It was overpriced for what we had. I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND THIS PLACE. The take out makes great dog food though.
Revise this with your best effort:
This place was absolutely terrible. The first time my mother and I visited, we were filled with excitement as we had heard so many positive things about it and we wanted to support a local business. Unfortunately, our visit coincided with a heavy downpour, and we stood shivering and soaked at the hostess stand, waiting to be seated. To make matters worse, not only was the hostess nowhere to be found, but no one even acknowledged our presence. The bartender, who was conveniently located next to the stand, paid more attention to his phone call than to us, only taking a moment to flirt with me. My mom was beyond frustrated, and we decided to leave.

However, against our better judgment, we decided to give this place a second chance. We happened to be in the area and thought, why not? Surprisingly, we were promptly shown to a table, and the music playing was enjoyable. Unfortunately, the waiter behaved as if serving us was a burden, displaying an attitude as if we were inconveniencing him by simply being there. The menu was disappointingly limited, offering very little variety. Eventually, the food arrived, and while it was decent, my mom's salmon cakes were a major disappointment. They were overly breaded and lacking in seasoning. Frankly, they resembled two pieces of bread more than anything else.

Considering our experience, the high prices we paid for such mediocre offerings were unjustifiable. I couldn't, in good conscience, recommend this place to anyone. Although, if you're in need of dog food, their takeout might serve that purpose just fine.

input: Service was good. Mesquite wings are very good  best to share or save some don't be greedy like me and try.and go back to work. Only downside was the weak lemonade. It was the weakest I ever had.
Revise this with your best effort: The service provided was excellent, beyond satisfactory. The mesquite wings were exceptionally delicious, highly recommended to be shared or saved for later. I must admit, I made the mistake of indulging myself and not leaving any room to continue working. If only I had not been so greedy. However, the only drawback to this otherwise delightful experience was the rather disappointing lemonade, which happened to be the weakest I have ever tasted.

input:
I don't know how I lucked out with having this taqueria in our neighborhood, but this is the best Mexican food you'll get in New Orleans.

We discovered Taqueria Guerrero after finding that burrito joint down the street was packed, had a line wrapping around the buidling (you know which one!).

After finding street parking near the mattress store, we plopped down and ordered the 3-taco plate (al pastor, mmmm) with beans and rice on the side and a burrito (barbocoa). I am a creature of habit and order the same tacos, but the bf has ventured out to get other dishes such as the fajita plate or the really spicy shrimp (camarones del diablo?). All very tasty.

The rest is history. It's embarrassing how often I suggest this place when we want to go out/get take out.
Revise this with your best effort:
I consider myself extremely fortunate to have stumbled upon Taqueria Guerrero in our neighborhood because, without a doubt, it serves the finest Mexican cuisine in all of New Orleans.

Our journey to Taqueria Guerrero began when we noticed that the popular burrito joint down the street was overflowing with customers - a seemingly never-ending line wrapping around the entire building (we all know which one I'm referring to!). Determined to satisfy our Mexican food cravings, we managed to find a spot to park our car nearby, conveniently close to a mattress store.

Settling ourselves in, we eagerly placed our order for the delectable 3-taco plate, with the al pastor variety being an absolute must-try. Of course, we couldn't resist complementing our tacos with a side serving of beans and rice. On top of that, my partner, being more adventurous, decided to explore other offerings on the menu, such as the fajita plate or the tantalizingly spicy shrimp dish known as camarones del diablo. Needless to say, everything we've tried has been exceptionally flavorsome.

Since that fateful day, Taqueria Guerrero has become an integral part of our dining routine. I'm almost embarrassed by how frequently I suggest this extraordinary establishment whenever we contemplate going out or ordering take-out.

input:
Came here with a group of 15 people on a Tuesday night. We had reserved a space in advance. 
While the food was good, what was lacking was good service and cleanliness. We sat down at our table and it was sticky, and there was a dirty and also sticky fork still on it...so the assumption was that the table simply hadn't been wiped down all the way. Yuck. 
We ordered and the food took a fair amount of time, understandable because of such a large party. Problem was, when the food came out, no server knew what we'd individually ordered, so it became a huge mix up with people eating others' food. 
I ordered the pork belly tacos which had a great caramelization on the outside and tender inside. I also ordered the spicy beef pho, which was perfectly balanced with flavor after adding the accompanying bean sprouts and limes. 
The wait for the check and processing payment was long and arduous, a problem again because we had a Lyft driver waiting outside for us. 
All in all, go for the food, not for the service.
Revise this with your best effort:
We arrived at the restaurant on a Tuesday night with a group of 15 people, having made a reservation in advance. While the quality of food was satisfactory, we were disappointed with the service and cleanliness. Upon sitting down, we discovered that our table was sticky and there was a dirty fork left behind, suggesting that it hadn't been properly wiped down. It was an unpleasant sight. 

We placed our orders, anticipating a longer wait time due to the large party. However, when the food was served, the servers seemed oblivious to who had ordered what, leading to a major mix-up where people ended up eating each other's dishes. 

I myself opted for the pork belly tacos, which were excellently caramelized on the outside and tender on the inside. Additionally, I ordered the spicy beef pho, which had a well-balanced flavor after the bean sprouts and limes were added. 

Unfortunately, the wait for the check and payment processing was excessively long and tedious, causing further inconvenience as our Lyft driver was waiting outside for us. 

All things considered, I would recommend this place solely for its food rather than its lackluster service.

input:
