input:
When I was preparing to write this review and give Sam's a particular number of stars, I encountered a dilemma.  Should my star rating be based upon comparing Sam's to all Sports Bars in which I have ever been?  Or, should it be a comparison to Nashville Sports Bars?

I chose the former:  compared to everywhere - because if you're from out of town that only seemed fair.  The sad news is that for a vibrant southeastern city where we have two professional sports teams, our sports bars kinda suck.

Sam's is honestly one of two great sports bars in the city.  I really like Sam's and I really like the patio in Spring, Summer, and early Autumn.  But, when compared to so many sports bars across the country in other cities of comparable size with their own sports' teams... Sam's is just mediocre.  

The service is always a toss up, and the ladies dressed in those referee outfits - could you not find some attractive Southern women to put on those booty shorts and v-cut referee shirts?  Some of the regular old-time employees who have been there since I was in undergrad - a decade ago - really should not be wearing tight clothes.  Wow.  That was just really mean.  I'm sorry.

The food is on the better side of bar fare.  But their beer selection could want for some better beers and a wider variety of selection.  The mixed drinks tend to be a bit weak, in my opinion.

But, hey, it's a bar.  It has lots of TVs and they play the game commentary over the speakers throughout the bar.  All and all, if you want to watch sports at a bar, then I would recommend Sam's.
Revise this with your best effort:
When I sat down to write this review and assign a specific number of stars to Sam's, I found myself facing a dilemma. Should I base my rating on comparing Sam's to all the sports bars I've ever been to, or should I only consider Nashville sports bars?

After careful consideration, I decided to go with the former option - comparing Sam's to sports bars everywhere - because I believe it's only fair, especially for out-of-towners. Unfortunately, the disappointing truth is that despite being situated in a vibrant southeastern city with two professional sports teams, the sports bars here are quite lackluster.

Sam's, however, is one of the two exceptions to this trend. I genuinely enjoy this place, especially the patio during the beautiful seasons of Spring, Summer, and early Autumn. However, when compared to sports bars in other cities of comparable size with their own sports teams, Sam's falls into the mediocre category.

The service at Sam's can be hit or miss, and I must admit that the ladies in referee outfits could use an upgrade. It wouldn't hurt to find attractive Southern women willing to don booty shorts and v-cut referee shirts. Additionally, some of the long-time employees who have been there since my undergrad days (about a decade ago) might benefit from choosing more flattering attire. I apologize if my previous remark came off as harsh.

As for the food, it leans towards the better side of typical bar fare. However, their beer selection could use improvement, both in terms of quality and variety. In my opinion, the mixed drinks tend to be weak.

That being said, it's important to remember that it is, after all, a bar. Sam's boasts numerous TVs and they play game commentary throughout the establishment. Overall, if you're looking to watch sports in a bar setting, I would recommend giving Sam's a try.

input: Great location, great food, and friendly staff! There are only a few seats and the store gets pretty crowded with people waiting for their food. I saw a lot of online order ready to go at the counter and think that would be the smart move the next time I want to come during a weekday lunch rush. Weather permitting, it's great to grab some HCV and eat it in Rittenhouse Square across the street! I've come a few times with friends and coworkers and no one has complained about their choices (vegetarians and meat eaters alike)!
Revise this with your best effort: With its exceptional location, delectable cuisine, and amiable staff, this eatery truly has it all! Although it boasts only a limited number of seats, the establishment tends to get quite packed, as patrons eagerly await their scrumptious meals. During my visit, I couldn't help but notice the multitude of online orders lined up at the counter, prompting me to consider this savvy option for future weekday lunch rushes. If the weather permits, there's nothing quite like procuring some heavenly culinary delights from here and relishing them amidst the scenic beauty of Rittenhouse Square just across the street! Whether accompanying friends or coworkers, I have frequented this place on multiple occasions, and it is worth mentioning that all dietary preferences, be it vegetarian or meat lovers, have been met with absolute satisfaction, leaving no room for complaints!

input: Absolute garbage company. Trying to get from Indy to Chicago and they are more than an hour late, did not inform me of the delay, and their entire customer policy (feel free to read it on the website) consists of "we cannot be held responsible for anything." Sitting at a bus stop with 20 people whom are all having their time wasted with absolutely no recourse.
Revise this with your best effort: This company's services are incredibly disappointing. I had scheduled a trip from Indianapolis to Chicago, only to find out they were over an hour late. What's worse, they didn't bother informing me about the delay in advance. Upon reviewing their customer policy, which I encourage you to read on their website, it seems they take no responsibility for any inconveniences caused. Here I am, stuck at a bus stop with about 20 other frustrated individuals, all wasting precious time without any form of recourse.

input: I'm glad that Michael & Lucy found a way to open up another family restaurant after years at Tony's on Linden (now closed following an ugly family dispute). The food is good and the prices are reasonable (ask about the slice and salad special). The Tuscany design is pleasant as are the owners (Lucy is always sweet and friendly). They have local beer on tap (Figueroa, Island Brew and others), 3 HD sports TVs inside, one HD sports TV outside for patio diners, a TV dedicated to surf videos and a TV dedicated to kids shows (and a classic old family friendly Ms Pac-Man game that was a hit with 2 kids when I was there). It's a tough location but I hope they make it work. Santa Claus Lane seems to be having a bit of a Renaissance after many years of being known mostly for outdated kitschy roadside attractions. Good luck!
Revise this with your best effort:
I am absolutely delighted by the fact that Michael and Lucy were able to establish another family restaurant following their time at Tony's on Linden, which unfortunately closed due to a bitter family dispute. Not only is the food exceptional, but the prices are also quite reasonable (don't forget to inquire about their fantastic slice and salad special). The charming Tuscany design creates a pleasant ambiance, much like the owners themselves (Lucy is always effortlessly sweet and friendly).

In addition, they offer a selection of local beers on tap, including Figueroa and Island Brew, among others. Inside, you will find three high-definition sports TVs, ensuring you never miss your favorite game. For those dining on the patio, there is one outdoor high-definition sports TV. They even have a dedicated TV showcasing surf videos and another dedicated to kids' shows. And let's not forget the exciting addition of a classic, family-friendly Ms Pac-Man game that was a hit with two children during my visit.

Undoubtedly, the location presents its challenges, but I sincerely hope that they overcome them and thrive. Santa Claus Lane appears to be experiencing a renaissance after years of being known mainly for its outdated and kitschy roadside attractions. Wishing Michael and Lucy the best of luck!

input: Don't let the shopping center location deter you! Amazing place and even a more amazing staff. Curtis is the true epitome of great service. Loves his job and wants nothing more than for you to enjoy your dining experience. Try the scallops small plate, you won't regret it, but the whole dining experience is top notch.
Revise this with your best effort: Do not be discouraged by the shopping center location! This establishment is truly remarkable, and the staff is even more exceptional. Curtis embodies the essence of outstanding service, genuinely passionate about his work and solely focused on ensuring your dining experience is enjoyable. I highly recommend indulging in the scallops small plate; it will leave you beyond satisfied. However, I must emphasize that the entire dining experience is unparalleled and of the utmost excellence.

input: Awesome! Loved this place. Great little breakfast joint easy walk south of route 90. Easy walk from French Quarter and surrounding areas. We got the bananas foster and it was incredible. Great decorations and colorful setting that feels like how you'd expect New Orleans to feel. Highly recommend.
Revise this with your best effort: Wow! I absolutely adored this place. It's an incredible little breakfast joint that is conveniently located within a short stroll south of route 90. The best part is that it's also just a leisurely walk away from the French Quarter and other nearby areas. We tried their bananas foster and it was nothing short of mind-blowing. The ambiance is stunning, with vibrant decorations that truly capture the essence of what one would expect New Orleans to be like. I cannot recommend this place highly enough.

input:
Great birthday cakes...I mean it.
  BUT: The cupcakes and cookies out front tend to be stale at times...although when I have complained they made good on everything. 
  I will go back!
Revise this with your best effort: I cannot stress enough how amazing the birthday cakes are at this place. Truly exceptional. HOWEVER, there have been instances where the cupcakes and cookies displayed upfront were a bit stale, which is disappointing. Nevertheless, I must commend their customer service as they promptly addressed and resolved my concerns. Despite this minor setback, I remain eager to return because the quality of their birthday cakes is undeniably top-notch.

input:
Service was a bit slow for Saturday lunch but not unacceptable. Understandable as a new place gets its feet under it. I tried to go Friday night and it was a total mess. Long line and nobody taking names. We left. 

The margarita was great. I had the cilantro chicken enchiladas. Also great! The outdoor seating area was very pleasant under the umbrellas on a lovely Saturday afternoon. 

Overall, I liked it. They just need a bit more time to figure out the flow. I'm thrilled to see something affordable move into my neighborhood. The prices are very reasonable and this place isn't trying to be "casual fancy" like the last two train wrecks that occupied this space.

Hope Loco thrives for years to come!
Revise this with your best effort:
The service during Saturday lunch was slightly slow, but still within an acceptable range. It's understandable considering the establishment is still finding its footing as a new place. We had attempted to visit on Friday night, but the experience was chaotic. There was a long line and no one was keeping track of names, so we ultimately decided to leave.

On a positive note, the margarita was fantastic. I opted for the cilantro chicken enchiladas, which were also excellent. The outdoor seating area, adorned with umbrellas, made for a pleasant atmosphere on a lovely Saturday afternoon.

All things considered, I enjoyed my experience at the restaurant. They just need a little more time to iron out their operations. Additionally, it's refreshing to finally have an affordable option in my neighborhood. The prices are very reasonable, and it's a breath of fresh air that this new establishment isn't aiming for an overly pretentious or fancy vibe like its ill-fated predecessors.

Here's hoping that Loco thrives for many years to come!

input:
I've been going here now for a couple of months. I have never received more compliments on my nails then I have since seeing Nary! 

I love all the girls that work there, and we all banter amongst each other, and the other clients as well. No more sitting in silence while I get my nails done!! Yay!

I recommend making an appointment! This is not a dime a dozen nail salon! They offer the newest designs and jewels that so many others don't, and because of that, it's busy. You can walk in, but prepare to sit and wait. And if you want crazy encrusted nails, you can get them here! But you'll pay for what you want, so if you're on a budget throw out your number from the beginning so you aren't shocked at check out. 

See you ladies in 2 weeks!!
Revise this with your best effort:
I have been a loyal customer of this nail salon for a few months now, and I can confidently say that I have never received as many compliments on my nails as I have since I started going to Nary! The entire staff is amazing, and we all engage in lively banter, creating a fun and enjoyable atmosphere for both the clients and the employees. Gone are the days of sitting in silence while getting my nails done! It's a definite yay!

I highly recommend making an appointment at this nail salon, as it is far from your average dime a dozen place. They offer the latest nail designs and exquisite jewels that many others don't, which is why it tends to be quite busy. While walk-ins are welcome, be prepared to wait as the demand is high. And if you're looking for intricate and embellished nails, you've come to the right place! Just keep in mind that with such lavish designs, the cost may be higher. It's always a good idea to communicate your budget upfront to avoid any surprises at the checkout counter.

Looking forward to seeing you lovely ladies in two weeks!

input: A definite go-to place if you're in Treasure Island! Love the char-grilled oysters!  Great staff!  Big outdoor seating area and best yet, it's pet friendly so bring your pup!!!  Coming from Austin where pets are accepted everywhere this is a real bonus for me!
Revise this with your best effort: If you find yourself in Treasure Island, this is hands down the ultimate destination to check out! The char-grilled oysters here are absolutely divine – a must-try for seafood enthusiasts. Moreover, the staff is incredibly friendly and attentive. What sets this place apart is the spacious outdoor seating area, perfect for enjoying a delightful meal in a relaxed atmosphere. And best of all, it warmly welcomes our furry friends, making it an ideal spot for pet owners. As someone who hails from Austin, where pets are embraced everywhere, I truly appreciate this fantastic bonus!

input: Lots and lots of mostly fried seafood. Surprisingly expensive for a working class joint. It's the kind of place a dock worker would take his family for a fancy meal and not feel out of place. And it's definitely a New Orleans sort of experience. But the food isn't that great.
Revise this with your best effort: A wide variety of predominantly fried seafood can be found abundantly at this establishment. Astonishingly, the prices are rather steep for a restaurant catering to the working class. It is the type of establishment where a dock worker might bring his family for a special occasion, without feeling out of their element. Undoubtedly, it offers a genuine New Orleans ambiance. However, regrettably, the culinary offerings fail to impress.

input: This place came highly recommended from some family that has been here many times. Service was fast and friendly even though they were extremely busy. Food was very tasty with mostly basic fare for breakfast.  The Cajun tasso omelet was fantastic. Not too spicy but just enough. Hash browns were fluffy and delicious. Other food at the table was French toast and eggs over medium. Everybody left satisfied and full. Will def come back for more next visit.
Revise this with your best effort: This establishment was highly recommended by our family, who have frequented it multiple times. Despite being incredibly busy, the service remained fast and friendly. The breakfast offerings primarily consisted of classic dishes, and the Cajun tasso omelet, in particular, was exceptional. It struck the perfect balance of flavor without being overly spicy. Additionally, the hash browns were wonderfully fluffy and delightful. Among the other dishes ordered were French toast and eggs over medium, both of which left everyone at the table satisfied and fully satiated. Without a doubt, we will be returning for more during our next visit.

input: I came here with a group of four and had a great experience. There are tons of interesting appetizers to try--we had dumplings with corn and mushrooms, wings, and some specials that are escaping me. Each of us also got an order of noodles. These are not chinatown noodle house portions, but they also aren't chinatown noodle house ingredients. Interesting, fresh, and tasty. Plus its a great deal and BYO to boot. Great addition to 10th street!
Revise this with your best effort: My group of four had an exceptional experience at this place. The variety of fascinating appetizers was truly impressive; we indulged in delectable dumplings filled with corn and mushrooms, flavorful wings, and a few delightful specials that slip my mind at the moment. In addition, each of us savored a portion of noodles that, although not as generous as those from a typical Chinatown noodle house, were nonetheless tantalizing and crafted from high-quality ingredients. The dishes were undoubtedly intriguing, fresh, and packed with flavor. On top of all this, the establishment offers a fantastic deal and allows guests to bring their own beverages. It is undoubtedly a superb addition to 10th street!

input: Best sandwiches in St.Louis! Could eat here everyday. Always a very friendly crowd when I come and eat here.
Revise this with your best effort: The sandwiches offered at this St. Louis establishment are undeniably the best in town! With their mouthwatering flavors and exceptional ingredients, I could easily indulge in one of these creations every single day. Furthermore, the warm and welcoming atmosphere is consistently complemented by a friendly crowd, making each visit to this place an enjoyable experience.

input:
A great lunch or dinner stop in Reno, NV.  

We've had some fine meals in this establishment......Tyler (manager) does a great job with his staff, and it shows in the overall results.

They are also a pub, so its got a great selection of beers and wines too!
Revise this with your best effort:
If you're looking for an exceptional lunch or dinner spot in Reno, NV, look no further. Our experience at this establishment has been nothing short of delightful. The credit goes to Tyler, the manager, who possesses great leadership and ensures the staff delivers exceptional service and culinary excellence.

What sets this place apart is not just the fantastic food but also the fact that it doubles as a cozy pub. As beer and wine enthusiasts, we were thrilled with the extensive selection they offer. So whether you're in the mood for delectable dishes or a refreshing libation, this establishment has got you covered.

input:
As a childless woman I wasn't sure how I was going to enjoy my experience here but I give the good folks at Chuck E Cheese credit....they do run a fairly tight ship. There are lots of staff running around both on the floors and behind the counters so whether you need to order another sample platter or get a refund after a machine ate your token you will never be stuck waiting too long. There is also staff at the door and they do stamp the kids to make sure they don't wander away on their own or with somebody they do not know.

I like that all the games here are just one token. There are also quite a few different types of games available from Arcade style to games of chance. One thing I did notice is that the game area is larger then the play area which means your kiddo's are more likely to want to spend their time here and your likely going to be reaching for your wallet on more then one occasion.

There was a decent amount of food sent to our birthday party table and even with six kids and five adults there was still pizza left over. I did find the birthday area to be a little crowded and we did on more then one instance accidentally back our chairs into people from the neighboring party table. 

The staff here were great and very attentive making sure all the special birthday rock stars were well looked after. I don't know how many times I would really need to come into a place like this as I don't have that many friends with kids but it was great to see them enjoying themselves as well as reliving some fond memories from my own trips to Chuck E Cheese as a little girl.
Revise this with your best effort:
As a woman without children, I had my reservations about how enjoyable my experience at Chuck E Cheese would be. However, I must give credit to the exceptional team at this establishment; they truly know how to maintain an efficient operation. The presence of numerous staff members, both on the floors and behind the counters, ensures that you never have to wait too long, whether you need to order another sample platter or request a refund for a token that was swallowed by a machine. Furthermore, the staff at the entrance take great care to stamp children, preventing them from wandering off alone or with strangers.

I appreciate the fact that all the games here require just one token, and there is a variety of games available, ranging from arcade-style games to those based on luck. One observation I made is that the game area is larger than the play area. Consequently, children are more likely to choose this section, resulting in numerous occasions where you may find yourself reaching for your wallet.

During our birthday party, an ample amount of food was provided, and even with six kids and five adults, we still had leftover pizza. However, I did find the birthday area slightly crowded, and on more than one occasion, our chairs accidentally bumped into people from the neighboring party table.

The staff at Chuck E Cheese were outstanding and attentive, ensuring that all the birthday "rock stars" received excellent care. Although I may not have many opportunities to visit a place like this, as many of my friends do not have children, it was heartwarming to witness their enjoyment and reminisce about my own memorable trips to Chuck E Cheese as a young girl.

input: This was such a nice change from the other restaurants. Simple fresh organic food.  Full coffee, latte, etc options. Sasquatch brew is delicious. Also, very nice ambiance. Casual, relaxed, and comfortable. The owners are amazing and friendly.
Revise this with your best effort: I was pleasantly surprised by this restaurant as it offered a refreshing change from the others I have visited. The menu consisted of simple, yet delectable, fresh organic food that left me satisfied. Moreover, I was impressed by their extensive coffee selection, which included delightful options such as lattes and more. The Sasquatch brew, in particular, stood out to me with its incredible taste. In addition to the culinary delights, the ambiance of the restaurant was absolutely delightful, creating a casual, relaxed, and comfortable atmosphere. What truly sets this place apart, though, is the exceptional hospitality of the owners. They were not only incredible at their job but also exuded warmth and friendliness that made the whole experience even more enjoyable.

input: Delicious! Best place around for ice cream . Everything is made fresh from cows without hormones and antibiotics . It's cash only, but it's worth the trip to the ATM.
Revise this with your best effort: Absolutely delectable! The paramount destination in town for heavenly ice cream. Each and every scoop is meticulously crafted from fresh cow's milk without the interference of hormones or antibiotics. Although the payment method is exclusively cash, the absolute delight it offers makes a visit to the ATM unquestionably worthwhile.

input:
This was our second choice after finding out Rio Mar was closed for Mardi Gras week. We had a hell of a time getting here since it was on the other side of the parade from where we were staying.
   Nonetheless, we had a great meal. 
    Service was spot on. Professional but not overbearing or obvious. 
    A little disappointed that they were out of two ingredients for one of their signature cocktails, but it WAS the day before Mardi Gras.
   The bread and butter at the table was excellent. Crunchy outside, soft inside.
   The beets salad was so much better and different from similarly named items at other restaurants. The greens literally tasted like they had been picked from a sun warmed field minutes before.
    G's Choucroute was a meaty fiesta. He loved it. My crab ravioli was lovely with a delicate Meyer lemon sauce. 
    Bread pudding for dessert was just how we like it - sans raisins.
    Truly a memorable meal. Way better than most hotel restaurants.
Revise this with your best effort:
This dining experience became our second choice when we discovered that Rio Mar had closed for Mardi Gras week. Despite the challenges of navigating through the parade from our accommodation, we managed to arrive and were pleasantly surprised by the exceptional meal that awaited us.

The service we received was impeccable – professional, yet not overwhelming or conspicuous. Although we were slightly disappointed to learn that they had run out of two ingredients for one of their signature cocktails, we understood that it was the day before Mardi Gras, and such occurrences were to be expected.

The bread and butter provided at our table proved to be excellent. Its outer crunchiness gave way to a delightful softness within. The beet salad, in particular, stood out from similar offerings at other establishments. The greens possessed a distinct freshness, as though they had just been plucked from a sun-drenched field mere minutes before arriving to our plate.

G's Choucroute was a carnivorous delight that he thoroughly enjoyed, while my crab ravioli was elegantly complemented by a delicate Meyer lemon sauce. To cap off the meal, the bread pudding, prepared to our liking without raisins, satisfied our dessert cravings.

Indeed, this dining experience will be etched in our memories as a truly exceptional one. It far surpassed our expectations of typical hotel restaurants.

input: Found 51st Deli on Uber Eats and we loved it!!! I can't wait to check it out in person!
Revise this with your best effort: We recently discovered 51st Deli on Uber Eats and were absolutely thrilled with our experience! We enjoyed the food so much that we are eagerly anticipating visiting the deli in person.

input: The Honey Apple grilled cheese sandwich is totally to die for! I never been more happy to eat a grilled cheese sandwich in my life! The staff is friendly, the decor is cool and hip, and the food is great. The Meltdown in Montgomeryville does not compare. The service is rude and the decor is too futuristic/weird. I had my server throw my sandwich at me and splash another customer with soup at Montgomeryville. Regardless of then other shops, I love meltdown it really helps a cheese lover out!
Revise this with your best effort: The Honey Apple grilled cheese sandwich at Meltdown is absolutely amazing. I have never been this delighted with a grilled cheese sandwich before in my life. The staff is incredibly friendly, the decor is trendy and cool, and the food is simply fantastic. In comparison, The Meltdown in Montgomeryville falls short. The service there is quite rude, and the decor gives off a strange futuristic vibe. I even had a server throw my sandwich at me and accidentally splash another customer with soup in Montgomeryville. Despite these negative experiences at other shops, Meltdown truly caters to my love for cheese and never disappoints.

input:
They have combination deals that make rolls and sushi super cheap! The rolls are definitely on the smaller side, so you'll need to order up on the combination deal if you want to get full. Sashimi was actually more fresh than I thought it would be, considering the price! 

Also, the joint is sort of small, and the service is slow, but the place is BYO, so you can just head downstairs and bring up some beers while you're waiting.
Revise this with your best effort:
They offer incredible combination deals that make rolls and sushi incredibly affordable! Though the rolls are smaller in size, you can satisfy your appetite by ordering one of their generous combination deals. Surprisingly, the sashimi exceeded my expectations in terms of freshness, especially considering the reasonable prices!

Additionally, it's worth noting that the establishment is on the smaller side and the service might take a bit longer. However, the advantage is that it is a BYO place, allowing you to conveniently head downstairs and bring up some refreshing beers while you wait.

input: The food was good, service was horrible. I ordered orange juice for my kids and waited till we were almost done eating then finally got the juices. They take cash or checks only. Everything else was OK, but they could do a little bit better on their service.
Revise this with your best effort: While the food exceeded expectations, the service left much to be desired. Despite ordering orange juice for my children, we had to endure a lengthy wait until our meal was nearly finished before the juices arrived. Additionally, it was inconvenient that the establishment only accepted cash or checks. Although the rest of the experience was satisfactory, improvements in their service would greatly enhance the overall dining experience.

input:
After coming here for many years, I was very disappointed by my last trip. The one place you never cut corners is in the food, and that's exactly what they did. 2 of the 3 salsas were so watery that you didn't get any tomatillo or tomato on your chip, at all. The third salsa, the pics de gallo, was the worst chop job I've ever seen in a restaurant. Huge pieces of Serrano pepper with varying sizes of everything else, and in stark contrast to the other 2, completely dried out. 

Without even looking at the menu, I know what I want... #15. That decision hasn't changed for over 10 years. Today I should have made a different choice. I'm not sure if they recently went thru a purveyor change but the quality of everything on the plate was horrible. 

I used to love the rice, it changed. I used to love the chicken quesadilla, now it's flavorless and covered in 2 lbs of cheese for 1/2 a breast.

Please go back to your old ways and cut costs elsewhere, other than the food.
Revise this with your best effort:
After being a loyal customer for many years, my recent trip to this establishment left me utterly disappointed. I have always believed that compromising on food quality should never be an option, yet that is exactly what they did. Out of the three salsas served, two were disappointingly watery, depriving the chips of any hint of tomatillo or tomato flavors. However, the salsa that caught my attention, pico de gallo, was an appalling miscut mess. It consisted of oversized Serrano pepper pieces with a jumble of inconsistent sizes of other ingredients, and to make matters worse, it was completely dried out, unlike the other two salsas.

Even without needing to glance at the menu, my go-to dish has always been #15 for over a decade. However, on this regrettable occasion, I should have ventured towards an alternative option. I cannot say for certain if they recently switched suppliers, but the quality of every element on my plate was simply abhorrent.

Previously, I adored the rice served here, but it has undergone a drastic change for the worse. Additionally, my once-beloved chicken quesadilla has lost all its flavor and is now drowned beneath an excessive two-pound cheese blanket, obscuring the mere half-breast portion.

I implore the establishment to revert to their old practices and find methods to reduce costs without compromising the quality of their food. There are undoubtedly ways to manage expenditures that do not directly impact the integrity of the culinary experience they were once known for.

input: Just got 2 tattoos at Stigma today and I am so happy! I went there because they have good reviews and their website is good. I got a cluster or roses on my shoulder with some "brush strokes" of color on them. My tattoo artist is Eddie. He is very friendly and fun! He did exactly like I asked. He is a very good artist. His line work is perfect and so I will be going back to him for more. I have a bad back (bulging and hemorrhaged discs) and sometimes I can't sit in the same place for long periods of time. Eddie was very helpful and accommodating with that. While I was there I talked to pretty much every employee there. The entire staff are really friendly. It's a cool place to be. I did a Yelp check-in and got $10 off! How cool is that?! On the website I saw that the owner, Chino developed his own tattoo ointment. He said that he just wasn't very happy with the other stuff that's out there because they are petroleum product so he did a ton of research and developed his own. It has ingredients like sunflower and soybean oil, lavender, beeswax, vitamin E, Shea and cocoa butter. I bought some and it is indeed very soothing. If you are looking to get inked, go here. You will be in good hands with some great artists and you will be just as happy as I am right now.
Revise this with your best effort:
I am absolutely thrilled after getting two tattoos at Stigma today! I specifically chose Stigma based on its outstanding reviews and impressive website. My shoulder now boasts a stunning cluster of roses with delicate brush strokes of color, expertly crafted by the talented artist, Eddie. Not only did he execute my vision flawlessly, but his exceptional line work showcased his undeniable skill. I am already eagerly planning my next visit to Eddie for more artwork.

What truly sets Stigma apart is their genuine concern for their clients' comfort and well-being. As someone with a challenging back condition, I often struggle with sitting in one position for extended periods. However, Eddie went above and beyond to accommodate my needs, which was immensely appreciated. During my time at Stigma, I had the pleasure of interacting with the entire friendly staff, who made the experience even more enjoyable. The atmosphere of the studio radiated cool vibes, making it an inviting and exciting place to be.

In addition to the remarkable service, I received a pleasant surprise when I checked in on Yelp and received a $10 discount. How awesome is that? Furthermore, while exploring their website, I discovered that the owner, Chino, had developed his own tattoo ointment. He shared his dissatisfaction with petroleum-based products available in the market and consequently conducted extensive research to create his own formula. This innovative ointment, containing nourishing ingredients such as sunflower and soybean oil, lavender, beeswax, vitamin E, Shea and cocoa butter, provides soothing relief. I purchased some myself and can attest to its effectiveness.

If you are in search of a top-notch tattoo studio, look no further than Stigma. With a team of talented artists and exceptional service, you can trust them to bring your ink dreams to life. Like me, you will leave feeling overjoyed and extremely satisfied.

input: This place is a lot of fun. I like that there is a outdoor patio with hip hop music and indoor dance area with salsa . If you need a change in tunes or scenery , just move !
Revise this with your best effort: This place is an absolute blast! I love the fact that it offers an outdoor patio where you can groove to some fantastic hip hop tunes, as well as an indoor dance area dedicated to salsa dancing. If you're craving a switch in music or ambiance, all you have to do is make a move!

input:
Had not been for years.

We went for lunch. Great decor. Great wait staff. Personable and on the ball.

My bud had the fish special, serving was a bit small but delish he said.

I had the fattoush salad with chicken. Spicing was everything it should be. The chicken was good, just that. The lettuce was limp and so was the pita. Not an olive in sight.

Pricey, especially for lunch. We will not be rushing back.
Revise this with your best effort:
We hadn't been here in years, but decided to go for lunch. The restaurant had a fantastic decor and the wait staff were exceptional - friendly, attentive, and efficient.

My friend ordered the fish special and mentioned that while the serving size was a bit small, it was absolutely delicious. On the other hand, I opted for the fattoush salad with chicken. The spices used in the dish were perfectly balanced, and the chicken was decent, nothing more. However, to my disappointment, the lettuce and pita were both limp, lacking the desired freshness. Additionally, I couldn't help but notice the absence of any olives in the salad.

The biggest downside was the price, particularly for a lunch meal. Considering the experience and the portion sizes, it seemed quite pricey. As a result, we don't anticipate rushing back anytime soon.

input: Our animals are an extension of our family.  So, we aren't going to take them to any old place for boarding, grooming and medical examinations.  I'm a big fan of the Animal Clinic because they treat the pets as if they were their own pets.  You can't ask for any more.  I would have given them 5* but the location is a little difficult to get out of when leaving.
Revise this with your best effort: Our beloved animals are considered valued members of our family. Therefore, when it comes to boarding, grooming, and medical care, we wouldn't trust just any facility or clinic. Personally, I cannot recommend the Animal Clinic enough, as they go above and beyond in caring for pets as if they were their own. It's truly remarkable. While I would have gladly awarded them a perfect 5-star rating, I must mention that the only drawback is the slightly inconvenient location, making it a little challenging to navigate when departing.

input: Literally, the worst Taco Bell I have ever been to. The restaurant is filthy, the service is awful, and they didn't make any of our order correctly, and really, how hard is that?  I won't be back and if I were you I would find a different place to go.
Revise this with your best effort: Without a doubt, this Taco Bell establishment is the epitome of disappointment. The facility itself is appallingly unsanitary, the service leaves much to be desired, and to make matters worse, our order was completely mishandled. I fail to fathom how anyone could botch such a simple task. Needless to say, I have zero intentions of returning, and if I were in your shoes, I would seek an alternative dining option.

input:
I like the Neuvo-Latino-Americano grub here.  The place has moved locations and is now a bit larger.  Chips & Salsa are always fresh 7 tasty, too.

I wish I could give a more substanital review but I ate here so long ago - and at the old location - so I'd better just keep my mouth shut.
Revise this with your best effort:
I thoroughly enjoy the delectable Neuvo-Latino-American cuisine offered at this establishment. Furthermore, I am pleased to note that the restaurant has recently relocated to a more spacious venue. The Chips & Salsa, constantly fresh and flavorsome, never fail to impress as well.

Although I hold a positive opinion of this restaurant, it has been quite some time since my last visit, and that was at the previous location. Therefore, in order to provide an accurate assessment, I believe it is wisest for me to withhold my commentary.

input: Found Player's while driving by. Everyone is very friendly. The service is great. Atmosphere is very relaxed. Great experience overall. Oh and a great shave and cut for a great price!
Revise this with your best effort: I discovered Player's while driving by, and I must say, it was truly a fantastic experience. The staff was incredibly friendly, providing top-notch service throughout. The atmosphere exuded a tremendously relaxed vibe that added to the overall enjoyment. Not to mention, the shave and cut I received were simply splendid, especially considering the great price.

input: terrible food and the manager was shockingly rude when I tried to return my food. I had the frogs legs and they were rubbery and tasted awful. I was disgusted by her behavior and she should be ashamed of herself. I have never been treated more horribly by someone.
Revise this with your best effort: The food I received was of poor quality and unfortunately, the manager's attitude towards my attempt to return it was shockingly rude. Specifically, the frogs legs I ordered were both rubbery and distasteful. I found her behavior to be incredibly offensive and believe she should feel ashamed of herself. This encounter stands out as one of the worst I have ever experienced in terms of how I was treated.

input:
The location is pretty random (at the end of a long winding road with a bunch of other hotel off of the highway with no food nearby) and the building has seen better days.  

My room featured an unclean floor, torn wallpaper, dusty bathroom vents, and water spots in the bathroom.  The hallways might remind one of "red rum" and the building itself is ugly showing it's age as a product of the 70s (as am I so I can judge).

The bed was comfortable and the room serviceable but it was disappointing as I have grown accustomed to a higher level of quality in my Doubletree experience throughout the country.
Revise this with your best effort:
The location of the hotel is rather unpredictable, situated at the end of a meandering road amidst other hotels off the highway, devoid of nearby dining options. Moreover, the building's condition leaves much to be desired, having clearly witnessed better days.

Upon entering my room, I couldn't help but notice an unclean floor, torn wallpaper, neglected bathroom vents collecting dust, and several water spots in the bathroom. The hallways themselves evoke a sense of unease, akin to the famous phrase "red rum," casting a shadow of discomfort throughout. The building's appearance further accentuates its antiquity, a testament to the bygone era of the 70s (much like myself, allowing for some judgment).

Although the bed provided a modicum of comfort and the room served its basic purpose, I couldn't help but feel disappointed. Having experienced the Doubletree's elevated standards across the country, this particular encounter fell short of the higher level of quality I have grown accustomed to.

input:
The hotel is beautifully done. It has a boutique feel and not like just a normal hotel like the Hilton. I had my birthday party there at the restaurant and it was so very nice. The service was wonderful and the rooms are beautiful. The air conditioner was pretty loud in our room but that is my only complaint. It's very close to Printers Alley which is so cool! 
I would definitely stay in this hotel again!
Revise this with your best effort: The hotel exudes a captivating ambiance with its striking design. Unlike common hotels like the Hilton, it effortlessly showcases a boutique atmosphere. I had the pleasure of celebrating my birthday at the restaurant within the premises, and it truly surpassed all expectations. The impeccable service and the stunning rooms heightened the overall experience. Admittedly, the only drawback was the slightly noisy air conditioner in our room. However, this minor inconvenience fades in comparison to the hotel's prime location near the remarkable Printers Alley. Undoubtedly, I would eagerly choose to stay in this exceptional hotel again!

input:
Cool spot in a great location.
We got there early, so didn't have the same crushing crowds others have talked about.
The bartenders are awesome.
Made me a Perfect Rye Manhattan on the rocks, never had one before...I'm hooked.
Easily the best burger I've ever had!
Will absolutely be back
Revise this with your best effort: This place is seriously cool, situated in a fantastic location. By arriving early, we were fortunate enough to avoid the overwhelming crowds that others have mentioned. The bartenders here are absolutely amazing, creating a Perfect Rye Manhattan on the rocks for me, which I had never experienced before. Let me tell you, I am now completely hooked! Furthermore, the burger served at this establishment is hands down the best I have ever had. Needless to say, I will definitely be returning in the future.

input: Excellent food and excellent service!  My new favorite breakfast place. I loved the biscuits and gravy, extra crispy bacon, sausage links and challah French toast!
Revise this with your best effort: I must say, this place offers impeccable food coupled with exceptional service! It has swiftly become my ultimate go-to breakfast spot. The biscuits and gravy were absolutely divine, complemented perfectly by the extra crispy bacon, savory sausage links, and irresistibly delectable challah French toast.

input: We hired Terra as the florist for our wedding and were very pleased with her work. We liked that she took the time to run through the venue with my husband and really tried to understand our needs and accommodate our budget. The florals for the wedding came out beautiful and we loved the draping for the ceremony and the reception. The only concern we had was that some of flowers in the bride's and the bridesmaids' bouquets started wilting during the day, but we understand that it is because the flowers were in full bloom and it could also have been due to the heat. Overall, we were happy we found Terra for our wedding!
Revise this with your best effort: Terra was the perfect choice as our wedding florist and we couldn't be happier with her work. From the beginning, Terra went above and beyond to ensure she fully grasped our vision and stayed within our budget. We were particularly impressed with her thorough walkthrough of the venue with my husband, showing a genuine desire to cater to our specific needs. The stunning floral arrangements for both the ceremony and reception were absolute showstoppers, and we were especially fond of the elegant draping. However, we did encounter a minor hiccup when some of the flowers in the bridal and bridesmaids' bouquets began to wilt throughout the day. Considering the flowers were in full bloom and the temperature was quite high, we understand these factors may have played a role. Despite this, we remain incredibly satisfied with Terra's services and are grateful to have discovered her for our special day.

input: Excellent healthy options for NOLA dining with lots of to go choices. I had turkey meatballs and spaghetti. It is a wonderful lunch place.
Revise this with your best effort: Discover incredible healthy dining options in NOLA offering an abundance of delicious choices available for takeout. Indulge in the delectable turkey meatballs accompanied by perfectly cooked spaghetti, making this the ultimate lunch destination that never fails to impress.

input: This is everything I want in take out food - fresh, yummy, and relatively healthy. I also love that there is a good to go place in Northern Liberties that is convenient - there is not enough of that!
Revise this with your best effort: This take-out food has everything I desire: it's fresh, delicious, and relatively healthy. Additionally, I appreciate the convenience of having a great-to-go option in Northern Liberties, which is unfortunately scarce.

input:
We had an alumni event here and I really enjoyed it. It's dimly lit, very cozy inside - it's decorated kind of like an old library. It was a great quiet,casual spot if you're looking for a low key place to have good drinks. 

They have a few beers and wines, but we focused mostly on the happy hour cocktails - moscow mules, old fashioneds, etc. Everyone loved theirs, no complaints!
Revise this with your best effort:
I thoroughly relished attending the alumni event held at this establishment. Its ambiance, with its dim lighting and inviting cozy atmosphere reminiscent of an aged library, truly captivated me. This hidden gem proved to be the perfect haven for those seeking a calm and laid-back setting to enjoy top-notch beverages.

Their selection included a modest variety of beers and wines, yet our attention was predominantly directed towards their delectable happy hour cocktails, such as Moscow Mules and Old Fashioneds. Each libation was met with unanimous adoration, as everyone reveled in their choice without a single complaint.

input: The burgers are amazing! French fries are decent (so get the onion rings).
Revise this with your best effort: The burgers are absolutely incredible, truly unmatched! While the french fries are decent, we highly recommend opting for the onion rings instead - they are simply irresistible!

input: Ive eaten there twice and both times it was terrible. Steak was salty, fish dry, my salad was frozen , service awful. . Im really not sure how this place gets any good reviews.
Revise this with your best effort: I have dined at that establishment on two occasions, and unfortunately, both experiences were severely disappointing. The steak was excessively salty, the fish turned out to be incredibly dry, and to my dismay, my salad was completely frozen. Furthermore, the service I received was notably subpar. Considering these unfortunate circumstances, I cannot comprehend how this particular establishment manages to accumulate any positive reviews.

input: Even after finding many great Spanish restaurants in the country (mostly NYC), Modesto is still one of my favorite Spanish place to eat.  This place is really good!  Too bad I don't live near St. Louis anymore since this is one of the places that I miss.
Revise this with your best effort: Despite discovering many excellent Spanish restaurants across the country, particularly in NYC, Modesto remains one of my utmost preferred dining destinations. Needless to say, this place is truly spectacular! Regrettably, I no longer reside near St. Louis, which intensifies my longing for this exceptional establishment.

input:
Wow what a terrible spa. I can only speak for the manicure/pedicure aspect because I did not get a massage. Typically, you go to a spa to escape and relax - you can not do that here. It is small, dirty, and the staff is terrible. 

I walked in and the receptionist was on the phone - he did acknowledge that I was standing there, but several staff walked by and did not offer to assist. Finally, after two other guests came in behind me, someone came up and took me back - just to get me out of the way. Asked what my name was and left. Did not offer me water/refreshments of any kind. I've had better reception at the local nail salon. Then I had to wait for 10-15 minutes for my technician to finish up her current client, which I didn't mind because I leisurely picked out my color. When it was my turn, the nail technician was shaky and rushed. She cut my cuticle and I bled. She was sick and kept blowing her nose into her shirt (gross!!) and took time outs to really blow/dig in her nose with a tissue right in front of me! Lady, you are touching my hands with yours, you are blowing bacteria into the air, if you are that sick don't come to work - *Management, if your employee is that sick do not make them come in! You will lose clients. 

She gave me the worst hand/arm massage I have ever had (that is usually everyone's favorite part, and the technician's opportunity to shine!). No pressure was applied, and she just basically rubbed lotion into my skin and made a snarky comment about how my skin was so dry is was just "drinking up all the lotion." Yes, I realize it's dry, probably due to the 20 degree weather and wind outside, but thank you for making me feel self-conscious. 

When I went to leave the receptionist was on the phone again, but did actually put them on hold to get me out of there. I opted to put everything on my room charge, which resulted in extra fees but I didn't care. There was a blaring sign saying how they preferred cash gratuity and that there would be extra fees associated with putting services on your room. Yes, everyone prefers cash gratuity - but how tacky can you be?!! 

Overall, it was an extremely disappointing experience. I have been wanting to stay at the Monteleone for years and made it a priority to experience their salon. My gel nail polish is already chipping and it hasn't even been a week. Spa Aria definitely needs a overhaul and I would recommend you go anywhere else but here.
Revise this with your best effort:
I had such a disappointing experience at this spa. While I can only speak for the manicure/pedicure aspect since I didn't get a massage, I can confidently say that this is not a place where you can truly escape and relax. The spa is small, dirty, and the staff is absolutely terrible.

Upon walking in, I noticed that the receptionist was on the phone. Although he acknowledged my presence, several staff members walked past me without offering any assistance. Finally, after two other guests arrived, someone came and took me to my appointment, seemingly just to get me out of the way. They asked for my name and left without offering any water or refreshments. I've had better service at a local nail salon. 

After waiting for 10-15 minutes, my technician finally finished with her previous client. During this time, I leisurely chose my nail color, so the wait didn't bother me much. However, once it was my turn, I noticed that the nail technician was shaky and rushed. She even cut my cuticle, causing me to bleed. That wasn't the worst part - she was clearly sick and kept blowing her nose into her shirt, which was absolutely gross. She would take breaks to blow and dig into her nose right in front of me. Considering the fact that she was touching my hands and blowing bacteria into the air, I couldn't help but think that if she was that sick, she shouldn't have come into work. Management should be more considerate and understanding. Such behavior only drives away clients.

To make matters worse, the hand/arm massage I received was the worst I've ever had. This part of the experience is usually everyone's favorite, and a chance for the technician to shine. However, there was no pressure applied, and she simply rubbed lotion into my skin while making snarky comments about how dry it was. Yes, I'm aware that my skin is dry, especially in the freezing 20-degree weather outside, but no one likes unnecessary self-consciousness.

When it was time to leave, the receptionist was once again on the phone. However, this time, he did put the call on hold to attend to me. I decided to put everything on my room charge, which resulted in extra fees, but at that point, I didn't care. What bothered me was the glaring sign that proclaimed their preference for cash gratuity and warned of additional fees associated with charging services to the room. Yes, it's common for people to prefer cash gratuity, but displaying it so explicitly is tacky.

Overall, my experience at Spa Aria was incredibly disappointing. I had been wanting to stay at the Monteleone for years and made it a priority to try out their salon. Unfortunately, my gel nail polish is already chipping after less than a week. This spa desperately needs an overhaul, and I strongly advise anyone to go elsewhere for their spa needs.

input: I got the hot shave and it did not disappoint. They do 6 towels and a facial massage with oils in between. Great shave, great environment.
Revise this with your best effort: I had the privilege of experiencing a delightful hot shave that left me completely satisfied. The attention to detail was remarkable, as they adorned me with six warm towels and offered a rejuvenating facial massage infused with luxurious oils. The shave itself was fantastic, effortlessly removing unwanted hair, while the overall ambiance exuded comfort and relaxation.

input: We've been going to this place since it opened and it's always decent, not to mention super fast! TdM is owned by Subway and has a similar feel to it, but I think the quality is much better than Subway. It's a build-your-own burrito and taco place and the ingredients are always fresh and well-stocked. I usually eat vegetarian, so there are plenty of options for me to eat. I always get a veggie burrito and load it up with lots of veggies! I also like their chips and "medium" salsa. If ever around Delgado, check out Taco del Mar!
Revise this with your best effort: Since its grand opening, my companions and I have frequented this particular establishment, consistently finding it to be satisfactory in every regard, not to mention astonishingly speedy! Taco del Mar, owned by Subway, exudes a similar ambiance, yet I believe the quality vastly surpasses that of Subway. This build-your-own burrito and taco joint consistently impresses with its perpetually fresh and abundantly stocked ingredients. As a vegetarian, I am delighted by the plethora of options available to me. Without fail, I opt for a vegetable-packed burrito, generously filled to the brim! Moreover, I highly recommend indulging in their delectable chips paired with their tantalizing "medium" salsa. Should you ever find yourself in close proximity to Delgado, I strongly urge you to pay Taco del Mar a visit!

input: I only go here when I need something that Trader Joes doesn't carry. They are overpriced, and understaffed. Not a fan.
Revise this with your best effort: I only visit this establishment when I require items that are not available at Trader Joe's. Unfortunately, I find that they tend to be quite expensive and often lacking in sufficient staff. Consequently, I cannot say that I am a fan of this place.

input: Listen up, people!  Fall off the bone mushy ribs are not what you get at a proper barbeque joint!  If you want that stuff, then go elsewhere.  Smoked ribs are meant to be a little tough.
Revise this with your best effort: Attention, everyone! The tenderness we look for in a worthwhile barbecue establishment does not entail fall-off-the-bone, overly soft ribs! If that is what you desire, kindly seek an alternative option. Authentic smoked ribs are intended to possess a slight resistance when eaten.

input: Amazing place for lassi and chaat. The chaat is elegantly presented and tastes like traditional Karachi chaat. However, the chaat isn't as nearly as good as the lassi. It is soft and creamy and sweetened beautifully. Will be coming back for sure next time I'm in the area.
Revise this with your best effort: This place is absolutely fantastic for lassi and chaat lovers. The chaat here is exquisitely presented and exudes the authentic flavors of traditional Karachi chaat. However, while the chaat is definitely good, it falls slightly short in comparison to the exceptional lassi they serve. The lassi is incredibly smooth, creamy, and delightfully sweetened. Without a doubt, I will make it a point to return here whenever I find myself in the area.

input: My husband and I held our wedding reception at Hendel's Cafe and it was gorgeous, just a beautiful night and a perfect place in which to spend with our closest friends and family!
Revise this with your best effort: Hendel's Cafe provided an exquisitely stunning backdrop for our wedding reception, surpassing our wildest expectations. It was an enchanting evening, brimming with beauty, where we were able to create everlasting memories with our cherished friends and family members.

input: Cockroach in my room, wifi is slower than aol in 1996, private beach costs $10 a chair. I'll never come here again.
Revise this with your best effort: There is an unfortunate presence of a cockroach in my room, and to add to my dismay, the efficiency of the wifi is reminiscent of the sluggishness experienced during the early days of AOL back in 1996. Moreover, the added inconvenience of having to pay $10 per chair to enjoy the supposedly private beach further compounds my disappointment. Regrettably, such experiences have deterred any desire I may have had to revisit this particular location in the future.

input:
Our first visit to El Sol was to celebrate my daughter's birthday.  Needless to say, we were all BLOWN AWAY!   Our waiter was so attentive and polite, the pina colodas, margaritas and food was to die for, and at the end of the meal the whole staff came out with a very large cake, a desert for my daughter, sombreros and FIREWORKS!!  Birthday songs were played on the televisions and it was very festive.  
I'm so happy this gem is close enough to make regular dinner visits.  I'm also happy that an order of fajitas will feed me for dinner an lunch the next day. 
Good job, guys!
Revise this with your best effort:
Our family's initial visit to El Sol was solely to celebrate my daughter's birthday, and to our utmost delight, it surpassed all our expectations! From the moment we were seated, our waiter provided impeccable service with unwavering attentiveness and impeccable manners. The tantalizing concoctions of pina coladas and margaritas were simply divine, perfectly complementing the exquisite flavors of the delectable food that was presented before us. To our astonishment, as the meal drew to a close, the entire staff emerged while bearing an enormous cake, a specially prepared dessert for my daughter, along with festive sombreros and a grand display of fireworks! It was an enthralling experience, enhanced further by the captivating birthday songs resonating from the televisions, setting an extremely festive ambiance.

We are overjoyed to have this hidden gem situated within close proximity, allowing us to indulge in regular dinner engagements. Furthermore, the portion size of the fajitas we ordered left us exceptionally content, as we happily savored the leftovers for both dinner and lunch the following day. We extend our heartfelt appreciation to the entire team at El Sol for a remarkable dining experience. Well done, gentlemen!

input: What a hidden gem of a restaurant.  While everyone else go to Taco Bus and stands in long lines I'll come here to Taco Son and get just as good of food without the lines. Everything here is made from scratch and you can taste the freshness of the ingredients.  The portions are big so you get your monies worth. Oh and their breakfast burritos are killer grab you one after a long night.
Revise this with your best effort: What an incredible find this restaurant is! While the masses flock to Taco Bus, enduring long lines, I prefer the hidden gem that is Taco Son. The food here is equally delicious, if not better, and the best part? No lines! Every item on the menu is crafted from scratch, allowing you to truly savor the freshness of the ingredients. And let me tell you, the portion sizes are generous, making every penny you spend here totally worth it. Oh, and their breakfast burritos are absolutely amazing, especially after a late night out. Do yourself a favor and treat yourself to one.

input: We recently purchased a used car for my son, it was a 2006 and of course comes with no warranty because of the age, but I expected them to send it home with us in a safe condition. It was supposedly just inspected and had a brand new PA state inspection and oil change sticker from Conicelli. Needless to say we got it home and the next day the front left tire blew . It was completely dry rotted on the backside and the tire shop ended up replacing both front tires for $450. Money is one thing but after seeing how the tire just shredded we could have been killed on I95 on the way home. The tire just entirely fell apart. Never would recommend them now.
Revise this with your best effort: We recently purchased a used car for my son, a 2006 model. Despite its age, we expected the car to be delivered in a safe condition, especially since it had just undergone a supposedly thorough inspection and had a fresh PA state inspection and oil change sticker from Conicelli. Unfortunately, the very next day after bringing it home, our front left tire suddenly blew. Upon examination, we found that the tire was completely dry rotted on the backside. As a result, we had to pay $450 to replace both front tires at a tire shop. The financial cost is one issue, but what truly concerns us is the potential danger we faced. Considering how the tire completely fell apart and shredded, we could have been involved in a serious accident, potentially risking our lives while traveling on I95. Given this experience, we can no longer recommend Conicelli.

input: Food is on point.  I am deducting 1 star for the condition of the bathrooms on the Friday night I went.. Toilet didn't flush, no toilet paper or paper towels and overall gross.
Revise this with your best effort: The food is exceptional, deserving high praise. However, during my visit on a Friday night, the condition of the bathrooms was disappointing. Regrettably, I must deduct one star due to a malfunctioning toilet, absence of toilet paper and paper towels, and an overall unsanitary state.

input: Great food, awful service. I ordered online at 6:20, site said it would be ready at 6:40. I get there at 6:37 and i expected to wait a couple minutes but not the entire 20 minutes it takes to cook my food. They didn't even start cooking it till i got there. I leave at 7. They did nothing for the inconvenience and still made me pay full. Honestly, I'm so upset with how the whole situation was handled. Where is the customer service??
Revise this with your best effort: The food at this place is truly outstanding, however, the service leaves much to be desired. I placed an online order at 6:20 and the website indicated it would be ready by 6:40. Arriving promptly at 6:37, I anticipated a short wait, but was shocked to find out that my food hadn't even been started yet, with a 20-minute cooking time ahead. I reluctantly left at 7 with no resolution or acknowledgment of the inconvenience caused, yet still had to pay the full amount. Frankly, the way this entire situation was handled has left me incredibly disappointed. I can't help but wonder, where is their commitment to customer service?

input: Cute Japanese restaurant in Old City. Fresh sushi and amazing ramen. Wonderful customer service! This is my new favorite go to for sushi and ramen. There is a great selection on the menu.
Revise this with your best effort: Experience the charm of a charming Japanese restaurant nestled in the historic Old City. Indulge in a delectable array of fresh sushi and tantalizing ramen, expertly crafted with precision and care. Immerse yourself in a dining experience like no other, as you are greeted with unwaveringly wonderful customer service, adding an extra touch of excellence to your visit. From the moment I discovered this culinary gem, it instantaneously became my beloved go-to destination for a sushi and ramen fix. With an extensive menu offering a delightful variety, every visit presents an opportunity to savor new and exciting flavors.

input: Loved the abvionce.. got pampered and relaxed. It was hard to get a drink order place. Was the only reason I did not give them a 5. Had to ask 4 people before I was told to go call roommservice on the white phone.
Revise this with your best effort: I thoroughly enjoyed the ambiance and indulged in a truly pampering and relaxing experience. The only setback that prevented me from giving them a perfect score was the difficulty I encountered in placing a drink order. It took me multiple attempts, having to ask four different individuals before I was finally instructed to call room service on the designated white phone.

input:
Doctor Jeffers is one of the best vets I have ever dealt with, she shows compassion for all animals and can tell you within hours of literally anything that is wrong, plus very reasonable prices.

Dr Jeffers even accepts reptiles so being able to get that kind of service locally is great considering another vet on street road gouges you big time for just a vitamin shot ( 105.00 minimum charge )

Plus the practice has just about every type of machinery to insure that they know exactly what is going on with your pet. She even has animals for adoption. 

One great vet, as good as Dr Pol.
Revise this with your best effort:
Doctor Jeffers is genuinely one of the most exceptional veterinarians I have ever encountered. Her level of compassion towards all animals is truly unparalleled, and her ability to accurately diagnose various issues within a remarkably short timeframe is truly impressive. Additionally, her prices are incredibly reasonable, making her services even more of a gem. 

What sets Doctor Jeffers apart is her willingness to treat a wide range of animals, including reptiles. It is incredibly convenient to have access to such specialized care locally, especially when compared to another veterinarian on street road who shamelessly overcharges for even simple vitamin shots, demanding a minimum fee of $105. This stark contrast emphasizes the value and integrity of Doctor Jeffers' practice. 

Furthermore, Doctor Jeffers ensures comprehensive care through the availability of cutting-edge machinery that enables her to precisely determine the underlying cause of any issue your pet may be facing. Notably, she even offers animals for adoption, showcasing her dedication to the well-being of animals beyond her clinic's walls. 

In conclusion, Doctor Jeffers stands as an outstanding veterinarian, rivaling even the renowned Dr. Pol. Her exceptional level of care, comprehensive services, and genuine compassion make her a true asset to her profession.

input: Mahi Mahi was great, large portion. You could split a meal.You must like smoked fish. Server was pleasant.
Revise this with your best effort: The Mahi Mahi was absolutely fantastic, with a generous and satisfying portion size. It was even large enough to share with someone else if you preferred. If you enjoy the flavors of smoked fish, this dish is a definite must-try. Additionally, the server was incredibly pleasant and provided impeccable service.

input: Melissa is by far the BEST! I've gone to two other lash lounges and I will tell you Melissa outdoes them all. She knows her craft. She doesn't double or triple stack lashes. She gets you in and out. 100% recommend going to Melissa.
Revise this with your best effort: Melissa undoubtedly stands at the pinnacle of excellence! Having frequented two other lash lounges myself, I can unequivocally attest that Melissa surpasses them all. Her expertise in her craft is exceptional. Unlike others, Melissa does not resort to the practice of double or triple stacking lashes. Moreover, her efficiency ensures a swift and seamless experience. I wholeheartedly endorse Melissa without hesitation - a visit to her is an absolute must!

input:
Best casino in Reno.   4 deck and 2 deck blackjack, real drink glasses (no plastic fratboy cups), amazing decorum that will burn your retinas, and the restaurants inside are better the big casinos on the strip by a factor of a thousand.
The rooms are stellar for the price.  Get a hot tub and chilllllll.
Revise this with your best effort:
The finest casino experience awaits you in Reno! Indulge in the thrill of playing 4 deck and 2 deck blackjack, while sipping on your favorite beverages from elegant glassware, far from the realm of tacky plastic cups. Prepare to be mesmerized by the awe-inspiring decor that will leave an everlasting imprint on your senses.

But the excitement doesn't stop there; the restaurants within this remarkable establishment surpass those of the grandest casinos on the infamous strip by a magnitude of a thousand. Prepare yourself for an extraordinary culinary journey that will elevate your taste buds to unparalleled heights.

When it comes to accommodations, our stellar rooms provide exceptional value for your money. Lavish yourself with the luxury of a hot tub, letting all your worries melt away as you unwind and relish in pure relaxation.

Come and experience the epitome of casino perfection—one that will surpass your every expectation and leave you longing for more.

input:
My wife and I had been wanting to go here but just hadn't made it a priority.  

I had the fish and chips.  The batter wasn't thick, and it has a crispiness to it that was a great contrast to the moistness and juiciness of the fish.  I have to admit, when I'm not sure what to get I think of getting a burger or fish & chips, and there weren't any burgers on the dinner menu.  The serving size was 3 cod pieces, approx 4-6 oz, along with a generous serving of fries. Additionally, the tartar sauce appeared to be made in house, had a great flavor.  So, if you're in the mood for fish and chips, I would highly recommend getting them here...because while the serving size isn't as big as Great Basin's, it tastes way better.

My wife had the salmon tacos, and for the side she had the chicken tortilla soup.  While the tacos had some great flavors the salmon was a bit overcooked, thus making the tacos a bit overshadowed by the soup.  Similar to the fish & chips above, the serving size wasn't large, only 2 tacos, but again, the flavors were very good.

If you're starving and want a large meal with leftovers I'd recommend other places, but if you want a satisfying meal that's an appropriate size this place is very good.
Revise this with your best effort:
My wife and I had been eager to visit this place, but we just hadn't prioritized it until now.

I decided to try the fish and chips. The batter had a perfect thickness and a delightful crispiness that created a fantastic contrast with the moist and juicy fish. Usually, when I'm undecided about what to order, I lean towards a burger or fish and chips. However, this place didn't offer burgers on the dinner menu. The serving size of three cod pieces, approximately 4-6 oz each, accompanied by a generous portion of fries, was satisfying. The tartar sauce seemed homemade and had an excellent flavor. So, if you're craving fish and chips, I highly recommend giving them a try here. The portion size may not be as huge as Great Basin's, but the taste is far superior.

My wife opted for the salmon tacos and ordered the chicken tortilla soup as her side. While the tacos had amazing flavors, the salmon was slightly overcooked, which unfortunately overshadowed the overall enjoyment of the tacos, especially in comparison to the soup. Similar to the fish and chips, the serving size was not large, consisting of only two tacos, but the flavors were truly delightful.

If you're famished and seeking a substantial meal with leftovers, I would suggest exploring other eateries. However, if you desire a satisfying meal of appropriate size, this place is definitely worth a visit.

input: They sat us within 5 minutes and then took 40 minutes to even bring out sodas. The table next to us had the same server and got their good before their beverages came out.
