Revise this with your best effort:
My friends and I visited this place during Mardi Gras, and despite the weekend hustle and bustle, it was surprising to find that many places weren't overly crowded. However, I must say that the bartenders were quite disappointing. The service was lacking, and the quality of the pizza was subpar.

On the positive side, they did provide two Port-O-Potty options, which made it much more convenient for bathroom breaks. Additionally, the outdoor seating area was a nice touch, and the proximity to the parade route made it highly convenient.

Now, let's address the negatives. The bartenders seemed to struggle when it came to taking drink orders accurately. They would skip people, and even when it wasn't particularly busy, they would ignore those who approached the bar. There was a noticeable amount of standing around, leading to slow service. Furthermore, it was surprising to discover that the bartenders had no knowledge of what microbrew or IPA beers were, and I assure you, I'm not joking about this matter.

input: Really nice place to get a pedicure! People are very friendly and it is a relaxing environment. Definitely recommend if you are looking for a clean place to get your toes done!
Revise this with your best effort: This place is exceptionally lovely for a pedicure! The staff is incredibly friendly, and the ambiance is incredibly soothing. I highly recommend this establishment if you are seeking a pristine and hygienic environment to pamper your feet!

input: Nice new burger spot downtown! They are apart of the harry & izzys chain. The burgers are pretty good. You do have to order a side separately which kinda sticks but seems to be a trend these days. They take reservations so that's always a plus. If you are looking for additional options besides a burger might not be your best spot to go. I'd like to see them do a lunch special during the week for those that go during the work day. I think it would help with costs and getting a bigger lunch crowd. Overall great experience and service. Check them out!
Revise this with your best effort: Exciting new addition in downtown: a delightful burger joint! As part of the renowned Harry & Izzy's chain, you can never go wrong. The burgers themselves are undeniably tasty. However, it's worth noting that ordering sides separately has become quite the trend nowadays. On the bright side, they offer reservations, making your dining experience even smoother. While this spot may not cater to non-burger enthusiasts, I suggest they consider offering more diverse options. A lunch special during the week for those visiting during work hours would be a fantastic addition, benefiting both patrons and the business. Despite this minor suggestion, my overall experience was exceptional, and the service was top-notch. Do yourself a favor and give them a try.

input: Salad was good.  Pizza is not good!  Boring, tasteless and just unsatisfying.  Very disappointed.  Also on a chilly night it is a cold interior.  This was my third try there.  Won't go back
Revise this with your best effort: The salad was enjoyable; however, the pizza was disappointing. It lacked flavor and satisfaction, ultimately making it a bland and unsatisfying choice. I was highly disappointed with my experience, especially considering this was my third attempt at dining there. Additionally, the interior was uncomfortably cold on a chilly night. Based on my experience, I have no intention of returning to this establishment in the future.

input: Not impressed at all. Sandwich bar was closed so I ordered a burrito. It was reheated in the microwave, cost 8 bucks, and nasty. Some sort of cream of chicken and old cheese on top. I'm amazed they can sell this and call it food. Could have had better at taco bell.
Revise this with your best effort: I am thoroughly unimpressed. Unfortunately, the sandwich bar was closed, leaving me with no choice but to opt for a burrito instead. To my disappointment, it was simply reheated in a microwave, costing me a hefty 8 dollars, and the taste was nothing short of unpleasant. It was topped with an unappetizing combination of cream of chicken and aged cheese. It baffles me how they can pass this off as edible cuisine. I could have easily enjoyed a much more satisfactory meal at a Taco Bell.

input:
I have visited the brewpub several times now, and I'm finally ready to write up a review.  I really like the decor here.  It's old-school brewpub with lots of games for children.  The beer is pretty good.  I wish they would do some more adventurous offerings, but I can still get a good beer here.  
The food can be a mixed bag.  I had a small pizza that was a gooey mess (mushrooms and hearty toppings need a thick crust for stability).  I love all the scotch egg offerings (you can get it on a pizza or burger here), but they are so salty.  The burgers are good. The desserts are great (please get the frangipane).  It's also great to get the ploughman's plate and a beer, and just relax for a bit.
Revise this with your best effort:
After numerous visits to the brewpub, I am excited to finally craft a comprehensive review. The establishment's decor holds a distinct charm, emanating an old-school brewpub vibe accompanied by an array of engaging games for children. While the beer offerings, overall, are commendable, a touch more adventurous options would be highly appreciated. Nevertheless, one can still relish a satisfying brew here.

As for the culinary aspect, the food quality presents a mixed bag of experiences. On one occasion, I ordered a small pizza, only to encounter a gooey mess due to the combination of mushrooms and robust toppings that demanded a sturdier crust. On the other hand, the scotch egg offerings, available on both pizzas and burgers, enticed my taste buds, albeit with an excess of saltiness. The burgers, however, do manage to appease the palate with their delectable flavors. In addition, the desserts deserve resounding praise, especially the frangipane, which is a must-try. Furthermore, indulging in the ploughman's plate while sipping on a beer allows for a relaxing and enjoyable dining experience.

Overall, despite minor setbacks in the food department, the brewpub's engaging ambiance, commendable beer selection, and standout desserts make it an enticing destination worth considering for a leisurely visit.

input:
I think if I could, I would give Zen Yai a 3.5 stars, but alas, c'est la vie. 

The prices for their curry are excellent, at less than $12. Zen Yai is a tiny place, which is both good and bad. Good if you don't have to wait, because it is nice and cozy, but bad if enough people eat here on a given evening -- because you may just have to wait a while.

I like the decor a lot, and the use of colors. The tables and plates are full of refreshingly bright colors. 

The service was fine, and the food was at our table in no time.

My Pineapple curry was excellent! And the rice is served in the shape of a pyramid, which is fun. 

All that being said, my girlfriend had a less than pleasurable experience. She is a seasoned green curry lover, and was disappointed with their green curry offering.
Revise this with your best effort:
If given the option, I would rate Zen Yai with 3.5 stars. However, unfortunately, such is life. 

The prices for their curry dishes are commendable, coming in at less than $12. Zen Yai is a compact establishment, which holds both advantages and disadvantages. It is pleasant and snug if you are fortunate enough to avoid a wait. On the other hand, a considerable number of patrons dining here on a particular evening could lead to an extended wait time. 

I greatly appreciate the decor, which incorporates vibrant colors. The tables and plates are adorned with refreshing and lively hues.

The service was satisfactory, and our food arrived promptly at our table.

I must say, my Pineapple curry was exceptional! Additionally, the rice being served in the form of a pyramid adds an element of fun.

However, despite my positive experience, my girlfriend, who is an avid green curry enthusiast, had a rather disappointing encounter with their green curry offering.

input:
Having stayed here several times, it is my favorite hotel. The staff is excellent. Really exceptional. Everyone from housekeeping to front desk staff to valets.

Rooms are clean, heating and AC are quiet, beds are very comfortable and they make it feel special.

Special K is awesome. I cannot say enough about how wonderful and helpful he has been over all of our visits. One of the best reasons to visit this hotel. Did I mention the exceptional staff?

Turn-down service is Sucre chocolates on your pillow. Sweets for the sweet dreams.

The bathroom wasn't as slippery this time. 

This was the first time we used the valet service and it worked great. No more than a 10 minute wait for the car. You can text them from your phone and they text back with how long it will take.

They also hosted a Gold Status reception. We made a brief appearance on our way to a Mardi Gras ball.

Our only glitch was a mini-bar charge on our bill. We didn't consume any of their food or drink and they happily removed it from the bill.

We will be back. Note to hotel: please put Louis back in the elevator.
Revise this with your best effort:
Having visited this hotel multiple times, I can confidently say that it is my absolute favorite. The staff here is truly exceptional, from the housekeeping team to the front desk staff and valets.

The rooms are always spotless, with quiet heating and AC systems and incredibly comfortable beds that make you feel truly pampered.

Allow me to express my admiration for Special K. Across all of our visits, he has been incredibly wonderful and helpful. He is undoubtedly one of the main reasons why I love staying at this hotel. Let's not forget to mention the exceptional staff he belongs to.

During turn-down service, you can expect to find Sucre chocolates waiting for you on your pillow. It's the perfect sweet touch for a night of sweet dreams.

This time, I noticed that the bathroom was not as slippery as before. It seems like the hotel has taken steps to improve this aspect.

During our recent stay, we decided to make use of the valet service for the first time - and we were not disappointed. The wait for our car was no longer than 10 minutes, and we could even text them from our phone and receive updates on their ETA. Such a convenient feature!

Additionally, the hotel hosted a Gold Status reception, which we briefly attended before heading to a Mardi Gras ball. It was a delightful added touch.

The only hiccup we encountered was a mini-bar charge on our bill. However, the hotel staff promptly and happily removed it once we clarified that we hadn't consumed any of the items. Their understanding and willingness to rectify the mistake were truly appreciated.

Rest assured, we will definitely be returning to this fantastic hotel. And with that, I kindly request the hotel to bring back Louis in the elevator - it adds a certain charm and uniqueness to the experience.

input: Great rolls and sake. We sat in the bamboo room, which definitely added to the experience, if you are able and agile.
Revise this with your best effort: Indulging in delectable rolls and accompanied by top-notch sake, we found ourselves seated in the bamboo-clad room that effortlessly heightened the entire experience, particularly for those blessed with dexterity and agility.

input: First, I love that they offer food delivery! Second, THAT is a gyro! I got one delivered with fries, and actually I didn't need the fries! The gyro was so big I had to save half.  Both the fries and the gyro were very tasty. The tzaziki was spot on and the meat tender. I'll be back!
Revise this with your best effort: I really appreciate the fact that they provide food delivery services. Moreover, their gyro is absolutely outstanding! I recently ordered one along with a side of fries, but to my surprise, the gyro alone was incredibly filling. In fact, I had to save half of it for later. Both the fries and the gyro were incredibly flavorful, with the tzaziki sauce being the perfect accompaniment and the meat cooked to perfection. I am definitely planning on returning for more in the future!

input: I stopped in to order take out and get a drink while I waited since it was happy hour. I am usually a beer drinker but I decided to step out of my comfort zone and ordered the dragonberry iced tea which was refreshing but not obnoxiously cocktail-ly, very pleasant. I had lemongrass chicken and crab rangoon, the lemon grass chicken and rice was fantastic. I do wish the crab rangoon had a little more filling but the dipping sauce was great. I've been here a few times and I have never been disappointed in the food or the service.
Revise this with your best effort: I dropped by to place a take-out order and decided to indulge in a drink at happy hour while I waited. Although I typically prefer beer, I opted to venture beyond my usual choices and ordered the dragonberry iced tea. It turned out to be a refreshing beverage that struck a perfect balance between the cocktail feel and an enjoyable taste. For my meal, I savored the delightful combination of lemongrass chicken and crab rangoon. The lemongrass chicken, accompanied by rice, was exquisite. While I found the crab rangoon slightly lacking in filling, the exceptional dipping sauce compensated for it. Having visited this place multiple times, I can confidently say that I have never been let down by the food or the service.

input: Consistent quality and service.  Love the #1 Deluxe.  Props to Amanda for excellent customer service, above and beyond!
Revise this with your best effort: We are committed to delivering consistent quality and exceptional service. Our #1 Deluxe option is truly loved by our customers. A special shoutout to Amanda for her outstanding customer service, going above and beyond expectations!

input:
*note* I wrote a similar review on tripadvisor.
I really wanted to like this hotel- it was charming and in a great location, with cute, unique rooms. It was just my style. Unfortunately, some blood-sucking insects ruined that.
Yup- bed bugs. We found them the morning we were leaving, because they normally come out very early in the morning (we were up at 530). Bleck! The management let us stay as long as necessary to take care of the issue (ie throwing away a bunch of our stuff and bagging the rest in ziplocks to be boiled) but it didn't change the fact that it was gross and a huge inconvenience. I threw away about $300 worth of clothing, shoes and luggage and I'm still worried that we brought the creatures back to our house with us. 
I would never stay here again, and I would urge you to think twice about it. Without seeing every carpet and mattress in the place replaced, there's no way I'd trust that the bugs were gone.
Revise this with your best effort:
I had high hopes for this hotel as it exuded charm and boasted a wonderful location, complete with adorable and uniquely designed rooms that perfectly matched my personal style. Regrettably, my positive impression was marred by an unfortunate encounter with blood-sucking insects.

Yes, you guessed it – bed bugs. These unwelcome creatures made their presence known on the morning of our departure, as they tend to emerge during the early hours (we were up at 5:30, in fact). The mere thought of it gives me the shivers! To their credit, the management allowed us to extend our stay as long as needed to address the issue. This involved reluctantly discarding a significant portion of our belongings and packing the remaining items into ziplock bags to be thoroughly sanitized. Despite their efforts, the overall experience was undeniably repulsive and incredibly inconvenient. I ended up parting ways with approximately $300 worth of clothing, shoes, and luggage, and the fear of inadvertently bringing these creatures back to our home still lingers.

Needless to say, I will never consider staying at this hotel again, and I strongly advise you to carefully weigh your options before booking here. Unless every carpet and mattress in the establishment are replaced, it is hard to trust that the bed bug problem has been completely eradicated.

input: Still running on EST, we arrived @8:30 on a Saturday to find no wait to be seated OR helped, ordering up the sweet potato pancakes with cinnamon cream syrup (good topped with excellent) with some borderline awful hash browns (really, people??). Can't say I'd return even without a wait, though; would prefer to just buy a jar of the syrup and apply it at home. Ended up at $24.43 pre-tip; no paper towels in the restroom and the day had barely started, so that was probably a dogshow.
Revise this with your best effort: We kept up with the Eastern Standard Time and arrived promptly at 8:30 am on a blissful Saturday morning. To our delight, there was absolutely no wait for a table or assistance. Feeling adventurous, we ordered the indulgent sweet potato pancakes accompanied by the delightful cinnamon cream syrup, which elevated the dish to something truly extraordinary. However, we must express our disappointment with the hash browns, as they fell short of our expectations. It's puzzling how such a vital element could be prepared so poorly. Consequently, even in the absence of a wait time, we would be hesitant to return. Perhaps it would be wiser to simply purchase a jar of that delectable syrup and enjoy it in the comfort of our own home. The bill amounted to $24.43 before gratuity, a reasonable price considering the experience. Regrettably, the restroom lacked paper towels, a minor blot on an otherwise promising morning.

input:
There never seems to be a crowd at this Marsh store...getting in and out is always easy.  I agree with the other reviewer on the state of red baskets...ick.  Fix please!

I like that they opened up aisles so you don't have to walk all the way to one end to go to the next (prob happened a long time ago but I just noticed today).  And always seems like they are one cashier short here.

Very good selection of products (as always) from Marsh.
Revise this with your best effort:
This Marsh store consistently has a minimal crowd, making it a breeze to navigate and complete your shopping quickly. I wholeheartedly concur with the previous reviewer regarding the substandard condition of the red baskets – a definite improvement is necessary.

One positive aspect that caught my attention today is the store's arrangement of aisles. It seems they have revamped their layout, sparing customers the need to traverse the entire store to move from one section to another (although this change may have occurred quite some time ago, I only just noticed it now). However, it appears that there is consistently a shortage of cashiers, leaving one register unstaffed more often than not.

As always, the variety and range of products available at this Marsh location are commendable.

input: Creative food and good. We get coffee or tea while we wait to be seated and even that is a cut above.  We love their Bloody Marys too.  Always interesting and an adventure.
Revise this with your best effort: Creative cuisine and culinary excellence define this extraordinary eatery. While waiting for a table, patrons can indulge in a delightful assortment of coffee or tea, each surpassing expectations. Moreover, their Bloody Marys are simply unmatched, delivering an unforgettable taste sensation. This establishment consistently offers captivating and bold flavors, transforming each dining experience into an exhilarating adventure.

input: Wonderful atmosphere, great selection of beers.  We ordered the Asian chicken salads and the Cajun pasta and both were excellent. We will return again.
Revise this with your best effort: The atmosphere was simply delightful, and the beer selection was truly impressive. Our dining experience was elevated by ordering the Asian chicken salads and the Cajun pasta, which both exceeded our expectations in terms of taste and quality. It goes without saying that we will definitely be coming back for more.

input: Love this place introduced almost 25 years ago when I enrolled at the UD and have loved ever since. For longest time it was basically just a Delaware treat but so happy it is so many more places now. Just want to know when you are coming to the Huntsville AL area. Sorry this review is not about this specific location but if it is half as good as others I have been to it will be great!!! This location has plenty of seating was real clean and playing good tunes as I waited. About only negative is it doesn't have Herrs chips like the Delaware locations but that is not really a problem.
Revise this with your best effort:
I instantly fell in love with this place nearly 25 years ago when I first arrived at UD, and my affection for it has only grown since then. Initially, it was a hidden Delaware gem, but I am thrilled to see it expanding to numerous locations. I can't wait to know when it will make its way to the Huntsville, AL area. I apologize for this review not being specific to the current location, but if it is even remotely comparable to the others I have been to, I am confident it will be exceptional!

Speaking of the current location, it boasts ample seating, cleanliness, and enjoyable tunes playing in the background while I waited. The only minor downside is the absence of Herrs chips, a trademark of the Delaware locations, but I don't consider it a significant issue.

input: At first I thought the prices here were pretty decent, but then I realized that they charge for every add on- chips/salsa, rice and beans, etc. I would be fine with this if the food was exceptional, but it is subpar. Both times I've been here, my side order of rice has been hard and dry, and burritos sad and limp. Additionally, the waitress we've had the two times going there had a horrible attitude. The only thing that saves this place is the guac, and the strong margaritas. Their strategy must be to get people drunk enough to not care about what they're eating and the rude service.
Revise this with your best effort: Initially, the prices seemed reasonable at this establishment, but I soon discovered that they charge extra for every additional item, such as chips and salsa, rice, and beans. I wouldn't mind this if the food was exceptional, but unfortunately, it falls short. On both occasions I've dined here, the rice that accompanied my meal was dry and unappetizing, and the burritos lacked flavor and were disappointingly soft. Moreover, the service provided by the waitress on both visits was abhorrent, leaving a bitter taste in my mouth. The sole redeeming factors of this place are the delicious guacamole and the potent margaritas. It appears their tactic is to inebriate customers to the point where they disregard the mediocre food and rude service.

input: My boyfriend and I have lived in trolley square for about three months now and tend to stick to the same restaurants.  We went out the other night planning on El Diablo and decided to try this cute little Italian restaurant. We are so glad we did! First off, the waiter was awesome, so friendly and on top of it.  He told us the history of the restaurant and gave us some good suggestions. The food was some of the best Italian food I have had in a long time. You can tell everything is made fresh.  The bread was delicious and a new recipe the owner received from his brother who lives in Sicily. We started off with the prosciutto wrapped Shrimp with a yummy sauce. I ordered the Penne Alla Vodka and my boyfriend ordered the traditional spaghetti and meatballs. The sauce in both dishes was excellent! The portions were a decent size with plenty of leftovers for my lunch the next day.  Finally, the cannoli was the best I have ever had! My boyfriend has been to Italy and said it was just as awesome as the ones he tasted there. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a delicious Italian meal for a good price.  The special he night we went was order two entrees and get any appetizer for free! Check this place out!
Revise this with your best effort:
My boyfriend and I recently moved to Trolley Square and have been frequenting the same restaurants for the past three months. However, the other night we decided to step out of our comfort zone and try a charming little Italian restaurant instead of our usual choice, El Diablo. And boy, are we glad we did!

To begin with, our experience at this restaurant was greatly enhanced by the amazing waiter. He was extremely friendly and attentive, even taking the time to share the restaurant's history and provide us with some delectable recommendations. The food here was truly exceptional and some of the best Italian cuisine I have had in a long time. It was evident that every dish was made using fresh ingredients, and the flavors were simply exquisite.

One standout was the bread, a new recipe the owner received from his brother residing in Sicily. It was absolutely delicious and set the tone for a memorable meal. For starters, we opted for the prosciutto wrapped Shrimp with a delectable sauce that left us wanting more. As for our main courses, I chose the Penne Alla Vodka while my boyfriend ordered the traditional spaghetti and meatballs. The sauce in both dishes was beyond excellent, and the portion sizes were quite generous, providing us with enough leftovers for a satisfying lunch the next day.

Finally, the cannoli at this restaurant was a true showstopper. In fact, my boyfriend, who has been to Italy, even went as far as saying that it was on par with the ones he tasted during his travels. This alone speaks volumes about the quality of the dessert. All in all, I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone in search of a scrumptious Italian meal at a reasonable price. Notably, on the night we visited, they had a special offer where you could order two entrees and receive any appetizer for free! Don't miss out on the opportunity to experience this wonderful establishment.

input: 3.5 stars because they don't serve alcohol (and I was in dire need of a drink after a veryyyy long week). Get the margherita pie - it is delicious and fresh. Also ordered the Greek salad for an appetizer which was filled with yummy veggies. Yum.
Revise this with your best effort: I would rate it 3.5 stars primarily because they do not offer alcohol, which was disappointing for someone like me who really needed a drink after an incredibly exhausting week. However, I must say that the margherita pie was truly delightful, boasting delicious and fresh flavors. As for the appetizer, we opted for the Greek salad, which was brimming with delectable veggies, making it a scrumptious choice. All in all, the food was satisfyingly yummy.

input: I love Mr. Wizard's because they offer frozen yogurt which is a  lot healthier than frozen custard. I like that they offer some pre-select combinations or you can create your own. The only part that sucks is that there is only outside seating so if it's cold outside, plan to eat in your car.
Revise this with your best effort: I have a strong affinity for Mr. Wizard's due to their extensive selection of frozen yogurt, which is notably more health-conscious than frozen custard. A compelling aspect of their offerings is the option to choose from their tastefully pre-selected combinations or to indulge in the pleasure of crafting your own unique creation. However, it should be noted that the establishment lacks indoor seating, which could prove inconvenient during colder weather; consequently, patrons may need to resort to enjoying their frozen treats within the confines of their cars.

input:
Not sure the significance behind the name and logo of the restaurant.  Unless it was three guys putting their money together to form this business 
The food was great/ staff friendly/ huge menu from breakfast /lunch/dinner to dessert.   Open 24 hours will definitely be back next time in town
Revise this with your best effort: I am unsure about the meaning and significance behind the name and logo of the restaurant, unless it represents three individuals pooling their resources to establish this business. Nonetheless, the food was exceptional and the staff was friendly. They offered an extensive menu consisting of breakfast, lunch, dinner, and even dessert options. Additionally, the fact that they are open 24 hours is quite convenient. I will definitely make it a point to visit again the next time I am in town.

input: I went to Spasso the other night with some friends. All four of us were SO pleased with our experience and our meals! We each had something different. I had the special for the evening, which was seafood (jumbo shrimp and jumbo lump crab) over pappardelle with tomato and asparagus. it was to die for, and my leftovers the next day were just as tasty :) service was amazing and wine was perfect. I live on state street and can't wait to visit again very soon!!
Revise this with your best effort:
I recently had the opportunity to dine at Spasso with a group of friends, and I must say, it was a truly delightful experience. All four of us left the restaurant grinning from ear to ear, thoroughly satisfied with both our meals and the overall ambiance. 

When it came to our orders, we each opted for something different, wanting to savor the variety Spasso had to offer. As soon as I heard about the evening's special, I couldn't resist. A delectable seafood dish consisting of succulent jumbo shrimp and luscious jumbo lump crab atop a bed of pappardelle, generously adorned with flavorful tomato and crisp asparagus. The combination was simply divine, arousing an explosion of flavors on my palate. And to my surprise, even the leftovers the next day retained their mouthwatering taste—truly a testament to the chef's culinary prowess.

Alongside the phenomenal dishes, the service at Spasso was nothing short of exceptional. The staff went above and beyond to ensure our dining experience was nothing short of perfection. Attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable, they made us feel like valued guests throughout the entire evening.

To complement our meals, we indulged in a selection of their finest wines. Each sip was exquisite, perfectly enhancing the flavors of our chosen dishes. The careful pairing made for a dining experience that was truly unforgettable.

As a resident of State Street, I couldn't be more delighted to have such a remarkable establishment nearby. Spasso has undoubtedly earned a spot on my list of favorite restaurants, and I eagerly anticipate my next visit, which I already plan to make in the near future.

input: Returned to get a fill and pedicure a week after getting a gel polish change, once I discovered the cost would be over $85 I canceled the pedicure and only wanted a fill. Originally the owner was very nice and attentive but when she sensed I refused to pay their ridiculous price, she turned her attention completely off of me and showed absolutely no regard. She no longer cared for my business and she had no problem showing it. She even reassigned the nail tech to someone else bc I refused to be over charged for service. I asked why the original nail tech was no longer doing my fill, I got no answer. I looked over and saw the owner catering to customers that had just walked in. I sensed flaky business so I ultimately walked out without being serviced. Horrible customer service from the owner. I understand they use quality products but not everyone is looking to spend hundreds of dollars in a nail salon regardless of how "high end" it's self proclaimed to be!
Revise this with your best effort: I decided to return to the salon for a fill and pedicure, but upon learning that the cost would exceed $85, I made the decision to cancel the pedicure and only proceed with the fill. Initially, the owner was friendly and attentive. However, once she realized that I was not willing to pay their exorbitant price, her focus completely shifted away from me, demonstrating a complete lack of concern. It became evident that she no longer valued my business and had no qualms about showing it. To make matters worse, she reassigned the nail technician who was originally supposed to do my fill simply because I refused to be overcharged for their services. Despite my inquiry regarding the switch, I received no response. As I observed the owner catering to customers who had just arrived, my suspicion of their unreliable business practices grew, leading me to ultimately leave without being serviced. This experience with the owner left a lot to be desired in terms of customer service. While I understand the salon's use of high-quality products, not everyone is seeking to spend exorbitant amounts of money at a nail salon, regardless of its self-proclaimed "high-end" status.

input:
Ice cream wasn't the best, and definitely not for the price. But it was there when I was passing through Belmawr, and it hit the spot when I needed to satisfy my sweet tooth! 

The service was friendly, albeit a little slow. And the place has a cute, quaint charm about it with the decor. If I lived in the area I'd probably return, but I wouldn't make any special trips to go back here.
Revise this with your best effort: Although the ice cream fell short of being exceptional, especially considering the price, it happened to catch my attention as I was making my way through Belmawr, and it undeniably managed to appease my craving for something sugary. The service, although slightly sluggish, was accompanied by a warm and amiable demeanor. Additionally, the establishment exuded a charming and enchanting ambiance through its tasteful decor. While I could envision myself revisiting if I were a local resident, I wouldn't prioritize making deliberate trips solely to return here.

input: Best auto body shop in Philadelphia in my opinion. My Honda Fit had accumulated all sorts of nicks, dents, scratches, and even some really ugly lime deposit stains on the hood of my car. I took it to Devlin's to get touched up, and what I got back was a car that looked like it just rolled off the assembly line. Honestly, if I told you my car was 3 years old and had gone through a few scrape-ups, I don't think you'd be able to tell. Ed Devlin is a miracle worker, and he does his magic at a super affordable price... I was shocked at how inexpensive the bill came out to be.
Revise this with your best effort: In my personal opinion, Devlin's is the finest auto body shop in Philadelphia. When my Honda Fit started accumulating numerous nicks, dents, scratches, and unsightly lime deposit stains on the hood, I entrusted it to Devlin's for a touch-up. To my astonishment, the outcome was a car that appeared as if it had just rolled off the assembly line. Frankly, if you were unaware that my car had endured a few scrape-ups over its three-year lifespan, I doubt you would be able to discern its age. Ed Devlin's exceptional skills are akin to performing miracles, and he offers his remarkable services at an unexpectedly affordable price. I was genuinely taken aback by the modest bill that I received.

input:
Even though theres nothing ostensibly stand-out about 45, I spend quite a bit of time here. This is definitely a "Cheers" bar, where everybody knows your name. If you can make out their face through the haze of cigarette smoke, that is. Personally, the smoke doesn't bother me, though i have plenty of friends who refuse to go here for that reason. 

I just love the laid back, dive-y vibe. On game days, theres always a spread of food to help yourself to, which is such a nice tradition that you rarely see in bars now. During baseball season, well, I hope you're a Red Sox fan. If not, keep your allegiances quiet, lol. And theres often a food truck parked out front. Yum! A great pre or post show stop if you're seeing music at Tipitinas, which is just down the street.
Revise this with your best effort:
Despite its lack of obvious standout features, I find myself spending a significant amount of time at 45. It exudes a familiar atmosphere similar to that of the famous "Cheers" bar, where everyone knows your name, even if their faces are hidden amidst the haze of cigarette smoke. Personally, the smoke doesn't bother me, although I do have friends who refuse to visit this place for that reason.

What draws me in is the relaxed and gritty ambiance of this dive bar. On game days, there's always an inviting spread of food for patrons to help themselves to, a tradition rarely seen in bars nowadays. Additionally, during the baseball season, it's best to keep your allegiances to the Red Sox discreetly, as the bar tends to attract passionate fans. I also can't resist mentioning the mouthwatering food truck often parked right outside. It serves as the perfect pre or post-show stop for those attending music events at Tipitinas, conveniently located just down the street.

input: Please note: the coffee is excellent! However, you have to ask for cream and sugar. I find this pretentious and intimidating. It's coffee. I want it how I want it. It shouldn't be such a big deal.
Revise this with your best effort: Please be aware that the coffee served here is of exceptional quality! However, it is worth mentioning that if you desire cream and sugar, you will need to specifically request them. Personally, I find this aspect somewhat off-putting and overwhelming, considering that coffee preference is subjective. When it comes to enjoying a cup of coffee, I believe it should be prepared according to one's own preferences without any unnecessary complications or fuss.

input:
Is it okay to say this is my favorite brunch spot even though all I've ever had here is their grits? I would definitely try one of their other courses and I'm pretty sure they're amazing, but it is so hard to not get my favorite thing off their menu! Their portion is so huge, i usually share it with another person (if I'm not being greedy)! You can literally top anything onto your dish and they vary from .50 cents to 1.00 dollar.  I love to add on avocados, red bell peppers, bacon, cheddar, and mushrooms! Their grits are incredible, it is not grainy nor watery. It's just perfect. I can go on and on. but I'm pretty sure you get the point! 

Eventually, i will try their other dishes, but for now, it's all about their grits.
Revise this with your best effort: Is it acceptable for me to declare this as my preferred brunch location, even though I have only ever sampled their grits? Although I am eager to venture beyond that and indulge in their other delectable offerings, I find it difficult to resist ordering my all-time favorite item from their menu. The portion size is so generous that I often share it with another person, unless my selfishness gets the best of me! Additionally, the option to customize your dish with various toppings, ranging from 50 cents to 1 dollar, is simply marvelous. I take great pleasure in adding avocados, red bell peppers, bacon, cheddar, and mushrooms to enhance the flavors. The grits, in particular, are truly remarkable, devoid of any graininess or excessive liquid. They are simply perfect. I could continue to sing their praises, but I believe you comprehend my enthusiasm! While I do plan to eventually explore their other culinary creations, for now, it is all about their exceptional grits.

input:
Great staff.  Nothing is ever disappointing - chili cheese etoufee is the BOMB.  It's a 4 instead of 5 stars because it's CASH ONLY.  But I love that you can also sit outside on nice evening.  

Don't forget the garlic sauce!
Revise this with your best effort: The staff here is exceptional, and every visit is a delight. The chili cheese etoufee is absolutely phenomenal, to the point where it can be rightfully deemed the epitome of flavor. My only minor critique is that they solely accept cash, which slightly detracts from the experience. Nonetheless, the option to enjoy their delectable dishes outdoors during pleasant evenings is a definite plus. Oh, and let's not overlook the garlic sauce – it's an absolute must-try!

input: Nice view from outside tables. It has typical beach food and typical beach service, but nice place to grab a drink with a view.
Revise this with your best effort: The outside tables offer a delightful view, allowing you to soak in the beauty of your surroundings. While it offers the typical beach food and service one would expect, it serves as an ideal spot to unwind with a refreshing drink while enjoying the scenery.

input: Is there any way that I can give a sixth or even seventh star to this place? Perhaps I'll contact the Yelp! corporate offices in San Francisco to inquire about expanding the star system using Lou and All About Hair as the Exhibit A. I've been on a three year odyssey, which has included some of the worst haircuts and barbers this side of, well, anything, to find a place like All About Hair. It is simply fantastic. I was here early on a Friday morning and aside from doing an incredible to the follicles that rest atop my head, Lou provided fantastic conversation and an environment that was more than inviting. I haven't written a Yelp! review in a very long time, but after my experience at All About Hair, I felt compelled to fire off a five star review about this gem of a place. Needless to say, I've found my barber of choice and they've made a long-term customer out of me.
Revise this with your best effort: Is there any possible way to grant this place a sixth or even seventh star? Maybe I should reach out to Yelp's corporate headquarters in San Francisco to propose expanding the star rating system, using Lou and All About Hair as the prime example. I've been on a hair-related journey for three whole years, enduring some of the most dreadful haircuts and barbers imaginable, until I stumbled upon All About Hair. To put it simply, this place is absolute perfection. I visited early on a Friday morning, and apart from giving my follicles an absolutely amazing transformation, Lou engaged me in delightful conversation and created an atmosphere that felt incredibly welcoming. It's been ages since I last left a Yelp review, but after my experience at All About Hair, I couldn't resist showering this hidden gem with a well-deserved five-star rating. Needless to say, I have finally found my go-to barber, and they have earned my loyalty as a lifelong customer.

input:
Updating previous trip- I still would take my kids there but the derma bond sucked. Poor buddy has a scar. Yea, yea...it's in a bad spot. And he's not quite two (read: squirmy.) 

I don't think it's too much to want it all. 

 :-/
Revise this with your best effort:
Update on our previous trip - I would still choose to bring my kids along, despite the unfortunate experience with derma bond. My poor little buddy has ended up with a scar, unfortunately located in a highly noticeable spot. To make matters more challenging, he is not yet two years old and has quite a squirmy nature.

I guess it's not unreasonable to expect a seamless and worry-free trip, considering these circumstances. But alas, it didn't quite turn out that way. 

Oh well, onwards and upwards!

input: This hotel has wonderful views of the airport, and it has the only revolving rooftop restaurant.  It's connected to the airport that has several restaurants and shops.  From the revolving rooftop restaurant, I could see the runways, and the control tower.
Revise this with your best effort: Offering stunning views of the airport, this exceptional hotel boasts the exclusive distinction of featuring the one and only revolving rooftop restaurant. Seamlessly connected to the airport, guests will find themselves conveniently situated amidst a vibrant array of restaurants and shops. From the vantage point of the revolving rooftop restaurant, one can admire the mesmerizing spectacle of the runways and the majestic control tower.

input: Love this place! The turkey, beans, and biscuits are amazing. Have had better pecan pie but that won't stop me from coming back :)
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adore this place! The turkey, beans, and biscuits are nothing short of extraordinary. While I've had slightly more exceptional pecan pie elsewhere, that small detail won't deter me from returning to this lovely establishment.

input: Large menu. Clean restaurant and restroom. Friendly staff. They were fairly busy in the middle of the day when we visited. This was my first time here and all we had was a sandwich so I can't give them 5 stars yet but for a family style restaurant and bar we enjoyed our meal. They had a decent draft beer selection and also serve wine and mixed drinks. There are crayons on every table and instead of a single place mat they put a large sheet of white paper on the tables for the kids to draw on.
Revise this with your best effort: The restaurant boasts an extensive menu offering a wide variety of options. Moreover, the cleanliness of both the restaurant and restroom stands out noticeably. The staff members are incredibly friendly and accommodating. During our visit in the afternoon, we observed a fair amount of activity as they were attending to numerous customers. As it was my inaugural experience, we opted for a sandwich, preventing me from rating them with the highest praise just yet. Nonetheless, for a family-style restaurant and bar, we thoroughly enjoyed our meal. Additionally, their draft beer assortment was commendable, alongside their selection of wine and mixed drinks. Notably, the restaurant goes the extra mile by providing crayons on every table, while the children are delighted by the large sheet of white paper used as a do-it-yourself placemat.

input:
Delicious crab cocktail and my husband loved his steamers. 

Only down fall is it is really humid in the restaurant itself. A fan would be nice.
Revise this with your best effort: The crab cocktail was absolutely delectable, and my husband couldn't get enough of his steamed delicacies. The only downside was the significant humidity within the restaurant premises. It would have been greatly appreciated if there were a fan to help alleviate the discomfort.

input: Freddy's has the best fast-food style burgers I've ever had. Great toppings choices and fresh meat. Their fries are delicious with their "fry" sauce. Their custard is just as good as their food. It's rich and creamy, and did I mention how delicious it is.
Revise this with your best effort: Freddy's undeniably serves the most exceptional fast-food style burgers I have ever tasted. Not only do they offer an array of delectable toppings, but their meats are always remarkably fresh. The accompanying fries are irresistibly delightful, especially when paired with their delectable "fry" sauce. However, their custard is truly unparalleled - boasting a richness and creaminess that is simply divine. Words do not suffice to describe just how incredibly delicious it is.

input: This place had fantastic donuts! They were very well priced and so soft. We tried the blueberry cake donut and apple fritter. We will definitely be going back.
Revise this with your best effort: This place was absolutely incredible for donut enthusiasts! The donuts here were not only exceptionally tasty, but they were also reasonably priced and incredibly fluffy. Among the delightful selection, we indulged in the irresistible blueberry cake donut and the mouthwatering apple fritter. Needless to say, we left completely satisfied and already planning our next visit.

input:
I really had a wonderful experience at the Nashville location, and we found out that New Orleans had one now and should go to it. Last night we got there kinda late around 10pm. Sat there for 10min and not one person greeted us. Went to the bar to see about service and she informed that the kitchen was behind on completing orders. 
I had to apologize to my friends that we may not get any food after driving three hours down to enjoy the weekend. We did end up leaving the restaurant after 25 min wait for no service or an apology. 

I have to say this not what I expected from a big known place for adults to have fun along with kids also. Please do something about this. I hope this is not a reflection of how others could become.
Revise this with your best effort:
I had an absolutely marvelous experience during my visit to the Nashville location, and was thrilled to learn that there was now a location in New Orleans as well. However, last night's visit left much to be desired. We arrived at the New Orleans location around 10pm, and unfortunately, it was not the warmest welcome we had hoped for. Despite waiting for 10 minutes, not a single person acknowledged our presence. Growing concerned, we decided to approach the bar to inquire about service. The bartender informed us that the kitchen was severely behind on orders.

Having driven three hours to enjoy a fun-filled weekend, I was disheartened to apologize to my friends that we may not be able to enjoy a meal at this establishment. After waiting for an additional 25 minutes with no sign of service or even an apology, we made the difficult decision to leave the restaurant.

This experience was far from what I had expected from such a well-known establishment that caters to both adults and children alike. I kindly request that the necessary measures be taken to address these service issues, as I sincerely hope this is not indicative of what others might encounter.

input:
Allegro's is great. The pizza is really cheap, and lightning fast. My favorite was the sicilian, followed by the, uh, meaty kind, followed in a close third by anything stuffed (sometimes the centers were cold). They also sell beer, but I can't comment much on that because when I lived in Philadelphia I was under 21.
The only downside is the service (occasionally rude) and the constant crazies that hang out there talking to themselves.
Revise this with your best effort:
Allegro's is truly remarkable. Not only do they offer remarkably affordable and incredibly speedy pizza, but their menu holds an enticing selection of options. Personally, my top choice was the mouthwatering Sicilian, closely followed by the scrumptious meaty variety. Additionally, I must confess a weakness for their delectable stuffed pizzas, though occasionally their centers fell victim to an undesired chill. It's worth noting that Allegro's even provides a selection of beer, although my experience lacks insight due to my underage residency in Philadelphia at the time.

However, it is important to address a couple of downsides. From time to time, the service has been a tad discourteous, which can be off-putting. Moreover, the constant presence of eccentric individuals engaging in self-conversations can make for an unusual atmosphere.

input:
This place treats you right from the moment you walk through the doors. I stay here every time I come to Reno, and the service seems to be getting better and better every time I return. On my last visit I stayed for free for 3 out of the 4 nights, and on top of that they gave me $120.00 of free play. The Peppermill is rated the casino with the loosest slots in casino. The rooms were clean,  the bathroom smelled great, and there weren't any bed bugs in our bed. The casino reminds me of old casino, when they relied on millions of lights bulbs, neon signs, and the smell of argon in the air. Happy hour everyday from 4-6 , you get mini apps and 3 dollar martinis at the fireside lounge. Also the Fish bar is awesome to go and relax, since they have a 40 foot aquarium that wraps around two of the walls. They have some excellent restaurants in the casino, that you don't even have to leave to satisfy any food craving you might have. The staff is extremely friendly and that is the top reason I keep coming back to this casino in Reno.
The only thing about this place is that the lights in the casino can really discombobulate you! Just remember that they key sleeve they give you has a map, so keep that in your pocket !
Revise this with your best effort: From the moment you step foot through the doors, this place truly knows how to cater to its guests. Without fail, I choose to stay here each and every time I visit Reno, and with each return, the service consistently exceeds my expectations. During my most recent stay, I was fortunate enough to enjoy three complimentary nights out of the four I was here, and as an added bonus, they also gifted me with $120.00 of free play. The Peppermill, widely regarded as the casino with the loosest slots, lives up to its reputation. Not only were the rooms spotlessly clean, but the bathrooms emitted a pleasant scent, and our bed was entirely free of any unwelcome bed bugs. The casino itself exudes a nostalgic ambiance, reminiscent of the classic casinos of old, complete with countless luminous light bulbs, neon signs, and the distinct aroma of argon in the air. Daily happy hour from 4-6 grants you the opportunity to indulge in delectable mini appetizers and delightful $3.00 martinis at the fireside lounge. And let's not forget about the incredible Fish bar, where relaxation is guaranteed thanks to its mesmerizing 40-foot aquarium, enveloping two entire walls. As if these amenities weren't enough, the casino houses an array of exceptional restaurants, eliminating the need to venture elsewhere in search of satisfying any culinary craving. Above all else, the staff at this establishment exemplify unparalleled friendliness, and it is undoubtedly this remarkable trait that keeps me returning to this remarkable casino in Reno. It is worth noting, however, that the luminous lights within the casino can sometimes be disorienting. Thankfully, the key sleeve provided to you contains a map, so remember to keep it safely tucked away in your pocket!

input: Two very good experiences.  Excellent burger and very good pulled pork.  Wife loved her egg white and goat cheese omlette.  Solid beer list and a good spicy bloody Mary.  Also had great service and an ecclectic play list.
Revise this with your best effort: I had the privilege of enjoying two remarkable experiences at this place. The burger was absolutely outstanding, providing a delightful explosion of flavors. Additionally, the pulled pork was exceptionally delicious, leaving me thoroughly satisfied. My wife was particularly pleased with her egg white and goat cheese omlette, which she couldn't stop raving about. The establishment's beer list was commendable, offering a wide selection of top-notch options, and their spicy bloody Mary was nothing short of fantastic. I must also commend the staff for delivering exceptional service throughout our visit. Furthermore, the eclectic playlist playing in the background added to the overall enjoyable atmosphere.

input:
One of their guests went on a rampage and started punching random people, knocking one to the ground.  I told the bartender to call security, then I restrained the assailant as efficiently as humanly possible, causing no injuries, no striking, basically a bear hug, until security finally arrived.  Instead of a thank you I was told to go to my room or I would be trespassing--- fine, Did they look at the video and figure it out? Make it right later?  No.  I was treated poorly, and when I called days later, I got no response.  Spoke with Art in Security, and no call back. 

Not  the way to treat someone who helped you out. 

I will not be going back to Peppermill.
Revise this with your best effort: After witnessing one of their guests going on a violent rampage and physically assaulting innocent bystanders, I immediately instructed the bartender to notify security. Taking matters into my own hands, I promptly subdued the assailant without causing any harm, employing a non-violent bear hug technique. Despite my efforts, all I received was an order to go to my room or face potential trespassing charges. I wondered if the management reviewed the security footage and acknowledged my actions later, but to my disappointment, they did not. This whole experience left a bitter taste in my mouth. When I made an attempt to reach out days later, I was met with silence and neglect. Even my conversation with Art from the Security department bore no fruit in terms of a callback. It is disheartening to be treated so poorly after helping out in a situation that could have escalated. Due to this appalling treatment, I have decided that I will not be returning to Peppermill.

input:
IF YOU ARE ON A STUDENT BUDGET, READ ON:

This is a 5 mile wide/long convention center. It has up to 2,000 guestrooms.  The conference I went to had 6,000 attendants. Of course I booked late and I didn't want to spend $200+/night on these hotel rooms! Otherwise this place is ginormous. The service (shuttle), lunch/drinks were really well done.  This place is immaculate; I do not know how many workers they staff.  

The food of course is overpriced (I had lunch/dinner at Wasabi. My bento box was $25.  Overpriced right?)  I also had lunch at the pizza place Paisano (forgot the name).   

If you decide to stay at the hotels across the street from the convention center (it is only 1 mile away - across from the McGovick Pwky).  They have Cracker Barrel, Apple Bees, Chillis?, McDonalds there.  The hotel I stayed in (being on a student budget) was crappy but I can't complain for $55/night.  It was Days Inn. It was walkable to shuttle pick up stop at Marriott Hotel (walk ~0.3 miles).  

They have Finleys pub, FUSE (night/club), STAX burger, Jack Daniels and more restaurants inside this convention center.  

I posted some photos.
Revise this with your best effort:
Attention all students on a tight budget, listen up!

Let me introduce you to this massive convention center, spanning a whopping 5 miles in both width and length. With an impressive capacity of up to 2,000 guestrooms, it can accommodate a large number of attendees. Speaking of which, the conference I attended had a staggering 6,000 people! However, being the last-minute booker I am, I couldn't justify spending $200+ per night on those hotel rooms. But let me tell you, this place is enormous! The shuttle service, lunch, and drinks were all top-notch, leaving me thoroughly impressed. I have no idea how many workers they have on staff, but they sure keep this place spotless.

Now, let's discuss the food situation. I will admit, the prices were a bit steep. I had lunch and dinner at Wasabi, and my bento box cost a hefty $25. Definitely overpriced, wouldn't you agree? I also grabbed a bite to eat at the pizza joint Paisano (sorry, the name slipped my mind).

If you're looking for more affordable dining options, consider staying at the hotels across the street from the convention center, just a mile away near McGovick Parkway. There you'll find Cracker Barrel, Applebee's, Chili's, and even a McDonald's. As for my accommodations, given my limited student budget, I settled for a less-than-ideal hotel called Days Inn. It wasn't the best, but for $55 a night, I couldn't really complain. Plus, it was conveniently located within walking distance (approximately 0.3 miles) to the shuttle pick-up point at the Marriott Hotel.

Now, let's talk about the amazing restaurants right inside the convention center. You'll find Finleys Pub, FUSE (a happening night club), STAX Burger, Jack Daniels, and more. There's no shortage of delicious options to satisfy your cravings.

By the way, in case you're curious, I've posted some photos for you to check out.

input: I took an 8 year old and a 14 year old for the lunch special pizza.  We have done this on several occasions, and the kids love that they each get their own personal pizza, made the way they like.   They both ordered their pizza with 2 items and wanted BBQ sauce as the base instead of tomato sauce.  (this is the only way they enjoy pizza).   I was told that they could only get tomato sauce, not BBQ sauce.   I explained that we have gotten it this way several times before.   We were told that they don't offer it this way any more.   I see that some of the pizzas offer BBQ sauce and pointed it out, but again was told that it couldn't be made this way for them.   I asked if I could pay additional to have it made with BBQ sauce, but once again told it was not possible.   Sadly, we left the restaurant and chose a different nearby restaurant for lunch.  I'm sorry to say I won't be able to take the kids here anymore.
Revise this with your best effort: I took an 8-year-old and a 14-year-old to the lunch special pizza place, which we have visited multiple times before. The kids always enjoy getting their own personal pizzas, customized with their favorite toppings. On this particular occasion, they both requested BBQ sauce instead of tomato sauce as the base, as it is their preferred way of enjoying pizza. Unfortunately, we were informed that BBQ sauce was no longer offered as an option. I explained that we had ordered it this way previously, but the staff insisted that it was not possible anymore. I even pointed out other pizzas on the menu that included BBQ sauce, but they still refused to accommodate our request. I even suggested paying extra for the BBQ sauce, but that option was also denied. Disappointed, we left the restaurant and ended up choosing another nearby place for lunch. Regrettably, it seems like we won't be able to bring the kids here in the future.

input: Super cute place! Employees are very nice! Cookie dough is delicious! This is a must & we are glad we found it (lost while in town).
Revise this with your best effort: This place is absolutely adorable! The employees are incredibly friendly and welcoming. And let's talk about the cookie dough - it's simply divine, full of deliciousness! Finding this gem was a stroke of luck while we were lost in town, and we couldn't be more thrilled. This place is an absolute must-visit, and we are beyond grateful that we stumbled upon it!

input:
Tacos.....
The chips and salsa were pretty lame.....and the tacos were ok.....nothing special.....
Revise this with your best effort: The chips and salsa didn't quite hit the mark, lacking the desired flavor. As for the tacos, they were decent but failed to leave a lasting impression or stand out in any remarkable way.

input: Excited to have this place in Reno! Delicious matcha and ube flavors! Like authentic. Friendly staff, looking to get better but what they have as a base is solid. Soft serve, cake and the sauces aren't overly sweet.  Hoping they add more flavors!
Revise this with your best effort: I'm thrilled to have discovered this gem in Reno! The matcha and ube flavors here are absolutely delicious, reminding me of the authentic ones. The staff is not only friendly but also eager to improve, which is commendable. Their soft serve, cakes, and sauces have just the right amount of sweetness, not overly sugary. My only wish is that they would expand their flavor options in the future.

input: Delicious. So happy I Yelped for a restaurant closer to home and stumbled upon this. It's small and pleasant inside with some decent hip hop setting the mood. The menu is small, but packed a punch. We ordered the Duck Fries, which were heaven. Fries smothered in smoked gouda,  shredded duck, and scallions. For 8 bucks came a pretty large bowl that I couldn't stop picking at. I ordered one of the specials, the scallop and foie gras  tacos...wow...so good (then I read the origin of foie gras and hated myself, but aside that...). The person I was with ordered the pork roll burger, which I tried of course. It was incredibly juicy and cooked perfect. I will definitely come back here. Definitely.
Revise this with your best effort: I had such a delightful experience when I decided to search for a restaurant closer to my home on Yelp. It is simply marvelous that I stumbled upon this hidden gem. The cozy ambiance and the hip hop music playing in the background created a pleasant atmosphere. Although the menu may be compact, it certainly packs a punch. One particular dish that left me in culinary bliss was the Duck Fries. These heavenly fries were generously topped with smoked gouda, shredded duck, and scallions. The sizeable bowl that came for only $8 was irresistible, and I couldn't resist picking at it. As for my main course, I opted for one of the specials - the scallop and foie gras tacos. They were absolutely divine, but upon learning about the origin of foie gras, I couldn't help but feel a tinge of remorse. However, putting that aside, the flavors were extraordinary. Furthermore, I had the opportunity to sample the pork roll burger that my dining companion ordered. Every bite was juicy and perfectly cooked, making it absolutely scrumptious. No doubt, I will be returning to this fantastic establishment. Without a doubt.

input: Went to Three Muses our first night in New Orleans. The plates are tapas style, small and meant for sharing. Between the four of us we got the blue cheese stuffed dates, the crawfish egg rolls, steak and cake, lamb sliders, feta fries and fish tacos. Everything was really good,i could have done without the tacos, but the lamb sliders and the steak and cake were AMAZING. The goat cheese paired with the lamb was to die for. And the crab cake was the best I have ever had.
Revise this with your best effort: On our first night in New Orleans, we headed to Three Muses, a delightful restaurant where the dishes are served tapas-style, perfect for sharing. Our group of four indulged in an array of culinary delights, including the delectable blue cheese stuffed dates, tantalizing crawfish egg rolls, sumptuous steak and cake, mouthwatering lamb sliders, flavorful feta fries, and succulent fish tacos. While everything we tasted was undeniably good, I must admit that the fish tacos failed to impress. Yet, the lamb sliders with goat cheese were simply sublime, offering a divine combination of flavors that left us craving for more. As for the crab cake, it surpassed all expectations, easily claiming the title of the best I have ever had.

input: Great ambiance!  Loved the trendy and modern decor.  The presentation of the dishes was also great.  The food was just okay though.  The potatoes weren't cooked and the pancakes were a bit on the greasy side.  Would def. go back again and give it another try...french toast and omelette looked good!  I would also like to try their lunch. Service was excellent.
Revise this with your best effort: The ambiance was absolutely fantastic! I adored the trendy and contemporary decor that gave the place a vibrant atmosphere. Additionally, the presentation of the dishes was impeccable, enhancing the overall dining experience. However, I must admit that the food itself was only satisfactory. Unfortunately, the potatoes were undercooked, and the pancakes seemed a touch too greasy for my liking. Nevertheless, I am willing to give this place another chance since the French toast and omelette caught my eye. Moreover, I am curious to explore their lunch menu as well. It is important to note that the service provided was exceptional, ensuring a pleasant and enjoyable visit.

input: This place is awesome the food is dynamite . Super friendly service. And the. Coup de grace was the flan made in house fresh and believe me I've tried flan everywhere, there's is exceptional. The price was right on point. My only suggestion to make this place go into the stratosphere is if they had a liquor license.
Revise this with your best effort: This place is absolutely incredible! The food here is simply dynamite, and the service provided is genuinely super friendly. However, the real showstopper was their homemade flan which was so fresh and delicious. I have tried flan in numerous places, but theirs is truly exceptional. Moreover, the prices are just right and definitely worth it. If I were to offer a suggestion to take this place to greater heights, it would be to obtain a liquor license for an even more complete dining experience.

input: Had breakfast with the family after a quick stopover. Great food and service (thanks Jonathan!), definaelty a good find that was busy but had no wait on a Saturday.
Revise this with your best effort: After a brief stopover, our family enjoyed a delightful breakfast together. The food was absolutely fantastic, and the service provided by Jonathan was impeccable—our sincere thanks to him! It was truly a hidden gem that, despite being bustling with activity, surprisingly had no wait time on a busy Saturday.

input: During the parents' visit,  dad wanted some southern food. We tried Willie Maes, but the line was long and they weren't crazy about the area.  So we waited a bit and went down to The Praline Connection. Dad was in heaven. He's been talking about the food since we left. Dad got the taste of soul platter pictured below. He said the fried chicken was the best he's had and he had not tasted red beans and rice like that since he was a kid and my granny used to make em. Mom got the meatloaf with cabbage and lima beans. I got the ribs with potato salad and mac and cheese. My ribs were good but hard to cut the meat off the bone. I could've ate em with my hands but I didn't want a BBQ face. The potato salad was good but my mac & cheese was a little bland. The cornbread was great.  I'm going back next time for the fried chicken!
Revise this with your best effort:
During our parents' visit, my dad was craving some authentic southern cuisine. After attempting to dine at Willie Mae's but being deterred by the long line and less desirable location, we decided to wait a little and made our way to The Praline Connection instead. To say that my dad was ecstatic about the food would be an understatement - he hasn't stopped raving about it since we left.

Dad opted for their mouthwatering soul platter, which I have included a picture of below. According to him, the fried chicken was unparalleled, reminding him of the flavors he had not tasted since his childhood when my granny used to whip them up. My mom ordered the meatloaf accompanied by cabbage and lima beans, which she thoroughly enjoyed. As for me, I went for the ribs, accompanied by a side of potato salad and mac and cheese. Although the ribs were delicious, they proved to be a bit difficult to cut off the bone. I could have easily devoured them with my hands like a true barbecue enthusiast, but I wanted to avoid having a messy face. The potato salad proved to be tasty, while the mac and cheese fell slightly short on flavor. On a positive note, the cornbread was exceptional.

Next time we visit The Praline Connection, I am undoubtedly going to indulge in their acclaimed fried chicken.

input:
Buddy Brew is a very trendy coffee shop based in Tampa. Their coffee is flavorful and their presentation is nice. I really liked the fact that their lattes and cappuccinos have beautiful latte art on top. The store has a beautiful modern design that reminds me of coffee shops in New York. 

This particular location is in Hyde Park Village. The benefit is that parking is free. The down side is that seating is limited. The store is also extremely cold, so it is uncomfortable to sit and socialize for very long. You may be better off getting your coffee to go and walking around Hyde Park Village instead.
Revise this with your best effort:
Buddy Brew, an upscale coffee shop nestled in Tampa, has successfully capitalized on its trendy appeal. Savoring their flavorful brews becomes an exquisite experience with the captivating latte art adornments on their lattes and cappuccinos. Moreover, their aesthetically pleasing modern design evokes reminiscences of the vibrant coffee culture in the heart of New York City. 

Conveniently located within Hyde Park Village, patrons are bestowed with the boon of complimentary parking. However, it must be noted that seating options are relatively scarce, dampening prolonged socializing prospects within the premises. An added inconvenience manifests in the excessive chill within the store, which regrettably compromises comfort. As such, opting to grab your coffee to-go and leisurely meandering around the charming Hyde Park Village might prove to be a more gratifying experience.

input:
A really nice place to get your hair did with as much of an edge as you want.  

In the East Loop, across from the Pageant, might be one of the most underrated salons in the city.  I first went into this place as a walk-in, and keep on going back.  Yes, I'm a guy, and since my hair is pretty coarse, grows weird, and I want a bit of style to it, I go to hair salons.  At V Vegaz I've never been dissatisfied with my cut. 

When you walk in you realize how spacious the place is, with a bit of a slightly modern, slightly baroque interior design.  There's a nice vibe there too amongst the employees, and you can see that the stylists are happy with the work situation.  Of course, happy stylists, to me, mean better haircuts.

I go to Callie, since that first walk-in, and keep on going back.  Yes, she's real friendly, which is a nice touch, but she's also a great stylist.  I'm a bit wishy washy when I look for a cut, usually changing what I want most of the time.  Callie's sensitive to that, and really understands how my hair grows and where it's going to move.   I think the biggest compliment to her is that, as I'm a once a month haircut kinda guy, my brother and sister told me they really my hair a full month after I had it cut with Callie.  So that's really a testament to her skills.

I've not gotten color there, but it is a full service salon, and not just a turn and burn place.  

I highly recommend this place.
Revise this with your best effort:
Located in the vibrant East Loop, directly across from the Pageant, lies one of the city's most underrated salons. I stumbled upon this gem as a walk-in and have continued to return ever since. As a guy with coarse, unruly hair who craves a touch of style, I rely on hair salons to work their magic. V Vegaz has never failed to impress me with their exceptional cuts.

Upon entering, you'll be greeted by the spacious and beautifully designed interior. It strikes the perfect balance between modern and baroque aesthetics. The atmosphere is pleasant, and you can sense the contentment among the staff. Happy stylists make for superior haircuts, in my experience.

I exclusively book appointments with Callie, who has not only become a friendly face but also an outstanding stylist. I tend to be indecisive when it comes to my hair, frequently changing my preferences. Fortunately, Callie understands this and possesses an exceptional understanding of how my hair grows and moves. The ultimate testament to her skills came when my brother and sister remarked on how great my hair looked, an entire month after my appointment with Callie. Needless to say, her talent is truly remarkable.

While I cannot personally speak to their coloring services, it's worth noting that V Vegaz is a full-service salon, offering more than just quick and mediocre cuts.

If you're in search of a top-notch salon experience, I wholeheartedly urge you to give this place a try.

input:
The lady who works here is a miracle worker! I came in with a couple pairs of pants that needed to be hemmed, and a suit jacket whose sleeves needed to be shortened (both of which are not quick and easy, since suits are normally lined and it's a lot of work).
