Definitely returning.
Revise this with your best effort: The lady who operates here is truly a miracle worker! I arrived with a couple of pants requiring hemming and a suit jacket with sleeves to be shortened. These alterations can be quite challenging, considering suits are usually lined, making the job labor-intensive. To make matters urgent, I needed them completed swiftly as I had imminent travel plans. Astonishingly, she managed to finish all these alterations within a single day. Moreover, the workmanship was exceptional; the alterations were flawlessly executed, exhibiting a neat and highly professional finish. Consequently, I now possess a stunning suit that fits me impeccably for my upcoming business trip! Additionally, it's worth noting that they accept all major credit cards, including American Express, and maintain reasonable operating hours. Without a doubt, I will be a returning customer.

input:
Late one Saturday night, some friends and I made the mistake of trying to get drinks at Plough and the Stars and left very quickly. We were walking around trying to find somewhere else to go, noticed this unmarked bar and decided to check it out. We were so excited to see that there were so many great beers on tap, and there was a decent crowd there so we stuck around. It was a fun night! And after a few weeks of wondering where we had gone, we were able to find the Irish Pol on Yelp :D

I went back for happy hour recently and it wasn't exactly as I had remembered. It was pretty dark and dingy looking inside,  and the few people there were much much older. It just had a weird vibe. The beer was still great of course. The happy hour special was $3 drafts, but most of the beers I wanted weren't included. I won't be back for happy hour, but I would definitely stop in on a Saturday night!
Revise this with your best effort:
On a late Saturday night, a group of friends and I made the unfortunate decision of attempting to get drinks at Plough and the Stars, only to quickly realize our mistake and leave. As we wandered around in search of an alternative destination, our attention was drawn to an unmarked bar, sparking our curiosity to explore further. Excitement bubbled within us as we discovered an extensive variety of exquisite beers on tap, accompanied by a lively crowd that compelled us to stay. It turned out to be a truly enjoyable evening. Weeks passed and we found ourselves wondering where we had stumbled upon that hidden gem until, thanks to the wonders of Yelp, we tracked down the elusive Irish Pol.

Recently, I decided to revisit the establishment for their happy hour, longing for an experience akin to my first visit. However, upon entering, the ambiance seemed considerably dim and worn, while the patrons appeared to be much older than anticipated. A peculiar vibe seemed to permeate the air, making the experience less than ideal. Nonetheless, the beer remained exceptional, living up to my expectations. Admittedly, the happy hour special of $3 drafts fell short as most of the beers I desired were not included. As a result, I have decided not to return for happy hour in the future; nevertheless, I would still be inclined to drop by on a vibrant Saturday night.

input: Hands down the best spaghetti & meatballs I've ever had. The atmosphere here is so nice and cozy. It has just won out as my favorite Italian restaurant.
Revise this with your best effort: Without a doubt, this is hands down the most exceptional spaghetti and meatballs I've ever tasted. The delightful atmosphere of this place exudes warmth and coziness. Hence, it has effortlessly earned the top spot as my absolute favorite Italian restaurant.

input: We arrived at Happy Hour, 50 cent oysters and half price drinks, so we had both, the ordered the beet salad (divine), mussels, and flammenkuchen (an appetizer I used for my entree),  All were excellent.  I first had flammenkuchen (or tarte flambe) in Strasbourg at a street fair, this was far and above that experience, with caramelized onions resting atop the cheese and hunks of bacon strewn around.  So good!
Revise this with your best effort:
We eagerly arrived at Happy Hour, enticed by the allure of 50 cent oysters and half-priced drinks. Naturally, we indulged in both these delectable offerings before proceeding to order the exquisite beet salad that proved to be truly divine. Our dining experience escalated further as we savored the succulent mussels and the appetizing flammenkuchen, which I opted to relish as my entree. All three dishes exceeded our expectations, leaving us thoroughly impressed.

My encounter with flammenkuchen, or tarte flambe, traces back to Strasbourg, where I encountered it during a captivating street fair. However, the version presented before me now surpassed that previous experience. A delightful harmony was created as the caramelized onions gracefully rested atop a bed of cheese, while delightful chunks of perfectly cooked bacon lay scattered across the masterpiece. Each bite was an explosion of flavors, an amalgamation of sheer deliciousness.

In summary, our visit to Happy Hour not only gratified our taste buds but also served as a reminder of the exquisite culinary delights that exist in the world. The unparalleled combination of flavors and textures left a lasting impression, ensuring that we shall return to relish these gastronomic pleasures once more.

input: Have eaten at this place 3 times. Every time was a good experience for me and the kids. No smoke No noise and good food good service. Maybe because it has always been on a late tuesday afternoon we have eaten there. I have always ordered something different and have been satisfied  and happy with what I got. Definitely will be back to eat there again.
Revise this with your best effort: I have dined at this establishment on three occasions, and each time has been a delightful experience for both myself and my children. The absence of smoke and noise creates a pleasant atmosphere, allowing us to enjoy our meals in peace. The quality of the food and service has consistently been excellent. It is possible that our positive experiences are attributed to the fact that we have visited on late Tuesday afternoons. Regardless, I have made it a point to try something different from the menu during each visit, and I have always been thoroughly satisfied and content with my selection. Without a doubt, I will return to this place for another enjoyable dining experience.

input: Great pizza! The place is beautiful and the atmosphere is truly inviting. The service is very nice and fast.
Revise this with your best effort: The pizza here is absolutely fantastic! The establishment itself boasts a stunning ambiance that truly draws you in. The atmosphere exudes warmth and welcome, creating a truly inviting experience. Additionally, the service provided is exceptionally friendly and efficient, ensuring you get your pizza in no time.

input: Great dinner started with a wonderful fresh Caesar salad and bread followed by delicious cheese ravioli with pesto cream sauce. The pesto sauce was perfect, not overpowering the delicate pasta. I also enjoyed the Dunham cabernet. Delicious. Welcome to downtown, Richard's.
Revise this with your best effort: We kicked off an amazing dinner at the newly opened Richard's downtown with an exquisite, refreshing Caesar salad paired with freshly baked bread. The crisp lettuce and the tangy dressing were a fantastic prelude to the sublime cheese-filled ravioli, drenched in a divine pesto cream sauce. The harmony between the delicate pasta and the flavorsome pesto was impeccable, with neither one overwhelming the other. To complete this culinary delight, I relished every sip of the velvety Dunham cabernet, perfectly complementing the meal. Welcome to downtown, Richard's, where culinary bliss awaits.

input:
Had a great breakfast here last weekend before we headed out. You order at the front and they will bring the food out. I had the French toast (fruit on the side)  with an a la carte fried egg on the side. They dropped my egg when they got to the table but promptly brought out another one. I also had a vanilla latte which was yummy....no extra sweeteners needed. 

We sat outside on the patio which was just lovely. Even if you sat inside, like other restaurants in the French quarter, every door and windows are open, so fresh breezes flow throughout. Really nice experience.
Revise this with your best effort:
I had a superb breakfast at this establishment last weekend prior to our departure. Upon arrival, we placed our order at the front counter, and the food was promptly brought to our table. I opted for the French toast with a side of fresh fruit, complemented by a delectable a la carte fried egg. Regrettably, my egg accidentally slipped from the server's grip when it reached our table, but they quickly rectified the situation by promptly serving me a replacement. Additionally, I indulged in a delightful vanilla latte which proved to be perfectly satisfying without any additional sweeteners required. 

We chose to sit outside on the patio, which presented a truly enchanting ambiance. Even if one were to select indoor seating, akin to numerous establishments in the French Quarter, the presence of open doors and windows allows invigorating breezes to permeate the entire space. Overall, this was an exceptionally pleasant dining experience.

input:
We were early for church and wanted to grab a quick bite to eat. The atmosphere was really inviting and everyone on staff spoke to us at least once! 

The food was good, but not great. I had quiche and my guest had a croque madame. The crust of the quiche wasn't done and the bread on the croque wasn't that great. Otherwise these two dishes would have been perfect. The fruit was fresh and the coffee was great!

I will definitely return.
Revise this with your best effort:
We arrived at church ahead of schedule and decided to stop by for a light meal. The ambiance of the place was truly welcoming, and every staff member made it a point to engage with us during our visit.

The food was satisfactory, although not extraordinary. I ordered the quiche, which unfortunately had an undercooked crust, and my companion had the croque madame, which was accompanied by bread that didn't quite meet our expectations. Despite these minor setbacks, both dishes would have been impeccable. On a positive note, the fruit was delightfully fresh, and the coffee exceeded our taste buds' desires.

Without a doubt, I will be making a return to this establishment.

input:
Thoroughly enjoyed our visit to Salty's this evening.  As first time customers, it will be on our list of places to return when we make it back to town.  

They have a good kids menu, enough to keep the little ones content with options like burgers, Alfredo pasta, chicken, shrimp, quesadilla, etc.  

We started with the Crabby Dip which the whole family enjoyed but feel it was a little overpriced at $14.  For the main course I enjoyed a Salty Burger while she had the macadamia crusted grouper, both were excellent choices!  Service was spot on making this a five star experience for us!
Revise this with your best effort:
We had an absolutely delightful time at Salty's tonight. Being our first visit, we have definitely added it to our list of must-return places whenever we come back to town.

One of the things we loved about Salty's is their wonderful kids menu. It had a variety of options like burgers, Alfredo pasta, chicken, shrimp, quesadilla, and more, ensuring that our little ones were thoroughly satisfied.

To start off our meal, we ordered the Crabby Dip which the entire family thoroughly enjoyed. However, we did feel that the price of $14 was a tad bit high for what we received. As for our main courses, I opted for the mouthwatering Salty Burger while my partner chose the macadamia crusted grouper. Both dishes turned out to be outstanding choices!

Moreover, the service we received was impeccable, taking our dining experience to a whole new level. Overall, we cannot help but rate our experience at Salty's a resounding five stars!

input:

input: This place is awesome. A real throwback. Music is great, 4 stars (not 5) as they don't really offer seating beyond the first 15 ppl in line.

input: Really not even going to get into it go to Blue Fin or Masamoto
Revise this with your best effort: I strongly recommend dining at Blue Fin or Masamoto instead of going into the details.

input:
Stayed here for a bachelorette party. This place got the job done. Unfortunately, all the hotels in Santa Barbara are pretty freaking pricey. A lot of the other hotels started at $400+ /night.  This ain't Vegas where you can get something pretty cushy for $250. This seemed like a decent option on the lower end. Our rooms were about $250 a night. A lot of the other hotels in the area were already booked for the weekend or required more than one night to book. 

Pros: 
-decently priced
-clean and cozy rooms
-charming exterior and grounds
-relatively comfortable beds
-bath and body works shampoo, body wash etc
-free water bottles and fruit waiting for you in the room

Cons:
-dated decor 
-toilet issues: The hook inside kept coming undone. I guess we decided not to get maintenance because we temporarily fixed it, but it kept coming undone so it wouldn't really flush. We were checking out that day, so we decided just to deal with it. 
- door was difficult to open without using a certain technique
-no hair dryer, so bring your own
-no complimentary breakfast
-a bit noisy in the morning, but I slept fine. I guess the window in the bathroom was open or something for some ventilation.

Overall, I still don't think I would've chosen to stay anywhere else in Santa Barbara, so BW Pepper Tree Inn was still a good choice based on the location of the bachelorette and price range.
Revise this with your best effort:
I stayed at BW Pepper Tree Inn for a bachelorette party and found it to be a satisfactory choice, considering the prices of other hotels in Santa Barbara, which were quite high. Unlike in Vegas, where you can get a luxurious hotel for $250, Santa Barbara's options were significantly more expensive, with many starting at $400+ per night. With that in mind, the BW Pepper Tree Inn seemed like a decent and affordable option, costing us around $250 per night. Other hotels in the area were either fully booked for the weekend or required a minimum stay of more than one night.

The pros of this hotel include its reasonable pricing, clean and cozy rooms, charming exterior and grounds, relatively comfortable beds, and the presence of Bath and Body Works amenities such as shampoo and body wash. Additionally, they provided free water bottles and fruit in each room, which was a nice touch.

However, there were a few cons worth mentioning. Firstly, the decor of the hotel seemed dated. Additionally, the toilet in our room had a recurring issue with the hook inside, causing it to come undone and preventing proper flushing. Despite noticing this inconvenience, we decided against calling maintenance since we were checking out that day. Furthermore, opening the door required a specific technique, which was somewhat bothersome. Another drawback was the absence of a hair dryer, so guests should remember to bring their own. Additionally, there was no complimentary breakfast offered. Lastly, there was a bit of morning noise, possibly due to a bathroom window being left open for ventilation, although it didn't disturb my sleep.

Despite these drawbacks, I still believe that BW Pepper Tree Inn was the best choice for our bachelorette party in Santa Barbara considering its location and affordable price range.

input: In my book you can never go wrong having a good old-fashioned meal a Johnny Rockets. I had their recent promo which was a barbecued pulled pork burger. It was a lot of food and a lot of flavor!! Top that with endless fries and I'm a happy camper. Have never had a bad experience at this location. They were recently moved from the casino floor level to the shopping level and since they did that they don't do the singing or dancing anymore which is a shame
Revise this with your best effort:
In my opinion, you can't go wrong when it comes to enjoying a satisfying, traditional meal at Johnny Rockets. Recently, I had the pleasure of trying their mouthwatering promotional barbecued pulled pork burger, and let me tell you, it was a culinary delight! The portion was generous, and the flavors were abundant, leaving me completely satisfied. And to top it off, their endless fries were a true delight for my taste buds.

What sets this particular Johnny Rockets location apart is the consistently positive experiences I've had here. However, it's worth mentioning that they have relocated from the bustling casino floor level to a more tranquil shopping level. While the change in scenery is understandable, I must say, it's unfortunate that they no longer offer their singing or dancing entertainment. It added a unique and lively touch to the dining experience.

input: This salon is filthy.  There are cobwebs and dust every where.  The equipment is old and in disrepair.  My nail technician was actually watching you tube videos while doing my nails!  I do not know how the health department hasn't shut them down.
Revise this with your best effort: This salon is incredibly unclean, with cobwebs and visible dust accumulating throughout. The equipment appears worn out and neglected, showing signs of disrepair. Shockingly, my nail technician was engrossed in watching YouTube videos while attending to my nails. It truly baffles me how the health department has not taken action to shut down this establishment.

input: I always am in favor of local businesses.  They have a big selection here and you get free popcorn.  Why go to the big boys and have to pay for popcorn when you can get it here for free?
Revise this with your best effort: I have a strong inclination towards supporting local businesses. The wide range of products available here, coupled with the added perk of complimentary popcorn, makes it a much more appealing choice than opting for larger establishments where popcorn comes at a cost.

input:
I still love this place just as much as I ever did, and here's why:

1) Super friendly and knowledgeable staff 
2) Roomy, with lots of outlets and enough space to accommodate mid-sized groups (like the recent Yelp Office Hours)
3) Delicious tea, of course!

I've always loved their "Awake" Fizz Tea, but I've also broadened my horizons to include Pearl Tea (aka bubble tea). The taro flavor rocked my socks off. It did take a little getting used to though, as I had a mini anxiety attack every time I took a sip. Because I got it warm, it was in a paper cup and I never knew when a pearl was making its way into my mouth. As a result, I spent half my drink wondering "is there one in my straw?" It's totally worth the suspense, though.

The only thing that still troubles me is the music. It's just...not right. In fact, sometimes it's pretty distracting. It's easily avoided, however; just bring headphones and your own musical selection and all is well.
Revise this with your best effort:
I absolutely adore this place now more than ever, and here's exactly why:

1) The staff here is incredibly friendly and remarkably knowledgeable. Their warm and welcoming nature elevates the entire experience.

2) The spaciousness of this place is just remarkable. It boasts plenty of outlets and ample room to comfortably accommodate mid-sized groups. I recently attended Yelp Office Hours here and it was an absolute delight.

3) Let's not forget about the tea - it's absolutely divine! While I've always been enamored with their "Awake" Fizz Tea, I've also ventured into the world of Pearl Tea, commonly known as bubble tea. The taro flavor completely blew me away. Although I admit, it did take me a while to adjust to sipping it without any apprehension. The warm beverage was served in a paper cup, and I was always uncertain if I'd encounter a pearl with every sip. So, I'd find myself constantly wondering, "Is there one in my straw?" Despite the thrilling suspense, it's truly worth every moment.

The only aspect that continues to trouble me is the music. It just doesn't quite hit the mark, and at times, it can be rather distracting. Thankfully, the solution is quite simple - just bring your own headphones and curate your own musical selection. This way, you can fully immerse yourself in the soothing ambiance without any disruptions.

input: Yah Man was yah man! Go here and enjoy the atmosphere, the personal service and delicious Caribbean fare. The beef pie was yummy as was the chicken and island sampler plates. The bread pudding was to die for. We left full and happy. If you live in the Tampa area or are visiting you should go here! Nice people! BTW, this is the 3rd time I've posted on yelp just wanted to share this place, so good!
Revise this with your best effort: Yah Man truly lives up to its reputation as an exceptional dining experience! When you visit this establishment, you can expect an inviting atmosphere, personalized service, and mouthwatering Caribbean cuisine that is sure to satisfy even the most discerning palate. The beef pie, chicken, and island sampler plates were all incredibly delicious, leaving us craving for more. And let's not forget the bread pudding, which was simply divine and a perfect way to end our meal. We departed feeling completely satiated and filled with joy. Whether you reside in Tampa or are simply visiting, this is a must-visit destination that will leave you with unforgettable memories. The staff is incredibly friendly, further enhancing the overall experience. By the way, I just had to share this gem on Yelp for the third time. Such an incredible place, it deserves all the praise!

input:
Favorite place to go in New Orleans. Chill backyard bar with great local music options.

Smaller groups are better- seating can get tight. The wine and cheese bar up front services the live music venue in back. You can pick 3 or more cheeses and they put together a lovely cheese and accoutrements tray for you. You can also choose a wine to open up in the back. Wines have a great selection, mid-range price (almost all winces over $10-20 a bottle).

Great place to spend the night and have a wonderful time away from the packed tourists hot spots. (Mind you, this place is well known and a hot spot itself).
Revise this with your best effort:
One of my absolute favorite spots to visit in New Orleans is a charming backyard bar that exudes a relaxing vibe and offers an array of fabulous local musicians. While it is recommended to visit with smaller groups, as seating can become tight, the experience is well worth it. As you enter, you'll be greeted by a delightful wine and cheese bar that beautifully complements the live music venue in the back. The cheese aficionados in the establishment will expertly curate a heavenly assortment of three or more cheeses, accompanied by delectable accoutrements, all served on an exquisite tray. To complete this culinary experience, you can select a bottle of wine from their impressive collection, which boasts a diverse range of options at mid-range prices. Nearly all the wines are priced between $10-20 per bottle, ensuring a delightful evening without breaking the bank.

What sets this place apart is its ability to provide a fantastic night out, away from the tourist-heavy areas of the city. Despite its growing popularity, this hidden gem manages to retain its unique charm and respite from the bustling crowds. So, whether you're seeking a respite from the typical touristy spots or simply want to discover an exceptional local hotspot, this backyard bar in New Orleans is the perfect choice.

input: Had a great lunch here. I ordered a chicken Caesar and my dining companion ordered a custom salad. Waitress had a great personality and did not rush us at all. Allowed us to linger. Great space which is hidden from the outside.
Revise this with your best effort: I had an absolutely amazing lunch experience at this restaurant. I opted for the delicious chicken Caesar while my dining companion had the opportunity to customize their own salad. The waitress attending to us was delightful and displayed an exceptionally pleasant personality throughout our entire meal. She never once hurried us, graciously allowing us to take our time and fully enjoy our dining experience. The restaurant itself boasts a remarkable ambiance, its inviting space cleverly concealed from the outside world.

input: Made reservation a over a week ago with request to be near band. On arrival they had no record of it. And we are stuck in the back next to the bathroom. 5 stars for cocktail,food, band and Atmosphere. 1 stars for utter lack of organization.  The woman who took it said she was new. Always call to confirm I guess. Completely disappointed esp since we've had such amazing experiences here in the past.  There open tables near front and were told they were for people with reservations
Revise this with your best effort: I made a reservation over a week ago, specifically requesting to be seated near the band. Much to our disappointment, upon arrival, the staff had no record of our reservation. As a result, we were unfortunately stuck at the back, right next to the bathroom. Despite this, I must commend the establishment for their exceptional cocktails, delicious food, vibrant atmosphere, and talented band – all deserving of a 5-star rating. However, I cannot overlook the utter lack of organization displayed by the staff, particularly the new employee who took our reservation. This incident has left a bitter taste, especially considering the fantastic experiences we have had here in the past. Interestingly, we noticed empty tables near the front, which were allegedly reserved for guests. It would have been appreciated if we were given a proper explanation for this discrepancy.

input: Great professional tat shop!! My husband and I are very happy with our new ink. Bryan did an outstanding job and I highly recommend him. All the employees were super nice and I can see why this is the city's #1 tattoo shop. Don't forget their new location is 1418 N. Clairborne, in Suite 5, upstairs.
Revise this with your best effort: I am thrilled to share my excellent experience at this incredible professional tattoo shop! Both my husband and I are extremely satisfied with our new ink. Bryan, the talented artist, truly surpassed our expectations with his outstanding work. I cannot recommend him enough. Additionally, the entire staff was exceptionally friendly, which only added to the overall positive experience. It is no surprise that this establishment holds the prestigious title of being the number one tattoo shop in the city. And don't forget to check out their new location at 1418 N. Clairborne, Suite 5, upstairs.

input: Love this place.  Best view in Santa Barbara.   Awesome wines.  My wife and I are industry, and always treated great.  Tom and Gillian are ALWAYS generous hosts.  My wife works @carrwinery and always refers customers to them.  The Conway cabs are the best SB has to offer.  One of their tasting room employees just gifted us a Conway 13 reserve Syrah.  Beautiful. ...  Thank you Tommy.   Rolos red is a bottle that any wine snob would love,  but a great bottle for those finding their pallet as well.  My son is 5 and always wants mom and dad to go wine tasting when we hit the pier. Never disappointed.
Revise this with your best effort:
I absolutely adore this place. It truly boasts the most breathtaking view in Santa Barbara. The wines here are truly remarkable, leaving an everlasting impression. As individuals working within the industry, my wife and I are always treated with utmost respect and care. Tom and Gillian, the hosts, never fail to show their generosity and hospitality. My wife, who is employed at Carr Winery, never hesitates to recommend this place to her customers.

The Conway cabs are, without a doubt, the finest Santa Barbara has to offer. To our pleasant surprise, one of the employees at the tasting room recently presented us with a bottle of Conway 13 reserve Syrah. It was simply extraordinary, and we extend our heartfelt gratitude to Tommy for this wonderful gesture.

Speaking of exceptional bottles, Rolos red is a true gem that would certainly impress any wine connoisseur. Nevertheless, it also serves as a fantastic choice for those who are still exploring and developing their palate. Even our 5-year-old son eagerly insists that we visit this place every time we venture to the pier. And we have never once been disappointed.

input:
Yo this draft latte is BS good. 

Also the guy at the register complimented my tie. 10/10

input: This place is amazing!!! There aren't enough words for how amazing the food is here. input: Such a cool atmosphere and unlike anything I've ever been to. You walk into the wine and cheese shop, select a bottle (or 2!) and then select whatever cheeses and meats you so choose from a refrigerator. Once you have your items, you bring it to the counter to pay, they take your cheeses and meats, and deliver it to your outside (or upstairs inside in our case due to the rain!) and it's like magic. Revise this with your best effort:

Once you have made your selections, you proceed to the counter to complete your purchase. The staff takes charge of your chosen cheeses and meats, and remarkably, when it is delivered to you outside (or upstairs inside if the weather isn't ideal), it feels like pure magic. What appears before you is an exquisitely arranged cheese board, adorned with a delightful assortment of nuts and spreads, accompanied by a scrumptious loaf of perfectly sliced artisan bread. The presentation is simply stunning.

I wholeheartedly recommend this incredible establishment. As an added bonus, they even offer a menu if you find yourself wanting more from the kitchen. However, I must emphasize that after indulging in their generous platter of cheeses and meats, paired with a well-selected wine, my companion and I were completely satisfied.

input:
I have been here twice for breakfast.  The set-up is really awkward and it's clear the people running it on Saturday mornings don't really know what they're doing.  It's stressful to hear them cursing under their breath and yelling at their line cook, Carlos.  

You are instructed to order at the counter....except ocassionally, for certain clients, they'll actually come to your table and take your order ...but it seems pretty random.  It's all self serve (shitty) coffee and bottled beverages.  After a long time with the sun beating down on you (there are no shades for front window), the food arrives and it's Ok.  there was a lot of grizzle in my pulled pork texas wrap,  but the cornbread pancakes were tasty.  

You then pay afterwards---why not just pay when you get it?  I would like to minimize my face time with the awkward people who staff it on Saturday A.M.s, but no such luck. 

I brought my out-of-town brother here for brunch and regret it.  it's somewhat tasty, but kind of a dive.  Don't go here if you expect a nice/traditional b-fast service (i.e. a waiter and people who fill up your coffee.)  That said, it's pretty cheap so, guess you get what you paid for.
Revise this with your best effort:
I have visited this place for breakfast on two separate occasions. Unfortunately, the setup is quite awkward and it's evident that the staff on Saturday mornings lack proper organization and expertise. It can be quite stressful to hear them muttering curses under their breath and yelling at their line cook, Carlos.

The way the ordering system works is also quite inconsistent. While you are instructed to order at the counter, there are occasional instances where certain customers receive table service. However, this seems to be completely random. Additionally, the coffee and bottled beverages are self-serve and of poor quality. It doesn't help that there are no shades on the front window, which means you're exposed to the harsh sun for a long time.

When the food finally arrives, it's passable. However, my pulled pork Texas wrap had an excessive amount of gristle, which was disappointing. On a positive note, the cornbread pancakes were enjoyable.

One of the most frustrating aspects is the payment process. Instead of paying when you order, you have to wait until afterward. This prolongs any interaction with the awkward staff on Saturday mornings that I try to avoid.

I made the mistake of bringing my out-of-town brother here for brunch and I deeply regret it. While the food may have some taste, the overall ambiance is that of a dive. If you're expecting a pleasant and traditional breakfast service with attentive waiters and coffee refills, this is not the place to go. However, it is relatively cheap, so I suppose you get what you pay for.

input: Great classic Greek diner. The Greek omelette with feta, gyro meat, tomato and spinach was super. Classic griddle home fries and outstanding service. We will seek it out when we return to the area.

In the end, all eight of us had a wonderful experience with no complaints. It was truly a great time enjoyed by everyone.

input: The bayou burger is literally the best burger I've ever had. Great staff also -definitely a big thumbs up.
Revise this with your best effort: Without a doubt, the bayou burger surpasses all others I have ever tasted. The flavors burst in harmony, leaving an indelible mark on my palate. Additionally, the staff’s exceptional service cannot go unnoticed; they deserve a resounding applause.

input:
This review is for a corporate event in a private dining room with a limited food menu & bar. 

I was blown away! One of the best meals I've ever had and service was flawless, expert, courteous, and never intrusive. Passed hors d'ouevres were creative and tasty. Lobster consommé was delicious and filet was PERFECTLY cooked & seasoned, melted in my mouth, and a generous portion. And that view is just stunning! Actually a better view from our private room than the main dining room, where I've been for a happy hour event (which was less perfect since the space was very overbooked resulting in slow service). Highly recommend for an event and may be back here for a special occasion dinner.
Revise this with your best effort:
I was absolutely astounded! This corporate event held in a private dining room with a limited food menu and bar surpassed all expectations. The meal was truly exceptional, ranking among the finest I have ever experienced. Moreover, the service was flawless, conducted with absolute expertise, courtesy, and subtlety.

The hors d'oeuvres served were both creatively crafted and scrumptious. The lobster consommé was nothing short of delightful, while the filet was flawlessly cooked and seasoned. It practically melted in my mouth, and the portion size was more than generous. Additionally, the breathtaking view from our private room surpassed even that of the main dining area, where I had previously attended a happy hour event that suffered from overcrowding issues and consequently, sluggish service.

I highly recommend this venue for hosting an event, and I am genuinely considering returning for a special occasion dinner. The overall experience was truly commendable.

input: The pizza was the best we've had in the Fairmount/Art Museum/Brewerytown area and we've probably tried 5 or so.  The pepperoni was a little crispy (good thing) and the wings were, too.  That last one is really surprising since there are so many soggy wings out there.  Lazos does it right.  They gave me Sprite instead of Coke but otherwise this was a very good pizza+wing combo.  Will order again!
Revise this with your best effort: We were pleasantly surprised by the pizza at Lazos, undoubtedly the best we have tried in the Fairmount/Art Museum/Brewerytown vicinity. Despite having sampled around five different places, Lazos stood out. The pepperoni had a delightful crispness, adding an enjoyable texture to each bite, and even the wings amazed us with their crispy exterior. It's a rarity to find properly cooked wings considering the abundance of soggy ones flooding the market. Lazos definitely gets it right. The only minor flaw was the substitution of Sprite instead of Coke, but aside from that, the pizza and wing combo was truly fantastic. Without a doubt, we will be placing another order soon!

input: Old school decor - dark woods and copper tile ceiling (real?)  I was there for the express lunch, a good deal.  You get a choice of soup with the entree of the day.  The gumbo and crab bisque were spot on. Gumbo - rich with the andouille sausage adding just a bit of heat. Crab bisque - flavored with old bay style seasoning but not overly salty and just a bit of shredded crab. The entree was a garganelli with roast pork ragu, mushrooms and creole tomatoes.  The sauce was light and blended the flavors well.  The roast pork highlighted the dish - fork tender, caramelized and left me wanting more.
Revise this with your best effort:
The restaurant's old school decor, characterized by the elegant combination of dark woods and a potentially genuine copper tile ceiling, set the stage for my visit. Opting for their enticing express lunch, which offered a great deal, I was delighted to have the opportunity to choose a soup alongside the daily entree.

The gumbo and crab bisque, both exceptional in their own right, were truly remarkable. The gumbo possessed a rich, flavorful base, enhanced by the tantalizing addition of andouille sausage that added just the right amount of heat. Meanwhile, the crab bisque seduced my taste buds with its subtle use of old bay style seasoning, expertly avoiding excessive saltiness, and providing delicate shreds of crab for added depth.

As for the entree, I savored a dish of garganelli accompanied by a delectable roast pork ragu, mushrooms, and creole tomatoes. The sauce, skillfully crafted, possessed a lightness that effortlessly brought together the various flavors. The star of the dish was undoubtedly the roast pork, which flaunted tender perfection, a caramelized exterior, and left me yearning for yet another indulgent bite.

input: great hotel in a very good location. The staff was really friendly, and helped us out a lot. it's a 1-2 minute walk to the bars on Bourbon, 7-8 min walk to Harra's, 10 min walk to Jackson Square. The only downside is parking is $38 a night.
Revise this with your best effort: This fantastic hotel is perfectly situated in an excellent location. The staff went above and beyond in their friendly and helpful service, making our stay truly enjoyable. Its prime position allows for a mere 1-2 minute stroll to the bustling bars on Bourbon Street, a convenient 7-8 minute walk to Harra's, and a pleasant 10-minute walk to the iconic Jackson Square. However, it is worth noting that the only drawback is the $38 per night charge for parking.

input:
Really liked this store yesterday. Great selection, I was impressed by Chloe and Marc Jacobs items and Chanel pumps for $87 (too small for me=(
I found their price range great (now they have summer sales on) but in general you get great value for money. I am not looking for $20-30 T Shirts, I am ready to pay $100 for a silky blouse (which can retail for $300+) so I guess this will be my go-to store. 
And! the lady at the store was super friendly and nice.
Revise this with your best effort: I thoroughly enjoyed my visit to this store yesterday. The wide variety of items, particularly the Chloe and Marc Jacobs products and the Chanel pumps priced at $87 (unfortunately too small for me), left me quite impressed. Moreover, the store's current summer sales have made their pricing even more appealing. In general, I find the price range to be excellent, as I am willing to spend $100 on a luxurious blouse that would typically retail for $300 or more. This store has certainly earned its place as my preferred shopping destination. Additionally, I must commend the exceptional customer service provided by the friendly and amiable lady working at the store.

input:
I was here a few times because my friends won free happy hours. When I won one, I sent in my guest list and tried to call them a few times to confirm. Neither of the people who answered the phone were friendly or helpful, and I never did get in touch with the woman in charge of happy hours. She never returned my emails or phone calls. When I showed up with my friends, they didn't have my name on the list and forgot that they even offered me a happy hour. It was irritating, and after some fighting, they eventually let me through.

There is a dress code (no sneakers, flip flops, hats, etc.), but I don't really mind. The bouncers and bartenders aren't very friendly and can be slow, and I never tried the food. The crowd isn't great either - attractive and douchey (maybe because, like us, they're just trying to get drunk and go somewhere else). 

Free booze is always good, but I wouldn't come here for any other reason.
Revise this with your best effort:
I have visited this place on a few occasions when my friends managed to win free happy hours. On one occasion, when I won, I promptly submitted my guest list and made several attempts to confirm the details by giving them a call. Unfortunately, the individuals who answered the phone were neither friendly nor helpful, and despite my efforts, I was unable to get in touch with the person in charge of happy hours. My emails and phone calls were left unanswered. To my dissatisfaction, when I arrived with my friends, my name was not on the guest list, and they seemed to have completely forgotten about offering me a happy hour. After some argument, they eventually allowed me entry.

There is a dress code in place, prohibiting sneakers, flip flops, hats, and such, but I personally have no issue with that. However, it is worth noting that the bouncers and bartenders lack friendliness and can be quite slow in their service. I cannot comment on the quality of the food as I never had the opportunity to try it. Moreover, the crowd that frequents this establishment is not particularly appealing with their focus on looking attractive and displaying an air of arrogance, perhaps because, like us, they are solely interested in getting intoxicated and moving on to another location.

Undoubtedly, receiving complimentary drinks is always a positive aspect, but I would not consider coming to this place for any other reason.

input:
I don't know this for sure, but my first impression of this place is that it is run by unscrupulous people. Come along with me, as I journey back in time -- all the way back to Wednesday...

I step foot in this 7 Eleven, and the first thing I think is: this is one of the nicest looking 7 Elevens I've ever seen. It is very clean, bright, and spacious. Very nice looking selection of prepared meals. There were many that actually looked like they'd be quite good. But I wasn't hungry this day. No. All I needed were a few items. 

First, some good old TP. And let me be perfectly clear (as clear as Barack Obama): I DON'T buy the cheapest toilet paper because I'm cheap. I buy it because I like the way the cheap stuff feels. The more like sandpaper, the better. I like to feel like its working. I don't need to or even want to feel like an angel is up there. Or some perverted freak named Scott. 

In any case, I got myself 4 rolls. And then I just needed one more thing - some plastic cups for a little party I'm having this weekend. 

I go ahead and drop my stash on the counter, begin to extract several singles from my wallet, when the cashier looks at me and says, "24.99."

I respond, "That's not right."

He points at a price tag on the plastic cups which reads 19.99. I begin laughing. I tell him the price is clearly wrong. He tells me he's got to talk to his manager. Meanwhile, I tell the folks behind me waiting in line that I'm just going to go run and get different plastic cups to hurry the process along. Before he got back from doing his price check, I already had another cashier ringing up my two sleeves of cups for 1.99 each. That's more like it.

At around that same moment, the first cashier comes back from his consultation with his manager. He tells me that the price was, in fact, incorrect. And that the price is actually 14.99.

THAT'S the unscrupulous part.

CLEARLY, THAT price is also far too high. His manager did no actual price check at all. He simply told the cashier to pretend that the real price was actually 5 dollars less, thinking that I'd be stupid enough to accept this. Why, because I'm white, and you're a racially superior Indian? You think white people are stupid don't you? We'll just believe what you tell us, and fork over our money.
Revise this with your best effort:
While I cannot guarantee the accuracy of my impression, upon entering this 7 Eleven, I couldn't help but speculate that the individuals overseeing its operations may lack integrity. Join me as we embark on a journey back in time, all the way to Wednesday...

As I step through the doors of this establishment, my initial observation is that it is undeniably one of the most aesthetically pleasing 7 Elevens I have ever encountered. The cleanliness, brightness, and spaciousness definitely catch my attention. The assortment of prepared meals is also visually appealing, with several options that appear to be quite appetizing. However, on this particular day, I did not find myself hungry. My intentions were solely to purchase a few essential items.

First on my list was the ever-practical toilet paper. Allow me to clarify, much like former President Barack Obama, that my choice in purchasing the more economical option is not due to my frugality but rather a personal preference for the coarser texture. The roughness reminiscent of sandpaper provides a delightful sense of effectiveness. I don't seek the comforting sensation of angelic caresses or the peculiar notion of an individual named Scott being involved.

In any case, I acquired four rolls of this indispensable commodity. Additionally, I required plastic cups for an upcoming gathering over the weekend.

As I place my selected merchandise on the counter and begin extracting several dollar bills from my wallet, the cashier unexpectedly utters, "That will be $24.99."

Perplexed, I respond, "That doesn't seem right."

He proceeds to point out a price tag affixed to the plastic cups, which clearly indicates a price of $19.99. In this rather amusing situation, I take a moment to laugh and inform him that the price is clearly incorrect. Promptly, he seeks consultation with his manager. Meanwhile, to expedite the process, I inform the people waiting behind me that I will swiftly retrieve an alternative set of plastic cups. Even before his return from the price verification task, I find myself being served by another cashier who efficiently scans my two sleeves of cups, charging a mere $1.99 each. Now, that seems more reasonable.

Ironically, at that very moment, the initial cashier returns from his conversation with the manager. He admits that the price was, indeed, erroneous and should have been $14.99.

Here lies the unscrupulous aspect of this encounter.

Evidently, this price is still unreasonably high. The manager failed to conduct a proper price check and instead instructed the cashier to pretend that the actual price was $5 less, assuming I would be naïve enough to accept it. Is it due to my race, with me being white and the cashier presuming himself racially superior as an Indian? Does he assume that white individuals are intellectually inferior, readily believing whatever is told to them and willingly surrendering their money?

input: Worst nail salon experience ever. The guy said "what is wrong with you" to a customer who accidentally chipped her nail. When I was explaining how I wanted my nails filed he told me to do it myself. Really bad job. Everyone was rude and does the job too quickly. You would think after having such bad reviews they would learn..
Revise this with your best effort: My most terrible nail salon experience was beyond horrific. To my utter disbelief, a customer who had accidentally chipped her nail was met with a disdainful remark from one of the staff, who callously uttered, "What is wrong with you?" Astonishingly, it did not end there. When I attempted to explain how I desired my nails to be filed, I was abruptly told to do it myself. The atrocious quality of their work was evident, leaving me utterly dissatisfied. The entire staff displayed an alarming level of rudeness, and their propensity for rushing through each job was truly unsettling. One would assume that after receiving countless negative reviews, they would have taken the opportunity to improve their services.

input:
Calories and diabetes be damned - fewer things could be better than gelati on days as brutally hot as the ones we've had this week.  Thanks for helping to cool us all down w your frozen treats.  Five stars for you.

PS - visit the website for a little Vanilla Ice.
Revise this with your best effort:
Despite the concerns about calories and their impact on diabetes, gelati proves to be an irresistible delight on scorching days like the ones we've experienced this week. We truly appreciate how your frozen treats have been a savior, providing much-needed relief from the sweltering heat. Your exceptional service deserves nothing less than a perfect five-star rating.

P.S. Don't forget to visit the website for a taste of Vanilla Ice – a little something extra to enhance your gelati experience.

input:
All you can drink brunch? Yes please!

Sat and Sun they got brunch item and unlimited bloody marys or mimosas for $20. Perfect for some Sunday Funday. Enjoy!
Revise this with your best effort:
Would you like an all-you-can-drink brunch? Absolutely!

On Saturdays and Sundays, they offer a delightful brunch menu accompanied by unlimited servings of either bloody marys or mimosas, all for just $20. It's the ideal way to indulge in a splendid Sunday Funday. Go ahead, relax and savor the experience!

input: Good Chinese food and really nice beer selection.  Haven't tried the sushi yet, so I can't speak to that.  True, the staff isn't exactly the most cordial, but they're plenty nice enough for Chinese food take out.  This is not an expensive or fancy restaurant, so you should go in with reasonable expectations.
Revise this with your best effort: The restaurant offers excellent Chinese food alongside an impressive variety of beers. Although I haven't had the opportunity to try the sushi, I cannot provide any feedback on that. While the staff may lack some cordiality, they are still sufficiently friendly, particularly considering it is a Chinese takeout establishment. It's important to set reasonable expectations since this is not a high-end or pricey restaurant.

input:
The most amazing thing happened today.  I walked into Andres Richard Salon on Locust St for my appointment with Stephanie, a junior stylist at Andres.  We talked, I showed her pictures and the magic began.  I came in for a balayage, a fix from my existing washed out, brassy ombre.  Stephanie was so sweet, attentive and definitely catered to my request.  Hours later, my hair is exactly what I wanted!  I spent most of 2015 crying out of Salon after Salon.  This is will be the only person that will ever touch my hair again.
If you're looking for technical, creative, and expert hair care, you'll find it at Andres Richard.
Revise this with your best effort:
Today, I experienced something truly extraordinary. As I entered the doors of Andres Richard Salon on Locust St, I was filled with anticipation for my appointment with Stephanie, a talented junior stylist at the salon. The moment we started conversing, it was evident that Stephanie possessed a genuine passion for her craft.

I shared my vision with Stephanie, displaying carefully chosen pictures that reflected the transformation I desired. The enchantment began as Stephanie seamlessly began the process of rescuing my balayage, rescuing it from its previously washed-out, brassy state. Throughout the entire appointment, Stephanie's sweet demeanor and unwavering attention to detail made me feel cherished and attended to.

Several hours later, as I glanced in the mirror, I was greeted with a sight that exceeded my wildest expectations. My hair had been transformed into the exact masterpiece I had envisioned. It was a moment that contrasted sharply with the countless times in 2015 when tears streamed down my face as I left salon after salon, dissatisfied with the results.

From this day forward, Stephanie will be the only person I trust to touch my glorious locks. If you seek an establishment that embodies technical excellence, boundless creativity, and unparalleled expertise in hair care, look no further than Andres Richard Salon.

input:
I like it. The atmosphere is festive and there is a nice variety of music in Spanish. Service is attentive and they got my picky order straight.

It was a boring salad made with iceberg lettuce that could easily be improved by using romaine or something darker. My more culinary friend ordered the chicken soup and swears it is one of the best he has tasted. And this guy knows food. He is the type of person that has a hog slaughtered and knows what to do with the meat.

So it's a great place to go for chicken soup, and I heard the queso fundido is pretty darn good as well. Although it was recommended you order just the queso, and if you want chorizo, ask for it on the side because otherwise it gets a little greasy.
Revise this with your best effort:
I thoroughly enjoyed my experience at this establishment. The ambiance exuded a vibrant and festive atmosphere, complemented beautifully by the diverse selection of Spanish music. The staff was attentive and went above and beyond to ensure that my particular and meticulous order was executed flawlessly.

While I must confess that the salad I ordered left something to be desired, utilizing romaine or a darker lettuce variety, such as spinach, would undoubtedly elevate its appeal. On the other hand, my more culinary-inclined companion opted for the chicken soup, which he raved about incessantly. According to his discerning palate, it ranks among the best he has ever had. It is worth noting that this friend possesses an unparalleled knowledge of food and even possesses the skill to masterfully prepare a hog, if need be.

For chicken soup enthusiasts, this establishment is undoubtedly a haven. I have also heard whispers of the delectable queso fundido, which comes highly recommended. Nevertheless, it is advised to order the queso alone and, if a craving for chorizo strikes, requesting it on the side would be the wiser choice, as it can become a tad greasy if combined.

input: I went in when they had 4 people working, waited for 15 minutes for my tea latte which came out as basically water. Returned it twice but gave up when the barista offered some other iced tea latte they already had instead. It was still the same - water. The baristas should REALLY REALLY learn how to make their stuff... seriously Starbucks??!!! So disappointed!!!!! :'(
Revise this with your best effort: I entered the Starbucks location when they had a full staff of four individuals working. After patiently waiting for a duration of 15 minutes, I received my order of a tea latte, only to find that it closely resembled water in terms of consistency. In an attempt to rectify this issue, I returned the beverage not once, but twice. Frustration set in when the barista suggested substituting the tea latte with an alternative iced tea latte they had available, which unfortunately suffered from the same watered-down quality. It is quite disheartening that the baristas at Starbucks have yet to master the art of creating their beverages. This experience left me feeling exceedingly disappointed with their level of quality and craftsmanship.

input: We recently moved from Brooklyn, NY and have been in search of some really good pizza...and here it is! We were so happy to bite into a thin crispy crust! It was awesome, the service was amazing and we couldn't be more pleased. I highly recommend this place if you love great pizza and excellent customer service! They will surely get our business again and again.
Revise this with your best effort: After our recent move from Brooklyn, NY, we embarked on a quest to find exceptional pizza, and lo and behold, we have finally discovered it! Our hearts were filled with joy as we sunk our teeth into a thin, crispy crust that exceeded all our expectations. The experience was simply breathtaking, accompanied by impeccable service that left us nothing short of thrilled. If you are a pizza enthusiast seeking the perfect slice coupled with excellent customer service, this is the place for you. Without hesitation, we wholeheartedly recommend this establishment, and without a doubt, they will consistently earn our patronage.

input: This place might surpass me going to halal guys.Came in at 9:50, they close at 10; felt bad but this guy Jules was friendly throughout the whole ordeal, explained what I didn't know on the menu. Ordered the steak shwarma with rice with all the sauces. He even gave a sample of the Baba ganoush which was pretty good. The food however was.....ABSOLUTELY delicious!!! This had that healthy feel to it and was filling. Definitely coming back
Revise this with your best effort: I was truly impressed by this place, it may even surpass my visit to Halal Guys. I arrived at 9:50, just ten minutes before their closing time of 10. Despite feeling a bit guilty for coming in so late, I was pleasantly surprised by the friendliness of a guy named Jules, who assisted me throughout the entire experience. He took the time to patiently explain items on the menu that I was unfamiliar with. Eventually, I decided to order the steak shwarma with rice, accompanied by all the sauces they offered. To my delight, Jules even offered me a sample of their flavorful Baba ganoush, which I found quite tasty. Now, let's talk about the food itself... It was absolutely delicious! The meal had a distinct healthy touch to it, leaving me completely satisfied and fulfilled. Needless to say, I am already making plans to return to this remarkable place.

input: I loved the atmosphere here. It was quiet, but not too quiet. The waiters and waitresses made casual conversation, but still checked to see that the customers were satisfied. It's a small place, but there seems to be plenty of room. Everyone that worked there was friendly and happy to help. The food was also delicious. I had the Crabby Wife, which I'd definitely recommend (with fried eggs) while my boyfriend had the chicken & waffles (get it with hot-sauce, syrup, and the sauce they provide you - it was fantastic!). Overall, it was great.
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adored the ambience in this place. It possessed an alluring tranquility, striking a perfect balance between peaceful and vibrant. The attentive waitstaff engaged in casual conversations, imparting a sense of warmth while efficiently ensuring the customers' contentment. Despite its cozy size, the establishment exuded a spaciousness that comfortably accommodated everyone. The entire staff was exceptionally affable and readily available to offer assistance. As for the cuisine, it was nothing short of delectable. I indulged in the sensational Crabby Wife, a dish I wholeheartedly endorse, especially when relished with crispy fried eggs. Meanwhile, my boyfriend sampled the mouthwatering chicken & waffles, which reached extraordinary heights when paired with the tangy hot-sauce, delectable syrup, and the accompanying sauce - it was an absolute delight! All in all, this experience was undeniably impeccable and exceeded all expectations.

input: This place deserves a special mention.. it's not really on the heart of the city (for tourists), but it's definitely a place you should mark down for one brunch at least...shrimp n grits are hands down the best we've had in the city....the juices were fresh... and for a person who has a hard time eating Omelettes, Surrey's has converted me for sure.. the lump crab omelette with the sauce was just the cure for a dull grey rainy morning...! Word of caution-the place is always full, so make sure you get there at least 30 mins before you really want to eat, just to make sure you don't starve over the delish smells that keep on wafting out
Revise this with your best effort: This place deserves a special mention. While it may not be located in the heart of the city, it is certainly worth a visit, especially for brunch. The shrimp n grits here are undeniably the best we have come across in the entire city. The juices served are wonderfully fresh and refreshing. As someone who typically struggles to enjoy omelettes, Surrey's has managed to convert me without a doubt. Their lump crab omelette, accompanied by a delectable sauce, was the perfect remedy for a dreary and rainy morning. However, it is important to note that this place tends to be consistently busy. To avoid starving while being tantalized by the enticing aromas wafting out, it is highly recommended to arrive at least 30 minutes before you intend to eat.

input: I do like this store. Its large and clean and they seem to have a large selection of everything. But I just returned from there and have the say the customer service is lacking. I took my french bulldog in to try on some sweaters. Just to be sure I asked if it was ok to actually try stuff on and they said yes. I began looking through the selection and trying stuff on. She is very hard to fit b/c she is short and stocky with a big head. So there I was 27 weeks pregnant with my dog, a purse and a carry cart trying to get her in and out of clothes. I was the only person in the store, while 4 people were behind the counter (and I was in plain view of them). At some point one of the cats in the store (free roaming) swatted my dog on the nose and she got away from me for a quick second. Still no one came to help. I imagine if I had asked for help someone would have appeased me but I don't think I should have had to ask in the first place. I left without buying any of the many things on my list. Very disappointed with today's visit. I expected better service and maybe that was my fault. I doubt I will be going back.
Revise this with your best effort:
I really enjoy this store as it has a large and clean environment with a wide variety of products to choose from. However, my recent experience with their customer service was quite disappointing. I brought my French bulldog in to try on some sweaters, and before doing so, I made sure to ask if it was acceptable. The staff assured me that it was allowed. As I began searching through the selection and attempting to dress my dog, I realized that finding the right fit for her was challenging due to her unique body shape. Being 27 weeks pregnant, I had to manage my dog, my purse, and a carry cart simultaneously. Surprisingly, despite the store being empty with four employees visible behind the counter, nobody offered to assist me.

To make matters worse, one of the cats (which freely roamed inside the store) swatted my dog on the nose, causing her to briefly escape my grasp. Even then, none of the staff members intervened or came to my aid. While I believe that if I had specifically asked for help, they would have reluctantly obliged, I firmly believe that I shouldn't have had to ask in the first place. Consequently, I left the store without purchasing any of the items on my extensive shopping list. Today's visit left me immensely disappointed. I had expected better service, although I acknowledge that perhaps my expectations were partially to blame. Regardless, it is unlikely that I will return to this store in the future.

input: Hands down great guys, we have relocated to the area and have older cars. With that age comes quirks, I great appreciate their honesty, hard work and communication of the situation at hand.  Attention to detail is never messed and I highly recommend this shop for any service needs.
Revise this with your best effort: Without a doubt, these guys are truly exceptional. Recently, my family and I moved to the area and we own older vehicles. Naturally, older cars tend to have their own unique quirks. However, I am incredibly grateful for their genuine honesty, unwavering dedication, and effective communication regarding any issues that arise. Their meticulous attention to detail is unmatched, and I wholeheartedly endorse this shop for any service requirements.

input: This place was nice, clean, and bright. It's your typical serve-yourself fro yo bar with several choices for frozen yogurt and a topping station. The cashier was very (berry?) nice and let me pay via credit card even though I was a few cents short of the minimum. I'd say my son enjoyed his time here.
Revise this with your best effort: This place exuded an inviting atmosphere of cleanliness and vibrant brightness. It perfectly embodied the essence of a serve-yourself frozen yogurt bar, offering a plethora of choices for delectable frozen yogurt flavors and an enticing topping station. The cashier, brimming with kindness as sweet as berries, pleasantly surprised me by allowing me to pay with a credit card despite being a few cents shy of the minimum requirement. Without a doubt, my son had a truly delightful experience here.

input: We stopped by a couple of weeks ago for Sunday brunch.  The food was very good and filling.  Nice drinks, and we had a very pleasant server.  Cool cafe space.  Overall a good recommend.
Revise this with your best effort: A few weeks ago, we decided to drop by for Sunday brunch and were pleasantly surprised. The food exceeded our expectations both in terms of taste and portion sizes. Not to mention, their selection of drinks added an extra touch to our dining experience. Our server was not only attentive but also exceptionally pleasant throughout our visit. The café itself exuded a cool and inviting atmosphere that made our time there all the more enjoyable. All in all, we highly recommend this place as it left us with a thoroughly positive impression.

input: First visit tonight. Nice, clean place. Reasonably priced. Friendly staff. Excellent presentation of extremely bland, mediocre food. I ordered the chicken fajitas. Onions and pepper base (warm) on a tepid fajita platter. Meat, room temperature. Pico, cheese, sour cream, tortillas were nothing special. I was underwhelmed. I don't think I'll be back.
Revise this with your best effort: During my first visit tonight, I was pleased to find a nice and clean establishment with friendly staff and reasonable prices. However, I must admit that I was disappointed by the overall presentation and taste of the food, which fell short of my expectations. Specifically, I ordered the chicken fajitas and found the onions and peppers to be lukewarm on a tepid fajita platter, while the meat itself was served at room temperature. The accompanying elements such as pico de gallo, cheese, sour cream, and tortillas were rather ordinary and lacking in any standout qualities. As a result, I left feeling underwhelmed by the dining experience and have reservations about returning in the future.

input:
This is my favorite place to enjoy gelato in St. Louis. 

Consider the... 

Coffee house-like atmosphere. 
Large outdoor patio with a fountain and surrounding foliage. 
Delicious gelato and baked goods. 

Yes, everything at Gelateria is pleasing.
Revise this with your best effort: Gelateria in St. Louis is undoubtedly my go-to spot when it comes to indulging in gelato. Its coffee house-like atmosphere adds a touch of cozy charm and enhances the overall experience. Moreover, the presence of a spacious outdoor patio adorned with a captivating fountain and lush greenery creates a tranquil ambiance, perfect for relaxation and savoring every bite of the delectable gelato. Speaking of which, Gelateria never fails to impress with their mouthwatering gelato flavors and divine baked goods. It's a true haven for dessert lovers. Without a doubt, Gelateria encompasses everything that one could desire for a truly pleasing and satisfying gelato experience.

input: A friend of mine took me to this little jewel near Dale Mabry and it was a great time. Its a small place with under 12 tables and a sushi bar. The bar seems to be the place to sit for the entertainment value. The sushi chefs (and owner) are pretty chatty and always say hi to everyone that comes in. It has a very friendly feel. We ended up at a table because the bar was full. I had pretty average fare in a spicy tuna roll and a rainbow roll, a couple pieces of yellow tail, and 2 pieces of Wahoo. It was all done very well! Super fresh and tasty. The sticky rice wasnt all that sticky and I ended up with a bowl fill of soy sauce and rice by the end of it, but that Wahoo...whoa....that Wahoo!! Just try it and you wont be disappointed. I spent about $30 for dinner which was a fine price for what I got and I will certainly be back for more!
Revise this with your best effort:
My friend introduced me to this delightful hidden gem near Dale Mabry, and it turned out to be an amazing experience. This cozy establishment boasts a modest size, with fewer than 12 tables and a sushi bar. The bar stands out as the spot to sit for some entertaining interactions. The sushi chefs, who also happen to be the owners, are incredibly friendly and greet every customer with a warm welcome. There is a genuine sense of camaraderie in the air.

Although the bar was full, my friend and I managed to snag a table, and I must say, I was thoroughly satisfied with my meals. I ordered a spicy tuna roll and a rainbow roll, which proved to be quite average in taste. Additionally, I enjoyed a few pieces of yellowtail and two pieces of Wahoo, both prepared to perfection. The sushi was undeniably fresh and bursting with flavor. The only setback was that the sticky rice lacked the desired stickiness, resulting in a bowl full of soy sauce and loose rice by the end of the meal. However, the standout dish was unquestionably the Wahoo. Its taste was beyond words, and I highly recommend giving it a try. It certainly won't disappoint.

For the quality of food and overall experience, the price was more than reasonable, coming in at around $30 for my dinner. I can confidently say that I will be returning to this fantastic establishment for more delightful meals.

input: Cheap food and large selection. Unfortunately, they forgot our order, we waited 15 minutes and they were not even sorry about it. Bad customer service.
Revise this with your best effort: Affordable cuisine with an extensive array of options, marred by an unfortunate oversight in handling our order. Despite waiting for an additional 15 minutes, the lack of any remorse from the staff concerning their mistake reflected a disappointing level of customer service.

input:
For a long, long time, Dallesandro's was my philly cheesesteak haven.  However, since their change in ownership, they've gone steadily downhill.  Chubby's and Mama's tided me over until I could find suitable replacement.  Thanks to Larry's Steaks, I've rekindled my passion for cheesesteaks.

Larry's Steaks, situated by St. Joe's University, offers the closest thing to the original Dallesandro's cheesesteak I've found.  The meat is sliced and minced into tiny little pieces, maximizing surface area.  Then the cheese is melted throughout so it covers most of the steak and ensures a heavenly consistency and flavor.  The onions and mushrooms are up to snuff as well.  It's greasy enough to slide down your throat but not so much that it's a mess to eat.  I can't attest to the other menu items, but that hardly matters.  If you are up for a real philly cheesesteak, skip pat's and geno's (and the whiz, i can't believe people actually eat that stuff) and pick up a Larry's steak.
Revise this with your best effort:
In my search for the ultimate Philly cheesesteak, I had long considered Dallesandro's my haven. However, a change in ownership took them on a steady decline, leaving me in need of a suitable replacement. Thankfully, Chubby's and Mama's temporarily satisfied my cravings, but it wasn't until I discovered Larry's Steaks that I truly rekindled my passion for this delectable classic.

Larry's Steaks, conveniently located by St. Joe's University, offers a cheesesteak experience that comes incredibly close to the original Dallesandro's. The meat is expertly sliced and minced into minuscule pieces, maximizing its surface area for optimal flavor. What sets it apart is the way the cheese is melted throughout, ensuring each bite is coated in a heavenly consistency that perfectly complements the steak. Even the onions and mushrooms hold up to my highest standards. It strikes that delicate balance of being delightfully greasy enough to effortlessly slide down your throat, yet not so excessive that it becomes a messy affair. While I cannot speak for the rest of the menu, it becomes insignificant when it comes to the matter at hand – a genuine Philly cheesesteak experience.

I urge you to overlook the hype surrounding Pat's and Geno's, and especially the questionable appeal of the infamous whiz. Instead, opt for the far superior Larry's steak. Trust me, it's the real deal that will leave you utterly satisfied and craving more.

input:
I concur with the other comments that this place is awful.   The service here was about as bad as I have ever seen.   The food arrived cold and had to be sent back - which of course turned into a big ordeal.  

Until the management here shows some leadership and sets some higher expectations of their service and kitchen staff, I would avoid this place.
Revise this with your best effort:
I share the same sentiment as the other comments regarding the unpleasant experience at this establishment. The level of service received was truly disheartening, representing one of the worst encounters I have witnessed. The food, regrettably, was served cold and necessitated a return, resulting in an unnecessarily complicated situation.

Unless the management steps forward to exhibit true leadership and establishes elevated expectations for both their service and kitchen staff, I highly recommend steering clear of this place.

input: Well I did visit here a Year ago, long before the e.coli / colliform scare, so I have not been back out of concern for my health and safety. Darn shame too as I really did like this place, but I must admit that I still am not confident they have their act in order. My suggestion is they need to cook their meat longer and ensure it reaches optimum 165°F Temp, serve the food very hot temp to ensure bacteria are dead, and only source their greens and veggies from USA only sources. Avoid Mexico as they have big issues with water pollution cross-contamination.
Revise this with your best effort: I visited this place a year ago, before the e.coli / colliform scare, and haven't returned since due to concerns about my health and safety. It's truly a shame because I genuinely enjoyed this place, but I still doubt whether they have addressed the issues. In my opinion, they should consider cooking their meat for a longer duration, ensuring it reaches the optimal temperature of 165°F to eliminate any bacteria. Additionally, serving the food at a very hot temperature would help ensure the eradication of any harmful bacteria. They should also prioritize sourcing their greens and vegetables solely from US-based suppliers, as Mexico has well-known problems with water pollution and cross-contamination.

input:
I can't believe I have to give a star.  Quick rundown.  I ordered:
single with no ketchup, mayo, or mustard with med fried and large unsweetened teas
double with everything lg fries large coke
2 5 piece nuggets
side salad
cheeseburger kids meal plain with oranges and vanilla frosty.
Ok now for what I GOT:
double with bacon, no ketchup mayo or mustard, lg fries, coke
single with everything, lg fries coke
hamburger kids meal with fries and coke
right around the time I said no ketchup a blank look came across the face of the employee.
This is not rocket science.
Revise this with your best effort:
I can't believe I have to give this place a star. Here's a quick rundown of my order:

I specifically requested a single burger with no ketchup, mayo, or mustard, along with medium-sized fries and large unsweetened teas. Additionally, I wanted a double burger with all the toppings, large fries, and a large coke. I also ordered two 5-piece nuggets, a side salad, and a kids' cheeseburger meal, plain, with oranges and a vanilla frosty.

However, what I actually received was a double burger with bacon and no ketchup, mayo or mustard, along with large fries and a coke. The single burger came with everything on it, along with large fries and a coke. Surprisingly, the hamburger kids' meal came with fries and a coke instead of the requested sides. To make matters worse, when I mentioned my preference for no ketchup, the employee had a blank look on their face.

In all honesty, this is not rocket science. The order should have been simple enough to get right.

input: First time checking it out first breakfast as recommended by a friend! Service was quick and friendly. It was a busy Saturday morning but we got seated right away. I loved the veggie omelette with fruit and rye toast. Overall good selection to fit anyone's tastes. Reasonable prices for the amount of food. Will be back again!
Revise this with your best effort: I had the pleasure of trying out this breakfast spot for the first time based on a friend's recommendation, and it certainly did not disappoint! The service was not only efficient, but also very friendly. Despite it being a bustling Saturday morning, we were seated promptly, which was a great start to the experience. I opted for the veggie omelette with a side of fresh fruit and rye toast, and I must say, it was absolutely delightful. The combination of flavors was perfect, and it catered to my preferences perfectly. Moreover, their menu offers a wide variety of options, ensuring that there is something for everyone's palate. The prices were reasonable considering the generous portions of food that were provided. Needless to say, I will definitely be returning to this place again in the future!

input: Wells Fargo is a great atmosphere for all ages. Flyers host a great game every time I got no matter where you sit. I would recommend everyone to a game even if you don't like hockey!!
Revise this with your best effort: Wells Fargo offers an exceptional atmosphere that caters to people of all ages. Every time I visit, the Flyers host an incredible game that never disappoints, regardless of where you choose to sit. I highly recommend attending a game, even if you're not particularly fond of hockey.

input: Place for latest night eats around and drive through is a must. New menu items and some veggie options etc. forgot to put my dessert order in the bag though so I was very bummed when I noticed far too late!
