I hate it, it's a crap shoot on who your going to get to sit next to and basically listen to a complete strangers stupid conversations. Terrible idea.
Revise this with your best effort:
Wow, that burger was absolutely incredible. It was so moist and had a beautiful sheen, with the cheese melting perfectly into each bite. What set it apart from other burger places was the exceptional quality of the ingredients used. However, the bacon, while visually appealing, was disappointingly thick and consisted mostly of pure white fat. Had it melted in my mouth, it would have complemented the burger, but unfortunately, it just felt indulgent in a negative way.

Regrettably, I can't help but express my disdain for the communal table trend. It's a gamble on who you end up sitting next to, and being forced to listen to the conversations of complete strangers can be quite irritating. I believe it's a truly terrible idea.

input:
i've been a member of this gym for a couple of weeks now, and i'm enjoying it.  conveniently located, very reasonably priced, and all the basic amenities -- plenty of cardio machines, plenty of weights, a lap pool, a spin class room, and a big aerobics studio.  the staff are all really nice as well, and you get a free personal trainer session when you sign up.  and your membership fee allows you to use all of their area locations for no extra money.  and if you have kids (i don't), they offer babysitting for limited hours.

the only things i'm a bit bummed about are:  1. they don't open until 8am on the weekends (i'm an early riser and would prefer to go a bit earlier than that), and 2. the only group fitness class they offer before work is a 5:45am spin class (i'm sorry, i just can't do spin that early in the morning).

this isn't the gym for you if you want all sorts of foo-foo stuff like a smoothie bar and massage and lots of high-tech equipment.  but if you just want a place to come and work out with nice people on good equipment, then you'll save some money by joining LA fitness.
Revise this with your best effort:
I have been a member of this gym for a few weeks now, and so far, I am thoroughly enjoying it. The gym is conveniently located and offers reasonable prices, making it a great option. It has all the essential amenities one would need for a well-rounded workout experience - from a wide selection of cardio machines to an ample variety of weights. Additionally, they have a lap pool, a dedicated spin class room, and a spacious aerobics studio.

One aspect that really stands out is the friendly and approachable staff. Upon signing up, you are even entitled to a free personal trainer session, which is a fantastic perk. Another major advantage is that your membership fee grants you access to all their locations at no additional cost. It's an excellent deal for those who value convenience and flexibility.

While the gym meets most of my expectations, there are a couple of downsides that may disappoint some individuals. Firstly, the gym does not open until 8 am on weekends. As an early riser, I would prefer an earlier opening time. Secondly, the only group fitness class available before work is a 5:45 am spin class. Unfortunately, I personally cannot commit to a spin class that early in the morning.

If you are looking for a gym that offers a plethora of luxurious extras such as a smoothie bar, massages, or cutting-edge equipment, this may not be the perfect fit for you. However, if you simply want a friendly environment with decent equipment where you can work out alongside like-minded individuals, joining LA Fitness will undoubtedly save you money.

input: I'm very picky when it comes to Sushi. Quality of the fish and ingredients are very important but so is the chef, maybe the most important. Hiro San is absolutely amazing at what he does. His skills are hands down the best and he's also a really great human being to talk to. If you are in the Santa Barbara area looking for a great Sushi experience come here and sit in front of the master, you won't regret it.
Revise this with your best effort: When it comes to sushi, I have extremely high standards. The quality of the fish and ingredients holds utmost significance, but equally important is the skill and expertise of the chef, perhaps even more so. That's where Hiro San comes in - he is undeniably astonishing at his craft. His talent is unrivaled, and on top of that, he is incredibly personable and enjoyable to converse with. If you happen to be in the Santa Barbara area and crave an exceptional sushi experience, I highly recommend visiting Hiro's establishment and sitting in front of the master himself. Trust me, you won't be disappointed.

input: This theater is dated but you can't beat the cheap prices.  Staff is always very friendly and that alone keeps me dividing my time between here and the Loft.  It is never even close to being crowded and you can always see any of the major movies on top of lots of Indie films they show here and hardly anywhere else.  I would much rather wait out a movie til it comes here.
Revise this with your best effort: Despite its outdated appearance, the affordability of this theater is unbeatable. The consistently friendly staff alone makes it worth my time, causing me to divide my visits between here and the Loft. Remarkably, it is never crowded, allowing for a hassle-free movie experience. In addition to popular blockbusters, they also showcase a vast selection of Indie films rarely found elsewhere. Personally, I would rather patiently wait for the movies to arrive at this theater.

input: Fun place, inviting interior and a pleasure to hang outside with the couches, etc. brunch food was very good, and beer selection exceptional.  Waiter, however, was a disaster.  Was jerky to us from the beginning, (we were all sitting around asking each other why he was being such a jerk to us), did not know the menu at all, constantly disappeared on us, and was argumentative when he brought out the wrong order (twice)...and there were only 2 other tables at the time). Otherwise, would have gotten 4 stars.
Revise this with your best effort: This venue is a delightfully fun place with an inviting interior and an enjoyable outdoor area adorned with comfortable couches, making it a wonderful spot to hang out. The brunch food served here is exceptionally delicious, and the beer selection is truly outstanding. Unfortunately, our experience was significantly marred by the disastrous service provided by our waiter. Right from the start, he displayed an inexplicably rude demeanor towards us, leaving our group perplexed and questioning his unwarranted behavior. Not only was his grasp of the menu severely lacking, but he also frequently disappeared, leaving us unattended. Moreover, he proved to be argumentative when he served us the wrong orders on two occasions, despite the fact that there were only two other occupied tables at that time. If it hadn't been for this unfortunate service, this place would have easily garnered a four-star rating.

input: Great restaurant, and creative menu. We also love La Mulita next door, which shares the same kitchen. The only downside is that they do not take reservations, so it can be a bit of a gamble on a weekend. You also need your whole party to sit, so if you have a late friend, you could be stuck for a bit.
Revise this with your best effort: This establishment boasts a phenomenal restaurant experience, accompanied by an exceptionally innovative menu. Additionally, we hold high regard for our neighboring eatery, La Mulita, which conveniently shares the same kitchen. However, one slight drawback is the absence of a reservation system, thereby introducing an element of uncertainty especially during weekends. Furthermore, it is imperative for the entire party to be present in order to secure seating, which may lead to a temporary inconvenience should a member of your group arrive late.

input: For Cool Springs on a Thursday when Bonefish grill was packed this place had a comfortable wait of 15 minutes. Also the food is always amazing, but that's a given
Revise this with your best effort: On a bustling Thursday at Cool Springs, while Bonefish Grill was overflowing with patrons, this place pleasantly offered a comfortable wait of just 15 minutes. Moreover, it is worth mentioning that the food at this establishment consistently surpasses expectations, though one could argue that such excellence is to be expected.

input:
Yum-O! We spend the day in Tarpon Springs, and headed here around 3:45 for lunch / dinner. We waited for about 10 minutes for our table and were seated. 

This restaurant has a TON of staff and they are always running around. Our waiter was nice and quick.

We ordred:
Gyro - yum
Chicken Slouvaki - yum
Spanokopita - YES (this is what I ordered, good, but the top filo dough crust was a bit harder than I like)
Hotdog (this is what the 5 year old got)

We also got an order of the cheese, opa!

Yes, this will be our go to spot when we visit Tarpon Springs.
Revise this with your best effort:
Delicious! Our day in Tarpon Springs led us to this fantastic restaurant around 3:45 for a delightful lunch/dinner. After a brief 10-minute wait, we were promptly seated.

The restaurant boasts a multitude of staff members who are constantly hustling. Our waiter was not only friendly but also efficient.

For our order, we indulged in the mouthwatering Gyro, which was absolutely delightful. The Chicken Slouvaki was equally satisfying. I opted for the Spanokopita, which was good, although the top filo dough crust was slightly firmer than my preference. The little one enjoyed a Hotdog, as kids often do.

To enhance our meal experience, we couldn't resist ordering the savory cheese, opa!

Without a doubt, this will be our go-to eatery whenever we return to Tarpon Springs.

input: Simply put, the Grypon Cafe makes me feel infinite.  It's about two minutes away from the Wayne Starbucks, but believe me when I say that all the cool informed coffee connoisseurs flock to Gryphon Cafe.  Its setting is quiet and intimate.It exudes a chill and serene vibe, from its very dim lighting and small (in a good way!) space.  The lattes are very good- made with strong espresso.  In addition, it provides various baked goods, although I've had a really dry, stale brownie from there (A big no-no! As a result, I don't care too much for the baked goods).  In addition, Gryphon supports a lively local music scene; music begins at 9 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
Revise this with your best effort: The Gryphon Cafe, in simple terms, brings about a feeling of infiniteness within me. Despite being merely two minutes away from the Wayne Starbucks, I assure you that all the cool and well-informed coffee enthusiasts gravitate towards the Gryphon Cafe. Its ambiance is tranquil and intimate, radiating a cool and serene atmosphere through its dim lighting and cozy space. Their lattes are exceptionally delightful, crafted using robust espresso. Moreover, the cafe offers an assortment of baked goods, although I must confess, I once encountered a disappointingly dry and stale brownie (a definite letdown that deterred me from indulging in their baked treats). However, what sets the Gryphon Cafe apart is its unwavering support for the local music scene, with live performances beginning at 9 p.m. every Friday and Saturday, infusing the place with vibrant energy.

input:
Its a rarity that i give five stars for anything. But in comparing this tattoo shop to the others around Indy and how they've jacked me around i decided its simply worth it to give 5. The other places have cancelled on me at the last moment, even when i was en route to go get the tattoo, one guy didnt even remember me when i called the day before to make sure we were on schedule for the tat and yet another had the inks set out and asked me to sit down when he got a call that he needed to go pick up the kids at school - all of these places i scheduled months out in advance as well. So, here we are back at Metamorphosis where they actually like to run a business the way it should be. Honestly i have only had one tat done here by Trevor and at the time it was the most fun 4 hour rib tattoo experience i could have had. They act professional, not like the rock star wanna be's i tried to check out at other places. Just cool chill people who want your business here. Trevor gave me the tattoo i wanted in the place i wanted it even though i feel he would have given me honest advice if it were needed. When it came time to get the tat, he held his appointment and i was treated with respect and as though a customer should be treated. Honestly i dont think this place cost more than any other place where youll get good work. Prices are about average in my opinion for the quality of work done. Dont waste your time going to the other places and getting jerked around - ive already done the work for you. Its a shame too that they may have good artwork at other places but youll feel like less of a human going anywhere else. The artists are just as good here and youll be respected for your $.  And by the way, yes they do ask for a non refundable deposit so they know your serious which is no different than any tattoo place ive ever been to.
Hopefully they dont change up anything, especially their roster as i believe they have a good thing going here. Yes its in hoity toity popular town but its a diamond in the rough and there are no rock star attitudes here. Cant wait to go back to Trevor again.
Revise this with your best effort: It is a rare occurrence for me to give a five-star review, but after comparing this tattoo shop to others in Indy and considering how they have let me down in the past, I have decided that it is truly worth it to award them a perfect rating. Other places have canceled on me at the last minute, even when I was on my way to get the tattoo. One artist didn't even remember me after I called the day before to confirm our appointment. Another had everything set up and asked me to sit down, only to receive a call that he needed to pick up his kids from school. Keep in mind, I had scheduled all of these appointments months in advance. However, I am now back at Metamorphosis where they run their business with professionalism and integrity. I have only had one tattoo done here by Trevor, but it was an enjoyable four-hour experience for my rib tattoo. They have a team of cool, down-to-earth individuals who genuinely value your business. Trevor not only gave me the tattoo exactly as I wanted it, but I also feel that he would have offered honest advice if needed. He kept to our appointment and treated me with respect, the way every customer should be treated. In terms of pricing, I believe they are on par with other reputable tattoo shops. Don't waste your time dealing with the unreliable and unprofessional behavior at other places—I've already done the legwork for you. It's unfortunate that some of these places may have great artwork, but the way they treat their customers will make you feel like less of a person. The artists at Metamorphosis are just as talented, and they will respect you and your investment. Also, just a heads up, they do require a non-refundable deposit to ensure your commitment, which is a common practice among tattoo parlors. Hopefully, they don't make any changes, especially to their roster, as I believe they have found a winning formula here. Despite being located in a trendy and upscale area, this place is a hidden gem without any pretentious attitudes. I'm eagerly looking forward to my next visit with Trevor.

input: Had the lengua burrito. It was non greesy and plated neatly. Simple food that was easy on the wallet. Think I will try the flan next time
Revise this with your best effort: I opted for the lengua burrito, which turned out to be a delightful choice. Notably, it was impeccably presented and devoid of any excessive grease, showcasing a skilled preparation. Moreover, its affordability was a pleasant surprise, making it a perfect go-to for those seeking value. Having enjoyed the satisfying simplicity of this dish, I'm already looking forward to my next visit, contemplating the indulgence of their tempting flan.

input: Poor lighting very dark can't even see your food all the food was average. Sorry I really wanted to like it more.
Revise this with your best effort: I was quite disappointed by the poor lighting at the establishment, as it was very dark and made it difficult to even see the food on my plate. Additionally, I found that all the dishes I had were of average quality. I apologize for not being able to enjoy the experience more, as I had sincerely hoped to.

input: Banana pudding is amazing. You can get the extra toppings but just plain no nana is great. They care about their customers and are always welcoming. I love supporting their shop and hope it's around for years.
Revise this with your best effort: Banana pudding is an absolutely delightful treat. While the addition of extra toppings can enhance its flavors, even in its pure form, it remains truly spectacular. Notably, the establishment exhibits exceptional customer care and creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. Personally, I take immense pleasure in patronizing this delightful establishment and fervently wish for its long-lasting presence in our community.

input:
I mistakenly left my organizer/wallet on my table when eating at Shepard's yesterday (6/24/12). I realized the mistake early this morning and called Shepard's. I was told that no one turned in anything resembling my organizer. 

I called back a few hours later to try and determine who bussed my table and what management was on duty and was told that my organizer had indeed been found and was in the "safe". I asked about the contents of the wallet and discovered that everything was present except for a $100 bill that I had just gotten the night before. I have witnesses to the $100 bill being in the organizer. 

I went today to retrieve the organizer and met with the assistant manager, who told me it was not their responsibility to keep track of guests belongings and would not investigate the issue whatsoever. She would not approach the server, would not ask who turned the organizer in, would not ask who stored it in the safe and essentially told me it was not her problem. 

This is customer service at it's worst... I have no recourse at this establishment to even try to get my money back. I am incensed that they won't even conduct an investigation for me.
Revise this with your best effort:
Yesterday, when dining at Shepard's, I inadvertently left my organizer/wallet on my table (6/24/12). Realizing my mistake this morning, I promptly reached out to Shepard's in the hopes of recovering it. Sadly, they informed me that no one had returned an item resembling my organizer.

However, determined to uncover the truth, I persevered and called Shepard's again a few hours later. Surprisingly, I was informed that my organizer had indeed been found and secured in their "safe". Curious about the wallet's contents, I inquired further and discovered that everything was intact, except for a recently acquired $100 bill. Multiple witnesses can attest to the presence of the bill in my organizer prior to the incident.

To address this matter, I personally visited Shepard's today, meeting with the assistant manager. Unfortunately, she refused to take responsibility for tracking guests' belongings and displayed no interest in investigating the issue. She declined to approach the server, inquire about the person who turned in the organizer, or find out who placed it in the safe. Essentially, she conveyed that it was not within her purview to address the problem.

This dire state of customer service leaves me with no feasible course of action to recover my money at this establishment. I am absolutely outraged that they refuse to undertake even a basic investigation on my behalf.

input: As usual, this restaurant doesn't seem to heed the bad reviews and fix the problems. Dinner here last night was abysmal. The prime rib was 40% fat with tons of gristle. My dog wouldn't even eat the left overs!  Who wants cold fries? I asked for regular butter (not cinnamon) and never got it. Hey, Jeanne, do you not even TRY to fix your problems?
Revise this with your best effort: Once again, it appears that this restaurant disregards negative feedback and fails to address its issues. Unfortunately, last night's dinner experience was truly dreadful. The prime rib I ordered was overwhelmingly fatty, consisting of approximately 40% fat and numerous gristle pieces. The leftovers were unappetizing even to my dog. Additionally, serving cold fries is highly undesirable. Despite specifically requesting regular butter instead of cinnamon, my request was completely disregarded. Jeanne, it begs the question, do you make any effort at all to rectify these recurring problems?

input:
I'm only giving them 4 stars because I haven't tried out enough of their menu. But in regards to previous reviews saying the pizza was soggy, they must have listened! The pizza I ordered today was a personal specialty pie. Vegan general tso's pizza. It was so good! No skimping on the "chicken" either. The crust was crisp and fluffy, not greasy at all but still packed with flavor. The chicken had that delicious general tso's sauce coated on each piece, as well as a slight kick at the end. 

I will definitely be ordering from there again. When I called to see if it was possible to veganize an online order, they instructed me to simply write vegan in the comments section. And they called me back to iron out a pricing discrepancy as well! The delivery came within the time they quoted and was hot. I'd definitely recommend giving them a try. They make the seitan themselves and wow, it is good.
Revise this with your best effort:
I am giving them a rating of 4 stars because I haven't had the opportunity to try a wide enough variety of their menu. However, I must say that my recent experience with their pizza was excellent. Addressing previous criticisms about soggy pizza, it seems they have taken note and made improvements. The personal specialty pie I ordered, the Vegan General Tso's Pizza, was truly delightful. They did not skimp on the "chicken" topping, and the crust had the perfect combination of crispness and fluffiness. It wasn't the least bit greasy, yet it was bursting with flavor. The chicken was generously coated in the delicious General Tso's sauce, with a slight spicy kick at the end.

Based on this experience, I definitely plan on ordering from them again. When I called to inquire about the possibility of veganizing an online order, their instructions were simple; just mention "vegan" in the comments section. Furthermore, they took the initiative to call me back to resolve a pricing discrepancy. The delivery arrived promptly within the quoted time and the food was still hot. I highly recommend giving them a try. Their homemade seitan is truly impressive.

input:
This restaurant is attached to the Drury Plaza hotel, so it was conveniently located for dinner when you're not really familiar with the area. There were 20+ in our party each night and the service was pretty good. Only a few forgotten drinks, which was to be expected with such a large group. 
Portions are huge and food was good. I had the Cuban sandwich one night and it was massive but delicious. The shandy is good. The margaritas are not and I don't recommend their patron one. I forget the name but it wasn't that good. Their shrimp tacos have a kick but they're good too.
Revise this with your best effort: This restaurant, conveniently attached to the Drury Plaza hotel, proves to be the perfect dinner spot for those unfamiliar with the area. Each night, our party, consisting of over 20 individuals, experienced satisfactory service, with only a few forgotten drinks, which can be expected when dealing with such a large group. Furthermore, the portions provided were incredibly generous, and the food itself was quite tasty. One night, I opted for the Cuban sandwich, which turned out to be both massive and delicious. As for beverages, the shandy proved to be enjoyable, while I cannot say the same for their margaritas, particularly their patron one, which I do not recommend. Additionally, I cannot recall the exact name, but their shrimp tacos possessed a satisfying kick and were overall quite enjoyable.

input:
You know how those 5 stars mean, "Woohoo!  As good as it gets!"?

Each one of those stars is well deserved by Tanti and the rest of the crew at Papertini.  They specialize in wedding flowers but these aren't just your clump of red roses.  These are creatively and artistically designed masterpieces speckled with striking elements like papers, wires, luxe fabrics, and more.  As an added bonus, they're just great, friendly people.  A true asset to your wedding team.

If you want traditional wedding flowers, Papertini can do it but I think it would kill their soul - go elsewhere.  If you want something more unique without being artsy-fartsy, I can't recommend them highly enough!
Revise this with your best effort: Have you ever seen those 5-star ratings that scream, "Wow, this is as good as it gets!"? Well, let me tell you, Tanti and the incredible team at Papertini absolutely deserve every single one of those stars. While their specialty lies in crafting breathtaking wedding flowers, don't expect your average bunch of red roses. Oh no, these floral arrangements are true works of art, meticulously designed with a fusion of creativity and artistic flair. Imagine vibrant blooms intertwined with delicate papers, elegant wires, luxurious fabrics, and other striking elements. And that's not all – aside from their unrivaled skills, the folks at Papertini are genuinely warm and friendly individuals. Trust me, having them as a part of your wedding team is a true blessing. Now, if you're seeking traditional wedding flowers, Papertini can certainly deliver, but I must admit it might stifle their true essence. For a more distinctive and brilliantly unique touch without venturing into the realm of the overly artsy-fartsy, I cannot stress enough how enthusiastically I endorse Papertini. They are the epitome of excellence in their craft.

input:
Looking for a delicious New Year's Day brunch was hard this year in New Orleans. We didn't want to wait in line and wanted instant gratification. Although we may have felt tired, my bf and I were appropriately dressed to go to Mr. B's. As soon as we walked in, I felt transported into a different world. Jazz music was playing and I felt at home. 

First of all, I could not have been more grateful for the fresh loaf of bread we were given. We devoured it in a matter of minutes. Then came the gumbo ya-ya. It was spicy and savory and everything I expected from a gumbo. Finally came the bbq shrimp. We had been warned that these shrimp did come with their heads and tails on. Bibs were placed around our necks and we were off. The shrimp were some of the most rich and delicious ones I have ever tasted. The sauce they were served with was divine. Although it was messy, there is no other dish on the menu I would have traded for this.

Overall, service was friendly and quick at Mr. B's. The food was delicious, although a little pricey. Definitely try the brunch if you are able to.
Revise this with your best effort:
Finding a delectable New Year's Day brunch proved to be a challenge in New Orleans this year. We were determined to avoid long waits and sought instant satisfaction. Despite feeling a bit fatigued, my boyfriend and I dressed appropriately for our visit to Mr. B's. The moment we stepped inside, I was transported to a different world, greeted with the soothing melodies of jazz music that instantly made me feel at home.

To begin, I must express my utmost gratitude for the fresh loaf of bread presented to us. Its irresistible aroma and taste compelled us to devour it within minutes. Soon after, the gumbo ya-ya arrived, fulfilling all my expectations of a gumbo with its enticing blend of spiciness and savory flavors. And then came the much-anticipated bbq shrimp, complete with their heads and tails intact, as forewarned. We donned bibs, ready for the feast. These shrimp surpassed all expectations, boasting a remarkable richness and delectability. The accompanying sauce was nothing short of divine. Though a messy affair, I wouldn't have traded a single dish on the menu for this sensational experience.

Service at Mr. B's was not only friendly but also prompt, leaving us thoroughly satisfied. Admittedly, the prices were a tad high, but the flavors and quality of the food rendered them worthwhile. If you have the opportunity, do make a point to indulge in their brunch; it is undoubtedly worth trying.

input:
Nice Steakhouse in St. Louis. We went here for a client dinner and was pleasantly surprised. You get a nice view of the arch on the way in to the restaurant as well. 

The Apps were OK. We ended up getting the Carmine's trio (crab cakes, scallops and toasted ravioli). Crab cakes were above average. The scallops were a little saccharine for my tastes but the ravioli was good; and let's face it...one doesn't come to St. Louis for the scallops. Thankfully the filet mignon was exceptional. It was the perfect size, not too salty and rare just like I had requested. 

This was partnered with an above average wine list to make a great night out.
Revise this with your best effort:
We had the pleasure of dining at a wonderful steakhouse in St. Louis for a client dinner and were pleasantly surprised by the experience. As we made our way to the restaurant, we couldn't help but enjoy the stunning view of the arch.

To start our meal, we decided to try the Carmine's trio, which included crab cakes, scallops, and toasted ravioli. While the appetizers were decent, the crab cakes stood out as above average. The scallops, though a bit sweeter than our personal preferences, were still enjoyable. However, it was the ravioli that truly impressed us. It is worth mentioning that visiting St. Louis for the scallops is not the main attraction, and the overall quality of the appetizers did not disappoint.

The highlight of our dining experience was undoubtedly the exceptional filet mignon. Prepared to perfection, it was the ideal portion size, with just the right balance of flavors and cooked exactly as I had requested - rare. The quality of the steak truly elevated our evening.

Completing our experience, the steakhouse showcased an impressive wine list. Above average in variety and quality, the wines complemented our meal, making it a truly enjoyable night out.

Overall, our visit to this St. Louis steakhouse surpassed our expectations, offering not only a delightful view of the arch but also memorable flavors and impeccable service. It is undoubtedly a great choice for a special evening.

input: Three from my office had lunch delivered from San Antonio Taco today.  It was our first time from there.  The food did not live up to the reviews.  Three of us ordered sides of refried beans and rice.  All 3 thought the beans were much too salty and the rice was clumpy.  I had beef enchiladas.  The beef was cut with the grain instead if against it so it was stringy and inedible.  I will generally give a restaurant a second try but not sure I will this time.
Revise this with your best effort: Three of my colleagues and I decided to try out San Antonio Taco for lunch today. Despite the rave reviews, our experience fell short of expectations. We all ordered sides of refried beans and rice, only to be disappointed by the excessive saltiness of the beans and the clumpiness of the rice. As for myself, I opted for the beef enchiladas, which unfortunately turned out to be a culinary disappointment. The beef was improperly cut with the grain, resulting in a stringy and practically inedible texture. While I am usually inclined to give restaurants a second chance, I am unsure if I will be doing so in this particular case.

input:
Cousin's is the place to go if you live in North Philly. I take this joint any day over Fresh Grocer. 

The only complaints I have is with the produce (which is expected considering it is COUSIN'S after all) and the hours (like many others have said, they have awful and inconvenient hours post-5pm).

That being said, I can get most essentials here and for much cheaper than anywhere else. 

This is only a two minute bike ride from my apartment so there's no reason not to shop here. Matter of fact, I'm headed there tomorrow.

When it's too cold or you're feeling to cheap to go to Trader Joe's, Cousin's is the place to head to.
Revise this with your best effort:
Cousin's is undoubtedly the go-to place if you reside in North Philly. Without a doubt, I would choose this establishment over Fresh Grocer any day.

However, I must confess that I do have a couple of qualms, primarily concerning the produce section. One must keep in mind that considering this is COUSIN'S after all, it is somewhat anticipated. Additionally, their operating hours have been a common grievance among many others; they are undeniably inconvenient, especially post-5pm.

Nevertheless, one cannot deny the fact that this store caters to most of our essential needs and at remarkably lower prices than any other option available. The fact that I can reach this place within a mere two-minute bike ride from my apartment is reason enough to make it my preferred shopping destination. In fact, I am planning on going there tomorrow.

Whether the frosty weather discourages you or you simply wish to save a few bucks instead of visiting Trader Joe's, Cousin's is undeniably the ideal place to visit.

input:
I've been here twice now and sampled a bunch of what they have to offer - I feel like what you order will really dictate how much you like this place.  i.e. they do some things great and other things just so-so.

The two things I will surely go back for more of is the Sausage and Pepper Pizza (capitalized - because I mean business) and some sort of puff pastry that has a white cream in the middle - I'm sure it has a name but it escapes me.  The pizza was perfectly flavored and the sausage/peppers had a nice kick to it.  Im sure it would make for great leftovers but unfortunately (fortunately?) for me it was gone well before it found the refrigerator.  The cream puff cream was just awesome - couldn't pin-point the flavor (vanilla?) but I would prefer it to top every dessert I get from this point forward.

I also got a bunch of the other sweets (salted brownie, blondie, red velvet crumb-cake) and a few bagels.  All were good, but not great.  Was pleasantly surprised by the wheat everything bagels - whole wheat bagels usually suck.

What I didn't really like was the pepperoni pizza.  It was pretty bland for my liking - in complete contrast to the sausage and pepper pizza - and the pepperoni was pretty sparse. I also didn't like being told 25 minutes, showing up in 25 minutes and then standing there for 25 minutes waiting for the pizza.  The small shop + no chairs = awkwardly standing there for almost a half hour.  

Since it's close to me and has so many tasty looking treats yet to try - I'll surely be back.  Hopefully I'll get more 'great' than 'so-so'.
Revise this with your best effort:
I have visited this place twice now and have tried a variety of their offerings. In my experience, your satisfaction will heavily depend on what you order. They excel at certain dishes while others are just average.

There are two items that I absolutely recommend revisiting for: the Sausage and Pepper Pizza (yes, it's worth capitalizing because it means business) and a delectable puff pastry filled with a white cream. I can't recall its name, but the taste certainly lingers. The pizza had a perfect blend of flavors and the sausage and peppers added a delightful kick. It would have made fantastic leftovers, but unfortunately (or fortunately?), it disappeared before I could think of refrigerating it. The cream filling in the puff pastry was simply divine. Though I couldn't pinpoint the exact flavor (vanilla, perhaps?), I wish it could top every dessert I indulge in from now on.

I also tried a selection of their other sweets, including the salted brownie, blondie, and red velvet crumb cake, as well as a few bagels. While they were all good, they didn't quite reach the level of greatness. However, I was pleasantly surprised by the wheat everything bagels. Normally, whole wheat bagels are not up to par, but these ones stood out.

On the other hand, the pepperoni pizza didn't quite meet my expectations. It lacked flavor compared to the sausage and pepper pizza, and the pepperoni was disappointingly sparse. Additionally, I was disappointed when I was told the wait time would be 25 minutes, arrived exactly on time, and then had to awkwardly stand there for another 25 minutes in the small shop without any seating.

Despite these minor setbacks, due to its proximity to me and the multitude of tempting treats yet to be sampled, I will definitely be giving this place another chance. Hopefully, my next visit will bring more delightful experiences rather than just average ones.

input:
It is an actual speakeasy! Very cool and chill place. The ambience is classy but the vibe of the place is casual. Highly recommend if you just want to have good cocktails/drinks with good music. 
Warning: They literally serve one dish of appetizer (which is not that tasty). Don't go empty stomach and with expectation of good food (or any food). As I mentioned, it is true to its speakeasy status.
Revise this with your best effort: This is an authentic speakeasy; a truly amazing and relaxed spot. The atmosphere exudes elegance, yet the overall vibe remains casual. I highly recommend visiting if you're seeking excellent cocktails, great drinks, and enjoyable music. However, I should note that they solely offer one appetizer dish, which may not be particularly flavorful. It's best not to arrive on an empty stomach or with high expectations for the food. As I previously mentioned, this establishment perfectly embodies the essence of a true speakeasy.

input: Spent way too much money to get actually spoiled food delivered to us. Ordered a huge order, over 50% of it was incorrect. Will never return to this location.
Revise this with your best effort: We had an unfortunate experience where we ended up spending a significant amount of money on a delivery that turned out to be spoiled food. Despite placing a large order, we received more than 50% of the items incorrectly. Regrettably, we have decided not to revisit this particular location in the future.

input: This is actually a 3 1/2 star review for me. Only because everything that I wanted they did not have or weren't willing to do. Firstly, I came here specifically for the chicken slider because from the picture it showed that you can get it on a biscuit and when I told the lady taking my order, she said they don't do that -__-. Then I wanted that buttermilk bites and they weren't available, however, my brother ordered the brown buttered cream sundae and got the buttermilk bites in that!! Oh yes, and the glazed donuts are so thick and dry. I liked the sliders I had though: fried chicken, beef belly and catfish(okay). And the sundae is pretty tasty. Good for a first try but not to continue coming.
Revise this with your best effort:
This is a slightly disappointing 3 1/2 star review for me. The main reason being that the restaurant didn't have the items I was looking for or were unwilling to accommodate my requests. Initially, I was excited to try their chicken slider on a biscuit, as shown in the picture. Unfortunately, when I informed the lady taking my order, she informed me that they didn't offer that option. Disappointing, to say the least. 

Furthermore, I had my heart set on trying the buttermilk bites, but alas, they were not available. However, to my frustration, my brother ordered the brown buttered cream sundae and lo and behold, it came with buttermilk bites! The inconsistency was frustrating to witness. 

To add to my disappointment, the glazed donuts were incredibly thick and dry. It was quite a letdown. On a positive note, the sliders I did have - fried chicken, beef belly, and catfish - were enjoyable. They were decent, except for the catfish being just okay. The sundae, on the other hand, was quite tasty. 

Overall, this was a decent first try, but it's not a place I'll be inclined to revisit due to the lack of availability or willingness to accommodate my requests.

input: A short walk from my apartment I was told about a small, welcoming cafe very popular for breakfast and brunch. It did not disappoint! I had a salmon scramble with egg whites the first time i went. The second time i went i got the tofu with brown rice breakfast plate. Both meals were great!! And i was seated quickly
Revise this with your best effort: Just a brief stroll away from my apartment, I came across a charming little café that came highly recommended for its delightful breakfast and brunch options. And let me tell you, it absolutely lived up to the hype! On my initial visit, I opted for a scrumptious salmon scramble made with egg whites. The flavors were just marvelous. Upon my subsequent visit, I decided to indulge in the tofu dish served with a side of brown rice. It was an absolute delight for my taste buds. Additionally, the service at the café was remarkably efficient as I was promptly seated without any delay.

input: Went for Dinner at 6pm on a Friday and expect it to be packed, luckily for us, it wasn't. The staff is very friendly and the atmosphere is straight out of Magnolia Journal. The food was pretty dang good and drinks are too. The only reason I left off a star was the fact it took a little while to get our cocktails and our appetizer came at the same time as our food. But, they're new and I've been in hospitality before, so I get it!
Revise this with your best effort: Last Friday, we decided to have dinner at 6pm and anticipated a packed restaurant. To our pleasant surprise, it wasn't crowded. The staff was incredibly friendly, creating an atmosphere reminiscent of the pages of Magnolia Journal. The food was delicious, and the drinks were equally impressive. The only reason I deducted a star is because it took some time for our cocktails to arrive, and our appetizer coincided with our main course. However, considering that they are new and having worked in hospitality myself, I understand the challenges they may face.

input: This is a great quiet place to eat very 1960's business style.  You can have the food of Tony's or eat off the bar menu.  I had the Risotto which was excellent.  Other people at the table had the special, linguine with shrimp and lobster, and strip steak.  Everyone loved their meals.  Of course the service here is fantastic.  They are not overbearing but attentive as well.
Revise this with your best effort: This charming eatery exudes a serene ambiance, reminiscent of a classic 1960s business setting. The options here are aplenty, whether you desire the delectable cuisine crafted by the esteemed chef, Tony, or prefer to indulge in the delightful offerings from the bar menu. During my visit, I savored the remarkable Risotto, exquisitely prepared and bursting with flavors. Meanwhile, my companions at the table relished the tantalizing linguine with shrimp and lobster, as well as the succulent strip steak. Every dish received unanimous appreciation. Naturally, the service at this establishment is truly exceptional. The staff strikes the perfect balance, providing attentive and unobtrusive service that adds to the overall experience.

input: My go to place for sushi rolls! Their rolls are huge and the service is excellent. My favorite is heat attack appetizer( korean style jalapeno poppers) sapporo roll and honey roll. They also have a section of deepfried rolls on the menu! Their food always look so  fresh and appetizing. Great presentation. Try the spicy sashimi bowl if you wanna try something new!
Revise this with your best effort: When it comes to satisfying my sushi cravings, there's no better place than this gem! Not only are their sushi rolls impressively huge, but the service they provide is simply top-notch. Among their vast array of delicious options, my all-time favorites include the mouthwatering Heat Attack appetizer, which offers a delightful twist on Korean-style jalapeno poppers, as well as the delectable Sapporo Roll and Honey Roll. For those looking to indulge in some deep-fried goodness, their menu even features a dedicated section for such treats! Every dish they serve exudes a vibrant freshness and an irresistible aesthetic appeal. And if you're feeling adventurous, I highly recommend giving their Spicy Sashimi Bowl a try – it promises a unique and exciting taste experience.

input:
Ok. I am not the type to complain, but I have been here twice and both times I have had terrible service at the bar. The first bartender served me but acted as if I was bothering him.  This second time, with a completely different bartender mind you, it was worse. I am not dressed like a street person or anything, and I am not pan-handling. But you would think that I was the way he acted. First, I sit at the bar and I am waiting for service. So, the bartender walks by me, pours a glass a water, turns in front of me, puts the water down, gives me some stupid half-grin then walks off. Not one audible word of greeting or a grunt passed between his lips. Then, he gets a menu, drops that down and walks off again! Not a sound. Is it me, but when a customer enters an eating establishment, shouldn't they be greeted in some manner?  Not looked at like "why are you here. I have better things to do"?  I am not looking for a royal salute or anything. Just "Hey man, what can I get ya?"  or something to that affect.   Anyway, I start to look at the drink and food menus. Then, a group of anywhere from 10-15 people come in behind me and say, to what looked like a manager, "We don't want to eat, is it ok if we just have a few drinks at the bar?". The manager says "Sure." The guy then says, "Can we get few beers down here"? (paraphrasing). The bartender says "Sure!" and proceed to service this group, one-by-one, as they order drinks. Ok, fine technically, I was looking at the menu when this started. But still, he walked back and forth, right in front of me, for about 10-12 minutes. Not once did he say, "Hey, just shout and I will get you something", or "Hey man, just give me a few minutes and I will be right with you". Nothing!  It was obvious it was a big group, but I mean, he gave no acknowledgement to the fact that I was sitting there waiting! 

Long story short - after this 10-12 minutes of waiting, I just walked out and went somewhere else. Now this place has about 4\5 stars with around 500 reviews. So, I guess people like it. But their bartenders are as unfriendly as I have ever encountered.  Maybe if you get a table it's different.
Revise this with your best effort:
I apologize for any inconvenience, but I have had two unfortunate experiences at this bar and feel compelled to share my dissatisfaction. On both occasions, the service at the bar was exceptionally poor. The first bartender who served me seemed bothered by my presence, despite me being a paying customer. It was disheartening. During my second visit, with a different bartender, the level of service only worsened. I want to clarify that my attire was appropriate and I was not engaging in any disruptive behavior. However, the bartender acted as if I was inconveniencing him. 

Upon arriving at the bar, I waited patiently for service. As the bartender walked past me, he poured a glass of water, placed it in front of me, and mustered a half-hearted smile before walking away without uttering a single word of greeting or acknowledgment. Moments later, he dropped a menu on the counter and disappeared once again, displaying no regard for my presence. Naturally, I believe that when a customer enters an establishment, they should be greeted in a polite and welcoming manner. It shouldn't be met with a dismissive attitude or an unspoken question of why they are even there. I don't expect an extravagant reception; a simple "Hi, what can I get you?" would have sufficed.

While I attempted to peruse the drink and food menus, a group of approximately 10-15 people entered the establishment behind me. They approached what appeared to be the manager and asked if they could simply have a few drinks at the bar, without dining. The manager agreed, and one of the group members inquired about getting some beers. The bartender eagerly replied with a "Sure!" and promptly began serving them, attending to each person's drink order individually. Although I understand that it was a large group, the bartender completely disregarded my presence. For about 10-12 minutes, he continuously walked back and forth in front of me, without so much as a gesture or comment indicating that he would be with me shortly.

Feeling neglected and disrespected, I ultimately made the decision to leave and find another establishment to spend my time and money. I am aware that this particular bar has received positive reviews, averaging around 4.5 stars from approximately 500 previous customers. However, I would have to express my disappointment in the unfriendly demeanor of their bartenders. Perhaps the experience would have been different if I had opted for a table instead.

input:
Love it here

The atmosphere is great the options are more than average and the lunch bento boxes are great.  If you have the opportunity always try the boba as well.

Those complaining are just picky and should go back to eating at home.  

Try their beef braised soup as it is hearty and delicious.
Revise this with your best effort:
I absolutely adore this place! The atmosphere is fantastic and the variety of options surpasses your average eatery. Moreover, their lunch bento boxes are top-notch and never disappoint. I highly recommend treating yourself to their delectable boba drinks whenever you visit.

To be frank, those who complain about this place are simply being overly particular and should probably stick to dining in the comforts of their own home. Trust me, they're missing out.

If you're a fan of heartwarming and scrumptious dishes, don't miss out on trying their beef braised soup. It's a true culinary masterpiece that will leave you craving for more.

input: Beautiful decor, great atmosphere, amazing food! My husband and I were thinking how it's NY prices but better quality than most we have had at this price point. He had udon noodles and I had a few rolls (Spicy Salmon is a must!) Flavors were great- not too strong but tasteful! :) We enjoyed our experience!
Revise this with your best effort: The restaurant had a stunning decor, creating a delightful atmosphere that enhanced our dining experience. The food surpassed our expectations, considering its price point in New York. My husband tried the udon noodles, while I indulged in a variety of rolls (especially recommending the Spicy Salmon). The flavors were exceptional, striking the perfect balance between not overpowering and yet pleasantly tasteful. Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed our time and left satisfied with our experience.

input: Hotel is lovely. The front desk staff is extremely friendly and helpful. We were lucky enough to get a room away from the club so we had no problem sleeping. If you are looking for quiet stay somewhere else if you looking for fun this is perfect!
Revise this with your best effort: The hotel is absolutely delightful. The front desk staff goes above and beyond in terms of friendliness and assistance. Furthermore, we were fortunate to be assigned a room that was distanced from the club, ensuring uninterrupted and peaceful sleep. However, if you are seeking a tranquil experience, it would be advisable to consider alternative accommodations. This hotel is simply ideal for those in pursuit of an exciting and vibrant atmosphere!

input: I loved loved loved the pizza here. I returned and got their gnocchi and it was amazing as well. Really fresh ingredients nice variety on the menu. Really felt like a small family restaurant in Europe. Best pizza in middle Tennessee.
Revise this with your best effort: I absolutely adored the pizza at this place, it was truly exceptional. Intrigued, I decided to give their gnocchi a try and it surpassed all expectations, simply amazing. The ingredients used were incredibly fresh, and the menu offered a delightful range of options. The ambiance of the restaurant reminded me of a cozy, family-run establishment in Europe. Hands down, this is the best pizza you can find in middle Tennessee.

input: For a $16 haircut, I was expecting an OK-looking trim (all I really needed was some damage control - just someone to lop off my split ends and maybe add a few layers).  What I got was a very professionally looking haircut that works well with my face shape and made my hair a lot healthier and happier.  My expectations were far exceeded - and it definitely surpassed my last 'professional' hair salon experience.  Plus, the shampoo smelled amazing and the girl was really thorough.  I wish I had brought more cash to tip her!!!  The only thing you should keep in mind before going is time.  I had to wait an extra half an hour and it was the longest haircut I've ever had.  I would much rather have the student take the time to make sure it looks good, however, than have someone do a half-ass job.  I think it's important that the school has a series of steps and checklists their students have to go through to ensure they are giving you the best experience possible.  Just make sure you have a decent block of time in your schedule to relax in the chair!
Revise this with your best effort: I was initially expecting an average trim for the affordable price of $16, merely seeking to fix the damage caused by my split ends and perhaps add some layers. However, I was pleasantly surprised to receive a highly professional-looking haircut that beautifully complements my face shape, rendering my hair considerably healthier and happier. To say that my expectations were surpassed would be an understatement, as it far outperformed my previous so-called 'professional' salon experience. Moreover, the shampoo utilized exuded an amazing fragrance, and the stylist displayed remarkable thoroughness. I regret not having enough cash to adequately tip her! Nonetheless, it is important to note that time should be considered prior to visiting. The wait extended an additional half hour, making this the longest haircut session I have ever experienced. Nevertheless, I would much rather have a meticulous student take their time to ensure a satisfactory outcome, rather than receiving a subpar job. It is reassuring to know that the school implements a series of steps and checklists to guarantee the best possible experience for their students and customers alike. Simply allocate a decent amount of time in your schedule to fully indulge in the chair's relaxing ambiance!

input: My daughter was married at the Presidio Chapel in May, 2015. The wedding was magical and we were all treated really well by Rain Longo(she coordinates special events in the Chapel). She was very patient, supportive and enthusiastic. The chapel itself made for an outstanding and very authentic venue. My daughter and bridesmaids were able to get ready in a beautiful adjoining room. The rental of the Chapel included use for 6 hours and it was very affordable. Thanks to all for making this special day so perfect. Thanks!!!!
Revise this with your best effort:
In May 2015, my daughter had the privilege of getting married at the Presidio Chapel, and it was an enchanting experience. We cannot express enough gratitude towards Rain Longo, who meticulously coordinated the special event at the Chapel. Her unwavering patience, support, and enthusiasm were invaluable throughout the process.

Speaking of the Chapel, it truly exceeded our expectations as a remarkable and authentic venue. Its inherent charm and beauty created an awe-inspiring ambiance for the ceremony. Additionally, the availability of a stunning adjoining room allowed my daughter and her bridesmaids to prepare in elegance and comfort.

On top of all its wonderful attributes, the rental of the Chapel was surprisingly affordable, especially considering the six-hour duration provided. We are incredibly thankful to everyone involved in making this significant day absolutely perfect.

Once again, our deepest appreciation goes out to everyone who played a part in creating such a memorable and magical wedding. Thank you!

input:
I'm not a regular waxer, but went in for a pre-vacation treat. The wax specialist Miriam was prompt and knew what she was doing. She spent much of our hour together telling me why my regular shaving is bad and waxing is good, and seriously marketing the EWC products to me. 
Brows and lower legs were done well. Underarms were left with a decent number of stray hairs which she told me I could tweeze out later. Little bits of wax were left on my skin here and there. Overall I felt like I did not walk out of there ready to hit the beach.
Revise this with your best effort:
Although I am not a regular waxer, I decided to treat myself with a wax session before my vacation. Miriam, the wax specialist, was punctual and skillful in her work. Throughout our appointment, she provided insightful information on the downsides of regular shaving and the benefits of waxing, while also promoting various products from EWC. 

The treatment on my eyebrows and lower legs was executed well, leaving me satisfied. However, there were a noticeable number of stray hairs left on my underarms, which Miriam suggested I could take care of by tweezing later. Additionally, there were small remnants of wax left on my skin in some areas. As a result, I didn't feel completely beach-ready when I left the salon.

input:
The food was very good. The reason for the three stars is the noise level. I was with three other people in a corner table and we had to shout to hear each other. If the restaurant could work on the noise level, it would absolutely get more stars. The pad see ew got great reviews from the person who ordered it. I got The King and I (veg/chicken/shrimp stir fry) and it was excellent. Nice heat and curry flavor. The pad thai was a bit sweet I thought, but the person who ordered it really liked it.

Portion sizes are not enormous. We had some leftovers but also didn't come in starving.

Good service, very attentive. The noise level was the only negative.
Revise this with your best effort:
The food at this restaurant was truly exceptional, deserving high praise. However, my rating of three stars is solely due to the excessive noise level. Despite being seated at a corner table with three other individuals, we found ourselves needing to shout in order to hear one another. I believe that if the restaurant could address this noise issue, it would undoubtedly receive a higher rating.

I must mention that the pad see ew received rave reviews from the person who ordered it. As for myself, I opted for The King and I, a delightful stir fry consisting of vegetables, chicken, and shrimp. It was truly exceptional, boasting a perfect blend of heat and curry flavor. Conversely, I found the pad thai to be a touch too sweet for my liking, although the person who ordered it thoroughly enjoyed it.

While the portion sizes may not be overwhelmingly large, they were ample enough to leave us with some leftovers, ensuring we didn't leave the restaurant feeling famished.

On a positive note, the service provided was commendable, with the staff displaying great attentiveness. The only detraction from an otherwise pleasant experience was the persistently high noise level.

input:
***Please note that if you lose something valuable you may not get it back. The person who may clean the vehicle may be a thief. I left in the car my radar detector complete with a case not logged in to their lost and found. When I check in my rental on 12/21 and returned 01/02/2018 to visit the counter they told me nothing was found. They also told me that for something with a case go missing was very unlikely. Yet they found nothing. Hmmm, I wonder how it can go missing when it was the only place I left it? I filed a lost ticket with them; Reference Number: 4355421, Reported: 12/21/2017.

They may think their employees may be honest but my $300 radar detector is nowhere to be found at their location. So? Yes, one of their employee's stole it. 

I'm a fan of the concept of picking your car. As someone who has been using the same rental place in St. Louis Airport for 8 months and counting. I can tell you they do lousy job at cleaning the cars. I'm always finding plastic bottles underneath the back seats.

I'm also finding a lot un-wiped of front seat and dashboard areas full of sticky substances. The cars are never fully clean as someone who rents from them weekly.

This location does a shitty job of making cars ready for travel. As someone who has access to the execute cars due to the amount of travel I do. They fail to meet some simple travel requirements you expect when you rent. 

Next time you rent look underneath the seats in the passenger areas and you may find plastic bottle under them.

I would love for them to review the cameras and see who cleaned the car so they can fire them on the day I returned the rental! I brought them thousand of dollars and I do expect a refund for the stolen item.
Revise this with your best effort:
Please be aware that there is a possibility of not recovering a lost valuable item. It is important to note that the individual responsible for cleaning the vehicle could potentially be a thief. Unfortunately, I accidentally left my radar detector, along with its case, in the car without registering it in the lost and found section. Upon returning the rental on 12/21 and revisiting the counter on 01/02/2018, I was informed that nothing had been found. Despite being told that the chances of losing an item with a case were unlikely, they were unable to locate it. I promptly filed a lost ticket with the reference number 4355421, reporting the incident on 12/21/2017.

Although the rental agency may believe in the integrity of their employees, it appears that my $300 radar detector has mysteriously disappeared from their premises. Therefore, it seems probable that one of their employees may have taken it.

As a frequent customer of this particular rental place at St. Louis Airport for the past eight months, I can attest to their poor car cleaning practices. I consistently discover items, such as plastic bottles, beneath the rear seats. Additionally, I often encounter front seats and dashboard areas that have not been adequately wiped, leaving sticky substances behind. These cars never seem to be thoroughly cleaned, despite my frequent rentals.

This rental location fails to meet basic travel requirements that one would expect when renting a car. Being someone who frequently rents and has access to executive cars due to my extensive travels, I have noticed a consistent lack of attention to detail in preparing the vehicles for travel.

In the future, I recommend checking underneath the seats in passenger areas to ensure that no items have been left behind, such as plastic bottles.

I am eager for the rental agency to review their security camera footage to identify the individual responsible for cleaning the car on the day of my return. This would ensure appropriate actions are taken, including their immediate termination. Considering the substantial amount of money I have contributed to this rental agency, I anticipate a refund for the stolen item.

input: This place is so great. I love the laid back atmosphere. Walked right in with our dog and were seating on the cozy wrap around porch outside. We ate here the last morning of our trip and it was the perfect ending. I stayed full long enough to get me through and 8 hour car ride home! I had the bananas foster French toast which was amazing but super rich. I couldn't eat it all because of the portion size and richness. My fiancé opted for the healthier choice of a vegetable omelet which was delicious as well. I can't wait to come back here and try something else on the menu. I will definitely try one of their famous juices next time.
Revise this with your best effort:
I absolutely adore this place! The laid-back atmosphere here is simply amazing. Upon entering, we were warmly welcomed with our furry companion and were promptly seated on the cozy wrap-around porch outside. As we dined here on the final morning of our trip, we couldn't have asked for a more perfect ending. The food was so satisfying that it kept me satiated throughout the entire eight-hour car ride back home.

For my breakfast, I indulged in the bananas foster French toast, and let me tell you, it was nothing short of exceptional. The flavors were out of this world, but it was undeniably decadent and rich, which left me unable to finish it due to its generous portion size. On the other hand, my fiancé made a healthier choice and ordered the delightful vegetable omelet, which turned out to be absolutely scrumptious.

I am already eagerly counting down the days until I can return to this remarkable establishment and tantalize my taste buds with something new from their enticing menu. Next time, I am particularly keen on giving one of their renowned juices a try.

input: The food here is delicious and the portions are amazing for the price.  The girl who works behind the counter is an absolute sweetheart.  Always smiling and happy.   I wish I worked closer so I could come more often.
Revise this with your best effort: The food at this place is incredibly scrumptious, and the portions offered are truly fantastic for the price. Additionally, the girl managing the counter is an absolute gem - constantly adorned with a beaming smile and exuding pure happiness. It truly brightens my day! If only my workplace were in closer proximity, I would definitely frequent this establishment more often.

input: Nice scenery of nature. Great trail for running, walking, hiking and biking. Plenty of places to sit for a short break along the way.
Revise this with your best effort: Experience the awe-inspiring beauty of nature's breathtaking scenery. Embark on a splendid trail that caters to all your outdoor pursuits—from invigorating runs to leisurely walks, exhilarating hikes, and thrilling bike rides. Discover an abundance of serene spots perfect for a rejuvenating pause while immersing yourself in the surroundings.

input: Really truly slow service.  Not the waitress. The kitchen. 40 min to get a pasta and salad.  Recommended if you want to really drag that date out.
Revise this with your best effort: The service was incredibly slow, I mean exceptionally so! And it wasn't just the waitress who was at fault, it was primarily the kitchen. Can you believe it took a whopping 40 minutes just to receive a plate of pasta and salad? If you're interested in extending your date to the maximum, then I highly recommend this place.

input: This place is wonderful! Obviously the chips, salsa and beans are yummy, but get the guacamole too! The chimichanga bites are fantastic, whatever the sauce is that comes with them is super good! For dinner, the street tacos are amazing, so are the enchiladas. They don't have a full bar, but you can still get a real margarita, and they pack a punch! They make them at their other location and bring them over, which is clever, because this location doesn't yet have its liquor license. Overall 4 out 5 stars because it's a good Mexican restaurant, but 5 stars is reserved for my most favorites only. Close second though, and we love that it's right downtown. Oh, and the service... very good! We usually always have the same server, and she is very nice and attentive.
Revise this with your best effort: This place is absolutely delightful! Of course, the chips, salsa, and beans are incredibly delicious, but don't forget to try the guacamole too! The chimichanga bites are out of this world, and the accompanying sauce is incredibly tasty. Now, when it comes to dinner, you cannot go wrong with their phenomenal street tacos and mouthwatering enchiladas. Despite not having a full bar, their margaritas are the real deal and pack quite a punch! They craft them at their other location and bring them over, which is a clever workaround since this particular spot is currently waiting on its liquor license. I would rate this restaurant a solid 4 out of 5 stars because it truly is an excellent Mexican dining experience. However, I reserve 5 stars for only my absolute favorites. Nonetheless, this restaurant comes in at a close second, and we adore its convenient downtown location. Oh, and let me not forget to mention the outstanding service! We are always fortunate enough to have the same server, who is incredibly pleasant and attentive.

input: Holy _____! Good rolls. Great service. Good prices. Lots of healthy options. Try the sushi. It worth every penny!
Revise this with your best effort: Holy moly! Exceptional rolls. Impeccable service. Reasonable prices. Abundance of nutritious options. Don't miss out on the sushi; it is worth every single penny!

input: We had an excellent lunch here. The food was great and the service was fantastic. Great Gumbo Ya Ya, great BBQ shrimp, delicious crab cakes. Everything we tried was good. I highly recommend this place.
Revise this with your best effort: We had an outstanding dining experience at this establishment. The food surpassed our expectations, and the service provided was exceptional. The Gumbo Ya Ya and BBQ shrimp were particularly remarkable, and the crab cakes were a delectable delight. Every dish we sampled proved to be of high quality. Without hesitation, I highly recommend this establishment.

input:
Wow! What a workout you get in 20 minutes. 
I didnt believe it until I tried it. Now I'm hooked and feeling better than I have in a long time!!!
Ask for Chelsey. She is great to work with!!!
Revise this with your best effort: I am absolutely amazed by the incredible workout you can achieve within just 20 minutes! input:

We came back AGAIN a few weeks ago when a friend was visiting from LA. I had the Seared Ahi Tuna. The husband had the Halibut. Our friend had the Roast Beef Dinner. Our friend won when it came to food selection. My belly was so warm and happy after one bite of his roast beef. The meat was succulent, juicy, the perfect medium rare. The mashed taters were creamy with a slight hint of garlic. Mmmm.

I preferred my husband's halibut over my tuna. The tuna was good, but the halibut had more flavor, IMO.

Can't wait to go back again. Yum yum yum.

I have absolutely fallen head over heels for Jones. Seriously...

I have to say, the calamari at Jones is the best I've had in quite some time. It had the perfect crispiness, wasn't at all rubbery, and was bursting with flavor. It was pure yum.

And let's not forget about dessert. I opted for the Duncan Hines slice of yellow cake and a glass of milk, and boy was it a stroke of genius. It was absolutely amazing.

Just when I thought I couldn't possibly love Jones any more, we made another trip a few weeks ago when a friend came to visit us from LA. We each made different choices this time. Creamy, with just a subtle hint of garlic. Mmmm.

input:
I purchased a used 09 Rav4 from Glanzmann Subaru last month. Coming from TN, I chose to purchase this vehicle from Glanzmann due to its limited availability and attractive price. I communicated with sales on numerous occasions before committing to purchase from Glanzmann nearly 1000 miles from home.

The process was overall quite simple, though I felt we could have gotten alot more done regarding interstate complications prior to completing travel plans to purchase the vehicle. My only actual complaint stems from the vehicle's description. As an out of state buyer, I was at the mercy of the sales team to accurately describe and depict any conditional issues that might be of interest to a prospective buyer. Unfortunately, none of the issues with this vehicle were highlighted, depicted, described, or otherwise demonstrated throughout the entire sales process. I even asked the sales agent to, while on the phone, inspect the vehicle and describe any possible imperfection so that I could have no surprises upon arrival. I spent several hundred dollars in travel expenses to collect this vehicle, only to discover there were a number of aesthetic defects that deserved attention (large dents, cracked paint, cuts in leather). I had limited time and opportunity to react to these conditional flaws and purchased the vehicle - I had already flown from Nashville to Philadelphia! 

This is obviously a small family-owned dealership. I expected a considerably more honest and direct interaction and was disappointed with the outcome. The automobile is a fine machine, but the defects certainly take away from the value. Mr. Jeff Glanzmann, I implore you to make honesty your #1 policy.  I had the opportunity to purchase the same vehicle, with honestly similar defects, from a dealership in Atlanta for the same price. I opted to purchase yours, incurring not-insignificant travel expenses, because of it's immaculate description.
